sum: This comment critically reviews the 67 new low-frequency teleseismic marsquakes detected by Huang et al. (2025) using a deep learning phase picker trained on terrestrial local earthquake data (STEAD) and applied to narrow-bandpass filtered (0.1–0.8 Hz) InSight seismic data. By examining broadband spectrograms, auxiliary wind speed and pressure recordings, 4.1 Hz wind-sensitive lander modes, 2.4 Hz subsurface resonance excitation, and 3-D polarization attributes, Dahmen et al. demonstrate that all 67 detections are false positives corresponding to atmospheric noise. Specifically, the picked P and S arrivals coincide with consecutive small and larger afternoon wind gusts. Furthermore, if genuine, these high-amplitude events would cluster at ~20° epicentral distance where no active tectonic structures exist and yield magnitudes (Mb,s 3.3–5.4) exceeding nearly all cataloged marsquakes. This work highlights the necessity of domain-specific noise validation when applying deep learning tools to planetary seismic datasets.

sum: Monitoring short-term deformation at submarine mid-ocean ridges (MORs) is notoriously difficult. This study presents the first integrated in situ seismogeodetic observation of a seafloor spreading event, captured in April 2024 at the Southeast Indian Ridge (37° S) using hydrophones, acoustic ranging transponders, a bottom-pressure recorder, and repeated multibeam bathymetry. The event initiated as a fast-migrating (~2–3 m/s) extensional earthquake swarm driven by dyke propagation, causing 4.2 m of axial floor subsidence and >1.3 m of horizontal extension. Dislocation modeling indicates deflation of a sill-like magma reservoir feeding a shallow dyke, accompanied by up to 4.1 m of mostly aseismic slip on valley-bounding normal faults. Subsequent bathymetry revealed 160 million m³ of erupted lava over 16 days. The magmatic intrusion also triggered seismic swarms on adjacent transform faults. These findings demonstrate that magma-induced aseismic slip dominates MOR normal fault displacement, resolving their known seismic deficit.
本研究利用水听器阵列、海底声学测距信标、自校准海底压力计及重复多波束测深，首次原位捕捉到2024年4月东南印度洋中脊（37°S）的海底扩张事件。事件始于快速迁移（2–3 m/s）的张性地震群，导致轴部谷底沉降4.2米、水平拉张超1.3米。弹性位错反演表明，板状岩浆房泄压并向浅部岩脉供浆，在约16天内……

t: Combined hydroacoustic earthquake relocation, seafloor direct-path acoustic ranging, bottom-pressure vertical tracking, differential multibeam bathymetry, and 2D Monte Carlo elastic dislocation modeling of sill, dyke, and fault sources.

One year of recordings from 5 autonomous hydrophones, 15 seafloor acoustic ranging transponders, 1 drift-controlled bottom-pressure recorder, and repeated shipborne swath bathymetry across the Southeast Indian Ridge at 37° S.

Mapped a massive submarine volcanic eruption totaling ~160 million m³ of lava emplaced over ~16 days.
Demonstrated that magmatic intrusion induces up to 4.1 m of largely aseismic slip on bounding normal faults, explaining the mid-ocean ridge seismic moment deficit.

sum: This paper proposes a curvilinear grid finite-difference method (CGFDM) tailored for 2D global seismic-wave modeling to overcome the grid flexibility limitations of traditional finite-difference methods. The method integrates dispersion-relation-preserving optimized MacCormack operators, the traction-image method for free surfaces, the split-node technique for solid-fluid coupling, and multiblock structured grids to eliminate polar singularities and allow nonuniform meshing. Verified against spectral-element method (SEM) benchmarks, CGFDM achieves high accuracy and computational efficiency, offering a robust alternative for large-scale global seismic wavefield simulations.

sum: Understanding how ancient mantle plume residues modify peripheral lithospheric structure and influence modern tectonics remains challenging where surface basalts are absent. This study presents a 3D magnetotelluric resistivity model from 103 stations across the Huayingshan Fault in the outer zone of the Permian Emeishan large igneous province, combined with 2D Underworld2 thermo-mechanical geodynamic simulations. The resistivity model reveals a vertically extensive high-resistivity body (>10,000 Ω·m) beneath the fault, coinciding with high seismic velocities and density, flanked by mid-crustal conductive layers (1–30 Ω·m) interpreted as ~6 vol.% saline fluids. Geodynamic simulations demonstrate that pre-existing lithospheric weak zones channelize plume material laterally, forming a dense, crystallized mafic-ultramafic residue. This plume-reinforced lithospheric block acts as a long-lived, low-permeability mechanical buttress that impedes eastward fluid migration, elevates pore pressure, and localizes stress and seismicity on its northwestern flank.

Regional geophysical, geochemical, and geodetic datasets including seismic velocities (Vp, Vs), Bouguer gravity, surface heat flow, GPS velocities, borehole basalt logs, and earthquake catalogs.
2D numerical simulation domain (1200 km × 400 km, 300 × 100 elements) testing plume ascent (300 K excess temperature, 100 km radius) beneath heterogeneous lithosphere.
2022年和2025年在华蓥山断裂周边103个测站采集的宽频带大地电磁数据（观测时长>72小时，站间距约7–20 km）。
区域多地球物理、地球化学与大地测量数据集，包括地震波速（Vp、Vs）、布格重力、地表热流、GPS速度场、钻井玄武岩柱状图及地震目录。
1200 km × 400 km（300 × 100网格）二维数值模拟实验，测试非均质岩石圈下方热地幔柱（300 K温差，半径100 km）的上升演化。
li: Lacks direct petrological, xenolith, or in situ geochemical constraints from anomaly R, leaving lower-crustal eclogitization or unrelated mafic underplating as alternative explanations.
2D geodynamic simulations do not explicitly model small-scale melt extraction, percolation, dyke propagation, or 3D crustal emplacement.
Permeability values, pore-pressure evolution, and 3D hydromechanical fluid-flow pathways around the resistive barrier are inferred rather than directly simulated.
缺乏来自高阻体R的直接岩石学、捕虏体或原位地球化学约束，不能完全排除下地壳榴辉岩化或其他镁铁质底侵的可能。
二维地球动力学模拟未显式包含小尺度熔体抽取、渗流、岩脉扩展及三维地壳就位过程。
高阻屏障周边的渗透率参数、孔隙压力演化及三维水力-力学流体通道系基于多观测推断，尚未进行直接耦合模拟。

tm.why: The study integrates 3D magnetotelluric imaging and 2D thermo-mechanical geodynamic simulations to investigate how ancient Emeishan mantle plume residues modified lithospheric architecture and continue to modulate crustal deformation.

The paper examines how a high-resistivity, mechanically strong lithospheric block beneath the Huayingshan Fault acts as a low-permeability barrier that traps saline crustal fluids, elevates pore pressure, and localizes stress and seismicity.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 28-page Nature Communications Article-in-Press PDF, including full text, Methods, and Figures 1–4.

sum: Traditional constraints on Earth's deep interior rely on seismic wave propagation and gravity. This study presents an independent geophysical probe based on the weak force, using high-energy neutrino attenuation tomography at the IceCube Neutrino Observatory. Analyzing 368,071 upgoing muon-neutrino tracks (500 GeV to 100 TeV) collected over 10.7 years, the authors measure zenith- and energy-dependent flux suppression caused by neutrino-nucleon interactions across the Earth. Using a Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo framework, they fit five-shell and eight-shell concentric radial density models while simultaneously marginalizing over 37 nuisance parameters covering atmospheric/astrophysical fluxes, cross sections, and ice optical properties. The inferred radial density profile agrees well with the Preliminary Reference Earth Model (PREM), yielding an Earth mass of 7.25×10^24 kg and polar moment of inertia of 1.05×10^38 kg m^2. This represents the most precise weak-interaction measurement of Earth's interior structure to date.
传统地球深部结构研究依赖地震波和重力。本文利用南极IceCube中微子天文台10.7年观测的368,071个上行缪子中微子事件（500 GeV–100 TeV），通过弱相互作用衰减层析成像独立约束地球内部密度。基于贝叶斯MCMC方法，研究联合反演了5层和8层同心球壳径向密度模型及37个系统误差参数。……

t: Binned Poisson likelihood Bayesian MCMC fit of 5- and 8-shell concentric Earth density models to energy- and zenith-binned neutrino tracks, marginalizing over 37 flux, cross-section, and detector nuisance parameters.
对能量和天顶角分箱的中微子径迹进行分箱泊松似然贝叶斯MCMC拟合，联合反演5层和8层地球密度与37个系统误差参数。
10.7 years of IceCube 86-string operation (2011–2022) containing 368,071 upgoing muon-neutrino tracks (93,762 starting, 274,309 throughgoing) across reconstructed energies of 500 GeV to 100 TeV.
IceCube 10.7年（2011-2022）观测的368,071个上行缪子中微子径迹，能量范围500 GeV至100…
Inferred 5-shell densities match PREM; derived Earth mass is 7.25×10^24 kg (68% HPD [6.31, 8.31]×10^24 kg) and polar moment of inertia is 1.05×10^38 kg m^2 (68% HPD [9.04×10^37, 1.24×10^38] kg m^2).
5层密度与PREM一致；反演地球质量为7.25×10^24 kg，极转动惯量为1.05×10^38 kg m^2。
Systematic uncertainties dominate over statistical errors in most analysis bins, driven primarily by poorly constrained astrophysical neutrino flux parameters.
大多数分箱中系统误差大于统计误差，主要受限于天体物理中微子通量参数的不确定性。
Uses an order of magnitude more neutrino data and an updated 37-parameter systematic uncertainty treatment to achieve the most precise weak-interaction measurement of Earth's interior to date.
使用多一个数量级的数据和更新的系统误差处理，实现了迄今最精确的弱相互作用地球内部测量。

kc: Constrained Earth's radial density profile in 5-shell and 8-shell parameterizations using 10.7 years of high-energy neutrino attenuation data from IceCube.

Derived weak-interaction-based measurements of Earth's mass (7.25×10^24 kg) and polar moment of inertia (1.05×10^38 kg m^2), consistent with gravitational and seismic PREM values within 95% credible intervals.
Implemented a comprehensive Bayesian MCMC joint fit incorporating 37 systematic nuisance parameters for neutrino fluxes, cross sections, and glacial-ice detector optics.
利用IceCube 10.7年的高能中微子衰减数据，在5层和8层参数化下约束了地球的径向密度剖面。
推导出基于弱相互作用的地球质量（7.25×10^24 kg）和极转动惯量（1.05×10^38 kg m^2），在95%置信区间内与重力和地震学PREM参考值一致。
实现了包含中微子通量、截面和冰川光学特性等37个系统误差参数的全面贝叶斯MCMC联合反演。
me: Neutrino attenuation tomography exploiting energy- and zenith-dependent absorption of 500 GeV–100 TeV neutrinos traversing Earth chords.
Forward modeling of neutrino attenuation as a function of column depth and energy via the nuFATE spline solver and CSMS NLO Standard Model cross sections.
Binned Poisson likelihood Bayesian inference sampled with the emcee MCMC ensemble sampler within the GollumFit framework, marginalizing over 37 nuisance parameters.
中微子衰减层析成像，利用穿过地球不同弦长的500 GeV–100 TeV中微子随能量和天顶角变化的吸收效应。
基于nuFATE样条求解器和CSMS次领头阶标准模型截面，正演模拟作为柱密度和能量函数的中微子衰减。
在GollumFit框架内使用emcee MCMC采样器进行分箱泊松似然贝叶斯推断，并对37个系统误差参数进行边缘化。
de: 10.7 years (May 2011 to June 2022) of IceCube 86-string data comprising 368,071 upgoing muon tracks (93,762 starting and 274,309 throughgoing events).
Two-stage blind analysis comparing fits excluding near-horizontal trajectories (-1.0 < cos θ < -0.1) against all upgoing data (-1.0 < cos θ < 0.0).
IceCube 86串探测器10.7年（2011年5月至2022年6月）的数据，共包含368,071个上行缪子径迹（93,762个起始事件和274,309个穿过事件）。
两阶段盲分析，对比排除近水平轨迹（-1.0 < cos θ < -0.1）与包含所有上行数据（-1.0 < cos θ < 0.0）的反演结果。
li: Large uncertainties in the poorly constrained diffuse astrophysical neutrino flux dominate the systematic uncertainty in the density inference.
Does not account for second-order tau regeneration effects or target non-isoscalarity (neutron excess in Earth nuclei), though both are sub-dominant to current uncertainties.
Radial resolution is limited to 5 to 8 coarse concentric shells under a strict spherical symmetry assumption.
约束较差的天体物理弥散中微子通量带来的巨大不确定性主导了密度反演的系统误差。
未考虑二阶tau中微子再生效应和靶核非等标量性（地球原子核中的中子过剩），尽管这两者均小于当前误差水平。
在严格的球对称假设下，径向分辨率仅限于5到8个粗略的同心球壳。

tm.why: The paper directly constrains the radial density profile of the Earth's interior (inner core, outer core, mantle, and crust) as well as total mass and moment of inertia, comparing them with the Preliminary Reference Earth Model (PREM).
The authors formulate a binned-likelihood Bayesian inversion using Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) to jointly infer concentric shell densities and 37 systematic nuisance parameters.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 24-page PDF manuscript including main text, Methods, and Supplementary Materials (Tables I–II and Figs. 1–11).

sum: This study addresses the lack of clear seismic indicators for sandstone-hosted uranium deposits (SUDs). Through systematic seismic modeling, attribute analysis, and petrophysical inversion, the authors identify that amplitude, frequency, and derivative attributes are highly sensitive to uranium-bearing environments. Furthermore, petrophysical parameters such as shear wave impedance, compressional impedance, and the shear modulus-density product (μ*ρ) serve as efficient indicators for identifying uranium-bearing strata. The methodology was validated using 3D seismic data from the Qihagertu area, where seismic attribute clustering and petrophysical inversion successfully mapped three NE-oriented sand-body distribution zones, aligning well with regional geological expectations.
本研究针对砂岩型铀矿（SUD）地震勘探中缺乏明确预测指标的问题，通过地震模拟、属性分析和岩石物理反演，系统研究了铀矿储层的地震响应特征。结果表明，振幅、频率及其导数属性对含铀环境高度敏感；剪切模量-密度乘积（μ*ρ）、纵波阻抗和横波阻抗是识别含铀地层的有效指标。该方法在齐哈格尔图地区的实际3D地震数……

t: Seismic modeling, attribute analysis, and petrophysical parameter inversion (including shear wave impedance, compressional impedance, and shear modulus-density product) are used to identify uranium-bearing strata.
利用地震正演模拟、属性分析以及岩石物理参数反演（包括纵横波阻抗和剪切模量-密度乘积）来识别含铀地层。
Synthetic modeling of typical SUD reservoirs and 3D seismic data from the Qihagertu area.
典型砂岩型铀矿储层的合成正演模拟数据以及齐哈格尔图地区的实际3D地震数据。
Seismic attribute clustering and petrophysical inversion successfully identified three NE-oriented sand-body spreading zones in the Qihagertu area.
地震属性聚类和岩石物理反演成功识别出齐哈格尔图地区三个呈东北方向展布的砂体带。
The abstract does not explicitly detail limitations, but applicability may depend on regional geological calibration of petrophysical parameters.
摘要中未详细说明局限性，但该方法的有效性可能依赖于区域岩石物理参数的精确校准。
Establishing specific seismic indicators (amplitude, frequency, μ*ρ, and impedance) for predicting favorable sandstone-hosted uranium metallogenic environments.
首次确立了用于预测砂岩型铀矿有利成矿环境的具体地震属性与岩石物理敏感指标。

kc: Derived the seismic response characteristics of sandstone-hosted uranium deposit (SUD) reservoirs.
Identified amplitude, frequency, and their derivatives as sensitive seismic attributes for uranium-bearing environments.
Established petrophysical parameters (μ*ρ, shear wave impedance, and compressional impedance) as efficient indicators for uranium-bearing strata.
Successfully applied the indicators to 3D seismic data in the Qihagertu area to map regional sand-body distributions.
推导了砂岩型铀矿（SUD）储层的地震响应特征。
确定了振幅、频率及其导数属性是含铀环境的敏感地震属性。
确立了岩石物理参数（μ*ρ、横波阻抗和纵波阻抗）作为识别含铀地层的有效指标。
成功将这些指标应用于齐哈格尔图地区3D地震数据，绘制出区域砂体分布图。
me: Seismic forward modeling of typical sandstone-hosted uranium reservoirs.
Seismic attribute analysis (amplitude, frequency, and derivative attributes).
Petrophysical parameter inversion and seismic attribute clustering.
典型砂岩型铀矿储层的地震正演模拟。
地震属性分析（振幅、频率及其导数属性）。
岩石物理参数反演与地震属性聚类。
de: Synthetic seismic modeling of typical sandstone-hosted uranium deposit reservoirs.
Real 3D seismic dataset from the Qihagertu area for experimental validation.
典型砂岩型铀矿储层的合成地震正演模拟。
用于实验验证的齐哈格尔图地区实际3D地震数据集。
li: The resolution of seismic attributes and inversion may be limited in highly complex or thin-bedded sandstone reservoirs.
在高度复杂或薄层砂岩储层中，地震属性和反演的分辨率可能会受到限制。

tm.why: The paper focuses on seismic modeling, attribute analysis, and inversion of sandstone-hosted uranium reservoirs for resource exploration.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the comprehensive abstract provided by OpenAlex, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates active crustal deformation in the Aegean region using a 3D elastic-kinematic block model (TDEFNODE). By jointly inverting 832 horizontal GPS velocities and 146 earthquake slip vector azimuths, the authors simultaneously estimate reference frame alignments, block angular velocities, and interseismic fault locking along major upper plate structures and the Hellenic subduction system. Results show geodetic slip rates on upper plate faults ranging from 0.5 to 19.4 mm/yr, with most faults exhibiting high or full locking and significant slip rate deficits, while a few (e.g., Katouna-Stamna fault zone) creep freely. Kinematically, blocks in SE Aegean-SW Anatolia rotate counterclockwise, whereas those in central-NW Greece rotate clockwise, separated by a fast southwestward-moving central domain. The novelty lies in deriving the first comprehensive, self-consistent regional set of geodetic fault slip rates, locking ratios, and moment accumulation rates accounting for both upper plate faults and subduction locking.
本研究利用三维弹性运动学块体模型（TDEFNODE），联合反演了832个GPS水平速度矢量和146个地震滑动矢量方位角，同步估计了爱琴海地区地壳块体的旋转角速度及断层震间闭锁程度。结果表明，上盘断层的大地测量滑动速率在0.5至19.4 mm/yr之间，大多数断层处于高闭锁或完全闭锁状态，积累了显著的……

t: Jointly inverts GPS velocities and earthquake slip vector azimuths using TDEFNODE via grid search and simulated annealing to estimate block rotations and Okada-based backslip fault locking.
使用TDEFNODE程序，通过网格搜索和模拟退火联合反演GPS速度与地震滑动矢量，估计块体旋转和断层闭锁。
832 horizontal GPS velocities from three regional datasets aligned into a Eurasian reference frame, plus 146 earthquake slip vector azimuths shallower than 40 km from the RCMT catalog.
整合统一至欧亚框架的832个水平GPS速度数据，以及RCMT目录中146个深度小于40 km的地震滑动矢量方位角。
Upper plate fault slip rates range from 0.5 to 19.4 mm/yr (e.g., 19 mm/yr on NAF, 19.3 mm/yr on CTFZ, 13.7 mm/yr across Corinth Rift), with most faults strongly locked.
上盘断层滑动速率为0.5–19.4 mm/yr（如NAF为19 mm/yr，CTFZ为19.3 mm/yr），多数断层处…
Uniform coupling was assumed per fault because solving for spatial along-strike or downdip variations yielded higher reduced chi-square misfits and larger parameter uncertainties.
每条断层假设均匀耦合，因为允许空间变化会导致更大的卡方拟合残差和参数不确定性。

Develops a comprehensive regional elastic block model that simultaneously accounts for upper-plate fault locking and Hellenic subduction interface coupling, providing new slip rate and moment deficit estimates.
首次建立同时考虑上盘断层闭锁和希腊俯冲带耦合的区域弹性块体模型，提供新的滑动速率与矩亏损估计。

kc: Developed a 26-block 3D elastic-kinematic model of the Aegean region inverting 832 GPS velocities and 146 earthquake slip vectors.
Provided first-time or refined geodetic slip rates (0.5–19.4 mm/yr), locking ratios, and moment accumulation rates for major active upper plate faults.
Demonstrated that opposing rotations in SE Aegean-SW Anatolia (CCW) and central-NW Greece (CW) are driven by Anatolian escape, slab rollback, and lateral plate boundary variations.
建立了包含26个块体的爱琴海三维弹性运动学模型，联合反演了832个GPS速度和146个地震滑动矢量。
首次提供或更新了主要活动上盘断层的大地测量滑动速率（0.5–19.4 mm/yr）、闭锁比及地震矩积累率。
揭示了东南爱琴海（逆时针）与希腊中-西北部（顺时针）的相反旋转受控于安纳托利亚逃逸、板片回撤及板块边界横向变化。
me: 3D elastic-kinematic block modeling using TDEFNODE with Okada half-space dislocation equations and backslip.
Simultaneous nonlinear inversion (grid search and simulated annealing) for GPS reference frame rotations, block Euler poles, and fault coupling coefficients.
GPS velocity profiling in Eurasia-fixed and central Aegean-fixed reference frames to delineate active deformation zones and block boundaries.
利用基于Okada半空间位错公式和后滑理论的TDEFNODE程序进行三维弹性运动学块体建模。
采用网格搜索和模拟退火非线性反演，同步求解GPS参考框架旋转、块体欧拉极和断层耦合系数。
在欧亚固定框架和爱琴海中部固定框架下进行GPS速度剖面分析，以圈定活动变形带和块体边界。
de: 832 horizontal GPS velocities compiled from three published solutions (Briole et al., 2021; Ergintav et al., 2022; Kurt et al., 2023) aligned into a common Eurasian frame.
146 earthquake slip vector azimuths (depth < 40 km) extracted from the European-Mediterranean RCMT catalog.
3D fault geometries, dip angles, and dip directions compiled from the GreDaSS database, DISS, and slab geometry from Bocchini et al. (2018).
整合自三个已发表解算结果的832个水平GPS速度矢量，在反演中统一对齐至欧亚参考框架。
从欧洲-地中海RCMT目录中提取的146个浅源（<40 km）地震滑动矢量方位角。
整合自GreDaSS数据库、DISS以及Bocchini等（2018）俯冲板片模型的三维断层几何与产状参数。
li: Assumes uniform scalar coupling coefficient per fault because allowing spatial along-strike or downdip variations yielded larger misfits and uncertainties.
High uncertainties in slip rate estimates for several faults in NW Greece and Albania due to sparse GPS station coverage.
Hard geological slip rate constraints were required on the Atalanti fault to enforce the expected sense of motion.
假设每条断层具有均匀的耦合系数，因为允许沿走向或倾向的空间变化会导致更大的拟合残差和不确定性。
由于GPS台站覆盖稀疏，希腊西北部和阿尔巴尼亚部分断层的滑动速率估计存在较大不确定性。
阿塔兰蒂（Atalanti）断层需要施加硬性地质滑动速率约束才能获得符合地质预期的运动方向。

tm.why: The paper develops an elastic-kinematic block model to quantify present-day crustal deformation, block rotations, and geodynamic processes across the Aegean region.
The study estimates interseismic fault locking ratios, geodetic fault slip rates, creeping behavior, and slip rate deficits on major upper plate faults.
Slip rate deficits are used to calculate geodetic moment accumulation rates and earthquake recurrence intervals for major seismogenic faults.

ev.notes: Full 32-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§7), Table 1, and Figures 1–11.

sum: This study explores the physical mechanisms of friction weakening and compaction in sheared granular flows subjected to acoustic vibrations. By analyzing granular dynamics, the work aims to clarify how external acoustic waves alter the shear strength and packing density of granular materials, which serves as an analogue for fault gouge behavior during seismic wave passage. The findings provide insights into dynamic earthquake triggering and the mechanical response of fault zones to transient seismic waves.
本研究探讨了声波振动作用下剪切颗粒流摩擦弱化与压实的物理机制。通过分析颗粒动力学，该工作旨在阐明外部声波如何改变颗粒材料的剪切强度和堆积密度。这可作为地震波通过时断层泥行为的模拟，为动态地震触发及断层带对瞬态地震波的力学响应提供了新见解。

t: Investigation of sheared granular flows subjected to acoustic vibration to measure friction and compaction.
研究承受声波振动的剪切颗粒流，以测量摩擦和压实作用。
Experimental or simulated granular flow data under varying shear rates and acoustic vibration amplitudes.
在不同剪切速率和声波振动振幅下的实验或模拟颗粒流数据。
Acoustic vibrations lead to significant friction weakening and compaction in sheared granular media.
声波振动导致剪切颗粒介质中显著的摩擦弱化和压实。
Scaling laboratory granular physics to real-world fault gouge under high pressure remains challenging.
在高压下将实验室颗粒物理学推广到实际断层泥仍具有挑战性。
Directly coupling acoustic vibration effects to both friction weakening and compaction in sheared granular flows.
直接将声波振动效应与剪切颗粒流中的摩擦弱化和压实结合起来。

kc: Analyzed the effects of acoustic vibration on the shear strength of granular flows.
Investigated the compaction behavior of sheared granular materials under dynamic acoustic loading.
Linked granular physics observations to fault weakening and dynamic earthquake triggering mechanisms.
分析了声波振动对颗粒流剪切强度的影响。
研究了动态声学载荷下剪切颗粒材料的压实行为。
将颗粒物理观测与断层弱化及动态地震触发机制联系起来。
me: Granular flow shear experiments or discrete element modeling under acoustic vibration.
Analysis of friction coefficient and packing fraction variations.
声波振动下的颗粒流剪切实验或离散元模拟。
摩擦系数和堆积体积分数变化的分析。
de: Laboratory measurements or numerical simulations of sheared granular gouge under acoustic perturbation.
声学扰动下剪切颗粒断层泥的实验室测量或数值模拟。
li: Laboratory scale and simplified granular geometries may not fully capture the complexity of natural fault zones.
实验室尺度和简化的颗粒几何形状可能无法完全捕捉自然断层带的复杂性。

tm.why: The paper investigates friction weakening and compaction in sheared granular flows under acoustic vibration, which directly relates to fault gouge mechanics and earthquake triggering.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the title, authors, and metadata from Crossref and OpenAlex.

sum: This study investigates ongoing plate boundary readjustments at the Rodriguez Triple Junction (RTJ) in the Indian Ocean, where the Central, Southeast, and Southwest Indian Ridges meet. Using an 8-month deployment of 15 ocean-bottom seismometers, the authors apply ambient-noise clock drift correction, deep-learning phase picking (PickBlue), event association (REAL), probabilistic localization (NonLinLoc), and double-difference relocation (HypoDD) to compile a catalog of 1,466 local earthquakes (Mw 1.0–4.2). Results show seismicity is concentrated along the Central Indian Ridge (CIR) up to 16 km depth below seafloor and is systematically shifted eastward of the CIR axial valley and northeastward along the Southwest Indian Ridge. Additionally, CIR seismicity extends southward into crust accreted at the largely aseismic Southeast Indian Ridge. This provides the first direct seismological evidence that ridge migration is driven by gradual, sequential relocations of the rift axis and lithospheric capture rather than abrupt ridge jumps.
本研究利用在印度洋罗德里格斯三联点（RTJ）布设的15台海底地震仪（OBS）8个月的连续数据，结合背景噪声钟差校正、深度学习震相拾取（PickBlue）、REAL事件关联、NonLinLoc概率定位及HypoDD双差重定位方法，构建了包含1466个局部地震（Mw 1.0–4.2）的高精度目录。结果显……

t: Clock drift was corrected via cross-correlation; events were detected with PickBlue (PhaseNet for OBS), associated using REAL, located probabilistically with NonLinLoc using 1-D velocity models and station corrections, and relocated via HypoDD.
采用噪声互相关校正钟差，结合PickBlue拾取、REAL关联、NonLinLoc定位及HypoDD重定位。

Eight months of continuous 250 Hz waveform data (December 2019 to August 2020) recorded by 15 retrieved free-fall ocean-bottom seismometers deployed around the southernmost CIR segment and Kairei hydrothermal vent field.
在CIR最南端及Kairei热液区布设并回收的15台海底地震仪8个月的250 Hz连续波形数据。

The catalog contains 1,466 events (Mw 1.0–4.2, b-value 1.26) reaching 16–17 km below seafloor, with seismicity systematically shifted eastward along the CIR and northeastward along the SWIR relative to their axial valleys.
构建含1466个事件（Mw 1.0–4.2，b值1.26）的目录，震源深达16–17 km，CIR和SWIR地震呈系统性…

Seafloor station locations relied on surface drop-off coordinates without acoustic positioning, and network geometry primarily covered the CIR, leaving the SWIR and SEIR only marginally sampled at their tips.
海底台站仅使用海面投放位置，且台网主要覆盖CIR，仅覆盖SWIR和SEIR的尖端。

Provides the first direct seismological constraints demonstrating that mid-ocean ridge migration and triple junction boundary readjustments occur through progressive rift axis relocations and lithospheric capture.
首次提供直接地震学证据，证明洋中脊迁移和三联点边界调整由裂谷轴渐进迁移驱动。

kc: Compiled a high-resolution catalog of 1,466 local earthquakes over 8 months at the Rodriguez Triple Junction using 15 OBS stations.
Revealed systematic eastward and northeastward offsets of seismicity relative to the bathymetric axes of the CIR and SWIR, respectively.
Provided the first direct seismological evidence of ongoing small-scale ridge migration via progressive rift axis relocation and lithospheric capture.
利用15台海底地震仪8个月的观测数据，构建了罗德里格斯三联点包含1466个局部地震的高精度目录。
揭示了地震活动相对于中印度洋脊（CIR）和西南印度洋脊（SWIR）地形轴线分别存在系统性的向东和向东北偏移。
首次提供了洋中脊通过裂谷轴渐进迁移和岩石圈捕获实现小尺度迁移的直接地震学证据。
me: Linear and 7th-order polynomial non-linear clock drift correction via daily stacked hourly ambient noise cross-correlations.
Automated phase picking using OBS-adapted deep learning algorithm PickBlue and event association via REAL.
Probabilistic hypocenter location using NonLinLoc with iterative station corrections and 1D refraction-derived velocity models, followed by HypoDD double-difference relocation.
基于每日叠加的小时级背景噪声互相关，进行线性和七阶多项式非线性仪器钟差校正。
使用适用于OBS的深度学习算法PickBlue进行自动震相拾取，并利用REAL算法进行事件关联。
采用NonLinLoc结合一维折射速度模型和迭代台站校正进行概率震源定位，并使用HypoDD进行双差重定位。
de: Continuous 8-month seismic waveform recordings (Dec 2019 to Aug 2020) from 15 free-fall ocean-bottom seismometers (4.5 Hz geophones, broadband seismometers, and hydrophones) around the RTJ and Kairei vent field.
2019年12月至2020年8月期间，在罗德里格斯三联点及Kairei热液区周围自由落体布设的15台海底地震仪（含短周期检波器、宽频带地震计和水听器）连续8个月的波形数据。
li: No acoustic ranging was available to locate stations on the seafloor, so surface drop-off coordinates had to be used as station locations.
Most OBS stations covered the CIR and only the tips of the SWIR and SEIR, limiting spatial resolution away from the triple junction along SWIR and SEIR.
布设和回收时缺乏测定海底台站精确位置的手段，只能使用海面投放点坐标作为台站位置。
大多数OBS台站仅覆盖了CIR以及SWIR和SEIR的末端，限制了对远离三联点的SWIR和SEIR轴部的观测能力。

tm.why: The paper builds a local earthquake catalog of 1,466 events using PickBlue, REAL, NonLinLoc, and HypoDD.
It interprets the spatial distribution of earthquakes to reveal mid-ocean ridge migration, asymmetric accretion, and plate boundary readjustments at a triple junction.
The study relies on an 8-month deployment of 15 ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) including ambient noise clock drift corrections.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF read and analyzed, including all text sections, methods, results, discussions, and figure captions.

sum: Whether and how the subducting Indian lower crust is incorporated into the Himalayan orogen remains debated. Using broadband seismic data from 74 stations of the southern Hi-CLIMB array, this study applies high-resolution Pn-wave receiver function (PnRF) Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking to image the crustal architecture. Results reveal that the Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT) dips northward from ~14 to ~44 km (reaching ~50 km depth), while the underthrusting Indian crust gradually thins northward from ~29 km to ~16 km. Above the deep MHT lies a prominent wedge-shaped low-velocity zone. Synthetic PnRF forward modeling demonstrates that this wedge geometry matches a radiogenic heating thermal model rather than a narrow frictional shear heating model. Combined with compiled metamorphic P-T path width ratios (b/a), the authors propose that radiogenic heating drives ductile delamination of the deep Indian crust in the central-eastern Himalayas, contrasting with colder brittle duplexing in the west.
针对俯冲印度下地壳是否及如何并入喜马拉雅造山带的争议，本研究利用Hi-CLIMB台阵南段74个宽频带台站数据，采用高分辨率Pn波接收函数（PnRF）共转换点（CCP）叠加方法对地壳结构进行成像。结果显示主喜马拉雅逆冲断层（MHT）向北加深至约50 km，俯冲印度地壳厚度从约29 km向北逐渐减薄至约……

t: High-resolution Pn-wave receiver functions (PnRFs) are computed via time-domain iterative deconvolution in distance-dependent windows and migrated using Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking with the 3D CSRM1.0 velocity model.
采用距离相关时窗时间域迭代反褶积计算Pn波接收函数，并结合三维CSRM1.0模型进行CCP叠加成像。

1,320 PnRFs extracted from regional earthquakes (epicentral distances 5°–15°, magnitudes >4.5) recorded at 74 broadband stations (3–4 km spacing) along the southern Hi-CLIMB profile, plus compiled metamorphic P-T paths.
利用Hi-CLIMB南段74个台站记录的5°–15°区域地震提取1320条PnRF，并汇编变质岩P-T轨迹数据。
The MHT dips northward from ~14 to ~44 km above a Moho at 43–60 km, revealing Indian crustal thinning from ~29 to ~16 km and an overlying wedge-shaped low-velocity zone (10–25 km depth).
揭示MHT向北加深（14–44 km），俯冲印度地壳由29 km减薄至16 km，且MHT上方存在楔状低速区。
Station spacing of 3–4 km limits coherent noise suppression at high frequencies, restricting the Gaussian filter parameter to 2.5 (~1.2 Hz), and ray turning creates an upper-mantle imaging gap.
3–4 km台站间距限制了高频噪声压制（最高频率~1.2 Hz），且上地幔存在射线水平出射导致的成像空白区。

First application of Pn-wave receiver functions to the Hi-CLIMB array, resolving a wedge-shaped low-velocity zone and linking it with P-T path ellipse ratios to distinguish radiogenic from shear heating.
首次将PnRF应用于喜马拉雅，结合P-T轨迹椭圆扁率定量区分了放射性生热与剪切生热模式。

kc: High-resolution Pn-wave receiver function CCP image across the Himalayan orogen using 74 Hi-CLIMB stations.
Quantifies progressive northward thinning of the underthrusting Indian crust from ~29 km to ~16 km down to ~50 km depth.
Identifies a wedge-shaped low-velocity zone above the deep MHT, confirming radiogenic heating over shear heating via synthetic forward modeling.
Links lateral thermal heterogeneity across the Himalayas (east vs. west of ~84°E) to metamorphic P-T path widths (ellipse b/a ratios) and distinct crustal thinning modes.
利用74个Hi-CLIMB台站数据获得了横跨喜马拉雅造山带的高分辨率Pn波接收函数CCP成像。
量化了俯冲印度地壳向北由约29 km渐进减薄至约16 km（MHT深达约50 km）的几何特征。
识别出深部MHT上方的楔状低速带，并通过合成理论地震图正演证实其主要由放射性生热而非摩擦剪切生热产生。
将喜马拉雅东西向（以~84°E为界）的热结构横向不均一性与变质岩P-T轨迹宽度（椭圆b/a比值）及不同的地壳减薄模式相联系。
me: Pn-wave receiver function (PnRF) calculation using time-domain iterative deconvolution with a distance-dependent time window and Gaussian parameter of 2.5 (~1.2 Hz).
Common Conversion Point (CCP) depth migration and stacking using the 3D CSRM1.0 velocity model and accounting for upper-mantle Pn velocity gradient.
Synthetic PnRF forward modeling using the Raysum code to test shear heating vs. radiogenic heating velocity models.
Geometric quantification of compiled metamorphic rock P-T paths by fitting normalized ellipses and calculating short-to-long axis ratios (b/a).
采用基于距离相关时窗的时间域迭代反褶积方法计算Pn波接收函数（高斯系数2.5，对应最高频率~1.2 Hz）。
考虑上地幔顶部Pn波速度梯度，结合三维CSRM1.0速度模型进行共转换点（CCP）深度偏移叠加。
利用Raysum程序开展合成PnRF正演模拟，对比检验剪切生热与放射性生热速度模型。
对汇编的变质岩P-T轨迹进行归一化椭圆拟合，计算短长轴比（b/a）以定量表征P-T轨迹宽度。
de: Regional earthquakes (epicentral distances 5°–15°, Mw > 4.5) recorded by 74 broadband stations in the southern segment of the Hi-CLIMB array (3–4 km spacing, 2002–2005), yielding 1,320 PnRFs.
Five velocity models (CSRM1.0 and four regional 1D models) used to evaluate depth and thickness uncertainties in CCP stacking.
Compiled database of Greater Himalayan Crystalline metamorphic rock pressure-temperature (P-T) paths across the orogen.
Hi-CLIMB宽频带台阵南段74个台站（间距3–4 km，2002–2005年）记录的震中距5°–15°、震级>4.5的区域地震波形，共提取1320条PnRF。
采用CSRM1.0三维模型及4个区域一维速度模型评估CCP成像中界面深度与地壳厚度的不确定性。
汇编了横跨造山带的高喜马拉雅结晶岩系变质岩温度-压力（P-T）轨迹数据集。
li: Large station intervals (3–4 km) prevent coherent superposition from fully suppressing high-frequency noise, restricting the usable Gaussian filter parameter to 2.5 (~1.2 Hz).
A laterally varying imaging blank zone appears in the upper mantle where the P-wave velocity equals or exceeds the reciprocal of the Pn ray parameter.
Compiled metamorphic P-T values carry inherent geothermobarometry uncertainties of ±15–70°C and ±0.4–1.6 kbar.
台站间距较大（3–4 km）导致射线路径密度不足以通过相干叠加压制高频噪声，限制了可用高斯滤波系数仅为2.5（~1.2 Hz）。
当上地幔P波速度大于或等于射线参数倒数时射线水平传播，导致CCP剖面上地幔出现横向变化的成像空白区。
汇编的变质岩P-T数据存在±15–70°C和±0.4–1.6 kbar的温压计方法不确定性。

tm.why: The paper applies Pn-wave receiver function (PnRF) Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking to image the Moho, Main Himalayan Thrust, and intracrustal low-velocity zones.
The study investigates the thermal structure, crustal thinning, and exhumation mechanisms of the subducting Indian crust beneath the Himalayan orogen.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF read and analyzed, including all 4 figures, methodology equations, CCP uncertainty analyses, and petrological P-T path synthesis.

sum: This study investigates the structural controls on fault reactivation in the Weishan–Fengqing region of the southeastern Tibetan Plateau. Using two-phase dense seismic array data, the authors perform 3D common conversion point (CCP) imaging and H-kappa-c analysis of receiver functions alongside machine-learning-based earthquake relocation (LOC-FLOW). They identify a localized high-velocity body in the mid-lower crust characterized by high Vp/Vs (>1.80) and aligned anisotropy, interpreted as a fossil magmatic intrusion from slab-tear-related mantle upwelling. This mechanically strong block concentrates stress in the overlying brittle crust, promoting the reactivation of four subparallel pre-existing faults and driving the observed earthquake clusters.
本研究探讨了藏东南巍山—凤庆地区断裂活化的深部结构控制机制。利用两期密集地震台阵数据，开展了接收函数3D共转换点（CCP）成像和H-kappa-c分析，并结合机器学习地震定位系统（LOC-FLOW）构建了高精度地震目录。结果在中下地壳发现了一个高波速、高波速比（>1.80）且具各向异性的局部异常体，……

t: 3D common conversion point (CCP) imaging and H-kappa-c analysis of dense-array receiver functions, combined with the machine-learning-based LOC-FLOW earthquake location workflow.
采用密集台阵接收函数的3D共转换点（CCP）成像和H-kappa-c分析，结合基于机器学习的LOC-FLOW地震定位工作…
Two-phase dense passive seismic array data deployed in the Weishan–Fengqing region of the southeastern Tibetan Plateau.
部署在青藏高原东南部巍山—凤庆地区的两期密集流动地震台阵记录的连续波形数据。

Identification of a localized mid-lower crustal high-velocity body with high Vp/Vs (>1.80) and aligned anisotropy, which correlates with concentrated seismicity and four reactivated subparallel faults.
在中下地壳发现高波速、高波速比（>1.80）的局部异常体，该异常体与地震群集及四条活化的平行断裂密切相关。
The study relies on passive source imaging and earthquake locations, which are subject to the spatial distribution of seismicity and station coverage.
成像与定位精度受限于天然地震事件的分布以及密集台阵的观测周期与空间覆盖范围。
Linking a deep fossil magmatic intrusion (imaged via dense receiver functions) to the stress concentration and reactivation of overlying subparallel faults.
首次将深部古岩浆侵入体（通过密集接收函数成像）与上覆多条平行预存断裂的应力集中及活化机制直接联系起来。

kc: Imaged a localized high-velocity, high Vp/Vs (>1.80) fossil magmatic intrusion in the mid-lower crust of the southeastern Tibetan Plateau.
Constructed a high-resolution relocated earthquake catalog for the Weishan–Fengqing region using the machine-learning-based LOC-FLOW workflow.
Proposed a mechanical model where a strong fossil magmatic block concentrates stress in the overlying brittle crust, driving the reactivation of subparallel pre-existing faults.
在藏东南中下地壳成像出高波速、高波速比（>1.80）的局部古岩浆侵入体。
利用基于机器学习的LOC-FLOW工作流构建了巍山—凤庆地区的高分辨率重定位地震目录。
提出了一个力学模型，即坚硬的古岩浆块体导致上覆脆性地壳应力集中，从而推动了数条平行预存断裂的活化。
me: 3D Common Conversion Point (CCP) imaging of receiver functions to map crustal interfaces.
H-kappa-c analysis of receiver functions to retrieve crustal thickness, Vp/Vs ratio, and crustal anisotropy.
LOC-FLOW machine-learning-based earthquake detection and location workflow to build a high-resolution catalog.
接收函数3D共转换点（CCP）成像，用于精细刻画地壳界面。
接收函数H-kappa-c分析，用于获取地壳厚度、波速比（Vp/Vs）及地壳各向异性。
基于机器学习的LOC-FLOW地震检测与定位工作流，用于构建高分辨率地震目录。
de: Seismic waveform data recorded by a two-phase dense passive seismic array deployed in the Weishan–Fengqing region, southeastern Tibetan Plateau.
部署在青藏高原东南部巍山—凤庆地区的两期密集流动地震台阵所记录的地震波形数据。
li: The resolution of the fossil magmatic structure and fault geometry is constrained by the spatial coverage and aperture of the dense array.
古岩浆结构和断裂几何形状的分辨率受限于密集台阵的空间覆盖范围和孔径。

tm.why: The study uses dense-array receiver functions, 3D common conversion point imaging, and H-kappa-c analysis to retrieve crustal parameters.
The authors apply the machine-learning-based LOC-FLOW scheme to build a high-resolution relocated earthquake catalog.
The paper images a fossil magmatic intrusion in the mid-lower crust and discusses its geodynamic link to slab-tear-related mantle upwelling.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from Seismological Research Letters, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar, as no full PDF was available.

sum: This study utilizes ambient noise tomography to resolve the poorly constrained uppermost crustal structure (upper 6 km) of eastern Taiwan. By deploying five temporary arrays with 411 seismic stations between 2016 and 2019, the authors construct a high-resolution 3D shear-wave velocity model. The results reveal a distinct north-south variation in the low-velocity zone. In the south, the low-velocity anomalies are twice as thick as those in the north, with near-surface velocities below 1.0 km/s. This is attributed to subsidence and sediment transport along the Longitudinal Valley fault, fluid/gas enrichment, and the sedimentary Lichi Formation, which is inferred to extend further north to 23.5° N.
本研究利用背景噪声成像技术，解析了台湾东部上地壳（浅部6公里）的高分辨率三维剪切波速度结构。研究利用2016至2019年间部署的5个临时台阵（共411个地震台站）的数据，发现低速带存在显著的南北差异：南部低速异常厚度几乎是北部的两倍，且近地表波速低于1.0 km/s。研究认为，该差异由纵谷断层下盘的……

t: Ambient noise tomography using continuous data from five sequentially deployed dense temporary arrays to reconstruct 3D shear-wave velocity.
利用五个陆续部署的密集临时台阵的连续背景噪声数据，进行三维剪切波速度成像。
Continuous seismic waveform data from 411 temporary stations deployed in five arrays across eastern Taiwan between 2016 and 2019.
2016至2019年间在台湾东部部署的5个临时台阵、共411个台站的连续地震波形数据。
Discovery of a distinct N-S difference in low-velocity zones, with southern anomalies being twice as thick and showing near-surface velocities < 1.0 km/s.
发现低速带存在显著南北差异，南部异常厚度达北部两倍且近地表波速低于1.0 km/s。
The study focuses strictly on the uppermost crustal structure down to 6 km depth.
探测深度局限于最浅部地壳（深度6公里以内）。
First comprehensive dense-array ambient noise imaging of eastern Taiwan bridging surface geology with the underlying uppermost crustal tectonic architecture.
首次利用密集台阵背景噪声成像填补了台湾东部极浅部地壳结构与地表地质联系的空白。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution 3D shear-wave velocity model of the upper 6 km of eastern Taiwan using dense temporary arrays.
Identified a major north-south asymmetry in the thickness and velocity of the uppermost crustal low-velocity zones.
Inferred the northward subsurface extension of the sedimentary Lichi Formation to near 23.5° N.
Revealed contrasting fault-zone velocity signatures between the northern and southern segments of the suture zone.
利用密集临时台阵构建了台湾东部浅部6公里的高分辨率三维剪切波速度模型。
发现了上地壳低速带在厚度和速度特征上存在显著的南北非对称性。
推断了利吉沉积地层在地下向北延伸至北纬23.5度附近。
揭示了缝合带北部和南部段落截然不同的断裂带速度对比特征。
me: Sequential deployment of five temporary seismic arrays (411 stations total) from 2016 to 2019.
Ambient noise cross-correlation to extract empirical Green's functions.
Surface-wave dispersion analysis and 3D ambient noise tomography (ANT) for shear-wave velocity (Vs).
在2016至2019年间陆续部署了5个临时地震台阵（共计411个台站）。
利用背景噪声互相关技术提取经验格林函数。
进行面波频散分析和三维背景噪声断层成像（ANT）以获取剪切波速度（Vs）。
de: Continuous seismic waveform data recorded by 411 temporary stations across eastern Taiwan.
3D shear-wave velocity model of the upper 6 km depth.
由台湾东部411个临时台站记录的连续地震波形数据。
深度达6公里的三维剪切波速度模型。
li: The depth resolution is limited to the uppermost crust (upper 6 km) due to the frequency range of ambient noise and array apertures.
受背景噪声频率范围和台阵孔径限制，深度分辨率仅局限于上地壳最浅部（6公里以内）。

tm.why: The study uses ambient noise tomography to image the 3D shear-wave velocity structure of the upper 6 km in eastern Taiwan.
The paper constructs a 3D shear-wave velocity model of the uppermost crust using surface-wave dispersion from ambient noise.
The paper interprets the resulting velocity structure in terms of tectonic units, fault zones, and sedimentary formations in eastern Taiwan.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from Crossref, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar. No PDF was available, so the figure analysis array is empty.

sum: This study utilizes 3D magnetotelluric sounding to image the electrical structure of the middle-southern Longmenshan fault zone, aiming to explain the seismic gap between the 2008 Wenchuan and 2013/2022 Lushan earthquakes. The authors identify two fragile buffer zones (A and B) that constrain aftershock propagation. Zone A features shallow fracturing and partial melts (low-resistivity anomaly C2), while Zone B exhibits crustal fragmentation and fluid infiltration (low-resistivity anomalies C1 and C3) driven by tensile stress and crustal tearing. These findings provide critical geodynamic insights into how heterogeneous crustal properties and fluid processes control earthquake rupture limits and seismic gaps.
本研究利用三维大地电磁测深成像了龙门山断裂带中南段的电性结构，旨在解释2008年汶川地震与2013/2022年芦山地震之间的地震空区成因。研究识别出两个限制余震传播的脆弱缓冲区（Zone A和B）。Zone A具有浅表破裂和部分熔融（低阻异常C2），而Zone B在拉张应力和地壳撕裂作用下表现出地壳……

t: Three-dimensional magnetotelluric sounding is used to image the electrical resistivity structure of the crust and upper mantle.
利用三维大地电磁测深方法成像地壳和上地幔的电阻率结构。
Magnetotelluric sounding data acquired across the middle-southern Longmenshan fault zone.
在龙门山断裂带中南段采集的大地电磁测深数据。
Identification of two fragile zones (A and B) with low-resistivity anomalies (C1, C2, C3) representing partial melts and fluid infiltration that constrain aftershock propagation.

sum: This paper presents the first application of Multidimensional Small Baseline Subset (MSBAS) processing to NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) L1 Radar Single Look Complex data. Using 9 acquisitions from ascending and descending tracks over Central Nepal, the authors generated line-of-sight deformation time series and decomposed them into vertical and east-west displacement components. The L-band coherence remained high across the challenging Himalayan terrain, successfully capturing glacier deformation exceeding 3 m/yr and slow-moving landslides at the centimeter-per-year level. This work establishes a complete processing workflow using the AMSTer toolbox, validating NISAR's capability for global systematic deformation monitoring.

sum: This paper presents a comprehensive, open-access ground-motion flatfile combining 29 years (May 1996–December 2025) of recordings from Japan's K-NET (1,047 surface stations) and KiK-net (702 surface and borehole stations) networks. Over 950,000 three-component records from 18,738 earthquakes (MJMA 2.5 to 9, distances up to 1,200 km) were automatically processed and matched with the JMA and F-net catalogs. The automated processing pipeline includes STA/LTA phase detection, LOESS-smoothed SNR calculation, adaptive Butterworth filtering, sixth-order polynomial baseline correction, and sinc oversampling to 400 Hz. It provides peak parameters (PGA, PGV, PGD), RotD0/50/100 pseudo-spectral accelerations, Fourier amplitude spectra, Arias intensity, significant duration, and CAV. Novel quality metrics—such as noise energy ratio and signal-window energy ratio to flag multiple-event contamination and late-trigger issues—classify 59% (556,831 records) as high quality. This is the first large-scale harmonized integration of both K-NET and KiK-net data.

Over 950,000 three-component strong-motion records from 18,738 earthquakes (MJMA 2.5–9, distances up to 1,200 km) recorded between May 1996 and December 2025 across 1,047 K-NET surface and 702 KiK-net surface/borehole stations.
1996年5月至2025年12月日本1,047个K-NET和702个KiK-net台站记录的18,738次地震的950,…

Out of 950,796 processed ground motions, 556,831 (59%) meet high-quality criteria (usable frequency range ratio >0.6, noise energy ratio <0.01, signal energy ratio >0.8), showing high correlation (ρ > 0.96) for RJB, Rrup, PGA, and PGV with existing flatfiles.
成功处理950,796条记录，其中556,831条（59%）符合高质量标准；断层距与PGA、PGV与既有数据库高度相关（…

Trigger-based recording limits pre-event noise windows (especially for 60 s K-NET records), and the energy-ratio method cannot detect multiple earthquake arrivals occurring inside the theoretical P- and S-wave window.
触发式记录导致震前噪声窗受限，且能量比方法无法识别发生在理论P/S波窗内部的多事件重叠。

First large-scale harmonized flatfile integrating both K-NET and KiK-net (surface and borehole) records up to December 2025, introducing automated energy-ratio metrics to evaluate noise windows and multiple-event arrivals.
首次大规模统一整合K-NET与KiK-net长达29年的数据，并提出评估噪声窗质量与多事件污染的能量比新指标。

kc: Compiled the first harmonized flatfile integrating both K-NET and KiK-net (surface and borehole) strong-motion records spanning May 1996 to December 2025 (950,796 three-component records from 18,738 earthquakes).

Developed an automated processing workflow including JMA/F-net catalog matching, rupture distance (RJB, Rrup) calculation, STA/LTA phase picking, SNR-based filter corner selection, baseline correction, and 400 Hz sinc oversampling.
Introduced energy-ratio quality metrics to flag multiple-event arrivals and evaluate noise-window contamination in trigger-based records, identifying 556,831 high-quality records (59%).
Benchmarked calculated rupture distances, filter corner frequencies, and peak amplitudes (PGA, PGV, PGD) against NGA-West 2, DAW16, and BEA20 flatfiles.
构建了首个统一整合日本K-NET和KiK-net（地表及井下）1996年5月至2025年12月强震记录的参数数据库（涵盖18,738次地震的950,796条三分量记录）。
开发了全自动波形处理流程，包括JMA/F-net目录匹配、断层距（RJB、Rrup）计算、STA/LTA拾取、基于信噪比的滤波频带选择、基线校正及400 Hz sinc重采样。
提出了基于能量比的质量控制指标，用于检测多事件混叠并评估触发式记录的噪声窗污染，筛选出556,831条（59%）高质量记录。
将计算得到的断层距、滤波拐角频率及峰值参数（PGA、PGV、PGD）与NGA-West 2、DAW16和BEA20数据库进行了系统对比。
me: Event matching with JMA and F-net catalogs using origin time (<1 min), magnitude (<0.3 units), and epicentral distance within 3x Blaser et al. (2010) estimated rupture length.
Rupture distance (RJB and Rrup) computation via iteratively refined mesh using NIED finite-fault models or F-net focal mechanisms and Blaser et al. (2010) scaling relations.
Automated waveform processing: STA/LTA first-arrival detection, theoretical P/S windowing via JMA travel-time tables, and signal-to-total energy ratio (>0.8) to detect multiple-event arrivals.

Noise window selection (pre-event ≥11 s preferred, or post-signal with noise energy ratio <0.01) and LOESS-smoothed Fourier spectra to determine SNR>3 usable frequency range (0.01–0.7 Hz to 15–30 Hz).

Acausal 4th-order Butterworth filtering, 6th-order polynomial baseline correction, Whittaker–Shannon (sinc) oversampling to 400 Hz, and computation of PGA, PGV, PGD, RotD0/50/100 PSA, FAS, Arias intensity, significant duration, and CAV.
利用发震时刻（<1分钟）、震级（<0.3）及震中距（小于Blaser等(2010)经验破裂长度的3倍）将强震记录与JMA和F-net地震目录进行事件关联。
结合NIED有限断层模型或F-net震源机制与Blaser等(2010)破裂尺度关系，采用迭代加密网格法计算断层距（RJB和Rrup）。

优选震前（≥11 s）或尾波后（噪声能量比<0.01）窗口作为噪声窗，利用LOESS平滑傅里叶谱确定SNR>3的可用频带（低频0.01–0.7 Hz，高频15–30 Hz）。
应用非因果四阶Butterworth滤波、六阶多项式基线校正、400 Hz Whittaker–Shannon (sinc)重采样，计算PGA、PGV、PGD、RotD0/50/100 PSA、FAS、Arias强度、显著持时和CAV。

Systematic cross-dataset comparison with NGA-West 2, Dawood et al. (2016) [DAW16], and Bahrampouri et al. (2020) [BEA20] for common KiK-net and K-NET records.

针对共有记录，与NGA-West 2、DAW16及BEA20数据库进行了断层距、滤波频带和峰值振幅的系统对比实验。
li: Trigger-based recording causes ~25% of records to start at the S-wave arrival and limits pre-event noise availability, particularly for shorter (60 s) K-NET records where coda waves can contaminate post-event noise windows.
The energy-ratio method cannot detect multiple earthquake arrivals that occur inside the theoretical P- and S-wave window.

The flatfile does not classify tectonic earthquake types (e.g., shallow crustal vs. interface/intraslab subduction), leaving classification to the user, and about 40% of events lack F-net moment tensor matches.

数据库未提供地震构造类型分类（如浅源地壳、俯冲带板间或板内地震），且约40%的事件缺乏F-net矩张量匹配。

tm.why: The paper presents an automatically processed ground-motion flatfile of over 950,000 strong-motion records from K-NET and KiK-net in Japan for earthquake engineering and ground-motion modeling.

sum: This white paper introduces the concept, prototype design, and scientific goals of a mobile deep-ocean neutrino experiment designed to detect geoneutrinos from uranium and thorium decay in the Earth's mantle. By operating in the deep ocean, the detector achieves a 50- to 100-fold reduction in crustal background compared to continental detectors, enabling direct measurements of mantle geoneutrinos. The mobility of the detector allows for multiple stereoscopic projections to map spatial variations in heat-producing elements within the mantle. The paper also reports on recent hardware developments and active prototyping of the detector.
该白皮书介绍了一种深海移动式中微子探测器的概念、原型设计和科学目标，旨在检测地幔中铀和钍衰变产生的地球中微子。通过在深海运行，该探测器相比陆地探测器可减少50至100倍的地壳背景干扰，从而实现对地幔地球中微子的直接测量。探测器的移动性允许进行多重立体投影，以绘制地幔内产热元素的空间变化。文中还报告了……

sum: This study presents a 'dynamic mush model' for the Campo Alegre-Corupá system in Brazil, combining textural analysis and thermodynamic modeling to resolve the origin of high-silica rhyolitic magmas and their complementary cumulates. The authors show that syenites and melasyenites represent silicic-mafic cumulates formed at low crystallinities (16-33 vol.%) after extracting 47-80% of interstitial melts. Unlike static models requiring high crystallinity, this dynamic reservoir model suggests early melt segregation where alkali-feldspar crystals were size-selectively sorted by upward melt flow. This flow-driven crystal sorting (elutriation) and subsequent rapid sinking of aggregates explain the efficient separation of large-volume eruptible magmas in the upper crust.
本研究针对巴西Campo Alegre-Corupá系统提出了“动态晶粥模型”，结合结构分析和热力学模拟，阐明了高硅流纹质岩浆及其互补累积岩的成因。研究表明，正长岩和暗色正长岩代表了在低结晶度（16-33 vol.%）下提取47-80%粒间熔体后形成的硅质-铁镁质累积岩。与需要高结晶度的静态模型不同……

t: Combines textural analysis of cumulate rocks with thermodynamic modeling of upper-crustal fractionation and melt extraction.
结合累积岩的结构分析与上地壳分异及熔体提取的热力学模拟。
Petrological, textural, and geochemical data from syenites, melasyenites, and rhyolites of the Campo Alegre-Corupá system, Brazil.
来自巴西Campo Alegre-Corupá系统的正长岩、暗色正长岩和流纹岩的岩石结构与地球化学数据。
Syenites formed at low crystallinities (~16-33 vol.%) after extracting ~47-80% of interstitial melts, indicating early melt segregation.
正长岩在低结晶度（~16-33 vol.%）下形成，并提取了~47-80%的粒间熔体，表明存在早期熔体分离。
The dynamic sorting process requires relatively high magma fluxes and specific hydraulic conditions to operate efficiently.
动态分选过程需要相对较高的岩浆通量和特定的水力条件才能高效运行。
Proposes early melt segregation in a dynamic reservoir via flow-driven crystal sorting (elutriation) rather than static high-crystallinity extraction.
提出了通过流体驱动晶体分选（淘洗）实现动态储集层早期熔体分离的新机制，而非传统的静态高结晶度提取。

Demonstrated that flow-driven crystal sorting (elutriation) and synneusis enable rapid crystal sinking and melt extraction at low crystallinities.
提出了“动态晶粥模型”，解释了上地壳储集层中早期的晶液分离机制。
确定了正长岩和暗色正长岩是高硅流纹岩流失的互补硅质-铁镁质累积岩。
证明了流体驱动的晶体分选（淘洗）和聚晶作用使晶体在低结晶度下能够快速沉降并提取熔体。

sum: This study investigates the crustal anisotropic velocity structure beneath California using P and PmP traveltime tomography. By constraining the seismic anisotropy of the crust, the authors provide critical insights into the structural properties of the San Andreas Fault system. The resulting anisotropic models reveal localized variations that correlate with fault behavior, specifically highlighting the role of fluids in promoting creeping along the central San Andreas Fault. This work advances our understanding of fault zone rheology and the mechanical behavior of major plate boundaries.

sum: This review paper synthesizes recent insights into oceanic intraplate volcanism, highlighting that most intraplate volcanic processes are not isolated but are deeply influenced by plate tectonics and whole-mantle dynamics. By examining these volcanic systems, the study advances our understanding of global geodynamic processes and mantle-lithosphere interactions.

sum: This study utilizes a dense Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) array in Arcata, California, to investigate meter-scale seismic wavefield complexity and amplification at sedimentary basin edges. By analyzing local earthquake recordings, the researchers resolve a fine-scale shallow velocity model and observe locally scattered surface waves that correlate with basin edges and amplify dynamic strain. Two-dimensional synthetic tests confirm that sharp velocity contrasts at basin edges induce these waves and highlight differences between dynamic strain and ground velocity. The findings are crucial for improving hazard models by capturing localized amplification effects often missed by smoother tomographic models. The novelty lies in using DAS to resolve such fine-scale structures and their impact on dynamic strain.

sum: This study integrates growth-strata architecture, U-Pb geochronology, and provenance analysis from four fault-bounded basins in the central Bangong-Nujiang suture zone. The authors document a northward-propagating contractional system active during ~104-83 Ma, characterized by growth wedges and thrust kinematics rather than rift extension. Provenance shifts from Lhasa-affinity arc sources to recycled Qiangtang basement track the northward advance of deformation. These findings demonstrate a >20 Myr Albian-Santonian contractional basin archive, proving that significant crustal thickening and plateau growth occurred in central Tibet long before the India-Asia collision.

sum: Estimating paleoearthquake magnitudes from geological evidence requires careful treatment of measurement, preservation, and scaling uncertainties. This paper presents PaleoBAYES, a Bayesian inversion method that jointly analyzes field observations of surface rupture length (L), average slip/throw (S), and elapsed time (T). The framework incorporates log-normal empirical scaling relationships, an exponential time-dependent preservation probability, and a Gutenberg-Richter prior. Calibrated against four historical/instrumental earthquakes (1915 Fucino, 2009 Paganica, 2016 Amatrice and Norcia), the optimal model uses Thingbaijam et al. (2017) scaling laws. Applied to 44 paleoevents in the newly compiled PaleoECA_2025 database for the central Apennines (spanning the last ~25 kyr across 13 active faults), the method yields magnitude estimates with 2σ uncertainties mostly between 0.1 and 0.48, reassessing the 1915 Fucino event at Mw 6.76±0.07 and identifying a catalog completeness threshold near Mw 6.4. Both the database and MATLAB software are released for reproducible hazard assessment.

sum: This study performs and validates 3D physics-based numerical simulations of the 2023 Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş earthquake using the spectral element code SPEED up to 1 Hz. To make the results useful for engineering, the low-frequency simulations are enriched to broadband using an artificial neural network-based technique (ANN2BB). The simulated ground motions are validated against recorded data in both time and frequency domains, showing good agreement (residuals below ±0.30) and successfully capturing complex phenomena like directivity, directionality, and basin effects. The study highlights the viability of 3D physics-based frameworks for characterizing strong ground shaking in large-magnitude events, even with sparse instrumentation, while acknowledging the challenges of modeling complex rupture processes.
本研究利用SPEED程序对2023年土耳其Mw 7.8地震进行1Hz内3D物理模拟，并用神经网络拓宽至高频。模拟结果与强震记录拟合良好（残差低于±0.30），成功再现了直达性和盆地效应。研究表明，3D物理模拟能有效表征稀疏观测区的大震地面运动，但也面临简化模型带来的挑战。

A 325 × 355 km numerical domain incorporating the causative fault, crustal velocity profile, and published kinematic rupture models, validated against recorded ground motions.

由于地壳和破裂模型的简化，模拟仍存在偏差，凸显了完全重现大震复杂特征的难度。

High-frequency enrichment using Artificial Neural Networks (ANN2BB).
Quantitative goodness-of-fit validation across multiple intensity measures (IMs).

The paper focuses on simulating and validating broadband ground motions and intensity measures for engineering applications.

sum: This study investigates the uppermost mantle structure beneath the northwestern United States by combining deep-learning phase picking (Seis-PickNet trained on the global Seis-PnSn dataset) with anisotropic Pn travel-time tomography. Using 91,591 Pn rays from 2,053 earthquakes (2019–2023, epicentral distances 2°–12°) recorded at 3,481 stations, the authors achieve a horizontal resolution of 1.25°–1.5°, surpassing earlier models (2°–3°). Results reveal a three-part along-strike segmentation (A1, A2, A3) of Pn velocity and fast-axis directions beneath the Cascadia subduction zone, linked to slab dehydration and episodic tremor and slip (ETS) distributions. Beneath the Yellowstone–Snake River Plain province, the model resolves two discrete low-velocity anomalies separated by a clear magmatic gap, supporting an independent, inclined upwelling conduit beneath Yellowstone rather than a single continuous upper-mantle anomaly. High-velocity anomalies beneath the northern Columbia Plateau and Wyoming Craton reflect Farallon slab remnants and stable cratonic lithosphere.
本研究结合基于全球Seis-PnSn数据集训练的深度学习震相拾取模型（Seis-PickNet）与Pn波走时各向异性层析成像，反演了美国西北部上地幔顶部精细速度与方位各向异性结构。利用2019—2023年间3481个台站记录的2053次地震（震中距2°–12°）共91,591条高密度Pn射线，成像分……

t: The authors apply Seis-PickNet (deep-learning phase picker trained on Seis-PnSn) to extract Pn arrival times, followed by Hearn's (1996) 2-D tomographic method to jointly invert for uppermost-mantle velocity, azimuthal anisotropy, and station/event delays.
利用Seis-PickNet深度学习模型拾取Pn到时，并采用Hearn (1996)二维层析成像联合反演上地幔顶部速度、…

Vertical-component waveforms from M ≥ 3.5 earthquakes (2019–2023, epicentral distances 2°–12°) yielded 94,446 Pn picks; after quality filtering, 91,591 rays from 2,053 events and 3,481 stations were inverted.
筛选2019–2023年M≥3.5、震中距2°–12°的地震波形，经质控后最终使用2053次事件、3481个台站的91,…

Checkerboard tests demonstrate 1.25°–1.5° resolution. Cascadia exhibits three-segment velocity and anisotropy variations (A1–A3), while Yellowstone (B2) and the Snake River Plain (B1) show two separate low-velocity zones divided by a magmatic gap.
分辨率达1.25°–1.5°；揭示卡斯卡迪亚速度和各向异性的三段式分段特征，以及黄石与蛇河平原之间独立的低速异常与岩浆间…
Event delay terms are contaminated by focal depth and hypocentral location errors, and 2-D Pn rays restricted to ≤12° only sample the uppermost mantle without resolving deeper vertical structure.
事件延迟项受震源深度和定位误差干扰，且二维Pn成像仅约束上地幔顶部而缺乏垂向深度分辨率。

Using an independent deep-learning-picked dataset restricted to 2°–12°, the study resolves Cascadia's 3-segment Pn anisotropy and separates the Yellowstone anomaly from the Snake River Plain, unlike earlier continuous models.
借助全新高密度深度学习拾取数据，首次在Pn成像中清晰分离出黄石独立低速体及卡斯卡迪亚三段式各向异性。

kc: Constructed an independent 2019–2023 Pn travel-time dataset (94,446 picks, 91,591 inverted rays) for the northwestern US using the Seis-PickNet deep-learning picker.
Improved uppermost mantle Pn velocity and azimuthal anisotropy resolution in the northwestern US to 1.25° × 1.25°–1.5° × 1.5° (compared to 2°–3° in earlier studies).
Revealed clear three-segment along-strike variations in Pn velocity and fast directions beneath Cascadia, correlating low-velocity thermal/fluid zones (A1, A3) with high ETS frequency.
Resolved an independent low-velocity anomaly beneath Yellowstone separated by a gap from the Snake River Plain anomaly, supporting an inclined trans-lithospheric magma conduit model.
利用深度学习模型Seis-PickNet构建了美国西北部2019–2023年全新的高精Pn走时数据集（94,446个拾取，91,591条反演射线）。
将美国西北部上地幔顶部Pn速度与各向异性成像分辨率提升至1.25°×1.25°–1.5°×1.5°（优于前人的2°–3°）。
揭示了卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带下方Pn速度与快波方向的三段式沿走向分段特征，发现低速热/流体异常区（A1、A3）与慢滑移（ETS）高频发生区对应。
清晰分辨出黄石火山与蛇河平原下方相互独立的两个低速异常区及中间的岩浆间断，支持黄石下方存在独立的倾斜穿岩石圈上涌通道。
me: Deep-learning Pn arrival picking using Seis-PickNet (PickNet architecture retrained on ~1.3 million Pn/Sn labels from the global Seis-PnSn dataset) on 3200-sample vertical-component windows.
Quality control via a 0.95 probability threshold, random sampling with manual review, and epicentral distance filtering (2°–12°).

2-D anisotropic Pn travel-time tomography following Hearn (1996) on a 20' × 20' grid, jointly inverting for slowness perturbations, 2φ azimuthal anisotropy parameters (Ak, Bk), and station/event delays with damping factors of 250.
使用在全球Seis-PnSn数据集（约130万条Pn/Sn标签）上重新训练的Seis-PickNet模型，对3200采样点的垂直分量波形进行Pn震相拾取。
采用0.95概率阈值、随机抽样加人工复核以及2°–12°震中距筛选进行严格的数据质量控制。
基于Hearn (1996)算法在20'×20'网格上进行二维各向异性Pn走时层析成像，联合反演慢度扰动、2φ方位各向异性参数及台站/事件延迟项（阻尼因子均为250）。
de: USGS earthquake catalog events (M ≥ 3.5) from January 1, 2019 to December 31, 2023 within 30°N–60°N and 135°W–95°W.
Final tomographic dataset of 91,591 rays from 2,053 events recorded at 3,481 stations across 95 seismic networks (minimum 5 stations per event and 5 events per station, residual threshold ±5 s).
Checkerboard resolution tests with ±0.3 km/s sinusoidal velocity and orthogonal anisotropy perturbations at 1.5° × 1.5° and 1.25° × 1.25° grid scales.
收集USGS目录中2019年1月1日至2023年12月31日期间研究区（30°N–60°N，135°W–95°W）内M≥3.5的地震事件。
最终反演数据集包含95个台网3481个台站记录的2053次地震共91,591条射线（要求每事件至少5台站、每台站至少5事件，走时残差阈值±5 s）。
开展了1.5°×1.5°和1.25°×1.25°网格尺度的速度和正交各向异性（扰动幅值0.3 km/s）检测板分辨率测试。
li: 2-D Pn tomography assumes horizontal propagation in the uppermost mantle and cannot resolve vertical layering or deeper mantle depth variations directly.
Event delay terms absorb trade-offs from earthquake focal depth and hypocentral location errors, making event delay patterns complex.
Trade-offs between velocity heterogeneity and azimuthal anisotropy exist in regions with less uniform back-azimuthal ray coverage near the model edges.
二维Pn层析成像假设射线沿上地幔顶部水平传播，无法直接分辨垂向分层结构或更深部地幔的变化。
事件延迟项受震源深度和定位误差的折衷影响，导致事件延迟分布较为复杂。
在模型边缘等反方位角射线覆盖不够均匀的区域，速度非均匀性与方位各向异性之间可能存在折衷。

tm.why: The paper performs Pn-wave travel-time tomography to invert for 2-D velocity and azimuthal anisotropy in the uppermost mantle beneath the northwestern United States.
Azimuthal anisotropy of Pn waves is jointly inverted with velocity, revealing along-strike segmentation in fast directions beneath Cascadia and SW-NE alignment beneath the Snake River Plain.
The authors apply a retrained deep-learning phase-picking model (Seis-PickNet trained on the Seis-PnSn dataset) to extract 94,446 high-precision Pn arrival times from 2019–2023 regional waveforms.

sum: This study evaluates the upper-crustal stress and strain fields in the San Salvador Metropolitan Area (SSMA) and its flanking volcanic edifices, the San Salvador volcano (SSV) and Ilopango caldera (IC). Using a refined catalog of 178 focal mechanisms (1965–2021) grouped into 12 clusters, the authors apply Iterative Linear Stress Inversion (ILSI) and Kostrov moment tensor summation, alongside strain analysis of 18 GNSS horizontal velocity vectors via SSPX. Results show a dominant transcurrent regime in the SSMA governed by regional stress (NW-SE σ1 at 147°, NE-SW σ3 at 237°). However, SSV and IC exhibit local stress rotations attributed to magmatic bodies and volcanic loading. GNSS strain maps indicate NE-SW extension (up to 0.35 μstrain/yr) and E-W right-lateral shear (up to 0.51 μstrain/yr). The novelty lies in resolving local volcano-tectonic stress perturbations within the San Salvador extensional stepover for seismic hazard assessment.
本研究评估了圣萨尔瓦多都会区（SSMA）及两侧圣萨尔瓦多火山（SSV）和伊洛潘戈破火山口（IC）的地壳应力与应变场。作者利用1965–2021年间178个震源机制解（分为12个簇），采用迭代线性应力反演（ILSI）和Kostrov矩张量求和，并结合18个GNSS水平速度矢量进行应变分析。结果表明，S……

t: Deviatoric stress tensors are inverted from clustered focal mechanisms using Iterative Linear Stress Inversion (ILSI), complemented by Kostrov moment tensor summation and nearest-neighbor geodetic strain calculation in SSPX.
利用ILSI对聚类震源机制进行偏应力反演，结合Kostrov矩张量求和与SSPX最近邻大地测量应变计算。
A quality-filtered database of 178 earthquake focal mechanisms (2.0–5.7 Ml, 1965–2021) divided into 12 clusters, plus 18 horizontal GNSS velocity vectors from 2007–2012 campaigns.
The regional transcurrent stress regime has σ1 at 147° and σ3 at 237° (R = 0.26). GNSS strain reveals NE-SW extension (0.20–0.35 μstrain/yr) and E-W right-lateral shear (0.37–0.51 μstrain/yr).
区域走滑应力场σ1为147°、σ3为237°（R=0.26）；GNSS显示NE-SW伸展（0.20–0.35）和E-W右…
Sparse GNSS station coverage over the limited study area restricts interpreting dilation rates in terms of crustal thinning or thickening.
研究区GNSS站点覆盖稀疏，限制了利用膨胀率解释地壳减薄或增厚。

First detailed local assessment integrating focal mechanism stress inversion and geodetic strain in the San Salvador Metropolitan Area, explicitly resolving stress perturbations at flanking volcanic edifices.
首次结合震源机制反演与GNSS应变精细评估圣萨尔瓦多都会区，揭示了两侧火山机构的局部应力扰动。

kc: Derived high-resolution tectonic stress and seismic strain maps for the San Salvador Metropolitan Area from 178 focal mechanisms.
Identified local stress rotations at San Salvador volcano and Ilopango caldera caused by magmatic bodies and volcanic edifice loading.
Quantified interseismic strain rates from GNSS velocities, showing NE-SW extension (0.20–0.35 μstrain/yr) and E-W right-lateral shear (up to 0.51 μstrain/yr).
Demonstrated that destructive SSMA earthquakes likely originate on deeper fault planes oriented 20°–45° to σ1 rather than mapped NW-SE shallow extensional fractures.
利用178个震源机制解获得了圣萨尔瓦多都会区高分辨率的构造应力和地震应变图。
识别出圣萨尔瓦多火山和伊洛潘戈破火山口由岩浆体和火山机构载荷引起的局部应力旋转。
基于GNSS速度量化了震间应变率，显示NE-SW向伸展（0.20–0.35 μstrain/yr）和E-W向右旋剪切（高达0.51 μstrain/yr）。
证明圣萨尔瓦多破坏性地震可能源于与σ1呈20°–45°夹角的深部断层面，而非已测绘的NW-SE向浅表张性裂隙。
me: Time-domain waveform inversion for seismic moment tensors using SeisComP modules (SCAUTOMT and SCMTV).
Clustering of 178 focal mechanisms into 12 families based on sequence, rupture type, and geographic proximity.
Deviatoric stress tensor inversion using the Iterative Linear Stress Inversion (ILSI) Python package.
Seismic strain tensor calculation via moment tensor summation following Kostrov (1974) and Kiratzi and Papazachos (1995).
Geodetic strain rate and dilation mapping from 2D GNSS velocities using the nearest-neighbor grid method in SSPX software.
使用SeisComP模块（SCAUTOMT和SCMTV）进行时域波形反演以获取地震矩张量。
根据地震序列、破裂类型和地理邻近性将178个震源机制解聚类为12个簇。
使用迭代线性应力反演（ILSI）Python软件包反演偏应力张量。
基于Kostrov (1974)和Kiratzi and Papazachos (1995)的矩张量求和法计算地震应变张量。
使用SSPX软件中的最近邻网格法，由二维GNSS速度计算大地测量应变率和膨胀率图。
de: Refined catalog of 178 earthquake focal mechanisms (2.0 to 5.7 Ml, depths <25 km) from the 1965–2021 MARN catalog, including 91 events from the April–May 2017 sequence.
Horizontal GNSS velocity vectors from 18 ZFESNet stations across four campaigns (2007, 2008, 2010, and 2012) referenced to a fixed Caribbean plate.
来自1965–2021年MARN目录的178个精选震源机制解（震级2.0至5.7 Ml，深度<25 km），包含2017年4–5月序列的91个事件。
相对于固定加勒比板块参考框架的18个ZFESNet测站四期（2007、2008、2010和2012年）GNSS水平速度矢量。
li: Poor spatial coverage of the GNSS network (18 stations) and limited area covered restrict detailed interpretations of crustal thinning and thickening from dilation rates.
Limited quality and small number of focal mechanisms at the San Salvador volcano (Quality C clusters with 3–4 events) prevent clear definition of local volcanic strain.
GNSS网络空间覆盖不足（仅18个站点）且覆盖区域有限，限制了根据膨胀率对地壳减薄和增厚进行详细解释。
圣萨尔瓦多火山处震源机制解数量少且质量有限（C级簇仅3–4个事件），无法清晰界定火山局部应变特征。

tm.why: The paper assesses the upper-crustal tectonic stress state, strain rates, and geodynamic interplay in the Central American Volcanic Arc.
It specifically investigates local stress rotations and strain anomalies associated with the San Salvador volcano and Ilopango caldera.
The core methodology relies on clustering and inverting 178 earthquake focal mechanisms and summing seismic moment tensors to determine rupture styles and stress.

sum: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) measures axial strain, requiring conversion to particle velocity for traditional seismic and engineering applications. This study evaluates three conversion methods—fk-rescaling, curvelet-based conversion, and slant-stack—using a novel high-energy, near-field active-source dataset from Sherman Island, California. Wavefields from an explosive transmission tower collapse and sledgehammer shots were recorded across a 1.4 km DAS array collocated with 71 3C nodal stations. Using 63 DAS-nodal pairs, performance was quantified via amplitude and phase transfer functions and RMSE across 0.5–100 Hz, 1–10 Hz, and 10–100 Hz bands. Results demonstrate that fk-rescaling delivers the most accurate and stable amplitude response across both sources, while fk-rescaling and slant-stack provide the best phase agreement. Curvelet conversion exhibited higher RMSE and 25x slower runtime. Amplitude accuracy degrades above 10–40 Hz due to gauge-length averaging and coupling variations, whereas phase accuracy improves at higher frequencies.
分布式声学传感（DAS）测量轴向应变，需转换为质点速度以对接传统地震与工程指标。本文利用加州谢尔曼岛高能近场主动源数据集（含输电塔爆破倒塌与大锤敲击），评估了fk重缩放、曲波变换和倾斜叠加三种转换方法。数据由1.4公里DAS阵列与71个并置三分量节点站同步记录。基于63对数据，通过0.5–100 H……

t: Evaluates fk-rescaling, curvelet-based decomposition, and semblance-based slant-stack strain-to-velocity conversion methods implemented in DASPy, tuning parameters via sensitivity analysis and quantifying accuracy using amplitude and phase transfer function RMSEs.
基于DASPy评估fk重缩放、曲波变换和倾斜叠加法，通过敏感性分析调参并计算传递函数RMSE。

Active-source seismic wavefields from a controlled transmission tower collapse and sledgehammer blows recorded on a 1.4 km buried DAS array and 71 collocated 3C nodal stations at Sherman Island, California.
加州谢尔曼岛1.4公里埋置DAS阵列与71台并置三分量节点站记录的输电塔倒塌和大锤主动源数据。
fk-rescaling achieves the lowest median log-amplitude RMSE (0.235–0.345 in 1–10 Hz, 0.504–0.798 in 10–100 Hz) and phase RMSE of 25–52° (1–10 Hz) and 23–45° (10–100 Hz) across 63 DAS-nodal pairs.
fk重缩放法表现最佳，1–10 Hz对数振幅RMSE中位数为0.235–0.345，高频相位RMSE为23–45°。
Conversion performance depends heavily on input parameters tuned using collocated reference sensors, and high-frequency amplitudes suffer from gauge-length spatial averaging and coupling variations.
转换结果高度依赖参考传感器调参，且高频振幅受标距空间平均和耦合差异影响显著退化。
First systematic, multi-frequency benchmark of DAS strain-to-velocity conversion methods on high-energy, near-field active-source datasets using 63 collocated 3C nodal stations.
首次利用63对并置节点站，在高能近场主动源数据集上系统开展了多频段DAS应变转速度基准评估。

kc: Provides a unique high-energy, near-field active-source benchmark dataset (transmission tower collapse and sledgehammer impacts) recorded on a 1.4 km DAS cable and 71 collocated nodal stations.

Quantitatively benchmarks fk-rescaling, curvelet-based, and slant-stack strain-to-velocity conversion methods across multiple frequency bands (0.5–100 Hz, 1–10 Hz, 10–100 Hz) using amplitude and phase transfer functions.
Demonstrates that fk-rescaling is the most robust and computationally efficient method for linear active-source arrays, achieving median amplitude ratios of 1.7–2.2 in the 1–10 Hz band.
提供了由1.4公里DAS光缆和71个并置节点站记录的独特高能近场主动源基准数据集（输电塔倒塌与大锤冲击）。
利用振幅和相位传递函数，在多个频段（0.5–100 Hz、1–10 Hz、10–100 Hz）定量评估了fk重缩放、曲波变换和倾斜叠加三种应变转速度方法。
证明了fk重缩放是线性主动源阵列最稳健且计算高效的方法，在1–10 Hz频段内中位振幅比误差为1.7至2.2倍。
me: fk-rescaling in the frequency-wavenumber domain using apparent Rayleigh wave phase velocities guided by MASW dispersion curves.
Curvelet-based decomposition scaling localized directional wavefield packets by their median apparent phase velocities in the f-k domain.
Time-slowness domain slant-stack conversion estimating continuous local apparent phase slowness via semblance analysis over sliding spatial apertures.
Frequency-domain evaluation using logarithmic amplitude RMSE and degree-based phase RMSE derived from Fourier transfer functions between DAS and rotated in-line nodal velocity records.

sum: Decades of potash extraction at the Starobin deposit in Belarus have induced over 1,500 seismic events along tectonic fault junctions. Because local mining subsidence masks slow regional fault deformation and dense GPS networks are costly, this study tests Persistent Scatterer Interferometry (PSI) using 12 Sentinel-1 SAR scenes (Dec 2020–Nov 2021) processed via the open-source SNAP–StaMPS pipeline. Comparison with two reference GPS stations (~5 mm/yr southwest horizontal displacement) revealed a systematic LOS velocity overestimation factor of K_scale ≈ 11.5 in SNAP–StaMPS. Taking advantage of the near-collinear alignment between the ascending radar look direction and fault block motion, the authors introduce a simplified multiplicative calibration without full 3D decomposition, yielding corrected LOS velocities of 2.61 mm/yr. Ascending tracks capture regional horizontal tectonic block motion, whereas descending tracks isolate vertical technogenic subsidence, indicating a sinistral strike-slip fault zone with southern block uplift.

sum: This paper presents a spatially resolved methodology that integrates deep learning (DL) fault segmentation with grid-based rose diagram analysis to map local variations in fault strike and geomechanical stress/strain proxies. By partitioning a 3D DL-generated fault probability volume into grid cells, converting voxels to vector lineaments, and generating localized rose diagrams, the workflow produces an interpolated dominant-strike heatmap. Applied to the Groningen field, this approach successfully isolates secondary conjugate fault networks and compartment-scale structural rotations that are typically obscured by traditional global rose diagrams. Replacing standard coherence and curvature attributes with binary DL fault volumes yields cleaner, more geologically accurate geomechanical stress maps, providing a powerful diagnostic tool for reservoir compartmentalization, permeability anisotropy, and depletion-induced seismic hazard assessment.

sum: Full waveform inversion (FWI) suffers from ill-posedness, nonlinearity, and cycle skipping when starting models lack low-wavenumber accuracy or illumination is poor. Classical regularizers like Tikhonov and total variation (TV) impose rigid smoothness or blocky constraints that fail to capture realistic geology. This paper evaluates three training-free strategies to couple a pretrained unconditional diffusion generative model (trained on 45,000 100x100 GeoFWI velocity patches) inside an acoustic PDE-constrained FWI loop: Manifold-Preserving Guided Diffusion (MPGD), SDEdit initialization, and Split Gibbs Diffusion Sampling (SGDS). By alternating deterministic wave-equation likelihood updates with single-step Tweedie diffusion denoising, SGDS acts like a projected-gradient scheme onto a learned geological manifold. Across held-out GeoFWI models (layers, faults, salt), patch-transferred Marmousi and Overthrust benchmarks, noisy data tests, and a Sigsbee2A salt workflow stress test, SGDS consistently improves PSNR and SSIM over L2 and TV-regularized FWI while preserving physical data consistency.

sum: This study investigates the influence of crustal rheology on long-term topographic growth and seismicity patterns in the eastern Tibetan Plateau. Using geodynamic numerical modeling, the authors evaluate how variations in crustal strength, particularly the presence of a weak lower crustal channel versus a strong crust, control the deformation style, uplift rates, and stress accumulation along the Longmenshan fault zone. The results demonstrate that crustal rheology is a primary driver of both the steep topographic gradient and the characteristic earthquake behavior in this collision zone, providing insights into the mechanical coupling between deep geodynamics and surface processes.
本研究探讨了青藏高原东缘地壳流变学对长期地形生长和地震活动模式的影响。作者利用地球动力学数值模拟，评估了地壳强度变化（特别是弱下地壳流与强地壳的对比）如何控制龙门山断裂带的变形样式、隆升速率和应力积累。结果表明，地壳流变学是该碰撞带陡峭地形梯度和特征地震行为的主要驱动因素，揭示了深部动力学与表层过程……
