sum: Conventional passive image interferometry monitors subsurface velocity changes by cross-correlating continuous ambient noise to retrieve time-domain Green's functions, which is computationally heavy and susceptible to biases from varying noise source spectra. This study introduces Ambient Noise Spectroscopy, transferring coda wave interferometry into the spectral domain. By high-pass filtering and normalizing amplitude spectra or cross-spectra of short noise segments, the smooth source envelope is separated from rapid spectral fluctuations caused by multiply scattered coda waves. Stretching of these fluctuations directly yields relative velocity changes (dv/v = df/f) without inverse Fourier transforms or pairwise correlation storage. The method is validated using synthetic tests and field datasets from Kilauea volcano (tracking inter-eruptive changes despite gliding tremor, plus local and teleseismic P-wave co-seismic drops), northern Chile (0.4% co-seismic drop), and Nepal (monsoon groundwater variations), offering a lightweight solution ideal for edge computing and DAS.
传统被动成像干涉法需对连续环境噪声进行互相关以提取时域格林函数，计算量大且易受噪声源频谱变化引起的偏差影响。本文提出“环境噪声光谱法”，将尾波干涉拓展至频域。通过对短时噪声段的振幅谱或互谱进行高通滤波与归一化，可将平滑的震源包络与多次散射尾波产生的快速谱起伏分离。直接测量谱起伏的拉伸即可获得相对波速……

t: Extracts rapid fluctuations from ambient noise amplitude or cross-spectra via high-pass filtering and envelope normalization, then applies spectral stretching (df/f = dv/v) to measure velocity changes without inverse Fourier transforms.
通过高通滤波和包络归一化提取噪声振幅谱或互谱的快速起伏，直接利用频谱拉伸测量波速变化。
Evaluated on 1D synthetic scattering seismograms and continuous ambient noise from HV.WRM at Kilauea volcano, the 7F/CX array in northern Chile, and station XN.NEP10 in Nepal.
采用一维合成散射记录，以及基拉韦厄火山、智利北部台阵和尼泊尔台站的连续环境噪声数据。

Successfully isolates >1% inter-eruptive velocity changes from gliding tremor at Kilauea, detects 1% local and teleseismic P-wave co-seismic velocity drops, a 0.4% drop in Chile, and seasonal hydrological variations in Nepal.
成功分离火山颤动滑移与>1%波速变化，捕捉到1%远震P波同震下降、智利0.4%下降及尼泊尔季风变化。

Narrow-band resonant sources or homogeneous, weakly scattering media prevent separating source and medium effects; spatially heterogeneous velocity changes with distant sources require source-averaged cross-spectra.
窄带共振源或弱散射均匀介质会阻碍震源与路径分离；非均匀变化需用互谱。

Monitors subsurface velocity changes directly from continuous ambient noise amplitude or cross-spectra without correlation or inverse Fourier transforms, eliminating source-spectrum bias and drastically reducing compute and storage.
无需互相关和逆傅里叶变换，直接从噪声频谱无偏测量波速变化，大幅降低计算与存储成本。

kc: Formulates Coda Wave Interferometry in the spectral domain, showing that stretching the phase spectrum or the high-pass filtered fluctuating amplitude spectrum eliminates bias from changing source spectra.

Proposes Ambient Noise Spectroscopy to measure dv/v directly from single-channel noise amplitude spectra or multi-channel cross-spectra without inverse Fourier transforms to time-domain Green's functions.
Demonstrates separation of simultaneous volcanic tremor frequency gliding and subsurface velocity changes (>1%) during the 2025 Kilauea eruptive sequence.
Reports the first observation of a co-seismic seismic velocity drop at Kilauea induced by teleseismic P-waves from the 609 km deep Mw 8.3 Sea of Okhotsk earthquake.
Establishes the theoretical link between spectral correlation bandwidth, coda duration, and medium heterogeneity via radiative transfer theory.
构建了频域尾波干涉理论，证明拉伸相位谱或高通滤波后的起伏振幅谱可消除震源频谱变化带来的测量偏差。
提出环境噪声光谱法，无需逆傅里叶变换提取时域格林函数，直接从单通道噪声振幅谱或多通道互谱中测量dv/v。
在2025年基拉韦厄火山喷发序列中，成功将火山颤动主频滑移与超过1%的地下波速变化分离。
首次观测到由609公里深Mw 8.3鄂霍次克海远震P波引起的基拉韦厄火山同震波速下降。
基于辐射传输理论建立了频谱相关带宽、尾波持续时间与介质非均匀性之间的理论联系。
me: Frequency-domain stretching equivalence (dv/v = -dτ/τ = df/f) applied to complex, phase, and amplitude spectra.
Zero-padding time series prior to FFT to upsample and interpolate rapidly wrapping phase spectra.
High-pass filtering of amplitude/cross-spectra (in inverse frequency, Hz^-1) and geometric-mean envelope normalization to isolate path-induced spectral fluctuations from smooth source spectra.
Direct spectrogram stretching on short-window (e.g., 25–100 s) ambient noise amplitude spectra or ensemble-averaged cross-spectra.
将频域拉伸等价关系（dv/v = -dτ/τ = df/f）应用于复频谱、相位谱和振幅谱。
在快速傅里叶变换（FFT）前对时间序列进行补零，以对快速缠绕的相位谱进行上采样和插值。
对振幅谱/互谱进行逆频率域（Hz^-1）高通滤波及几何平均包络归一化，将路径散射引起的谱起伏与平滑震源谱分离。
直接对短时窗（如25–100秒）环境噪声振幅谱或系综平均互谱的时频图进行拉伸测量。
de: 1D synthetic coda model convolving a random delta-function reflectivity sequence (-5% velocity change) with a Ricker-like source wavelet (-50% frequency shift).
Continuous 3-component seismic records from station HV.WRM at Kilauea volcano (January 2025 inter-eruptive episode, May 2025 Ml 2.8 local earthquake, and May 2013 Mw 8.3 Sea of Okhotsk teleseism).
Local 9-station array (network 7F) and permanent IPOC station CX.PATCX in the Atacama Desert, northern Chile, during a Mw 6.2 earthquake at 150 km distance.
Multi-year continuous seismic records (2015–2018) from station XN.NEP10 next to the Bhote Koshi river in Nepal across dry and monsoon seasons.
一维合成尾波模型：将随机δ函数反射率序列（-5%波速变化）与震源子波（-50%频率偏移）进行褶积。
基拉韦厄火山HV.WRM台站连续三分量地震记录（2025年1月喷发间歇期、2025年5月Ml 2.8近震及2013年5月Mw 8.3鄂霍次克海深源远震）。
智利北部阿塔卡马沙漠9台站局部台阵（7F台网）及IPOC永久台站CX.PATCX在150公里外Mw 6.2地震期间的记录。

li: Requires the source time function's autocorrelation to be much shorter than the coda duration; narrow-band resonant sources or homogeneous, weakly scattering media impede separating source and path effects.

Single-station amplitude spectrum monitoring assumes spatially homogeneous velocity changes between noise sources and receivers; spatially heterogeneous changes with distant sources require source-averaged cross-spectra.
Spectral whitening preprocessing cannot be used because it destroys the amplitude fluctuations required by the spectroscopic method.
要求震源时间函数的自相关远短于尾波持续时间；窄带共振震源或均匀弱散射介质会阻碍震源与路径效应的分离。
单台振幅谱监测假设噪声源与接收器间的波速变化空间均匀；远场噪声源下的空间非均匀波速变化需使用震源平均互谱。
不能使用谱白化预处理，因为它会破坏光谱法所需的振幅谱快速起伏信息。

tm.why: The paper develops Ambient Noise Spectroscopy as a direct frequency-domain alternative to ambient noise cross-correlation and passive image interferometry.
The method relies on rapid spectral fluctuations generated by multiply scattered coda waves in heterogeneous media and links them to radiative transfer theory.
The method is demonstrated on eruptive and co-seismic changes at Kilauea volcano, earthquake damage in the Atacama desert, and monsoon hydrological cycles in Nepal.

ev.notes: Full 15-page preprint PDF (accepted at Geophysical Journal International, doi:10.1093/gji/ggag333) was read and analyzed in detail, including all equations, 11 figures, and 1 table.

sum: Standard elastic models used to infer fault locking depths from interseismic geodetic data assume time-invariant deformation, often yielding unphysically deep locking depths late in the earthquake cycle. This study proposes replacing the classic elastic dislocation model with Savage and Prescott's (1978) analytical viscoelastic model for strike-slip faults, balancing time-dependent physical realism with operational simplicity. Using Sentinel-1 InSAR velocity profiles across the Altyn Tagh Fault (ATF) and finite-element simulations, the authors address four practical complications: (1) quantifying trade-offs between recurrence interval and elapsed time, reducing inferred ATF locking depths from ~40 km (elastic) to realistic 8–20 km values; (2) deriving an empirical scaling relation to model across-fault rigidity contrasts without numerical modeling; (3) establishing a mechanics-based procedure to incorporate steady shallow creep via the creep-to-locked depth ratio; and (4) correcting for postseismic transients from nearby earthquakes.
传统弹性位错模型假设震间形变不随时间变化，常导致地震周期晚期的断层闭锁深度被严重高估。本文提出利用Savage和Prescott（1978）的解析粘弹性模型替代弹性模型，在保持简便性的同时考虑时间演化。结合阿尔金断裂带的Sentinel-1 InSAR速率剖面与有限元模拟，作者解决了四个实际问题：（……

t: Replaces the 2-D elastic dislocation model with Savage and Prescott's (1978) analytical viscoelastic model (elastic layer over Maxwell substrate), augmented with FEM-derived empirical scaling for across-fault rigidity contrasts and shallow creep.
用Savage和Prescott（1978）解析粘弹性模型替代二维弹性模型，结合有限元推导刚度比缩放与浅部蠕滑流程。

Sentinel-1 InSAR fault-crossing surface velocity profiles (2014–2019) along the Altyn Tagh Fault at 82.5°E, 84°E, 88.5°E, and 90°E from Shen et al. (2024), alongside 2-D finite-element synthetic benchmarks.

Viscoelastic modeling reduces Altyn Tagh Fault locking depths from unphysical elastic estimates of 40 km to realistic values of 8–20 km (e.g., 11 km at 88.5°E, 13 km at 90°E, and 17 km at 82.5°E after postseismic correction).
粘弹性模型将阿尔金断裂闭锁深度从弹性估计的40 km降至合理的8–20 km（如88.5°E处11 km，90°E处13…
The 2-D analytical model assumes an infinite fault length and distant boundaries, which can bias far-field deformation for faults with strong geometric complexity or finite strike lengths.
二维模型假设断层无限长，对于几何复杂或走向有限的断层可能需要三维粘弹性模型。

Adapts an analytical viscoelastic model to practically handle across-fault stiffness contrasts, leaky-stress-shadow shallow creep, and postseismic transients without requiring complex numerical modeling.
在不依赖复杂数值模拟的前提下，利用解析粘弹性模型解决了刚度差异、浅部蠕滑和震后瞬态改正难题。

kc: Demonstrates how replacing the 2-D elastic dislocation model with Savage and Prescott's (1978) analytical viscoelastic model avoids unphysically deep geodetic locking depth estimates on long-recurrence strike-slip faults.
Maps the trade-off between earthquake recurrence interval (T) and elapsed time (t) to bound locking depth uncertainties when paleoseismic constraints are incomplete.

Derives a finite-element-calibrated empirical scaling relationship that enables the laterally homogeneous analytical viscoelastic model to fit asymmetric velocity profiles caused by across-fault stiffness contrasts.

Establishes a mechanics-based three-step workflow to incorporate steady-state shallow fault creep based on the ratio of creep zone width to locked zone width (d/W), and corrects for postseismic transients from nearby earthquakes.
证明了用Savage和Prescott（1978）的解析粘弹性模型替代二维弹性位错模型，可避免长复发周期走滑断层出现不切实际的超深闭锁深度估计。
绘制了地震复发周期（T）与已逝时间（t）之间的折衷关系图，用于在古地震约束不足时评估闭锁深度的不确定性。
结合有限元模拟推导出经验缩放关系，使横向均匀的解析粘弹性模型能够拟合由断层两侧刚度差异引起的不对称形变剖面。

me: 2-D analytical viscoelastic earthquake-cycle modeling (Savage and Prescott, 1978) featuring an elastic upper layer over a linear Maxwell viscoelastic substrate.
2-D finite-element modeling (FEM) to benchmark analytical solutions and investigate across-fault rigidity contrasts, steady shallow creep, and elastic layer thickness greater than locking depth.
Empirical velocity and wavelength scaling to approximate across-fault rigidity contrasts within a laterally homogeneous analytical viscoelastic framework.
Superposition of viscoelastic interseismic locking models with elastic shallow creep solutions and 3-D rectangular-rupture postseismic viscoelastic relaxation models.
采用二维解析粘弹性地震周期模型（Savage and Prescott, 1978），包含弹性上覆层与线性Maxwell粘弹性基底。
利用二维有限元模型（FEM）检验解析解，并研究断层两侧刚度对比、稳态浅部蠕滑及弹性层厚度大于闭锁深度的影响。
通过经验速率与波长缩放方法，在横向均匀的解析粘弹性框架内近似模拟断层两侧的刚度差异。
将粘弹性震间闭锁模型与弹性浅部蠕滑解以及邻近地震的震后粘弹性松弛模型进行叠加。
de: Sentinel-1 InSAR fault-parallel velocity profiles (2014–2019) across multiple segments of the Altyn Tagh Fault (82.5°E, 84°E, 88.5°E, and 90°E) from Shen et al. (2024).
Synthetic interseismic surface velocity tests comparing classic elastic inversions against true viscoelastic models across varying recurrence intervals and cycle stages.
Postseismic perturbation modeling of the 2014 Mw 6.9 Yutian earthquake along the western Altyn Tagh Fault.
采用Shen等（2024）发表的2014–2019年Sentinel-1 InSAR跨越阿尔金断裂带多个段落（82.5°E、84°E、88.5°E和90°E）的断层平行速率剖面。
开展合成震间地表速率实验，对比不同复发周期和周期阶段下传统弹性反演与真实粘弹性模型的差异。
对阿尔金断裂带西段2014年Mw 6.9于田地震的震后扰动效应进行建模与修正。
li: Requires independent constraints on earthquake recurrence interval (T), elapsed time (t), and Maxwell relaxation time (τM), introducing parameter trade-offs.
Relies on 2-D infinite-fault geometry and a simple linear Maxwell rheology, neglecting 3-D fault complexity, transient Burgers rheology, and nonlinear power-law flow.
Assumes the locked zone extends through the entire elastic layer (Dv = H) in the baseline analytical model.
需要独立约束地震复发周期（T）、已逝时间（t）和Maxwell松弛时间（τM），存在参数折衷。

tm.why: The paper focuses on estimating fault locking depths, interseismic deformation, viscoelastic earthquake cycles, and steady-state shallow creep along strike-slip faults.
The study models viscoelastic relaxation in the lower crust and upper mantle and investigates across-fault lithospheric rigidity contrasts between the Tarim Basin and Tibetan Plateau.
Inferring accurate fault locking depth determines the downdip width of the seismogenic zone, which is fundamental to seismic hazard assessment.

sum: Magnetotelluric (MT) surveys frequently detect high electrical conductivity anomalies (0.01–1 S/m) along trans-lithospheric shear zones, the origin of which remains debated. Using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations on a forsterite bicrystal model (5,470 atoms) at 2 GPa and 1,300–1,700 K, this study quantifies ionic diffusivity and electrical conductivity at hydrogen-bearing grain boundaries (H-GBs). Results reveal that H+ diffusivity along grain boundaries exceeds lattice diffusivity by 4–5 orders of magnitude, establishing protons as the dominant charge carrier. Incorporating H-GBs into a cubic composite model increases bulk olivine conductivity by roughly two orders of magnitude compared to dry conditions. Extrapolated to realistic mylonitic shear zone conditions (900–1,200 K, grain sizes 10–200 μm), calculated conductivities quantitatively match MT observations worldwide. The novelty lies in directly modeling solid-state H-GB electrical transport atomistically, confirming trans-lithospheric shear zones as efficient pathways for deep volatile migration.
大地电磁（MT）探测常在穿岩石圈剪切带发现高导异常（0.01–1 S/m），但其成因尚存争议。本研究利用分子动力学（MD）模拟了2 GPa和1300–1700 K条件下镁橄榄石双晶模型（5470个原子），量化了含氢晶界（H-GB）的离子扩散率与电导率。结果表明晶界处H+扩散率比晶格高4–5个数量级，……

t: Classical molecular dynamics simulations in LAMMPS on a hydrous forsterite bicrystal model compute ionic self-diffusivities via Mean Squared Displacement, grain boundary conductivity via the Nernst-Einstein relation, and bulk rock conductivity using a cubic grain model.
利用LAMMPS对含水镁橄榄石双晶进行分子动力学模拟，结合Nernst-Einstein关系与立方体模型计算扩散率与电导…
Simulated trajectories of a 5,470-atom forsterite bicrystal system with 20 H atoms substituting 10 Mg atoms at the grain boundary, equilibrated and run for 300 ps at 2 GPa from 1,300 to 1,700 K.
5470个原子的镁橄榄石双晶系统（晶界含20个H原子）在2 GPa、1300–1700 K下的300 ps模拟轨迹。

H+ grain boundary diffusivity is ~5 orders of magnitude faster than lattice diffusivity with lower activation energy (123 vs. 210 kJ/mol), elevating bulk olivine conductivity by two orders of magnitude and matching MT observations (0.003–0.05 S/m).
晶界H+扩散率比晶格快约5个数量级，活化能降至123 kJ/mol，使体电导率提高两个数量级并与MT观测吻合。

Application to geological shear zones (<1,200 K) requires extrapolating high-temperature MD Arrhenius parameters (1,300–1,700 K), and slow lattice diffusivities (<10^-15 m2/s) could not be extracted directly from MD.
需将高温模拟参数外推至低于1200 K的地质温度，且晶格扩散过慢无法直接从模拟中提取。

First molecular dynamics study to directly quantify the electrical transport behavior of solid-state, hydrogen-bearing grain boundaries in olivine and link it to macroscopic MT conductivity anomalies.
首次利用分子动力学直接量化固态含氢橄榄石晶界的电输运性质，并解释宏观大地电磁高导异常。

kc: Demonstrated via MD simulations that H+ diffusivity at forsterite grain boundaries exceeds lattice diffusivity by 4–5 orders of magnitude with reduced activation energy (123 vs. 210 kJ/mol).
Showed that hydrogen-bearing grain boundaries increase bulk polycrystalline olivine conductivity by two orders of magnitude relative to anhydrous aggregates.
Quantitatively reproduced magnetotelluric high-conductivity anomalies (0.01–1 S/m) in trans-lithospheric shear zones for realistic mylonitic grain sizes (10–200 μm).
通过分子动力学模拟证明镁橄榄石晶界处的H+扩散率比晶格高4–5个数量级，且活化能显著降低（123 vs. 210 kJ/mol）。
表明含氢晶界使多晶橄榄石的体电导率相对于无水集合体提高了两个数量级。
在真实糜棱岩粒径（10–200 μm）条件下，定量重现了穿岩石圈剪切带的大地电磁高导异常（0.01–1 S/m）。
me: Constructed a forsterite bicrystal supercell using Atomsk and replaced 10 Mg atoms with 20 H atoms at the grain boundary to maintain charge balance.
Performed classical molecular dynamics simulations in LAMMPS using rigid-ion Morse, Lennard-Jones, and PPPM Coulombic potentials at 2 GPa and 1,300–1,700 K.

Computed ionic self-diffusivities from Mean Squared Displacement (Kubo relation), grain boundary conductivity via the Nernst-Einstein equation, and bulk aggregate conductivity using Waff's cubic model.
使用Atomsk构建镁橄榄石双晶超胞，并在晶界处用20个H原子替换10个Mg原子以保持电荷平衡。
在2 GPa和1300–1700 K条件下，利用LAMMPS软件采用刚性离子Morse、Lennard-Jones及PPPM库仑势进行经典分子动力学模拟。
基于均方位移（Kubo关系）计算离子自扩散系数，利用Nernst-Einstein方程计算晶界电导率，并通过Waff立方体模型计算集合体体电导率。
de: Atomistic MD trajectories (300 ps production runs) of a 5,470-atom hydrous forsterite bicrystal system across temperatures from 1,300 to 1,700 K at 50 K intervals.
Comparative experimental diffusion and conductivity datasets from literature (e.g., San Carlos olivine, dry peridotite, and regional MT anomaly surveys).

sum: Hydrothermal explosions in volcanic geothermal fields pose significant hazards because they typically lack identifiable precursors. This study analyzes continuous vertical-component seismic records from 15 temporary and permanent stations around Mutnovsky Volcano, Kamchatka, between September 2023 and March 2024 using the network covariance matrix approach. Complemented by Landsat and Sentinel satellite imagery, the authors refined the timing of two hydrothermal explosion episodes near Well No. 22 of the Mutnovsky Geothermal Power Plant to February 16–19 and March 2–7, 2024. Spectral width and eigenvector back-projection revealed a coherent seismic tremor in the 1.5–5 Hz band starting on February 6, 2024, about 10 days before the initial explosion. Hypocenters clustered beneath the northeastern volcano flank at depths down to 6 km. This represents the first documented seismic precursor to hydrothermal explosions at Mutnovsky, likely driven by magmatic fluid influx perturbing the hydrothermal system.
火山地热田中的水热爆炸通常缺乏明显前兆，极具危险性。本研究利用台网协方差矩阵方法，分析了2023年9月至2024年3月堪察加穆特诺夫斯基火山周围15个地震台的连续垂直分量记录，并结合卫星影像将地热电站22号井附近的两次水热爆炸时间精确限定在2024年2月16–19日和3月2–7日。谱宽度与特征向量反……

First documented observation of a seismic tremor precursor (10-day lead time) to hydrothermal explosions in the Mutnovsky geothermal field, missed by the sparse permanent network alone.

sum: Young oceanic lithosphere flexes as axial topography decays across mid-ocean ridge shoulders, yet the global expression of this deformation remained poorly constrained. This study analyzes 50 across-axis bathymetric profiles from 21 global regions spanning slow to fast spreading rates, identifying 1,201 abyssal-hill-bounding fault scarps. By regressing cumulative fault heave against off-axis distance on either side of the ridge shoulder and correcting for a ~0.02 apparent shortening bias caused by sedimentation and mass wasting, the authors isolate flexural strain. Three global regimes emerge: (1) axial-valley ridges record shortening that increases with axial relief; (2) fast-spreading axial-high ridges record extension scaling with relief; and (3) slow-to-intermediate axial-high ridges exhibit negligible flexural strain due to thicker axial lithosphere and weaker accretional curvature. A simple analytical flexural model reproduces these first-order trends, demonstrating that lithospheric unbending systematically modifies fault-generated seafloor morphology worldwide.
年轻大洋岩石圈在越过洋中脊肩部时会发生挠曲，但其全球表现尚不明确。本研究分析了全球21个区域（涵盖慢速至快速扩张）的50条跨轴水深剖面，识别出1,201个深海丘陵边界断层陡坎。通过分段回归累积断层水平断距并校正沉积与块体流失造成的约0.02视缩短偏差，提取了岩石圈挠曲应变。研究揭示了三种机制：(1)……

After removing a -0.02 surface-process bias, axial-valley ridges show flexural shortening scaling with axial relief, fast-spreading axial-high ridges show extension scaling with relief, and slow-to-intermediate axial-high ridges cluster near zero strain.
校正-0.02地表过程偏差后，轴谷型表现为随起伏增加的缩短，快速轴隆型表现为伸展，慢-中速轴隆型接近零应变。

Ultraslow-spreading ridges and oceanic core complexes were excluded, and a uniform -0.02 surface-process correction was applied globally despite potential regional variations in spreading rate and sediment supply.
排除了超慢速扩张脊和大洋核杂岩，且忽略沉积速率的区域差异，在全球采用了统一的-0.02地表退化校正。

Extends quantitative ridge-shoulder flexural strain estimation from isolated segments to a global 50-profile synthesis, revealing three distinct tectonic regimes controlled jointly by axial relief and axial lithospheric thickness.
将洋中脊肩部挠曲应变定量估计扩展至全球50条剖面，揭示了由轴部起伏和岩石圈厚度共同控制的三种全球应变机制。

Demonstrated that axial relief governs the sign and magnitude of flexural strain while axial lithospheric thickness controls inherited accretional curvature.

sum: This paper presents the 'Symmetric Nearest Neighbor' method, an advancement over conventional nearest-neighbor earthquake catalog declustering techniques. By incorporating the proximity of an event to subsequent earthquakes (rather than just preceding ones), the method achieves a more balanced and physically consistent identification of earthquake clusters and background seismicity. The authors provide the code, example runs, and catalogs used in Zhang & Houston (2026) to demonstrate the utility of this symmetric approach in statistical seismology.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of estimating moment magnitudes (Mw) for small regional earthquakes (Mw < 3.5), which are typically converted from other scales, introducing bias in seismic hazard analysis. The authors apply a spectral modeling framework to Sg waves recorded at 10–300 km distances for 25,712 earthquakes in Utah between 2001 and 2025. They successfully determine high-quality Mw for 16,173 events (63% of the dataset), ranging from 0.54 to 5.54. This increases the number of Utah earthquakes with direct Mw measurements by a factor of ~170. The resulting catalog has a completeness magnitude of 2.2 and a b-value of 1.14. This automated, near-real-time capable method provides a robust dataset for analyzing spatial-temporal b-value variations and crustal stress.

sum: This study analyzes an Mw 2.8 aftershock of the 2021 Mw 6.0 Yangbi earthquake using a dense nodal array. Through empirical Green's function analysis, the authors identify double-peaked apparent source time functions and non-Brune spectra. A Bayesian two-subevent inversion resolves two distinct patches (radii of 88 and 65 m) separated by 176 m, with an effective transfer speed of 4.0 km/s, exceeding the local shear-wave velocity. Dynamic rupture simulations demonstrate that P-wave stress perturbations from the first patch triggered the second critically stressed patch before the S-wave arrival. This provides strong evidence for cascading, two-asperity rupture with supershear transfer in small earthquakes, highlighting persistent fine-scale heterogeneity within the mainshock rupture zone.

sum: Global marine full-tensor gravity-gradient (FTGG) products with high spatial resolution remain scarce. This study recovers a global marine FTGG dataset from Level-2 sea surface height observations acquired by the Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) wide-swath altimetry mission (44 cycles). Using a remove-compute-restore framework, multi-cycle median stacking, and two-stage cross-track phase-error correction, the vertical gravity gradient (Tzz) is derived first. The remaining five tensor components (Txx, Tyy, Txy, Txz, Tyz) are reconstructed via Fourier-domain relations for a harmonic potential field using overlapping 5°×5° local Cartesian blocks with 1° buffers, followed by restoring EGM2008 reference fields. Compared against the independent CUGB2023GRAD model, global mean differences are negligible and root-mean-square differences range from 2.49 to 6.13 Eötvös. The novel SWOT-derived FTGG model preserves short-wavelength directional gravity signals across ridges, trenches, fracture zones, and seamounts, supporting bathymetric inversion and lithospheric studies.
本研究利用SWOT宽幅卫星测高44个周期的海面高数据，构建了全球高分辨率海洋全张量重力梯度（FTGG）模型。方法上采用“移去-计算-恢复”策略、多周期中值叠加及两步跨轨误差校正提取垂直重力梯度（Tzz），随后在带1°缓冲区的5°×5°局部笛卡尔分块内利用调和位场傅里叶谱关系重建其余5个张量分量，并恢……

t: Combines multi-cycle median stacking, two-stage cross-track error correction, and remove-compute-restore residual VGG estimation with buffered 5°×5° local Cartesian FFT spectral transformation to reconstruct all six FTGG components.
结合多周期中值叠加、两步跨轨误差校正、移去-恢复残差VGG估计及带缓冲区的5°×5°局部平面FFT谱变换重建6个分量。
Uses SWOT Level-2 Low-Rate Expert SSH observations from 26 July 2023 to 22 January 2026 (44 cycles, 584 passes), alongside SIO v32.1, EGM2008, CNES-CLS2022 MDT, and CUGB2023GRAD.

Global comparison against CUGB2023GRAD shows negligible mean differences (-0.0015 to 0.0734 E) and RMSDs from 2.4893 E (Txy) to 6.1310 E (Tzz), with regional RMSDs mostly below 5.23 E and up to 8.3022 E.
与CUGB2023GRAD相比全球均值差极小（-0.0015至0.0734 E），RMSD为2.4893至6.1310 …

Lacks a global independent reference FTGG field for absolute accuracy validation, and short-wavelength signals remain sensitive to residual SSH, MDT, phase errors, and local planar FFT approximations.

Extends SWOT 2D wide-swath altimetry gravity recovery from scalar vertical gravity gradient (Tzz) to the complete six-component full-tensor gravity gradient model at global scale.
首次将SWOT二维宽幅测高重力反演从单一垂直分量扩展至全球完整的六分量全张量重力梯度模型。

Combines multi-cycle median stacking, two-stage cross-track bias/phase-screen correction, remove-compute-restore, and buffered 5°×5° block-wise FFT spectral reconstruction.
Evaluates all six tensor components globally and across seven representative tectonic regions against the CUGB2023GRAD model, demonstrating global RMSDs of 2.49–6.13 E.
基于SWOT宽幅卫星测高数据构建了新的全球海洋全张量重力梯度（FTGG）数据集并公开了配套代码。

Multi-cycle median stacking of 2-km-spaced along-track and cross-track geoid slopes, coupled with two-stage cross-track bias and phase-screen error corrections and a 6-km low-pass filter.

Fourier-domain harmonic potential transfer functions applied within overlapping 7°×7° local planar blocks (5°×5° retained core plus 1° buffer) to reconstruct Txx, Tyy, Txy, Txz, and Tyz from Tzz, restoring EGM2008 long-wavelength fields.
基于SIO v32.1垂线偏差和CNES-CLS2022平均动力地形的“移去-计算-恢复”流程计算残差垂直重力梯度（VGG）。

de: SWOT Level-2 Low-Rate Expert sea surface height (SSH) products spanning 26 July 2023 to 22 January 2026 (44 repeat cycles, 584 orbital passes).
Auxiliary and reference models: SIO v32.1 deflections of the vertical and VGG, CNES-CLS2022 Mean Dynamic Topography, and EGM2008 spherical harmonic gravity model.

Global and regional validation experiments across seven tectonic zones (Charlie-Gibbs Fracture Zone, Mid-Atlantic Ridge, Ninety East Ridge, South China Sea, Mariana Trench, Hawaiian-Emperor Seamount Chain, Peru-Chile Trench) benchmarked against CUGB2023GRAD.

辅助与参考模型：SIO v32.1垂线偏差与垂直重力梯度模型、CNES-CLS2022平均动力地形模型以及EGM2008球谐重力场模型。
以CUGB2023GRAD为基准，在全球尺度及7个代表性构造区（查理-吉布斯断裂带、大西洋中脊、东经九十度海岭、南海、马里亚纳海沟、夏威夷-皇帝海山链、秘鲁-智利海沟）开展对比验证实验。

Short-wavelength gravity gradient signals remain sensitive to residual SSH errors, MDT uncertainties, and noise amplification during spatial differentiation and spectral transformation.

缺乏全球分布的独立实测FTGG基准场，因此评估仅反映模型间的一致性而非绝对精度。

sum: This dataset presents global geothermal heat flow (GHF) predictions generated using machine learning models. Crucially, it includes comprehensive uncertainty quantification, detailing model uncertainty, spatial uncertainty, and total prediction uncertainty. It serves as a companion to a publication on optimizing feature selection for GHF prediction, providing researchers with a reliable, spatially continuous global heat flow map with robust error bounds for geodynamic and thermal modeling.
该数据集提供了基于机器学习预测的全球地热流（GHF）数据。其核心创新点在于不仅提供了预测值，还量化并提供了模型不确定性、空间不确定性以及总预测不确定性。该数据集作为相关学术论文的补充，旨在通过优化特征选择来提高全球地热流预测的准确性，为地球动力学和热力学模拟提供具有可靠误差范围的全球地热流分布参考。

sum: This paper introduces the Albuquerque Seismological Laboratory (ASL) digitizer test suite, a publicly available Java-based software package designed to verify the performance and data integrity of seismic digitizers. While comprehensive testing (e.g., by Sandia National Laboratories) is resource-intensive, this suite focuses on a non-exhaustive yet highly efficient set of tests. It estimates key parameters such as sensitivity, timing accuracy, self-noise, clip levels, and signal fidelity. The primary novelty lies in providing a practical, open-source tool that allows seismic network operators to routinely identify common digitizer failures and ensure high-quality data before deployment, using a minimal amount of external equipment.
本文介绍了阿尔伯克基地震实验室（ASL）数传测试套件，这是一个开源的Java软件，旨在验证地震数传器的性能和数据完整性。虽然全面的仪器测试非常耗费资源，但该套件专注于一套高效且非详尽的测试方法，可评估灵敏度、授时精度、自噪声、剪切电平和信号保真度等关键参数。其核心创新在于为地震台网运营者提供了一个实……

sum: This study investigates the nucleation process of the 2018 Ms 4.8 and 5.2 Chengduo doublet in China. By performing high-resolution earthquake detection, relocation, focal mechanism inversion, and repeating earthquake analysis, the authors identified 638 events (3.4 times the standard catalog). The foreshocks and the Ms 4.8 mainshock occurred on a previously unmapped, near-vertical NEE-SWW trending fault. The foreshock sequence progressed in two distinct stages. Significant spatial overlap of rupture patches and the identification of two repeating earthquake groups indicate the occurrence of aseismic slip. Concurrently, stress perturbation analysis shows some large foreshocks occurred in areas of increased stress, suggesting stress transfer also played a role. The findings suggest that the doublet's nucleation was governed by a hybrid mechanism combining aseismic preslip and cascade stress triggering.
本研究剖析了2018年青海称多双震的孕育过程。通过地震检测、重定位、震源机制反演及重复地震识别，获取了高精度目录。结果显示，前震与主震发生于同一条未编图的近垂直断层。前震破裂区显著重叠并伴有重复地震，表明存在无震滑动；部分大前震位于应力增加区，表明存在应力传递。该双震孕育受无震预滑与级联应力触发共同……

t: Earthquake detection, relocation, focal mechanism inversion, rupture dimension estimation, stress perturbation analysis, and repeating earthquake identification.
结合地震检测、重定位、震源机制反演、应力扰动及重复地震识别的多方法联合分析。

记录2018年5月中国称多Ms 4.8和5.2级双震序列的地震波形数据。

检测到638个地震，揭示了受无震预滑和应力传递共同驱动的两阶段前震序列。
The physical evidence for aseismic slip is inferred indirectly from repeating earthquakes and rupture patch overlap rather than direct geodetic observations.
无震滑动的物理证据是通过重复地震和破裂重叠间接推断的，缺乏直接的大地测量观测。
Demonstrates a hybrid nucleation process combining both aseismic preslip and cascade stress triggering for the 2018 Chengduo doublet.
证实了2018年称多双震是由无震预滑和级联应力触发共同作用的混合孕育过程。

sum: Bayesian formulations of the Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) model using Gaussian Process (GP) priors flexibly estimate spatial background seismicity and quantify uncertainties, but struggle with large catalogs due to dense covariance matrices. This paper introduces SPDE-ETAS, which models the spatial background rate within a Log-Gaussian Cox Process (LGCP) driven by a Gaussian Markov Random Field (GMRF). By solving a Stochastic Partial Differential Equation (SPDE) on an adaptive triangular mesh via the finite element method (FEM), the dense GP covariance is replaced by a sparse precision matrix, with the GMRF posterior evaluated via Laplace approximation inside a blockwise MCMC scheme. Validated on synthetic catalogs (area-like and fault-like sources), SPDE-ETAS significantly reduces computation time and memory compared to GP-ETAS while improving small-scale spatial accuracy over KDE-ETAS and GP-ETAS. Applied to 14,802 Mw >= 3.0 Italian earthquakes (1980-2025), it recovers background rates matching the MPS19 seismic hazard map in ~5 hours.
基于高斯过程（GP）先验的贝叶斯震后余震序列（ETAS）模型受制于稠密协方差矩阵，难以处理大型地震目录。本文提出SPDE-ETAS方法，在对数高斯Cox过程（LGCP）框架下，利用自适应三角网格有限元法求解随机偏微分方程（SPDE），构建具有稀疏精度矩阵的高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF），结合拉普拉斯……

t: Replaces dense Gaussian Process covariances in Bayesian ETAS with a sparse Gaussian Markov Random Field precision matrix obtained by solving a Stochastic Partial Differential Equation via finite elements on a triangular mesh, inferred using Laplace approximation and blockwise MCMC.
利用三角网格有限元法求解SPDE构建稀疏GMRF精度矩阵，结合拉普拉斯近似和分块MCMC进行贝叶斯ETAS推断。

Evaluated on three synthetic suites (area source with 1,458 events, fault-like stripes with 965 events, and 11 scaling catalogs up to 5,200 events) and applied to 14,802 Mw >= 3.0 earthquakes (1980–2025) from the Italian HORUS catalog.
采用三组合成地震目录（最高5200个事件）及意大利HORUS目录1980-2025年间14,802个Mw>=3.0事件。

SPDE-ETAS is substantially faster and uses far less memory than GP-ETAS while achieving higher log-likelihood accuracy in high-seismicity zones. On the 14,802-event Italian catalog, Bayesian inference completes in ~5 hours and matches the MPS19 hazard map.
计算速度和内存显著优于GP-ETAS，高背景率区精度更高；意大利目录耗时约5小时，结果与MPS19危险性图吻合。

The recursive FEM precision matrix construction restricts the fractional exponent alpha to integer smoothing values, and the model omits time-varying background rates, short-term aftershock incompleteness, and anisotropic triggering kernels.
精度矩阵递归构建限制平滑参数α须为整数，且未考虑时变背景率、短期目录不完整性和各向异性触发核。

First integration of the SPDE-GMRF finite-element approximation and Laplace approximation into a latent-branching Bayesian ETAS model, enabling scalable non-parametric background seismicity inference on catalogs exceeding 10,000 events.
首次将SPDE-GMRF有限元与拉普拉斯近似引入潜在分支贝叶斯ETAS，实现超万级地震目录的高效非参数推断。

kc: Formulates the SPDE-ETAS model combining a latent branching ETAS structure with a Log-Gaussian Cox Process (LGCP) and Gaussian Markov Random Field (GMRF) prior.
Uses finite element discretization on an adaptive triangular mesh and Laplace approximation to achieve a sparse precision matrix, drastically reducing runtime and memory usage compared to GP-ETAS.
Demonstrates superior recovery of fine-scale fault-like background seismicity and robust uncertainty quantification across three synthetic benchmarks.
Applies SPDE-ETAS to 14,802 events (Mw >= 3.0) from the Italian HORUS catalog (1980-2025) in ~5 hours, aligning well with the MPS19 seismic hazard map.
提出了结合潜在分支ETAS结构与对数高斯Cox过程（LGCP）及高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF）先验的SPDE-ETAS模型。
利用自适应三角网格有限元离散和拉普拉斯近似构建稀疏精度矩阵，相比GP-ETAS大幅降低了运行时间和内存消耗。
通过三个合成基准测试，证明了该方法在恢复精细断层状背景地震活动率和稳健不确定性量化方面的优越性。
将SPDE-ETAS应用于意大利HORUS目录（1980-2025年，14,802个Mw>=3.0事件），在约5小时内完成推断，结果与MPS19地震危险性图高度吻合。
me: Stochastic Partial Differential Equation (SPDE) linking Matérn Gaussian Random Fields to Gaussian Markov Random Fields (GMRFs) with sparse precision matrices.
Finite Element Method (FEM) discretization on an adaptive 2D triangular mesh with piecewise linear basis functions.
Blockwise Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling updating the latent branching structure, LGCP background field (via Laplace approximation), and triggering parameters.
Benchmarking against semi-parametric Gaussian Process ETAS (GP-ETAS) and variable-bandwidth Kernel Density Estimation ETAS (KDE-ETAS).
利用随机偏微分方程（SPDE）将Matérn高斯随机场转化为具有稀疏精度矩阵的高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF）。
在二维自适应三角网格上采用分片线性基函数进行有限元法（FEM）离散。
采用分块马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样，依次更新潜在分支结构、LGCP背景场（通过拉普拉斯近似）和触发参数。
与半参数高斯过程ETAS（GP-ETAS）和可变带宽核密度估计ETAS（KDE-ETAS）进行对比基准测试。
de: Synthetic Test 1 (Area-like source): 1,458 events over 1,000 days in a 5x5 degree domain with two rectangular background rate zones.
Synthetic Test 2 (Fault-like sources): 965 events over 1,000 days featuring three narrow elongated high-rate stripes representing fault zones.
Synthetic Test 3 (Scaling benchmark): 11 synthetic catalogs ranging from 185 to 5,200 events tested on a 20-core Intel Xeon Gold 5115 cluster node.
Real-data case study: 14,802 complete events (Mw >= 3.0, 1980-2025) selected from the 514,465-event Italian HORUS catalog (1960-2025).
合成测试1（面源）：在5x5度区域内生成1000天共1458个事件，包含两个不同背景率的矩形区域。
合成测试2（断层源）：生成1000天共965个事件，包含代表断层带的三条狭长高背景率条带。
合成测试3（扩展性基准测试）：在20核Intel Xeon Gold 5115集群节点上测试11个规模从185到5200个事件的合成目录。
实际数据案例研究：从意大利HORUS目录（1960-2025年共514,465个事件）中选取1980-2025年间14,802个完整事件（Mw >= 3.0）。
li: The recursive precision matrix construction requires the fractional power parameter alpha to be an integer, constraining the analysis to integer smoothing values only.
The current model assumes a stationary spatial background rate and does not account for temporal variations driven by aseismic transients or swarms.
Short-term catalog incompleteness after mainshocks and anisotropic spatial triggering kernels along faults are not yet incorporated.
递归精度矩阵构建要求分数幂参数α为整数，限制了分析只能采用整数平滑值。
当前模型假设空间背景率平稳，未考虑无震瞬变或震群引起的时间变化。
尚未纳入主震后的短期目录不完整性以及沿断层的各向异性空间触发核。

tm.why: The paper develops a fast Bayesian inference framework using SPDE, GMRFs, and Laplace approximation to quantify parameter and background seismicity uncertainties in the ETAS model.
The method models space-time-magnitude earthquake catalogs using point processes to probabilistically decluster catalogs into background and triggered events.
The estimated stationary background seismicity and its uncertainty for the Italian catalog are directly compared against the Italian seismic hazard map MPS19 for hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Full 15-page PDF including appendices, equations, figures, and tables was analyzed.

sum: Due to the lack of modern M6+ interface recordings in the Cascadia Subduction Zone (CSZ), testing earthquake early warning (EEW) systems requires synthetic data. This study presents the first comprehensive validation framework for EEW-oriented simulations, generating 112 M6.6–9.4 kinematic rupture scenarios and broadband/GNSS waveforms across 191 onshore and offshore sites using the 1D semi-stochastic FakeQuakes code. The authors modified FakeQuakes' attenuation and geometric spreading relations and combined synthetic signals with empirical seismic and synthetic geodetic noise. Validation against empirical scaling laws and ground-motion models (NGA-Sub, GA21) demonstrates realistic STA/LTA detection rates (79% for EPIC, 99% for ONC-EW), P-wave displacement (Pd) scaling, peak ground displacement (PGD), PGA, PGV, and MMI distributions. Offline testing of six scenarios on ShakeAlert's EPIC and Ocean Networks Canada's ONC-EW algorithms highlights EPIC's expected magnitude saturation above M7 and demonstrates the value of joint seismic-geodetic processing.
针对卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带缺乏大地震观测记录的问题，本文提出了首个面向地震预警（EEW）的合成数据验证框架。研究利用改进了衰减关系的1D半随机程序FakeQuakes，生成了112个M6.6–9.4运动学破裂情景及191个台站的宽频带与GNSS波形，并叠加了真实地震噪声和合成大地测量噪声。通过对比经验标度……

t: Generates 1D deterministic low-frequency (<1 Hz) and stochastic high-frequency (>1 Hz) waveforms using FakeQuakes, joined via a two-frequency matched Butterworth filter and updated with crustal ray paths, R^-1.2 spreading, and elastic attenuation Qc=150.
利用FakeQuakes生成1D低频确定性和高频随机波形，采用双频匹配滤波，并改进地壳射线、几何扩散和弹性衰减。

112 synthetic M6.6–9.4 Cascadia kinematic ruptures simulated at 191 stations (157 coastal broadband/strong-motion, 29 collocated GNSS/strong-motion, 5 offshore cabled OBS), combined with real seismic noise and synthetic GNSS noise.
112个M6.6–9.4卡斯卡迪亚破裂情景在191个台站的合成宽频带和GNSS波形，叠加真实地震和合成GNSS噪声。
STA/LTA triggered on 79% (EPIC) and 99% (ONC-EW) of records, with 84% and 69% having arrival residuals <0.5 s. PGA/PGV residuals match NGA-Sub within uncertainty up to ~700–800 km.
EPIC和ONC-EW的STA/LTA触发率达79%和99%，84%和69%残差<0.5秒；700-800 km内PGA…
1D velocity models neglect 3D propagation and local site response, and offline EEW tests used a subset of stations and only six events without finite-fault algorithms like FinDer.
1D速度模型忽略了3D传播和场地响应；离线测试仅使用部分台站和6个震例，未测试FinDer。

First published validation framework specifically evaluating synthetic broadband and geodetic waveforms across all core EEW metrics (detection, magnitude, ground motion) and testing them in Cascadia EEW algorithms.
首个针对地震预警核心指标（检测、震级、地震动）全面验证合成地震与大地测量波形并开展离线测试的框架。

kc: Generated an open-access dataset of 112 M6.6–9.4 kinematic rupture scenarios and noise-padded broadband seismic and high-rate GNSS waveforms for 191 Cascadia stations.
Established a three-part EEW validation framework assessing STA/LTA P-wave detection, Pd and PGD magnitude scaling, and ground-motion intensities (PGA, PGV, MMI).
Improved high-frequency FakeQuakes simulations by restricting direct arrivals to crustal rays, adjusting geometric spreading to R^-1.2, and adding an elastic attenuation term (Qc = 150).
Evaluated ShakeAlert EPIC and ONC-EW offline performance on six M7–9 scenarios, confirming point-source saturation in EPIC and improved large-magnitude resolution in ONC-EW.
生成并公开了包含112个M6.6–9.4运动学破裂情景及191个卡斯卡迪亚台站加噪宽频带地震与高频GNSS波形的数据集。
建立了包含STA/LTA触发检测、Pd与PGD震级标度以及地震动强度（PGA、PGV、MMI）的三部分地震预警验证框架。
通过仅考虑地壳直达波射线、将几何扩散调整为R^-1.2以及引入弹性衰减项（Qc = 150），改进了FakeQuakes高频地震动模拟。
评估了ShakeAlert EPIC和ONC-EW在6个M7–9情景下的离线表现，证实了EPIC的点源震级饱和及ONC-EW对大震震级解析的改善。
me: 1D semi-stochastic broadband and deterministic 2 Hz GNSS waveform modeling using FakeQuakes (MudPy) with a two-frequency matched Butterworth filter (0.1 Hz highpass, 1 Hz lowpass).
Code modifications to FakeQuakes path attenuation: restricting direct arrivals to crustal rays, setting geometric spreading to 1/R^1.2, and incorporating elastic scattering attenuation Qc = 150.
Waveform post-processing by adding real screened onshore/offshore background seismic noise from IRIS and 10th, 50th, and 90th percentile synthetic GNSS noise.
Validation against ObsPy STA/LTA triggers (with 3-component polarization filtering for ONC-EW), Trugman et al. (2019) Pd scaling, Goldberg et al. (2021) PGD GMM, and NGA-Sub PGA/PGV GMM.
Offline performance testing of ShakeAlert EPIC and ONC-EW algorithms across six selected M7.1–9.4 scenarios.
使用FakeQuakes（MudPy）结合双频匹配巴特沃斯滤波器（0.1 Hz高通，1 Hz低通）进行1D半随机宽频带和确定性2 Hz GNSS波形建模。
修改FakeQuakes路径衰减代码：将直达波限制为地壳射线，几何扩散设为1/R^1.2，并引入弹性散射衰减项Qc = 150。
波形后处理：叠加从IRIS获取的陆地与海底真实背景地震噪声，以及第10、50和90百分位的合成GNSS噪声。
结合ObsPy STA/LTA触发器（ONC-EW含三分量极化滤波）、Pd标度律、PGD模型以及NGA-Sub PGA/PGV地震动模型进行全面验证。
针对6个选定的M7.1–9.4震例，开展ShakeAlert EPIC和ONC-EW算法的离线性能测试。
de: 112 simulated kinematic rupture models (M6.6–9.4) on the Slab2 Cascadia Subduction Zone geometry.
Synthetic broadband and strong-motion waveforms at 157 PNSN coastal Washington/Oregon sites, 29 collocated GNSS/strong-motion ONC sites on Vancouver Island, and 5 NEPTUNE offshore cabled OBS sites.
Real background acceleration noise from 3 ONC onshore stations (AL2H, CMBR, PHRD) and 5 NEPTUNE offshore stations downloaded from IRIS.
Offline EEW replay experiments on 6 rupture scenarios (Scenarios 15, 18, 51, 65, 96, 108) spanning M7.1 to M9.4.
基于Slab2卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带几何模型生成的112个运动学破裂模型（M6.6–9.4）。
157个PNSN华盛顿/俄勒冈沿海台站、29个温哥华岛同址GNSS/强震ONC台站以及5个NEPTUNE海底有线台站的合成宽频带和强震波形。
从IRIS下载的3个ONC陆地台站（AL2H、CMBR、PHRD）和5个NEPTUNE海底台站的真实背景加速度噪声数据。
针对跨越M7.1至M9.4的6个破裂情景（情景15、18、51、65、96、108）开展的离线地震预警回放实验。
li: The 1D velocity model cannot capture complex 3D subduction zone wave propagation effects or near-surface free-field soil response.
The two-frequency matched filter adds excess spectral energy outside the spectral dip bounds for smaller magnitude events, reducing apparent Pd saturation at 20 s windows.
Offline EEW tests were restricted to a partial station network and only six single-event scenarios, omitting finite-fault algorithms like FinDer and multi-event foreshock/aftershock sequences.
1D速度模型无法捕捉复杂的3D俯冲带波传播效应以及近地表自由场地土壤响应。
双频匹配滤波器为较小震级事件在频谱凹陷范围外增加了额外的能量，降低了20秒时间窗下的表观Pd饱和度。
离线预警测试仅限于部分台网和6个独立震例，未包含FinDer等有限断层算法以及前震/余震多事件序列。

tm.why: The paper develops a validation framework for synthetic strong ground motion and geodetic waveforms to evaluate Earthquake Early Warning (EEW) performance and intensity metrics (PGA, PGV, MMI).
A core part of the validation evaluates real-time STA/LTA earthquake detection triggers, P-wave arrival time residuals, and offline epicenter location accuracy.
The study generates 112 kinematic slip models (M6.6–9.4) for the Cascadia Subduction Zone using stochastic rupture scaling laws and evaluates source characterization algorithms.

ev.notes: Evaluated full 18-page PDF article including abstract, methodology, equations, all 10 figures, and offline EEW performance test results.

sum: Smoothness-constrained inversions of electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) and seismic refraction tomography (SRT) often obscure sharp geological faults. This study introduces a joint inversion workflow combining a layer-based model parameterization (LBMP)—explicitly representing horizontal layers offset by a fault—with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and adaptive unstructured meshing. By initializing multiple runs with random fault geometries, the method generates an ensemble of equally plausible models to assess structural uncertainty, optionally followed by geometry-preserving smoothness-constrained refinement. Tested on a three-layer synthetic normal-fault model and field data across a granite/sediment fault contact in the Paris Basin, the workflow narrows shallow fault locations to within a few meters. Incorporating simulated borehole constraints progressively improves parameter recovery, though opposite fault dips (normal vs. reverse) can yield comparable data misfits. The novelty lies in extending LBMP-PSO to explicit fault parameterization and ERT-SRT joint inversion to guide targeted ground-truthing.
常规平滑约束的电阻率层析成像（ERT）和地震折射层析成像（SRT）反演常模糊尖锐的断层边界。本研究提出一种联合反演流程，将显式包含断层错动层状结构的层基模型参数化（LBMP）与粒子群优化（PSO）及自适应非结构化网格相结合，并可进一步耦合保持几何形态的平滑约束反演。通过随机初始断层几何的多次独立反演……

t: Combines a layer-based model parameterization (LBMP) explicitly representing a fault and horizontal layers with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and adaptive unstructured meshing to jointly invert collocated 2-D ERT and SRT data.
将显式表征断层与水平层的层基参数化（LBMP）与粒子群优化（PSO）结合，对ERT和SRT数据进行自适应网格联合反演。
Evaluated on a 3-layer synthetic model with an 8 m normal fault (96 collocated sensors, 2 m spacing) and field ERT/SRT profiles across a granite/sediment fault in the Paris Basin, France.
采用含8米正断层的三层合成模型（96个共点传感器）及法国巴黎盆地花岗岩/沉积物断层实测ERT/SRT数据。

Adding interface depth constraints from one and two sides increases models resolving fault geometry within tolerance from 11% to 15% and 23%; field hybrid inversion achieves <8% misfits and locates the fault within 275–300 m.
引入单侧和双侧界面约束使断层位置达标率从11%升至15%和23%；实测数据将断层定位于275–300米处。
High computational cost (~20 hours per field inversion run on a single core) and persistent non-uniqueness where opposite fault dips yield comparable misfits.
计算成本高（单核单次运行约20小时），且存在正逆断层倾向相反但拟合差相近的多解性。
Extends layer-based PSO inversion to explicitly parameterize sharp fault discontinuities in joint ERT-SRT inversion, generating ensembles of plausible structural scenarios to guide ground-truthing.
将LBMP-PSO拓展至显式包含断层的ERT-SRT联合反演，通过生成模型集合量化结构不确定性以指导验证。

kc: Developed a layer-based model parameterization (LBMP) explicitly incorporating a geological fault and horizontal layers for joint ERT and SRT inversion using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO).
Implemented adaptive unstructured triangular mesh generation (via pyGIMLi/Triangle) that accommodates non-coincident ERT and SRT sensor layouts and refines along faults and interfaces.

Proposed an ensemble-based uncertainty analysis across multiple stochastic PSO runs and trade-off weighting schemes, combined with a two-step hybrid strategy fixing shallow heterogeneity and applying geometry-preserving smooth inversion.
开发了显式包含地质断层与水平层状结构的层基模型参数化（LBMP），结合粒子群优化（PSO）实现ERT与SRT联合反演。
实现了基于pyGIMLi/Triangle的自适应非结构化三角网格生成策略，支持非重合的ERT与SRT观测系统并在断层和界面处局部加密。
提出了基于多次随机PSO运行与不同权重方案的模型集合不确定性分析，以及固定浅表异质性并结合保几何平滑反演的两步混合策略。
me: Layer-based model parameterization (LBMP) with 6(n_i + 1) parameters representing fault surface/bottom nodes, layer interface depths, P-wave velocities, and electrical resistivities.
Global optimization via Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) minimizing a weighted sum of relative linear SRT travel-time misfit and logarithmic ERT apparent resistivity misfit.
Hybrid near-surface constraint fixing the uppermost heterogeneous zone (~8 m in field data) using deterministic smooth inversion results before running deep LBMP-PSO.
Smoothness-constrained geometry-preserving deterministic inversion decoupling regularization across LBMP-derived fault and layer boundaries.
采用层基模型参数化（LBMP），以6(n_i + 1)个参数描述断层地表/底部节点、层界面深度、P波速度及电阻率。
利用粒子群优化（PSO）进行全局寻优，最小化SRT走时相对线性误差与ERT视电阻率对数误差的加权目标函数。
采用混合浅表约束策略，利用确定性平滑反演结果固定最浅部非均质层（实测数据中约8米），再对深部进行LBMP-PSO反演。
执行保持几何结构的平滑约束确定性反演，在LBMP获得的断层与层界面处解除正则化平滑耦合。
de: Synthetic 2-D test case: 3 horizontal layers offset by an 8 m normal fault (96 collocated sensors at 2 m spacing, Dijkstra ray-tracing for SRT with 3% noise, dipole-dipole and multi-gradient ERT with 4% noise) tested across 3 prior-knowledge scenarios (0, 1, and 2 boreholes).

Field dataset from Les Fontaines Salées (Paris Basin, central France): collocated ERT (96 electrodes, 5 m spacing, 475 m profile) and SRT (120 geophones, 1 m spacing, 2 m shot spacing, 240 m overlap profile) across a normal fault separating Mesozoic sediments and Variscan granite.
二维合成算例：被8米落差正断层错动的三层水平模型（96个共点传感器，间距2米；SRT采用Dijkstra射线追踪并加3%噪声，ERT采用偶极-偶极与多梯度装置并加4%噪声），测试了3种钻孔先验场景。
法国中部巴黎盆地Les Fontaines Salées实测数据：跨越中生代沉积物与华力西期花岗岩正断层接触带的共线ERT（96电极，5米间距，长475米）与SRT（120检波器，1米间距，2米炮距，重叠段240米）剖面。
li: High computational cost: a single PSO inversion run of the field data requires about 20 hours on a single desktop CPU core due to thousands of forward simulations and adaptive remeshing.
Inability of purely homogeneous layers to fit complex near-surface heterogeneity in field data (>20% misfit), requiring ad-hoc fixing of the shallowest ~8 m from smooth inversions.
Intrinsic non-uniqueness persists: models with opposite fault dips (normal vs. reverse) and varying vertical offsets yield comparable data misfits without additional geological constraints.
计算成本高昂：由于需要数千次正演模拟和自适应网格重构，实测数据单次PSO反演在单核桌面CPU上耗时约20小时。
纯均匀层假设无法拟合实测数据复杂的浅表非均质性（误差>20%），需依赖平滑反演结果人为固定浅部约8米参数。
固有的反演多解性依然存在：若无额外地质先验约束，倾向相反的断层（正断层与逆断层）及不同断距均可产生相近的数据拟合差。

tm.why: The paper develops a layer-based model parameterization and global Particle Swarm Optimization workflow for the joint inversion of collocated seismic refraction and electrical resistivity data.
Seismic refraction tomography (SRT) using P-wave first-arrival travel times is one of the two primary methods jointly inverted to image subsurface velocity structures and fault zones.
The workflow generates ensembles of best-fitting models from randomized starting fault geometries using stochastic PSO to explore non-uniqueness and quantify structural uncertainty.

ev.notes: Full 41-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including abstract, methodology, synthetic and field experiments, 10 figures, and 1 table.

sum: This study investigates the thermochemical state of the mantle beneath the Central Mediterranean using 1798 high-quality teleseismic P receiver functions from 33 broadband stations. By applying phase-weighted slowness stacking across multiple frequency bands and converting times to depths with hybrid local-tomographic velocity models, the authors constrain the depth, sharpness, and amplitude ratios of the X (272±8 km), 410 (399±4 km), and 660 (669±4 km) discontinuities. All three interfaces are relatively sharp (~15±5 km). Synthetic reflectivity tests linked to mineral physics databases (HeFESTo/stx21) demonstrate that comparable PXs and P410s amplitudes require ~70–80% basalt (eclogite), tracing recycled oceanic crust tied to HIMU-like magmatism. While 410 uplift reflects moderate slab cooling (-250 to -310 K), large 660 depressions (~30 km) beneath the Adriatic cannot be explained by temperature, hydration, or akimotoite alone, pointing instead to the post-garnet transition in basalt-enriched domains aiding slab stagnation.
本研究利用33个宽频带台站的1798条高质量远震P波接收函数，结合多频段相位加权慢度叠加与混合速度模型时深转换，研究了地中海中部地幔间断面。研究识别出清晰的X（272±8 km）、410（399±4 km）和660（669±4 km）间断面，厚度均较薄（约15±5 km）。结合矿物物理数据库与反射率……

t: P receiver functions are computed via frequency-domain water-level deconvolution across multiple frequency bands, stacked using phase-weighted slowness vespagrams in back-azimuth sectors, and depth-converted using hybrid local-tomographic velocity models.
通过多频段频率域水准反褶积计算P波接收函数，按反方位角扇区进行相位加权慢度叠加，并用混合速度模型进行时深转换。
Teleseismic waveforms from 33 permanent broadband stations (networks IV, FR, MN) for Mw 5.8–7.5 events at 30–90° distance (1995–2023), filtered via STA/LTA and visual checks to 1798 P-RFs.
收集33个宽频带台站记录的1995–2023年Mw 5.8–7.5远震波形，经质量控制筛选出1798条高质量接收函数。
The X, 410, and 660 discontinuities average 272±8 km, 399±4 km, and 669±4 km depth with ~15±5 km thickness; comparable PXs and P410s amplitudes indicate ~70–80% basalt fractions.
X、410和660间断面平均深度分别为272±8、399±4和669±4 km，厚度约15±5 km；振幅比表明存在70…

Mantle velocity uncertainties affect absolute depths, and the thermochemical interpretation lacks a fully self-consistent thermodynamic inversion accounting for strong lateral subduction heterogeneity.
地幔速度不确定性影响绝对深度，且热化学解释尚未采用完全自洽的三维热力学反演。

Provides the first systematic characterization of the X discontinuity in the Central Mediterranean and explains large 660 depressions via the post-garnet transition in eclogite-rich mantle rather than akimotoite.
首次系统表征地中海中部X间断面，并提出富榴辉岩中的后石榴石相变（而非秋本石）控制了660间断面大幅加深。

kc: First systematic characterization of the X discontinuity (average depth 272±8 km, deepening to 334±4 km beneath Calabria) in the Central Mediterranean.
Constrained upper-mantle basalt fractions to ~70–80% using P410s/PXs amplitude ratios and thermodynamic modeling, linking recycled oceanic crust to HIMU-like volcanism.

Demonstrated that ~30 km depressions of the 660 discontinuity beneath the Adriatic Sea are controlled by the post-garnet transition in basalt-rich domains rather than akimotoite stabilization or hydration.
首次对地中海中部X间断面（平均深度272±8 km，卡拉布里亚弧下加深至334±4 km）进行了系统表征。
利用P410s/PXs振幅比和热力学建模将上地幔玄武岩比例约束在约70%–80%，将再循环洋壳与HIMU型火山活动联系起来。
证明亚得里亚海下方660间断面约30 km的下凹受控于富玄武岩区域的后石榴石相变，而非秋本石稳定化或水化作用。
me: Frequency-domain water-level deconvolution (k=0.001) of teleseismic P waveforms across multiple frequency bands (0.02 to 0.12–0.64 Hz).
Linear and phase-weighted stacking (PWS) in the relative time-slowness domain (vespagrams) and fixed-slowness stacking grouped by 40° back-azimuth sectors.
Time-to-depth conversion using a hybrid velocity model combining station-specific joint P- and S-RF inversions (0–200 km) with MITP08 global tomography (200–800 km).
Synthetic seismogram modeling via the reflectivity method (CRFL) coupled with Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni (stx08, stx21) thermodynamic databases for basalt-harzburgite mechanical mixtures.
在多个频段（0.02至0.12–0.64 Hz）对远震P波波形进行频率域水准反褶积（k=0.001）。
按40°反方位角扇区分组，在相对时间-慢度域（速度谱图）进行线性和相位加权叠加（PWS）以及固定慢度叠加。
结合台站特定P波和S波接收函数联合反演（0–200 km）与MITP08全球层析成像模型（200–800 km）的混合速度模型进行时深转换。
利用反射率法（CRFL）结合玄武岩-方辉橄榄岩机械混合物的热力学数据库（stx08、stx21）进行合成地震图正演建模。
de: 22,917 teleseismic waveforms (Mw 5.8–7.5, 30°–90° epicentral distance, recorded 1995–2023) from 33 broadband stations across networks IV, FR, and MN, quality-filtered to 1,798 high-quality P-RFs.
Synthetic RF datasets computed for epicentral distances of 30°–90° at Tp = 1300 K and 1600 K with basalt fractions varying from 0% to 100%.
来自IV、FR和MN台网33个宽频带台站的22,917条远震波形（Mw 5.8–7.5，震中距30°–90°，1995–2023年记录），经质量控制筛选出1,798条高质量P波接收函数。
在Tp = 1300 K和1600 K、玄武岩比例0%至100%条件下，针对30°–90°震中距计算的合成接收函数数据集。
li: Uncertainties in mantle velocity structure and travel-time corrections can introduce artificial short-wavelength topography on MTZ discontinuities.
Thermochemical interpretations rely on simplified 1D mechanical mixture end-members rather than a fully self-consistent 3D thermodynamic inversion.
Limited spatial coverage of robust piercing points in the Northwestern Tyrrhenian Basin and parts of the Calabrian Arc.
地幔速度结构和走时校正的不确定性可能会在地幔过渡带间断面上引入人为的短波长起伏。
热化学解释依赖于简化的一维机械混合物端元模型，而非完全自洽的三维热力学反演。
第勒尼安海西北部和卡拉布里亚弧部分区域的可靠穿刺点空间覆盖有限。

tm.why: The paper analyzes 1798 teleseismic P receiver functions to determine the depth, sharpness, and impedance contrasts of the X, 410, and 660 mantle discontinuities.
The study infers mantle temperature, basalt fraction, and slab stagnation mechanisms in the Central Mediterranean upper mantle and transition zone.

sum: This study reassesses the Holocene caldera resurgence at Campi Flegrei (Southern Italy) by integrating onshore geological records with offshore high-resolution seismic reflection profiles and geodetic data. Mapping a 12 ka tephra marker layer (S2a) and submerged infralittoral prograding wedges across the Pozzuoli Gulf reveals ~190 m of net permanent uplift over the last 10.5 kyr. The deformation forms a ~9-km-wide, axisymmetric bell-shaped dome centered near Rione Terra (Pozzuoli), matching modern GNSS and InSAR unrest patterns. Elastic half-space modeling (Fialko sill model) constrains a stacked-sill magmatic source at 3.4 ± 0.6 km depth with a 3.3 ± 0.7 km radius. Novel volume reconstructions show intruded magma volumes are roughly three times larger than erupted volumes since 10.5 ka, indicating resurgence acts as an eruptive damper while driving inward vent migration and more silicic magma compositions.
本研究结合陆地地质记录、波佐利湾高分辨率海洋地震反射剖面及大地测量数据，重新评估了意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞破火山口的全新世复活机制。通过追踪12 ka的火山灰标志层（S2a）和水下滨岸进积楔，揭示了过去10.5 kyr间约190米的永久净隆升，形成以波佐利为中心、宽约9公里的轴对称钟形穹隆，与现代GNSS……

t: Digitized the 12 ka S2a reference horizon from offshore seismic reflection profiles, fitted an axisymmetric 4th-degree polynomial, and inverted for sill source parameters using Fialko's elastic half-space model.
数字化近海地震反射剖面12 ka标志层，进行四阶多项式拟合，并用Fialko弹性半空间模型反演岩床参数。

Over 700 data points mapped on the S2a tephra layer from Pozzuoli Gulf seismic reflection profiles (2008–2013), integrated with infralittoral prograding wedges, La Starza stratigraphy, and GNSS/leveling data.
波佐利湾地震剖面S2a层700多个点，结合水下进积楔、La Starza地层及现代GNSS与水准数据。
Documented >190 m of net uplift in a 9-km-wide bell-shaped dome centered near Pozzuoli, best fit by a sill source at 3.4 ± 0.6 km depth and 3.3 ± 0.7 km radius, with ~3.5 km3 DRE net intruded volume.
揭示超190米净隆升与9公里宽钟形穹隆，最佳拟合岩床深3.4±0.6 km、半径3.3±0.7 km，净侵入约3.5 k…

Uncertainties arise from paleobathymetric reconstructions, faulting/erosion, and modeling permanent geological displacement using a homogeneous elastic half-space that neglects crustal layering and deeper sources.
受限于古水深重建精度、断层侵蚀影响，以及均匀弹性半空间假设忽略了地壳分层和深部源。

First continuous 12 kyr deformation curve at the caldera center linking millennial stacked-sill dome resurgence to decadal unrest, proving resurgence dampens eruptions and refuting block-resurgence models.
首次建立破火山口中心12 kyr连续形变曲线，证实叠置岩床驱动的穹隆复活具有尺度不变性并抑制喷发。

kc: Reconstructed a complete 12 kyr vertical ground deformation curve at the Campi Flegrei caldera center by integrating onshore stratigraphy with offshore seismic reflection markers and infralittoral prograding wedges.
Demonstrated that ~190 m of net Holocene uplift forms a 9-km-wide axisymmetric bell-shaped resurgent dome whose normalized spatial pattern is scale-invariant and matches decadal GNSS/InSAR unrest.

Constrained the permanent deformation source using an elastic sill model to a stacked-sill complex at 3.4 ± 0.6 km depth with a radius of 3.3 ± 0.7 km, showing that intruded magma volume exceeds erupted volume by ~3x.
结合陆地地层、近海地震反射标志层和水下滨岸进积楔，重建了坎皮佛莱格瑞破火山口中心完整的12 kyr垂直地表形变曲线。
证实约190米的全新世净隆升形成了一个9公里宽的轴对称钟形复活穹隆，其归一化空间模式具有尺度不变性，并与数十年尺度的GNSS/InSAR动荡一致。
利用弹性岩床模型将永久形变源约束在深3.4±0.6 km、半径3.3±0.7 km的叠置岩床复合体，表明侵入岩浆体积约为喷发体积的3倍。
me: Seismostratigraphic horizon digitization and depth conversion of the 12 ka S2a tephra layer across offshore seismic reflection profiles.
Paleobathymetric elevation reconstruction using Roll-Over Points (ROPs) of submerged Infralittoral Prograding Wedges (IPWs) and marine abrasion surfaces.
Axisymmetric 4th-degree polynomial fitting and elastic half-space sill inversion (Fialko model via dMODELS) to estimate source depth, radius, and displaced rock volumes.
近海地震反射剖面中12 ka S2a火山灰层的地震地层层位数字化与时深转换。
利用水下滨岸进积楔（IPWs）的坡折点（ROPs）和海蚀面进行古水深高程重建。
轴对称四阶多项式拟合与弹性半空间岩床反演（基于dMODELS的Fialko模型），以估算源深度、半径和排替岩石体积。
de: Published high-resolution offshore seismic reflection profiles acquired in the Pozzuoli Gulf between 2008 and 2013 (>700 digitized points on the S2a horizon).
Onshore geological, borehole, and geoarchaeological paleo-elevation markers from the La Starza marine terrace and surrounding coastal sites.
Historical leveling, continuous GNSS, and InSAR vertical deformation time series (1905–2025) and post-NYT volcanic glass geochemical compositions (SiO2 and FeO).
2008至2013年间在波佐利湾采集的已发表高分辨率海洋地震反射剖面（S2a层位上超过700个数字化数据点）。
来自La Starza海成阶地及周边海岸遗址的陆地地质、钻孔和地质考古古高程标志点。
历史水准测量、连续GNSS和InSAR垂直形变时间序列（1905–2025年）以及NYT喷发后的火山玻璃地球化学成分（SiO2和FeO）。
li: The reconstructed deformation curve relies heavily on the accuracy of prior paleobathymetric reconstructions, age attributions, and uniform seismic velocity assumptions (1,850 m/s) for marine fill.
The Fialko analytical sill model assumes a homogeneous, isotropic elastic half-space and neglects crustal layering, viscoelastic relaxation, and deeper superposed magma sources.
重建的形变曲线高度依赖于先前的古水深重建精度、年代归属以及海相充填物均匀地震波速假设（1,850 m/s）。
Fialko解析岩床模型假设均匀各向同性弹性半空间，忽略了地壳分层、粘弹性松弛以及更深部叠加岩浆源的影响。

tm.why: The paper reconstructs the Holocene volcano-tectonic deformation, magma emplacement, and caldera resurgence of the Campi Flegrei volcanic system using offshore seismic reflection profiles and geodetic modeling.
It models shallow crustal deformation, flexural rigidity, and sill intrusion mechanics within the upper crust of the Campi Flegrei caldera.

ev.notes: Full 33-page PDF analyzed, including all text sections, equations, and 14 multi-panel figures.

sum: Moment tensor inversion of shallow mining seismicity suffers from sparse station coverage and structured near-surface waveform distortions not captured by random Gaussian noise. Using the Jacobina mining district, Brazil, as a reference, this study introduces a synthetic diagnostic framework comparing band-limited Gaussian noise, structured empirical contamination from recorded local events, and phase-randomised empirical waveforms. Conventional full-waveform inversion (FW-I) is evaluated alongside a Cut-and-Paste-inspired P–S segmented inversion (PS-I) across 6- and 12-station geometries and depths of 0.1–5 km. While phase-randomised contamination mimics smooth Gaussian degradation, structured empirical contamination with preserved temporal phase creates a pronounced positive high-error tail in tensor rotation, primarily affecting fault orientation rather than eigenvalue source type. PS-I and 12-station coverage substantially suppress these large-error occurrences. Additionally, restrictive deviatoric or double-couple constraints can mask contamination sensitivity while introducing severe persistent mechanism bias.
浅源矿山诱发地震的矩张量反演易受稀疏台网和近地表结构性波形畸变影响。本文以巴西Jacobina矿区为例，构建了对比带限高斯噪声、真实小震结构化经验污染及相位随机化经验波形的合成诊断框架，评估了6台和12台几何下常规全波形反演（FW-I）与P-S分段反演（PS-I）的表现。结果表明，相位随机化表现与高……

t: Compares conventional full-waveform (FW-I) and CAP-adapted P–S segmented (PS-I) moment tensor inversions in MTUQ under three contamination regimes: band-limited Gaussian noise, structured empirical small-event waveforms, and Fourier phase-randomised empirical waveforms.
在MTUQ中对比常规全波形（FW-I）和P-S分段反演（PS-I）在高斯、结构化经验与相位随机化三种污染下的表现。

Synthetic 1–5 Hz waveforms across 0.1–5 km depths for two 6-station temporary networks and a 12-station union in the Jacobina mining district, Brazil, plus local microseismic records used as contaminants and a real ML 1.2 test event.
巴西Jacobina矿区两套6台及联合12台几何下0.1–5 km深度的1–5 Hz合成波形，以及实测小震污染和ML 1…

Structured empirical contamination creates a strong positive high-error tail in FW-I rotation (32.1% of Network 2 comparisons exceed phase-randomised errors by >5° at α=1), which decreases to 14.3% under PS-I and 3.1% with 12 stations.
结构化污染在FW-I下产生显著大误差尾部（台网2中32.1%超随机相位5°以上），PS-I和12台联合将其降至14.3%…
Recorded empirical contaminants include source radiation rather than pure propagation error, and depth susceptibility patterns depend on the specific contaminant waveform and station geometry.
经验污染包含小震震源辐射而非纯传播误差，且深度敏感性取决于具体波形与台网几何。

Explicitly isolates the role of preserved temporal phase structure in empirical waveform contamination on shallow moment tensor inversion using a Fourier phase-randomisation control and distributional tail analysis.
利用傅里叶相位随机化对照和分布尾部统计，首次分离并量化了保留时间相位结构对浅源矩张量反演的影响。

kc: Developed a transferable three-stage synthetic stress-testing framework (Gaussian, structured empirical, and phase-randomised contamination) for shallow moment tensor inversion.
Demonstrated via phase randomisation that preserved temporal phase organisation—not just the empirical amplitude spectrum—causes the high-error tail in full-waveform moment tensor inversions.
Showed that P–S segmented inversion (PS-I) and 12-station network redundancy substantially reduce the frequency and magnitude of large structured-contamination errors.
Quantified the trade-off between contamination sensitivity and persistent mechanism bias under full, deviatoric, and double-couple moment tensor constraints.
开发了适用于浅源矩张量反演的可迁移三阶段合成压力测试框架（高斯、结构化经验与相位随机化污染）。
通过相位随机化证明了保留的时间相位组织（而非单纯经验振幅谱）是导致全波形矩张量反演大误差尾部的主因。
证明了P-S分段反演（PS-I）和12台站网络冗余可大幅降低结构化污染大误差的发生频率和幅度。
量化了全矩张量、偏张量和双力偶约束下污染敏感性与持续机制偏差之间的权衡关系。
me: Three-stage synthetic waveform contamination: band-limited Gaussian noise (1–5 Hz), recorded small-event empirical waveforms, and Fourier phase-randomised empirical waveforms.
Full moment tensor inversion in MTUQ comparing conventional single-window full-waveform inversion (FW-I) with CAP-adapted independent P- and S-wave window inversion (PS-I).
Evaluation of full-tensor rotation angle (ω) and orientation-independent eigenvalue source-type angle (θ_λ) across configuration medians and two-sided exceedance distributions.
Local event detection and relocation using PyMPA matched-filtering, SEISAN Hypocenter, and HypoDD to establish realistic source and contaminant baselines.
三阶段合成波形污染：1–5 Hz带限高斯噪声、实测小震结构化经验波形，以及傅里叶相位随机化经验波形。
基于MTUQ的矩张量反演，对比常规单窗全波形反演（FW-I）与借鉴CAP方法的独立P波和S波时间窗分段反演（PS-I）。
利用全张量旋转角（ω）和独立于方位的特征值震源类型角（θ_λ），通过中位数及双侧超越概率分布评估反演性能。
采用PyMPA匹配滤波、SEISAN Hypocenter和HypoDD进行地方震检测与重定位，构建真实的震源与污染波形基准。
de: 1-D CPS synthetic waveforms across 0.1–5.0 km depths, 4 lune source types (ISO, CLVD, MIX, DC), 3 faulting orientations, and 6 contamination levels (α = 0.0 to 1.0).
Two 6-station temporary network geometries (broad Network 1 and compact Network 2) and their 12-station union from the Jacobina gold mining district, Brazil.
Local seismic catalogue of 320 events (191 relocated in 3 mining clusters, ML -0.5 to 2.6) recorded by GEObit GEOtiny and Raspberry Shake 3-D stations at 100 Hz.
Real-data diagnostic depth-trade-off inversion of an ML 1.2 mining event recorded on the 6-station Network 2.
基于1-D CPS计算的合成波形，涵盖0.1–5.0 km深度、4种震源类型（ISO、CLVD、MIX、DC）、3种断层走向及6个污染水平（α = 0.0至1.0）。
巴西Jacobina金矿区的两个6台站临时台网几何（宽展台网1和紧凑台网2）及其组成的12台站联合台网。
由GEObit GEOtiny和Raspberry Shake 3-D台站（100 Hz采样）记录的320个地方震目录（其中191个重定位于3个矿区丛集，ML -0.5至2.6）。
由紧凑6台站台网2记录的一个ML 1.2矿震事件的实测数据深度折衷诊断反演。
li: Additive empirical contamination uses recorded small earthquakes containing source radiation rather than pure source-free path/site propagation errors.
Synthetic baseline tests rely on a homogeneous 1-D velocity model without explicit 3-D structural forward-modeling mismatch.
Numerical error thresholds and depth-localised susceptibility patterns are site-, geometry-, and waveform-specific rather than universal constants.
叠加的经验污染波形来自包含震源辐射的实测小震，而非纯粹无震源效应的路径/场地传播误差。
合成基准测试基于均匀一维速度模型，未包含显式的三维结构正演模型失配。
数值误差阈值和深度敏感模式依赖于特定场地、台网几何和污染波形，并非普适常数。

tm.why: The study specifically focuses on moment tensor inversion of shallow mining-induced seismicity using the Jacobina mining district in Brazil as a test case.
The core objective is evaluating the stability and bias of full moment tensor source mechanism and orientation recovery under waveform contamination.

The paper develops a synthetic diagnostic framework to evaluate non-Gaussian, temporally structured theory and observational errors, bias-sensitivity trade-offs, and model space constraints in waveform inversion.

ev.notes: Full 19-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF analysed, including all sections, equations, Table 1, and Figures 1–10.

sum: This study presents a Bayesian inversion framework to locate microseismic events by jointly using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and downhole geophone arrival time differences. Applied to the April 2022 Utah FORGE stimulation experiment, the joint inversion significantly reduces location uncertainty compared to single-sensor inversions. Synthetic tests mimic sensor outages to explain the geometric origins of posterior distribution patterns, providing guidance for optimal EGS monitoring design.
本研究提出一种贝叶斯反演框架，联合DAS与井下检波器走时差定位微震。该方法应用于2022年4月犹他FORGE地热激发实验。结果表明，联合反演相比单一传感器显著降低了定位不确定性。通过合成测试模拟传感器故障，解释了后验分布形态的几何成因，为优化增强型地热系统监测方案提供了指导。

t: A Bayesian inversion framework that jointly utilizes arrival time differences from both DAS and downhole geophones to construct posterior probability density functions of microseismic source locations.
联合利用DAS和井下检波器走时差的贝叶斯反演框架，用于构建微震位置后验概率分布。
Microseismic data from the April 2022 Utah FORGE stimulation experiment, alongside synthetic datasets designed to simulate sensor outages and geometry effects.
犹他FORGE激发实验的微震数据，以及模拟传感器故障和几何效应的合成数据集。

Joint inversion of DAS and geophone data significantly reduces microseismic location uncertainty compared to single-sensor datasets, with synthetic tests explaining the geometric causes of specific uncertainty patterns.
联合反演显著降低了微震定位不确定性，合成测试解释了不确定性模式的几何成因。
The method's accuracy depends heavily on the quality of arrival time picks and the accuracy of the background velocity model.

sum: This study investigates the influence of subducted seamounts on megathrust slip behavior using numerical simulations. By modeling the geometric and frictional perturbations introduced by seamounts, the authors demonstrate that these features act as local stress concentrators. Throughout the seismic cycle, this heterogeneity promotes a complex mix of aseismic creep, slow slip events (SSEs), and fast earthquake ruptures. The work provides a theoretical framework explaining how a single subducted feature can simultaneously act as a barrier to large ruptures and a generator of diverse slip behaviors, reconciling conflicting observational interpretations of seamount seismogenesis.
本研究通过数值模拟探讨了俯冲海山对超大逆冲断层滑移行为的影响。模拟表明，海山引入的几何与摩擦扰动充当了局部应力集中源。在整个地震周期中，这种非均匀性促进了无震蠕滑、慢滑移事件（SSE）和快速地震破裂的共存。该工作解释了单个俯冲特征如何同时作为破裂屏障和多样化滑移源，调和了关于海山发震机制的观测争议。

t: Numerical modeling of fault slip using rate-and-state friction to simulate the seismic cycle with geometric perturbations.

sum: This Zenodo repository presents BackTrackBB, a software program for the detection and space-time location of seismic sources. It leverages multi-scale, frequency-selective statistical coherence of wavefields recorded by dense seismic networks and local antennas. The workflow consists of signal processing, space-time imaging, and detection/location. This specific release documents a benchmark experiment using synthetic continuous data over a simulated 2-day period, executed on the Marenostrum V supercomputer. The run demonstrates the tool's computational workflow, profiling CPU usage across 108 nodes to evaluate HPC performance and task parallelization.

sum: This study performs 3D physics-based ground-motion simulations to evaluate site amplification in the Wellington central business district (CBD), New Zealand. By utilizing eight alternative models of the Wellington basin geometry, the authors quantify predicted site amplification (periods 0.5–10 s) and the associated epistemic uncertainty. The simulations successfully capture broad spectral amplification peaks and match observed amplification at deeper basin sites. However, discrepancies remain at shallower sites due to spatial resolution and a minimum S-wave velocity limit of 500 m/s. Linear spectral amplification factors reach up to 8. The work highlights the importance of basin-depth geometry and velocity characterization for improving future hazard assessments.

sum: This study compiles a high-resolution aftershock catalog of 23,748 events over three months to analyze the 2024 Mw 7.3 Hualien earthquake sequence. The aftershock distribution reveals a conjugate fault system consisting of the east-dipping Longitudinal Valley fault and the west-dipping Central Range fault. The logarithmic expansion of the seismicity front over time indicates afterslip-driven migration. Aftershocks predominantly occurred outside the high-slip zone, aligning with stress concentration areas. Coulomb static stress change calculations confirm that stress transfer from the mainshock triggered several major aftershocks. These findings provide critical constraints on fault geometry and postseismic hazard assessment in eastern Taiwan.
本研究利用三个月的连续地震波形，构建了包含23,748个地震的高分辨率余震目录，系统分析了2024年花莲Mw 7.3地震序列。余震空间分布揭示了由东倾纵谷断层和西倾中央山脉断层组成的共轭断层系统。余震序列随时间呈对数扩张，表明存在余滑驱动的迁移特征。余震主要分布在高滑移区外围，与应力集中区一致。库仑……

sum: Between December 2020 and February 2022, Mt. Etna experienced over 60 paroxysmal eruptions involving the mixing of evolved trachybasaltic and primitive basaltic magmas. Using a 1D steady-state multiphase conduit magma ascent model constrained by petrological data and Latin Hypercube Sampling sensitivity analyses, this study evaluates the roles of magma composition versus syn-eruptive conditions. Results show both magma end-members produce equivalent eruptive styles across most conditions; primitive magma actually crystallizes more readily during ascent than previously fractionated evolved magma. Sustained lava fountaining requires conduit inlet (4 km depth) temperatures >1090–1100 °C, conduit radii <3 m, and crystal contents <25 vol%, whereas effusive eruptions require temperatures <1110–1120 °C, water <3 wt%, and crystals >20 vol%. Furthermore, the authors identify a critical inlet bulk viscosity (~50 Pa s for Etna) where eruptive style abruptly transitions, increasing mass eruption rate by orders of magnitude independently of thermodynamic state.

t: A 1D steady-state multiphase magma ascent model (MAMMA) coupled with MELTS/MagmaSat constitutive laws and Latin Hypercube Sampling (10,000 runs per end-member) plus local sensitivity analyses across inlet parameters.

sum: Understanding fluid and magma transport in subduction zones requires accurate knowledge of viscosity across silicate-H2O joins under supercritical conditions. This study uses molecular dynamics driven by an ab initio-quality DeepMD machine learning potential to investigate supercritical NaAlSi3O8-H2O fluids across 0–100 wt% H2O at 1200–3000 K (2 GPa) and 1–5 GPa (2500 K). The simulations reveal continuous depolymerization of the silicate network with increasing water content and demonstrate that viscosity is controlled primarily by the degree of polymerization. Notably, the computed viscosities are up to an order of magnitude smaller than predictions from previous empirical models. Fitting the results to a global Vogel-Fulcher-Tammann equation and applying a Darcian porous flow model to subduction zones shows that ascending fluids accelerate into the hot mantle wedge and decelerate toward the Moho. Plausible water contents yield slab-to-Moho ascent times as short as 8,000 years, satisfying U-Th-Ra disequilibria constraints without requiring channelized flow.
本研究利用基于第一性原理精度训练的DeepMD机器学习势函数进行分子动力学模拟，探究了超临界NaAlSi3O8-H2O流体在0–100 wt%含水量、1200–3000 K（2 GPa）和1–5 GPa（2500 K）下的粘度与结构。结果表明，水通过连续解聚硅酸盐网络降低粘度，且所得粘度显著低于以往……

sum: This study presents a covariance-propagation framework to evaluate the physical detection limits of targeted dense arrays of low-cost dual-band GNSS sensors for monitoring pre-rupture transient crustal deformation. By fitting regional offset and planar fields as nuisance modes and incorporating independent receiver noise and residual locally correlated noise into an explicit covariance matrix, the framework uses minimum-variance weighting to estimate localized deformation amplitudes. Testing across favorable, reference, and conservative scenarios for a 20x20 km domain shows that spatial-search-adjusted detection thresholds range from 2.03 to 1.19 cm for 900 to 4,900 nodes, with persistent local correlation imposing a several-centimeter floor. The framework is validated using 2014 Iquique sequence records (PSGA and IQQE) and Monte Carlo simulations, providing a rigorous basis for designing mechanically grounded pre-rupture monitoring arrays.

sum: This paper presents a novel multi-stage 'warm-up' framework for seismic Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) that incorporates electromagnetic (EM) data to mitigate cycle-skipping. Instead of using complex joint inversion objective functions, the method uses EM resistivity inversion to extract a low-frequency skeleton of the subsurface. The resistivity image is clustered into distinct zones, each assigned a constant velocity. A preliminary FWI is then performed to determine these velocities and fit the seismic data roughly. Finally, a full-bandwidth FWI refines this model to achieve high-resolution results. Tested on the Marmousi model, the approach avoids strong petrophysical assumptions and outperforms conventional seismic-only FWI in both data fitting and computational efficiency, demonstrating the value of EM data as a natural low-pass filter for FWI initialization.

sum: Basaltic fissure eruptions fed by elongated rift dykes often display discontinuous surface vents and variable cone morphologies. This study investigates how along-strike topographic variations and associated crustal stress gradients control vent localization at Iceland's Laki (1783–1784) and Eldgjá (~939–940) eruptions. Using 2-m satellite DEMs and 20-cm drone photogrammetry, the authors mapped 311 eruptive cones across ~100 km of fissures and reconstructed pre-eruptive topography. They applied 2D analytical elastic half-space models to calculate out-of-plane confining stress (Syy) gradients in the uppermost 0.5 km. Using K-means clustering and ROC analysis, they established a Combined Stress Gradient (CSG) threshold separating Permissive domains (capturing >82% of large cones) from Restrictive domains (inhibiting cone growth). Furthermore, peaks in horizontal stress gradients accurately predicted (99%) non-eruptive fissure gaps at Eldgjá. This novel quantitative framework links surface relief to dyke dynamics, improving spatial forecasting of rift vent development.

sum: This study applies ambient noise interferometry to Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data recorded along the northern margin of the South China Sea. By extracting reflected S-waves from the ambient noise field, the authors successfully image the fine-scale geometry and precise locations of submarine fault zones in shallow waters. This passive seismic approach overcomes the limitations of traditional active-source marine surveys in shallow environments, demonstrating the high potential of combining DAS technology with noise interferometry for cost-effective, high-resolution submarine structural characterization.

sum: This study presents HSIM 1.0, a high-resolution 3D subduction interface model for the Hikurangi margin, New Zealand, built via an implicit structural modeling workflow in SKUA/GOCAD. The model integrates 250-m bathymetry, 54 2D seismic reflection profiles, the NZ3D reflection volume, seismic tomography, 222,006 relocated earthquakes, and 148 focal mechanism orientations. Results reveal a sharp along-strike transition: the southern locked zone has a smooth, low-curvature interface (0–2 × 10^-6 m^-1), whereas the northern slow slip event (SSE) region exhibits a rough, high-curvature interface (6–10 × 10^-6 m^-1). Notably, the northern margin features NE-trending curvature bands linked to subducted rift-related seamount chains. Cumulative SSEs (2002–2014) concentrate within a negative-to-low-curvature corridor interpreted as a fluid-rich sediment lens and stress shadow in the wake of a subducted seamount chain, offering new structural constraints for physics-based earthquake and tsunami hazard modeling.
本研究利用SKUA/GOCAD隐式建模方法，整合测深、二维/三维地震反射剖面、层析成像、重定位地震目录和震源机制解，构建了新西兰希库朗伊俯冲带高分辨率三维界面模型（HSIM 1.0）。结果显示沿走向存在明显过渡：南部闭锁区界面平滑且曲率低，而北部慢滑移（SSEs）区界面粗糙且曲率高。北部发育东北向曲……

Integrates 250-m bathymetry, 54 2D seismic reflection profiles, a 3D reflection volume (NZ3D), seismic tomography, 222,006 relocated earthquakes (1970–2020), and 148 filtered GeoNet moment tensor solutions.
