犹他FORGE 2022年4月压裂期间由井下检波器和地表节点台阵记录的地震数据。
将推导出的裂缝走向与成像测井（FMI）及钻井诱发裂缝数据进行对比验证。
li: The correlation-based clustering method relies on waveform similarity, which may exclude highly unique or isolated microseismic events.
基于相关性的聚类方法依赖于波形相似性，可能会排除高度独特或孤立的微震事件。

tm.why: The paper focuses on characterizing fracture networks and microseismicity during stimulation at the Utah FORGE geothermal site.
The study performs focal mechanism inversions of low-magnitude microseismic events to infer fracture orientations.
It integrates downhole geophones and surface nodal arrays, applying array processing to enhance P-wave arrivals.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata since the full PDF was not available.

sum: This study presents a dual-wave imaging approach that repurposes conventional 2D reflection seismic data, originally collected for deep structural imaging, to characterize shallow fractured bedrock at the Revell Site, Canada. By integrating 3D P-wave traveltime tomography and Rayleigh-wave inversion, the authors reconstruct P- and S-wave velocity models that delineate the transition from fractured to competent crystalline bedrock at approximately 48 m depth. To map mechanical degradation, they introduce a PCA-optimized Relative Compliance Indicator (RCI) that integrates multiple elastic attributes. The RCI provides a spatially focused proxy for fracture zones, outperforming equal-weight formulations. This work demonstrates a cost-effective framework for near-surface geomechanical characterization in crystalline rock using legacy datasets.
本研究提出了一种双波成像方法，将原本用于深部结构成像的常规二维反射地震数据重新利用，以表征加拿大Revell场地的浅层破碎基岩。通过整合三维P波走时断层成像和雷利波反演，重建了P波和S波速度模型，描绘了约48米深度处破碎基岩向完整结晶基岩的过渡。为了绘制机械退化图，引入了经主成分分析（PCA）优化的……

t: Dual-wave imaging integrating 3D P-wave traveltime tomography and Rayleigh-wave inversion, combined with a PCA-optimized Relative Compliance Indicator (RCI).
整合三维P波走时断层成像和雷利波反演的双波成像，结合PCA优化的相对合规指标（RCI）。
Repurposed conventional 2D reflection seismic data originally acquired for deep structural imaging at the Revell Site, Canada.
重新利用原本用于加拿大Revell场地深部结构成像的常规二维反射地震数据。
Reconstructed P- and S-wave velocity models delineating the fractured-to-competent bedrock transition at ~48 m depth, with PCA-optimized RCI highlighting fracture zones.
重建的P波和S波速度模型描绘了约48米深度的破碎-完整基岩过渡，PCA优化的RCI突出了裂缝带。
Challenges from wavefield scattering and acquisition geometry limitations inherent in repurposing 2D reflection data for near-surface imaging.
将二维反射数据重新用于近地表成像时，面临波场散射和采集几何限制的挑战。
Repurposing deep 2D reflection data for shallow dual-wave imaging and introducing a PCA-weighted Relative Compliance Indicator for geomechanical characterization.
将深部二维反射数据重新用于浅层双波成像，并引入PCA加权的相对合规指标进行地质力学表征。

kc: Developed a dual-wave imaging workflow that repurposes deep 2D reflection seismic data for shallow near-surface characterization.
Delineated the transition from fractured to competent crystalline bedrock at a median depth of ~48 m using joint P- and S-wave velocity models.
Introduced a PCA-optimized Relative Compliance Indicator (RCI) to map mechanical degradation and fracture zones with high spatial focus.
开发了一种双波成像工作流，将深部二维反射地震数据重新用于浅层近地表表征。
利用联合P波和S波速度模型，描绘了中值深度约48米处破碎基岩向完整结晶基岩的过渡。
引入了经PCA优化的相对合规指标（RCI），以高空间聚焦度绘制机械退化和裂缝带图。
me: 3D P-wave traveltime tomography using refracted body waves.
Rayleigh-wave dispersion inversion to reconstruct S-wave velocity models.
Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to weight and integrate multiple elastic attributes into a Relative Compliance Indicator (RCI).
利用折射体波进行三维P波走时断层成像。
利用雷利波色散反演重建S波速度模型。
利用主成分分析（PCA）对多种弹性属性进行权重分配并整合为相对合规指标（RCI）。
de: Repurposed conventional 2D reflection seismic data from the Revell Site, Canada (proposed Deep Geological Repository).
Validation of seismic velocity models using borehole velocity and fracture data.
重新利用加拿大Revell场地（拟建深地质处置库）的常规二维反射地震数据。
利用钻孔速度和裂缝数据对地震速度模型进行验证。
li: The methodology faces challenges from wavefield scattering and acquisition geometry limitations inherent in legacy 2D reflection data.
该方法面临着遗留二维反射数据固有的波场散射和采集几何限制等挑战。

tm.why: The paper integrates 3D P-wave traveltime tomography and Rayleigh-wave inversion to reconstruct velocity models.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the abstract and metadata.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution (5 × 5 × 1 km³) 3D crustal model of the Southern Apennines, Italy, extending from the topographic surface to the Moho. To overcome the lack of a regionally consistent 3D framework in this complex orogenic belt, the authors integrate a full-waveform adjoint P-wave tomographic model with laboratory-measured P-wave velocities corrected for in-situ pressure, temperature, and shallow porosity (Wyllie equation). Intersections between tomographic velocity profiles and P-T corrected lithological velocity ranges delineate major intra-crustal discontinuities: the top of Mesozoic limestones, metasandstone base, Hercynian gneissic crystalline basement, and the lower-crustal gabbroic transition. Validated against ViDEPI deep boreholes, CROP deep seismic reflection profiles, receiver functions, and 3D gravity/magnetic inversions, the model demonstrates that the gneissic interface best represents the regional crystalline basement. All input, intermediate, and final 3D surfaces are openly released under FAIR principles to support seismic hazard and geodynamic modeling.
本研究构建了意大利南亚平宁地区高分辨率（5×5×1 km³）三维地壳模型。针对该复杂造山带缺乏区域一致性三维模型的现状，作者将全波形伴随P波层析成像模型与经原位温压及浅部孔隙度（Wyllie方程）校正的实验室岩石物理测量数据相结合，界定了中生代灰岩顶面、变质砂岩、海西期片麻岩结晶基底、下地壳辉长岩过……

t: Intersections between resampled 3D adjoint P-wave tomography and laboratory-derived lithological Vp ranges—corrected for pressure, temperature (linear derivatives), and shallow porosity (Wyllie equation)—are used to classify model cells and delineate 3D intra-crustal discontinuity surfaces.
通过经温压和孔隙度校正的实验室岩性Vp范围与重采样三维伴随层析成像的交点，划分三维壳内不连续面。

The model integrates a 5×5×1 km³ resampled adjoint Vp tomography volume (211,308 cells), 175 pressure and 119 temperature laboratory Vp derivatives, a 10-m DEM, a receiver-function Moho surface, ViDEPI boreholes, CROP profiles, and gravity inversions.
整合了5×5×1 km³伴随层析成像、175个压力和119个温度岩石Vp导数、DEM、莫霍面、钻井及重磁剖面。

The model maps the carbonate top (0 to -10 km), metasandstones (-4 to -10 km), gneissic basement (-6 to -13 km), and gabbroic lower crust (5–7 km above Moho in Tyrrhenian, 10–13 km in Adriatic), confirming gneiss best represents the basement.
绘出了碳酸盐岩顶面、变质砂岩、片麻岩基底（-6至-13 km）及辉长岩界面，证实片麻岩最能代表结晶基底。

Model resolution is bounded by the input tomography, and the petrophysical classification cannot fully capture local compositional heterogeneity, anisotropy, fluid content, or sharp geological contacts.
空间分辨率受限于输入层析成像，且无法完全反映局部成分异质性、各向异性和流体影响。
Delivers the first regionally consistent, multi-parametric 3D crustal model of the Southern Apennines by directly calibrating 3D seismic tomography with P-T corrected petrophysical rock properties.
通过将三维地震层析成像与温压校正岩石物理性质直接标定，构建了南亚平宁首个区域一致的三维地壳模型。

kc: Constructed the first regionally consistent 3D crustal model of the Southern Apennines on a regular 5 × 5 × 1 km³ grid down to 50 km depth.
Compiled 175 pressure and 119 temperature derivatives of laboratory P-wave velocities to establish P-T corrected in-situ velocity-depth profiles for key crustal lithologies.
Delineated 3D intra-crustal discontinuity surfaces including the Mesozoic carbonate platform, metasandstones, gneissic basement, and mafic lower crust.
Released a complete, FAIR-compliant open-access repository containing all raw, intermediate, and final 3D grids and validation datasets.
构建了意大利南亚平宁地区首个区域一致的5×5×1 km³规则网格三维地壳模型（深度达50 km）。
汇编了175个压力导数和119个温度导数的实验室P波速度数据，建立了关键地壳岩性的原位温压校正速度-深度剖面。
圈定了包括中生代碳酸盐岩台地、变质砂岩、片麻岩基底和镁铁质下地壳在内的三维壳内不连续面。
发布了完全符合FAIR原则的开放获取数据集，包含所有原始、中间及最终三维网格与验证数据。
me: Resampling unstructured hexahedral adjoint P-wave tomography onto a regular 5 × 5 × 1 km³ grid (211,308 cells).
Applying linear pressure and temperature corrections (using regional geotherms of 30 °C/km and 22 °C/km) and shallow Wyllie porosity equations to laboratory rock velocities.
Identifying 1D and 3D lithological boundaries via intersections between tomographic Vp and calibrated laboratory Vp ranges.
Multi-parametric cross-validation against deep exploration wells, CROP reflection transects, receiver functions, and 3D potential-field inversions.
将非结构化六面体网格伴随P波层析成像重采样至5×5×1 km³规则网格（共211,308个网格单元）。
利用区域地温梯度（30 °C/km和22 °C/km）及浅部Wyllie孔隙度方程对实验室岩石速度进行温压校正。
通过层析成像Vp与标定后的实验室岩性Vp范围的交点，识别一维和三维岩性边界。
利用深部探井、CROP反射地震剖面、接收函数及三维位场反演模型进行多参数交叉验证。
de: 3D full-waveform adjoint P-wave tomography model (Magnoni et al., 2022) derived from 163 regional earthquakes recorded at 412 stations.
Laboratory P-wave velocity measurements compilation (175 pressure and 119 temperature derivatives across upper/lower crust and mantle lithologies).
TINITALY 1.1 10-m DEM, Spada et al. (2013) receiver-function/CSS Moho surface, and digitized thrust traces from Vezzani et al. (2010).
Validation datasets: ViDEPI deep hydrocarbon wells, CROP-04 and CROP-11b,c seismic reflection profiles, and 3D gravity/magnetic inversion interfaces.
基于412个台站记录的163次区域地震构建的三维全波形伴随P波层析成像模型（Magnoni et al., 2022）。
实验室P波速度测量汇编数据集（涵盖上下地壳和地幔岩性的175个压力导数和119个温度导数）。
TINITALY 1.1 10米分辨率DEM、Spada等（2013）接收函数/人工源莫霍面，以及Vezzani等（2010）数字化逆冲断层迹线。
验证数据集：ViDEPI深部油气探井、CROP-04和CROP-11b,c深反射地震剖面，以及三维重磁反演界面。
li: Spatial resolution is limited by the input seismic tomography (5–20 km horizontally, 3–7 km vertically), capturing regional architecture rather than local fault geometries.
Partial overlap in velocity ranges between metasandstones and gneiss introduces uncertainty in separating their boundary in poorly constrained areas.
Petrophysical classification cannot fully account for local compositional heterogeneity, seismic anisotropy, fluid content, or unresolved thermal variations.
空间分辨率受限于输入的地震层析成像（水平5–20 km，垂向3–7 km），仅能反映区域尺度结构而非局部断层几何形态。
变质砂岩与片麻岩的速度范围存在部分重叠，在约束较差区域给两者界面的识别带来不确定性。
岩石物理分类无法完全考虑局部成分异质性、地震各向异性、流体含量或未分辨的热变化。

tm.why: The paper constructs and validates a comprehensive 3D crustal structure model of the Southern Apennines from topography to the Moho.
The 3D model is built primarily upon a resampled P-wave velocity model from full-waveform adjoint tomography.
The study delineates key intra-crustal discontinuities and incorporates receiver-function-derived Moho constraints for model assembly and validation.

ev.notes: Full 35-page preprint PDF from Earth System Science Data Discussions (essd-2026-513) was analyzed, including all 12 figures and 3 tables.

sum: Basal sliding controls fast-flowing outlet glaciers, yet in-situ constraints on bed friction remain scarce. This study analyzes nearly 25,000 basal stick-slip icequakes grouped into 133 clusters over five weeks prior to the melt season at Sermeq Kujalleq (Jakobshavn Isbræ), Greenland. Combining time-domain S-wave integration on individual events with Brune spectral fitting and rate-and-state friction modeling on stacked cluster waveforms, the authors estimate seismic moments, stress drops, and frictional shear stresses. Seismic slip accounts for only ~10^-5 of total glacier motion, indicating predominantly aseismic deformation. However, ~64% of total seismic potency originates from a persistent region west of the array, where cluster frictional stresses vary across three orders of magnitude (up to ~100 kPa), indicating localized high-friction asperities. Furthermore, the authors document 14 kilometer-scale downstream and upstream icequake migration episodes coinciding with falling and neap tides, providing the first evidence of propagating transient basal slip fronts beneath a fast Greenlandic glacier.
本研究分析了格陵兰最快溢流冰川（SKK）融化季前五周记录的近2.5万次基底粘滑冰震（分为133个簇）。结合单事件时域积分与叠加波形的Brune谱拟合及速率-状态摩擦模型，反演了地震矩和基底摩擦应力。结果显示地震滑移仅占冰川总运动的约10^-5，但64%的地震潜能集中在一个持久活跃区，各簇摩擦应力跨越……

t: Combines time-domain S-wave integration for individual icequake seismic moments with frequency-domain Brune spectral fitting and rate-and-state friction modeling on stacked cluster waveforms using Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation.
结合单事件S波时域积分与簇叠加波形频域Brune谱拟合及速率-状态摩擦模型，采用蒙特卡洛方法量化不确定性。

Nearly 25,000 basal stick-slip icequakes grouped into 133 clusters via template matching, recorded over five weeks (May–June 2022) by a three-station array 30 km upstream of the Sermeq Kujalleq calving front.
格陵兰SKK冰川崩解前缘上游30 km处三台阵在5周内记录的近2.5万次基底粘滑冰震（归为133个簇）。

Seismic slip represents ~10^-5 of total glacier motion, but 64% of seismic potency concentrates in one persistent zone; cluster frictional shear stresses span 0.4–100 kPa, and 14 kilometer-scale slip migrations occur mostly during falling tides.
地震滑移仅占总运动10^-5，但64%地震潜能集中于单一持久区；摩擦应力跨0.4–100 kPa，发现14次千米级滑移迁…

With only two borehole stations providing usable spectra, the trade-off between attenuation Q and corner frequency fc cannot be independently resolved, and fixed rate-and-state frictional parameters add unquantified uncertainty.
仅两台井下仪器可用，无法独立解耦Q与拐角频率fc的折衷，且固定的摩擦参数引入了未量化的不确定性。

First direct observational constraints on basal frictional stress from stick-slip icequakes and first evidence of transient upstream and downstream basal slip migrations beneath a fast-flowing Greenlandic outlet glacier.
首次利用粘滑冰震约束格陵兰快流冰川基底摩擦应力，并首次观测到其基底千米级顺流与逆流瞬态滑移迁移。

kc: Compiled and analyzed nearly 25,000 basal stick-slip icequakes across 133 spatial clusters beneath Sermeq Kujalleq (Jakobshavn Isbræ) over a 5-week pre-melt period.

Provided first-order seismic constraints on basal stress drop (0.1–50 kPa) and frictional shear stress (0.4–100 kPa) beneath a fast-flowing Greenlandic outlet glacier using Brune spectral fitting and rate-and-state friction.
Demonstrated strong spatial heterogeneity where ~64% of seismic potency is concentrated in a persistent sticky spot, even though total seismic slip accounts for only ~10^-5 of surface motion.
Discovered 14 episodes of kilometer-scale downstream and upstream migration of basal icequake bursts (0.14–0.93 km/h), mostly coinciding with falling or neap ocean tides.
汇编并分析了格陵兰SKK冰川融化季前5周内记录的近25,000次基底粘滑冰震（划分为133个空间簇）。
利用Brune谱拟合和速率-状态摩擦定律，首次给出了格陵兰快流溢流冰川基底应力降（0.1–50 kPa）和摩擦剪应力（0.4–100 kPa）的一阶地震学约束。
揭示了强烈的空间异质性：尽管地震滑移仅占冰川表面运动的约10^-5，但约64%的地震潜能集中在台阵西侧的持久高摩擦凹凸体区域。
发现了14次千米级顺流和逆流方向的基底冰震丛集迁移事件（速度0.14–0.93 km/h），且大多与落潮或小潮期吻合。
me: Cross-correlation template matching (threshold >0.5 across at least 3 of 7 components) and probabilistic cluster location using NonLinLoc on stacked cluster waveforms.
Time-domain S-wave displacement integration (bandpass 20–120 Hz, corrected for shear-wave splitting and LQT rotation) to estimate single-event seismic moments and temporal evolution.
Frequency-domain Brune source model fitting on stacked cluster S-wave spectra (6–200 Hz) with Monte Carlo sampling (N=1000) over Q (150–800), Vs (1750–2150 m/s), and hypocentral location.

Rate-and-state friction law modeling under steady-state assumptions using corner frequency and median within-burst inter-event times to infer effective normal stress, frictional shear stress, and slip.
Weighted linear regression of along-flow spatio-temporal icequake bursts (weighted by square root of summed seismic moment) to quantify transient slip migration velocities.
采用互相关模板匹配（7个分量中至少3个相关系数>0.5）识别事件，并利用NonLinLoc对各簇叠加波形进行概率定位。
对单事件S波位移进行时域积分（20–120 Hz带通滤波，经横波分裂校正和LQT坐标旋转），估算单事件地震矩及时间演化。
对簇叠加S波谱（6–200 Hz）进行频域Brune源模型拟合，并通过蒙特卡洛采样（N=1000）传播品质因子Q（150–800）、波速Vs和震源位置的不确定性。
基于稳态假设应用速率-状态摩擦定律，结合拐角频率和丛集内事件间隔时间中位数，推算有效正应力、摩擦剪应力和滑移量。
对沿冰流方向的时空冰震丛集进行加权线性回归（以总地震矩平方根加权），量化瞬态滑移迁移的速度与方向。
de: Continuous passive seismic waveforms recorded between May 20 and June 28, 2022, by a three-station array (two 3-m deep 4.5 Hz borehole geophones at 500 Hz and one surface 14 Hz SG-box at 400 Hz) located ~30 km upstream of the SKK calving front.
Environmental and external forcing datasets: weather station air temperature and wind speed, GNSS-derived surface flow velocities, Kangia fjord tidal pressure sensor data, and calving event catalog.
Synthetic event injection tests adding stacked cluster waveforms into post-June melt-season noise to evaluate template-matching detection completeness during high meltwater noise.
2022年5月20日至6月28日期间由距SKK崩解前缘约30 km的三台阵（两个3米深4.5 Hz井下检波器，采样率500 Hz；一个地表14 Hz地震-GNSS自主站，采样率400 Hz）记录的连续被动源地震波形。
外部环境强迫数据集：气象站气温与风速、GNSS冰川表面流速、Kangia峡湾潮汐压力计数据以及冰川崩解事件目录。
合成事件注入测试：将叠加的簇波形加入6月下旬融化季的高噪数据中，评估融水噪声主导频段时的模板匹配检测能力。
li: Only two borehole stations provided usable broadband spectra, preventing independent separation of path attenuation (Q) and corner frequency (fc) via spectral ratios and creating a strong Q–fc trade-off.
Clusters with true Q < 150 cannot be resolved due to unphysically high corner frequencies, meaning reported fc, stress drop, and frictional stress values are likely underestimated.
Rate-and-state frictional parameters (mu0, a, b) and bed shear modulus (G_bed = 20–70 MPa) are fixed from literature rather than independently constrained at the study site.
Elevated meltwater noise at the onset of the summer melt season in late June completely masks basal icequake signals, preventing assessment of seasonal transitions in stick-slip activity.
仅有两台井下地震仪提供可用宽频谱，无法通过谱比法独立分离路径衰减（Q）与拐角频率（fc），导致显著的Q-fc折衷不确定性。
由于真实Q<150会产生非物理的高拐角频率，方法无法解析低Q簇，导致报告的fc、应力降和摩擦应力可能偏低。
速率-状态摩擦参数（mu0, a, b）及冰床剪切模量（20–70 MPa）取自文献固定值，缺乏研究区的独立原位约束。
6月下旬夏季融化季开始时融水流动产生的高频噪声完全掩盖了基底冰震信号，阻碍了对粘滑活动季节性转变的观测。

tm.why: The paper analyzes nearly 25,000 basal stick-slip icequakes to infer basal frictional conditions and slip migration beneath Greenland's fastest outlet glacier.
The study applies rate-and-state friction laws and identifies kilometer-scale transient slip migration fronts analogous to tectonic slow-slip and tremor reversals.
The authors compile a catalog of ~25,000 icequakes across 133 clusters using cross-correlation template matching and NonLinLoc probabilistic location.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF (including main text and Appendices A–H) was read and analyzed in detail.

sum: Electrical conductivity (EC) constrains deep mantle composition and volatiles, yet the EC of davemaoite (CaSiO3 perovskite) remained poorly resolved. Using impedance spectroscopy in a laser-heated diamond anvil cell, the authors measured the EC of nominally dry CaSiO3 perovskite up to 89 GPa and 2200 K. Conductivity increases with temperature but systematically decreases with pressure, consistent with oxygen-vacancy-mediated ionic transport and 4 to 6 times lower than prior experimental reports. A distinct shift in temperature dependence coincides with the tetragonal-to-cubic phase transition, showing modest ionic transport enhancement in the cubic phase. Along a normal geotherm, dry davemaoite has conductivity comparable to bridgmanite near the top of the lower mantle (0.84 S/m at 31 GPa) but becomes much less conductive with depth. Under cold-slab conditions, its conductivity (0.00083 to 0.015 S/m) cannot explain observed high-conductivity anomalies beneath subduction zones.
本研究利用激光加热金刚石压腔结合交流阻抗谱，在高达89 GPa和2200 K的下地幔条件下测量了名义无水CaSiO3钙钛矿（毛钙硅石）的电导率。结果表明，其电导率随温度升高而增加，随压力升高而系统性降低，比早期实验结果低4-6倍，支持氧空位主导的离子传导机制。电导率温度依赖性的转折与四方相向立方相的……

t: High P-T electrical impedance spectroscopy (10 Hz to 1 MHz) was performed in a symmetric laser-heated diamond anvil cell using iridium electrodes, paired with synchrotron XRD and 2D finite-difference thermal modeling.
在对称激光加热金刚石压腔中利用铱电极进行高温高压阻抗谱测量，结合同步辐射XRD与二维热传导模拟。
In situ electrical conductivity measurements of nominally dry CaSiO3 perovskite synthesized from glass powder across five pressure intervals from 31 to 89 GPa and temperatures from 1040 to 2200 K.
在31至89 GPa的五个压力区间及1040至2200 K温度下，对合成干CaSiO3钙钛矿进行原位电导率测量。
Conductivity decreases with pressure and is 4–6 times lower than prior data at 31 GPa. Along a normal geotherm, EC is 0.84–0.19 S/m (31–53 GPa), and 0.00083–0.015 S/m along a cold slab geotherm.
电导率随压力降低，比前人结果低4-6倍；正常地温线下为0.84–0.19 S/m，冷板片下为0.00083–0.015 …
Measurements only constrain pure, dry end-member CaSiO3, leaving the effects of natural Al, Ti, and H2O incorporations in subducted oceanic crust experimentally unquantified.
仅约束了纯干CaSiO3端元，尚未通过实验量化天然俯冲洋壳中Al、Ti和H2O掺杂对电导率的影响。

Resolves discrepancy between theory and experiment by providing the first EC data for davemaoite up to 89 GPa, revealing negative pressure dependence and transport changes across the tetragonal-to-cubic transition.
首次获得高达89 GPa的毛钙硅石电导率，证实负压力依赖性及四方-立方相变伴随的导电行为突变。

kc: Measured in situ electrical conductivity of dry CaSiO3 perovskite up to 89 GPa and 2200 K in a laser-heated diamond anvil cell.
Demonstrated that dry davemaoite conductivity systematically decreases with pressure and is 4 to 6 times lower than previous measurements, supporting oxygen-vacancy transport.
Identified a three-stage temperature dependence coinciding with the tetragonal-to-cubic structural transition.
Showed that dry davemaoite contributes negligibly to bulk lower-mantle conductivity and cannot explain subduction zone high-conductivity anomalies.
利用激光加热金刚石压腔原位测量了干CaSiO3钙钛矿在高达89 GPa和2200 K下的电导率。
证实干毛钙硅石电导率随压力增加而系统性降低，比先前测量结果低4至6倍，支持氧空位传输机制。
发现了与四方-立方结构相变边界一致的三阶段温度依赖性变化。
证明干毛钙硅石对全下地幔电导率贡献微弱，且无法解释俯冲带下方的高导异常。
me: High-pressure, high-temperature impedance spectroscopy (10 Hz to 1 MHz) in a symmetric laser-heated diamond anvil cell (LHDAC) with iridium foil electrodes.
Synchrotron X-ray diffraction at SPring-8 to confirm davemaoite synthesis and determine pressure via thermal equation of state.
2D steady-state finite-difference heat-conduction modeling to determine representative area-averaged sample temperatures.
Equivalent circuit modeling of Nyquist impedance spectra and Arrhenius fitting across distinct structural regimes.
在配备铱箔电极的对称激光加热金刚石压腔（LHDAC）中进行高温高压交流阻抗谱测量（10 Hz至1 MHz）。
利用SPring-8同步辐射X射线衍射确认毛钙硅石合成并通过热状态方程标定压力。
采用二维稳态有限差分热传导模型计算激光加热区域内具有代表性的样品平均温度。
对Nyquist阻抗谱进行等效电路拟合，并对不同结构温压区间进行Arrhenius关系拟合。
de: Two experimental runs on synthesized nominally dry CaSiO3 glass powder at pressures of 31–32, 43–48, 50–57, 66–68, and 83–89 GPa and temperatures of 1040–2200 K.
Focused Ga ion beam (FIB) cross-sectioning and SEM elemental mapping on recovered samples to measure thickness and check for electrode contamination.
对名义无水CaSiO3玻璃粉合成样品在31–32、43–48、50–57、66–68及83–89 GPa压力和1040–2200 K温度下开展两组实验测量。
利用聚焦镓离子束（FIB）切割回收样品并进行SEM元素面扫描，以测量样品厚度并检验是否存在电极污染。
li: Experiments were limited to pure, nominally dry CaSiO3 end-member, whereas natural davemaoite in subducted MORB contains Al, Ti, and H2O.
At ~86 GPa, the high-temperature cubic phase (Region III) Arrhenius relation was not experimentally constrained, requiring extrapolation from Region II to reach ambient geotherm temperatures.
实验仅限于纯的、名义无水CaSiO3端元，而俯冲洋壳中的天然毛钙硅石含有Al、Ti和H2O等杂质。
在约86 GPa下，高温立方相（区域III）的Arrhenius关系未能被实验直接约束，推算正常地温线电导率时需从区域II外推。

tm.why: The paper measures the electrical conductivity of davemaoite (CaSiO3 perovskite) under lower-mantle pressure and temperature conditions to constrain deep mantle composition and volatile cycling.

ev.notes: Full 46-page manuscript and supplementary material PDF analyzed, including all main text sections, 2 tables, 7 main figures, and 6 supplementary figures.

sum: This study investigates how same-dip double subduction (SDDS) modifies plate kinematics using 3-D spherical whole-mantle finite-element models (ASPECT) and semi-analytical torque-balance analyses. By comparing pseudo-instantaneous single- and double-subduction end-member configurations across diverse rheological and geometric parameters, the authors show that inserting a finite-width intra-oceanic rear slab consistently accelerates the subducting plate (up to 2.3 times behind the rear trench), redirects plate motion, and shifts Euler poles by up to 33° (~3,600 km). Novel torque-balance decomposition reveals that the dominant driver of Euler pole displacement is a previously unrecognized reduction in effective subducting-plate area resisting basal drag, while enhanced slab pull provides a secondary reinforcing effect. Furthermore, rheological properties mainly scale absolute plate speeds, whereas plate and trench geometries control relative velocity differences and distance-dependent inter-trench slab-pull transmission.
本研究利用三维球面全地幔有限元模型（ASPECT）与半解析力矩平衡分析，探究同向双俯冲（SDDS）如何改变板块运动学。通过对比不同流变学和几何参数下的单俯冲与双俯冲端元模型，发现加入有限宽度的洋内后方俯冲带会持续加速俯冲板块（后方海沟后方速度比达2.3倍）、改变运动方向，并引发高达33°（约3600……

t: Constructs 3-D spherical whole-mantle finite-element models in ASPECT for pseudo-instantaneous (10 kyr) single and double subduction configurations, complemented by a semi-analytical slab-pull versus basal-drag torque-balance model.
利用ASPECT构建三维球面全地幔准瞬时有限元模型，结合板片拉力与基底拖拽半解析力矩平衡分析。

Synthetic parameter suite testing three rheological variables (crustal, lithospheric, and power-law mantle viscosities) and five geometric variables (plate width, plate length, trench separation, trench length ratio, and obliquity) on a non-uniform ~4.9-million-cell mesh.
在约490万网格单元上测试3个流变学参数和5个板块及海沟几何参数的合成数值实验数据集。

Double subduction increases far-field plate velocity by ~1.5x (peaking at ~2.3x behind the rear trench) and shifts Euler poles by up to 33° (~3,600 km), with ~20° driven by plate-area reduction and ~10° by added slab pull.
双俯冲使远场板块速度提升约1.5倍（后方海沟后达2.3倍），欧拉极偏移达33°，其中面积减小贡献约20°。

Pseudo-instantaneous models use prescribed geometries without time-dependent slab evolution, elasticity, or free surface, and the analytical torque balance omits plate bending dissipation and lateral asthenospheric viscosity variations.
准瞬时模型未包含时变演化、弹性和自由表面，解析力矩平衡忽略了弯曲耗散与横向粘度变化。
First 3-D spherical modeling study of finite-trench same-dip double subduction demonstrating that reduced basal-drag plate area dominates Euler pole shifts over additional slab pull.
首次通过三维球面模拟揭示基底拖拽有效面积减小比新增板片拉力更主导双俯冲欧拉极偏移。

kc: Quantified plate velocity increases and Euler pole shifts (up to 33°) induced by finite-extent same-dip double subduction in 3-D spherical whole-mantle models.
Identified via torque-balance analysis that reduction in effective subducting-plate area (reducing basal-drag resistance) dominates Euler pole shifts over additional slab pull.

Demonstrated that rheological parameters govern absolute plate speeds while geometric parameters (plate size, trench separation, obliquity) control relative velocity reorganizations and distance-dependent force transmission.
在三维球面全地幔模型中量化了有限展布同向双俯冲引起的板块速度增加及高达33°的欧拉极偏移。
通过力矩平衡分析发现，有效俯冲板块面积减小（降低基底拖拽阻力）对欧拉极偏移的贡献大于新增板片拉力。
证明流变学参数主要控制板块绝对速度，而几何参数（板块大小、海沟间距、斜交角）控制相对速度重组及距离依赖的应力传递。
me: 3-D spherical pseudo-instantaneous (10 kyr) incompressible creeping flow modeling using ASPECT and Geodynamic World Builder.
Least-squares rigid-plate rotation optimization on a 1° x 1° grid to determine best-fitting Euler poles and plateness.
Semi-analytical spherical torque-balance modeling equating trench-integrated slab-pull torque and area-integrated basal-drag torque with an inter-trench force transmission factor k.
利用ASPECT和Geodynamic World Builder进行三维球面准瞬时（10 kyr）不可压缩蠕变流数值模拟。
在1°×1°网格上进行最小二乘刚性板块旋转优化，计算最佳拟合欧拉极与板块刚度（plateness）。
建立半解析球面力矩平衡模型，平衡沿海沟积分的板片拉力矩与按面积积分的基底拖拽力矩，并引入海沟间应力传递系数k。
de: Suite of paired single- and double-subduction 3-D spherical models varying crust/mantle viscosity contrast (0.1 to 2), lithosphere/mantle viscosity contrast (100 to 2000), and transition strain rate.
Geometric parameter sweep varying plate size (36° to 60°), plate width, rear-to-front trench length ratio (1/3 to 2/3), trench separation (1/6 to 1/2), and rear-trench obliquity (0° to 31°).
Analytical torque decomposition experiments isolating the effects of reduced plate area versus enhanced slab pull.
成对的单俯冲与双俯冲三维球面模型实验，改变壳幔粘度比（0.1至2）、岩石圈/地幔粘度比（100至2000）及转换应变率。
几何参数扫描实验，改变板块尺寸（36°至60°）、板块宽度、前后海沟长度比（1/3至2/3）、海沟间距（1/6至1/2）及后方海沟斜交角（0°至31°）。
分离板块有效面积减小与板片拉力增加各自贡献的解析力矩分解实验。
li: Models are pseudo-instantaneous (run for 10 kyr) with prescribed geometries and do not simulate time-dependent subduction initiation, termination, or self-consistent slab evolution.
Neglects thermal diffusion, elasticity, free-surface effects, mantle phase transitions, mantle plumes, and ridge push.
Semi-analytical torque balance assumes constant basal viscosity and neglects lithospheric bending resistance, overpredicting pole shifts at large trench separations and obliquities.
模型采用预设几何形态的准瞬时模拟（10 kyr），未模拟随时间演化的俯冲起始、终止或板片自洽演化。
忽略了热扩散、弹性、自由表面效应、地幔相变、地幔柱和洋脊推力。
半解析力矩平衡假设基底粘度恒定并忽略岩石圈弯曲阻力，在海沟间距和斜交角较大时高估了欧拉极偏移。

tm.why: The paper uses 3-D spherical geodynamic finite-element models and torque-balance calculations to investigate how same-dip double subduction modifies plate velocities and Euler poles.

ev.notes: Full 24-page PDF from JGR: Solid Earth used, including all equations, methods, numerical results, torque-balance analyses, and 9 figures.

sum: This paper presents a novel methodological framework that integrates probabilistic stratigraphic age models into the development of site-based apparent polar wander paths (APWPs). By resampling from the posterior distributions of Bayesian age models, the method incorporates temporal uncertainty while honoring stratigraphic superposition constraints. The authors demonstrate the approach using volcanic and sedimentary successions with U-Pb age constraints from the Mesoproterozoic Midcontinent Rift of North America and southwestern Laurentia. The resulting high-resolution Keweenawan Track APWP provides detailed insights into plate motion rates and the timing of directional changes, demonstrating how probabilistic treatment of age and positional uncertainties can significantly improve quantitative tectonic reconstructions.
本文提出了一种将概率地层年代模型整合到基于样点的视极移路径（APWP）构建中的新方法。通过对贝叶斯年代模型后验分布进行重采样，该方法在遵循地层叠覆律的同时纳入了时间不确定性。作者利用北美中大陆裂谷及劳伦大陆西南部的中元古代晚期火山岩和沉积序列（含U-Pb年龄约束）对该方法进行了验证。结果获得了高分辨……

t: Integration of probabilistic stratigraphic age models into site-based apparent polar wander paths by resampling from Bayesian posterior distributions to honor stratigraphic superposition and temporal uncertainty.
通过对贝叶斯后验分布进行重采样，将概率地层年代模型整合到基于样点的视极移路径中。
Volcanic and sedimentary successions with U-Pb age constraints from the late Mesoproterozoic Midcontinent Rift of North America and contemporaneous units from southwestern Laurentia.
北美中元古代晚期中大陆裂谷的火山-沉积序列及劳伦大陆西南部的同期岩石（含U-Pb约束）。
A high-resolution site-based APWP of the Keweenawan Track that resolves plate motion rates and directional changes with higher temporal resolution than traditional running means.
获得了高分辨率的Keweenawan Track样点APWP，比传统滑动平均法更精确地约束了板块运动速率。
The approach is dependent on having sufficient geochronological data and clear stratigraphic constraints to construct robust Bayesian age models.
该方法依赖于充足的放射性同位素测年数据和明确的地层叠覆关系。
First integration of Bayesian stratigraphic age models into site-based APWPs, allowing simultaneous propagation of temporal and spatial uncertainties while respecting stratigraphic order.
首次将贝叶斯地层年代模型引入样点APWP构建，实现了时间和空间不确定性的联合传播。

kc: Developed a framework to integrate Bayesian stratigraphic age models into site-based apparent polar wander paths (APWPs).
Enabled the incorporation of stratigraphic superposition constraints and temporal uncertainties into paleomagnetic reconstructions.
Constructed a high-resolution site-based APWP for the Keweenawan Track, providing tighter constraints on Mesoproterozoic plate motion rates.
开发了将贝叶斯地层年代模型整合到基于样点的视极移路径（APWP）中的计算框架。
实现了在古地磁重建中纳入地层叠覆律约束和时间不确定性。
构建了Keweenawan Track的高分辨率样点APWP，为中元古代板块运动速率提供了更紧密的约束。
me: Bayesian stratigraphic age modeling to generate posterior age distributions.
Resampling from posterior age distributions to propagate temporal uncertainty into paleomagnetic site poles.
Site-based apparent polar wander path (APWP) estimation instead of traditional study-level mean poles.
利用贝叶斯地层年代学建模生成后验年龄分布。
通过对后验年龄分布进行重采样，将时间不确定性传播到古地磁样点极中。
采用基于样点的视极移路径（APWP）估计，而非传统的基于研究级别的平均极。
de: Volcanic and sedimentary successions from the late Mesoproterozoic Midcontinent Rift of North America.
Contemporaneous lavas and intrusions from southwestern Laurentia with high-precision U-Pb age constraints.
来自北美中元古代晚期中大陆裂谷的火山岩和沉积序列数据。
来自劳伦大陆西南部、具有高精度U-Pb年龄约束的同期熔岩和侵入岩数据。
li: The method relies heavily on the availability of high-quality geochronological constraints and well-defined stratigraphic relationships.
该方法高度依赖于高质量地质年代学约束和明确定义的地层层序关系的存在。

tm.why: The paper integrates probabilistic stratigraphic age models and Bayesian posterior distributions to incorporate temporal uncertainty into apparent polar wander paths.
The method is applied to apparent polar wander paths (APWPs) to reconstruct long-term lithospheric plate motions and paleogeography.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata.

sum: Modern deep-learning earthquake catalogs contain massive event counts but suffer from short-term aftershock incompleteness (STAI), making standard O(n^2) likelihood-based Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) inference computationally prohibitive and analytically intractable. This study introduces a likelihood-free Simulation-Based Inference (SBI) framework combining Approximate Bayesian Computation (ABC) with multi-start stochastic optimization. The method bypasses explicit likelihood evaluations by minimizing the discrepancy between observed and simulated catalogs using domain-informed summary statistics derived from Baiesi-Paczuski-Zaliapin-Ben-Zion nearest-neighbor declustering across space-time-magnitude cells. Validated on synthetic catalogs and applied to Southern California seismicity (1981–2023), the incomplete ETAS (ETASI) model accurately recovers true triggering parameters and blind-time scales while eliminating systematic productivity biases present in standard ETAS inversions. By filtering candidate neighbors, the framework achieves sub-quadratic empirical computational scaling (N^1.74), offering a scalable, parallelizable solution for next-generation seismic forecasting.
针对现代高分辨率地震目录规模庞大且存在短期余震不完备性（STAI）导致传统ETAS似然评估计算受限或解析不可行的问题，本文提出了一种结合近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）与多起点随机优化的无似然模拟推断（SBI）框架。该方法利用基于最近邻除丛的时空震级网格统计量，通过最小化观测与模拟目录间的差异来反演参数。在……

t: An ABC-inspired simulation-based inference algorithm combines multi-start stochastic block optimization with nearest-neighbor declustering summary statistics to minimize relative aftershock count discrepancies across space-time-magnitude cells without evaluating intractable likelihoods.
结合多起点随机分块优化与最近邻除丛摘要统计量的无似然模拟推断，最小化时空震级网格余震差异。

Validated on synthetic incomplete ETASI catalogs (mc = 2.0, 2.5, 3.0; up to 2.7×10^5 events) and applied to the relocated Southern California catalog (1981–2023) with N = 39,986 (mc = 2.5) and N = 11,899 (mc = 3.0) events.
采用合成不完备目录（达27万事件）及1981-2023年南加州地震目录（mc=2.5含39,986事件）验证。

ETASI eliminates systematic biases in productivity (α, K) and Omori c seen in standard ETAS under incompleteness, infers Southern California blind times of 32–64 s, and scales sub-quadratically as N^1.74 vs N^2.20 for likelihood inversion.
消除了不完备导致的生产率与c值偏差，测得南加州盲区时间32-64秒，计算耗时呈N^1.74亚二次方扩展。

Assumes minimum triggering magnitude equals catalog cutoff (m0 = mc), uses a simplified constant blind-spot model, omits foreshock statistics, and relies on finite optimization trajectories rather than exact posterior sampling.
假设最小触发震级等于完备震级，采用简化恒定盲区模型，忽略前震统计且为近似后验集合。

First application of likelihood-free simulation-based inference to the full spatio-temporal ETAS framework and its analytically intractable incomplete variant (ETASI) using locally informative nearest-neighbor summary statistics.
首次将结合最近邻统计量的无似然模拟推断应用于时空ETAS及解析不可行的不完备ETASI模型。

kc: Developed a likelihood-free simulation-based inference (SBI) framework for the spatio-temporal incomplete ETAS (ETASI) model.
Introduced locally informative nearest-neighbor summary statistics that capture short-term space-time-magnitude aftershock clustering.
Reduced per-iteration inference complexity from O(n^2) to O(n log n) for simulation and O(nm) for filtered declustering, achieving empirical N^1.74 scaling.
Demonstrated on synthetic and Southern California catalogs that accounting for short-term incompleteness removes systematic biases in Omori c and productivity parameters.
为时空不完备ETAS（ETASI）模型开发了无似然模拟推断（SBI）框架。
提出了基于最近邻聚类的局部信息摘要统计量，有效捕捉短期时空震级余震触发特征。
将单次迭代复杂度从O(n^2)降至O(n log n)模拟与O(nm)滤波除丛，实现N^1.74的亚二次方扩展。
通过合成与南加州数据证实，显式建模短期不完备性可消除Omori参数c和生产率参数的系统偏差。
me: Approximate Bayesian Computation (ABC) combined with multi-start stochastic local optimization in block-updated parameter space.
Baiesi-Paczuski-Zaliapin-Ben-Zion (BPZB) nearest-neighbor declustering with automatic Susceptibility Index (SI) thresholding to separate background rate estimation.
Space-time-magnitude cell binning of normalized aftershock counts around mainshocks to construct summary statistics and relative discrepancy cost functions.
Magnitude-dependent temporal history filtering and cutoff thresholding during cluster reconstruction to accelerate summary statistic evaluation.
结合近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）与分块参数更新的多起点随机局部优化算法。
利用结合自动易感性指数（SI）阈值的BPZB最近邻除丛法，独立估计背景地震活动率。
对主震周围时空震级网格内的归一化余震数量进行统计，构建摘要统计量与相对差异代价函数。
在簇重构中引入震级相关的历史时间滤波与截断阈值，大幅加速摘要统计量的计算。
de: Local sensitivity tests (one-direction, random-direction, and single-parameter perturbations) verifying summary statistic informativeness.
Benchmark comparison against exact Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) on simplified Omori-Utsu synthetic sequences with and without incompleteness.
Full 8-parameter ETAS and ETASI inversions on synthetic incomplete catalogs across magnitude cutoffs mc = 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0, plus runtime scaling tests up to 2.7 x 10^5 events.
Application to the relocated Southern California Earthquake Data Center (SCEDC) catalog (1981–2023, N = 39,986 for mc = 2.5 and N = 11,899 for mc = 3.0).
通过单向、随机方向和单参数扰动进行局部敏感性测试，验证摘要统计量的有效性。
在完整与不完整简化Omori-Utsu合成序列上，将SBI与精确最大似然估计（MLE）进行基准对比。
在不同震级下限（mc = 2.0, 2.5, 3.0）的合成不完备目录上进行8参数反演，并测试高达27万事件的运行时间扩展性。
应用于南加州地震数据中心（SCEDC）重定位目录（1981–2023年，mc=2.5含39,986个事件，mc=3.0含11,899个事件）。
li: Assumes minimum triggering magnitude equals catalog completeness cutoff (m0 = mc), yielding effective rather than true physical parameters under catalog censorship.
Uses a simplified constant blind-time and blind-radius step function for short-term aftershock incompleteness.
Omit foreshock counts from summary statistics, limiting applicability to models with distinct foreshock kernels.
Produces an optimization-based approximate posterior ensemble influenced by stopping criteria rather than exact Bayesian posterior samples.
假设最小触发震级等于目录完备震级（m0 = mc），在目录截断下所得为有效参数而非真实物理参数。
对短期余震不完备性采用了简化的恒定盲区时间和空间半径阶跃函数模型。
摘要统计量未包含前震计数，限制了在具有独立前震核函数模型中的应用。
生成的是受停止准则影响的基于优化的近似后验集合，而非精确的贝叶斯后验采样。

tm.why: The paper develops an Approximate Bayesian Computation (ABC) inspired simulation-based inference framework to approximate posterior parameter distributions without evaluating intractable likelihoods.
The method directly addresses parameter estimation in large, high-resolution earthquake catalogs affected by short-term aftershock incompleteness (STAI) and uses nearest-neighbor declustering.
The framework calibrates spatio-temporal Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) models used for short-term operational earthquake forecasting.

ev.notes: Full 34-page PDF (including HAL cover page and 33-page JGR Solid Earth article with Appendices A–E) was read and analyzed in detail.

sum: This review paper discusses the transformative role of compact, cable-free seismic nodes in environmental seismology. It examines how dense nodal arrays facilitate high-resolution monitoring of Earth's surface processes, including landslides, rivers, glaciers, and volcanic activity. By overcoming the logistical challenges of traditional seismometers, nodes enable unprecedented spatial coverage. The authors review recent applications, discuss data management challenges, and outline future directions for integrating nodal technology into environmental hazard monitoring and near-surface characterization.
本综述探讨了紧凑型无缆地震节点在环境地震学中的变革性作用。文章阐述了密集节点阵列如何实现对滑坡、河流、冰川和火山活动等地表过程的高分辨率监测。通过克服传统地震仪的物流限制，节点技术提供了前所未有的空间覆盖率。作者回顾了近年来的应用实例，讨论了数据管理面临的挑战，并指出了将节点技术整合到环境灾害监测和……

t: Review of dense seismic node array deployments and environmental noise/signal processing techniques.
综述了密集地震节点阵列的部署及环境噪声与信号处理技术。
Synthesis of case studies utilizing nodal seismic data from glaciers, landslides, and rivers.
综合了利用冰川、滑坡和河流等节点地震数据的案例研究。
Demonstrates that dense nodal arrays significantly improve spatial resolution and detection sensitivity for environmental signals.
表明密集节点阵列显著提高了环境信号的空间分辨率和检测灵敏度。
Limited battery life, lack of real-time telemetry, and massive data volumes requiring advanced processing.
电池寿命有限、缺乏实时遥测以及需要先进处理的海量数据。
First comprehensive review focusing specifically on the application of seismic nodes to environmental seismology.
首次专门针对地震节点在环境地震学中应用的系统性综述。

kc: Comprehensive synthesis of seismic node applications in environmental monitoring.
Evaluation of the advantages of dense nodal arrays over traditional seismic networks.
Identification of key challenges in data storage, battery life, and real-time telemetry.
全面综合了地震节点在环境监测中的应用。
评估了密集节点阵列相比传统地震台网的优势。
指出了数据存储、电池寿命和实时遥测方面的主要挑战。
me: Review of dense array deployment strategies.
Analysis of ambient noise interferometry and beamforming using nodal data.
密集阵列部署策略综述。
利用节点数据进行环境噪声干涉测量和波束形成分析。
de: Compilation of case studies from glacial, landslide, fluvial, and volcanic environments.
汇集了来自冰川、滑坡、河流和火山环境的案例研究。
li: Limited battery life restricts long-term continuous monitoring.
Lack of real-time data transmission in standard nodal deployments.
有限的电池寿命限制了长期连续监测。
标准节点部署中缺乏实时数据传输。

tm.why: The paper specifically reviews the application of seismic nodes to environmental seismology, which covers cryosphere, landslides, and surface processes.
It focuses on the instrumentation aspect, specifically seismic nodes and dense array deployments.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the title, publication venue, and general knowledge of seismic node applications in environmental seismology.

sum: This paper presents a distributed proximal Stein Variational Gradient Descent (ADMM-SVGD) framework for large-scale Bayesian seismic traveltime tomography governed by the eikonal equation. Traditional MCMC methods scale poorly with dimension, while standard SVGD cannot handle non-smooth regularizers like Total Variation (TV) and suffers from prohibitive memory costs in 3D. The authors address these challenges through a three-tier strategy: (1) solving forward traveltimes via the Fast Marching Method (FMM); (2) decomposing the multi-source objective into independent source- and particle-specific subproblems via consensus Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) and proximal splitting for non-smooth priors; and (3) deriving a data-space Gauss-Newton update using the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury identity to invert small receiver-sized matrices instead of model-space Hessians. Validated on a 1D VSP (calibrated against MCMC), the 2D BP 2004 salt model, and the 3D SEG/EAGE salt model, the method delivers sharp velocity reconstructions and reliable uncertainty maps.
本文提出了一种用于大规模贝叶斯地震走时层析成像的分布式近端Stein变分梯度下降（ADMM-SVGD）算法。针对高维模型空间计算瓶颈及传统SVGD无法直接处理非光滑全变分（TV）先验的问题，该方法采用快速行进法（FMM）求解程函方程，并通过共识交替方向乘子法（ADMM）与变量分裂将多震源、多粒子反演……

t: Combines consensus ADMM variable splitting and proximal operators with Stein Variational Gradient Descent, using the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury identity to solve local Gauss-Newton updates in receiver data space across parallel source-particle workers.
结合共识ADMM变量分裂、近端算子与SVGD，利用Woodbury恒等式在数据空间并行求解局部高斯-牛顿更新。

Evaluated on three synthetic benchmarks using FMM traveltimes: a 1D VSP profile (41 parameters), the 2D BP 2004 salt model (36,000 parameters, OBS geometry), and the 3D SEG/EAGE salt model (434,146 parameters).
采用1D VSP剖面（41参数）、2D BP盐丘（3.6万参数）和3D SEG/EAGE盐丘（43.4万参数）合成走时数…

Matches MCMC posterior standard deviations in 1D; achieves lower relative model error than deterministic ADMM in 2D/3D (<1% RME increase under 3-7% noise); limits 100-particle memory overhead to 31% (2D) and 43% (3D).
1D结果与MCMC一致；2D/3D精度优于确定性方法（3-7%噪声下误差增幅<1%），100粒子内存仅增31%-43%。
Runs use a fixed outer iteration budget rather than a formal convergence test, and sub-salt velocity drops remain unresolved due to poor illumination.
采用固定外循环迭代预算而非收敛测试，且盐下弱照明低速区无法被准确解析。
Enables SVGD to sample non-smoothly regularized (TV) posteriors in 3D traveltime tomography by combining dual-space consensus ADMM splitting with data-space Woodbury Gauss-Newton updates.
首次将对偶空间共识ADMM近端分裂与数据空间Woodbury更新结合，实现支持非光滑TV先验的3D分布式SVGD层析成像…

kc: Formulated a distributed proximal SVGD (ADMM-SVGD) framework for high-dimensional Bayesian traveltime tomography with non-smooth (Total Variation) regularization constraints.
Derived a data-space Gauss-Newton update using the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury identity, reducing local matrix inversions from model space (N x N) to receiver data space (N_r x N_r).
Developed a two-dimensional parallelization strategy across N_s sources and N_p particles that solves N_s x N_p mutually independent local subproblems concurrently.
Demonstrated automatic per-source, per-particle penalty parameter selection under noisy conditions using the residual whiteness principle (RWP).
Validated accuracy, uncertainty calibration, and 3D scalability on 1D VSP (against converged MCMC), 2D BP 2004 salt, and 3D SEG/EAGE salt benchmarks.
提出了支持非光滑（如全变分TV）正则化约束的高维贝叶斯走时层析成像分布式近端SVGD（ADMM-SVGD）框架。
利用Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury恒等式推导了数据空间高斯-牛顿更新，将局部矩阵求逆从模型空间（N×N）降至检波器数据空间（N_r×N_r）。
开发了跨N_s个震源和N_p个粒子的二维并行策略，可同时独立求解N_s×N_p个局部子问题。
展示了在噪声条件下利用残差白化原则（RWP）自动选择每个震源和粒子的惩罚参数。
在1D VSP（与收敛的MCMC对比）、2D BP 2004盐丘和3D SEG/EAGE盐丘基准模型上验证了反演精度、不确定性校准及3D可扩展性。
me: Second-order Fast Marching Method (FMM) for solving the isotropic eikonal equation and ray backtracking along negative traveltime gradients to assemble sparse Jacobians.
Consensus Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) with variable splitting to decouple per-source data misfits from non-smooth Total Variation priors.
Data-space Gauss-Newton local worker updates via the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury (SMW) matrix identity and FFT-based global consensus updates.
Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) with RBF kernel and median bandwidth heuristic integrated into the smooth dual-space ADMM target distribution.
Adaptive penalty parameter selection using spectral radius scaling and the Fourier-domain residual whiteness principle (RWP).
采用二阶快速行进法（FMM）求解各向同性程函方程，并沿负走时梯度回溯射线以构建稀疏雅可比矩阵。
利用结合变量分裂的共识交替方向乘子法（ADMM），将单震源数据拟合项与非光滑全变分（TV）先验解耦。
利用Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury（SMW）矩阵恒等式进行数据空间高斯-牛顿局部更新，并结合基于FFT的全局共识更新。
将基于RBF核与中值带宽启发式的Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）集成到平滑的对偶空间ADMM目标分布中。
采用谱半径缩放和傅里叶域残差白化原则（RWP）进行自适应惩罚参数选择。
de: 1D Vertical Seismic Profile (VSP) synthetic test (41 parameters, 1 source, 20 receivers, 1000 SVGD particles) calibrated against 8 chains of preconditioned adaptive Metropolis MCMC.

2D BP 2004 salt benchmark with ultra-long-offset fixed-spread OBS geometry (36,000 parameters, 67 sources, 225 receivers, 100 particles) tested under noise-free and 3%, 5%, and 7% additive Gaussian noise (10 realizations each).
3D SEG/EAGE salt model benchmark (434,146 parameters on a 34 x 113 x 113 grid, 100 sources, 154 water-bottom receivers, 100 particles) with 0.04 s Gaussian noise.
1D垂直地震剖面（VSP）合成测试（41个参数，1个震源，20个检波器，1000个SVGD粒子），与8条预处理自适应Metropolis MCMC链进行校准对比。
采用超长偏移距海底地震仪（OBS）观测系统的2D BP 2004盐丘基准测试（36,000个参数，67个震源，225个检波器，100个粒子），在无噪声及3%、5%、7%高斯噪声（各10次独立实现）下进行测试。
3D SEG/EAGE盐丘模型基准测试（34×113×113网格共434,146个参数，100个震源，154个海底检波器，100个粒子），含0.04秒标准差的高斯噪声。
li: Sub-salt and deep regions with poor or zero ray illumination cannot be resolved accurately, causing velocity reconstructions to revert to the smooth background trend and posterior uncertainty to widen.
Inversion runs are terminated at a fixed budget of K outer iterations rather than by a formal statistical convergence test.
Executing 100 particles still increases total wall-clock runtime by roughly 65-68x compared to deterministic ADMM on a 30-worker CPU pool.
盐下及深部缺乏射线照明的区域无法被准确解析，反演速度恢复为平滑背景趋势，且后验不确定性显著展宽。
所有实验均在固定的外循环迭代预算K处终止，而非基于正式的统计收敛准则。
在30个工作节点的CPU池上，运行100个粒子的总挂钟时间仍比确定性ADMM增加了约65至68倍。

tm.why: The paper focuses on 1D, 2D, and 3D seismic first-arrival traveltime tomography governed by the eikonal equation.
The authors develop a distributed Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) framework to perform posterior sampling and uncertainty quantification in high-dimensional model spaces.

The methodology introduces a dual-space consensus ADMM formulation with variable splitting, proximal operators for non-smooth priors, and a data-space Gauss-Newton update via the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury identity.

ev.notes: Full 27-page preprint PDF analyzed, including mathematical derivations, Algorithms 1 and 2, Tables 1-2, Figures 1-17, and Appendices A-B.

sum: This study introduces the Raspberry Shake Database (RSDB), a global labeled seismic waveform dataset constructed from affordable, citizen-operated Raspberry Shake geophones and MEMS accelerometers. Covering January 2022 to May 2024, RSDB includes 333,068 120-second waveforms (100 Hz) from 25,025 earthquakes (M ≥ 3.5) recorded across 2,417 stations within a 3° epicentral radius. Waveforms are preprocessed and annotated with 35 metadata attributes, including P and S phase arrivals, signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and coda end times. By evaluating multiple pre-trained PhaseNet models in SeisBench and filtering picks against AK135 theoretical travel times (within a ±10 s residual window), the authors found the DiTing-trained PhaseNet performed best, yielding 312,166 P and 136,480 S arrivals. Formatted in HDF5 and CSV via SeisBench into three sensor-specific chunks (RSGeo1C, RSGeo3C, RSMEMS3C), RSDB offers a novel, cost-effective benchmark for training and fine-tuning deep learning models on low-cost instrumentation.
本研究推出了基于低成本Raspberry Shake检波器和MEMS加速度计构建的全球标注地震波形数据集（RSDB）。数据集涵盖2022年1月至2024年5月期间2,417个台站在3°震中距内记录的25,025次M≥3.5地震，共计333,068条120秒（100 Hz）波形。通过对比SeisBen……

t: Waveforms are preprocessed with ObsPy, annotated with P and S arrivals using pre-trained PhaseNet models in SeisBench, and curated by filtering travel-time residuals within ±10 s of AK135 theoretical predictions.
利用ObsPy预处理波形，通过SeisBench中的PhaseNet模型拾取震相，并基于AK135理论走时以±10秒残差…

The dataset contains 333,068 120-second waveforms (100 Hz) from 25,025 earthquakes (M ≥ 3.5, Jan 2022–May 2024) recorded by 2,417 Raspberry Shake stations within a 3° radius, organized into three HDF5 chunks.
包含2,417个Raspberry Shake台站在3°范围内记录的25,025次M≥3.5地震的333,068条120…
PhaseNet trained on DiTing outperformed 12 other models, retaining 79.74% of P picks and 68.91% of S picks after curation, yielding 312,166 P and 136,480 S arrivals across the final dataset.
基于DiTing训练的PhaseNet表现最佳，清洗后保留79.74%的P波和68.91%的S波，最终提供312,166…
Higher self-noise in Raspberry Shake sensors necessitated a minimum magnitude threshold of M ≥ 3.5, and data availability issues restricted waveforms to January 2022–May 2024.
检波器较高的自噪声限制了震级下限（M≥3.5），且数据可用性问题使时间跨度仅限于2022年1月至2024年5月。
Introduces the first global, large-scale labeled machine learning seismic dataset constructed exclusively from low-cost, citizen-science Raspberry Shake geophones and MEMS accelerometers.
构建了首个完全基于低成本公众科学Raspberry Shake检波器和MEMS加速度计的全球大规模机器学习地震波形数据集…

kc: Compiled RSDB, a global dataset of 333,068 seismic waveforms from 25,025 earthquakes (M ≥ 3.5) recorded by 2,417 low-cost Raspberry Shake stations.
Benchmarked 13 pre-trained PhaseNet models using AK135 theoretical travel times, demonstrating that the DiTing-trained model best generalizes to Raspberry Shake data.
Structured the dataset into three sensor-specific HDF5/CSV chunks (RSGeo1C, RSGeo3C, RSMEMS3C) with 35 metadata attributes compatible with SeisBench.
构建了RSDB全球数据集，包含由2,417个低成本Raspberry Shake台站记录的25,025次地震（M≥3.5）的333,068条波形。
利用AK135理论走时对13个预训练PhaseNet模型进行了基准测试，证明基于DiTing训练的模型在Raspberry Shake数据上泛化性能最佳。
将数据集按传感器类型分为三个兼容SeisBench的HDF5/CSV数据块（RSGeo1C、RSGeo3C、RSMEMS3C），并提供35项元数据属性。
me: Automated waveform downloading and preprocessing (detrending, demeaning, resampling to 100 Hz) via ObsPy for stations within 3° of ISC catalog events.
Automated P and S phase picking using pre-trained PhaseNet models within the SeisBench framework.
Data curation and quality control by filtering picks with travel-time residuals < 10 s relative to the 1D AK135 velocity model and ensuring S arrives after P.
Derivation of SNR using 95th percentile amplitude ratios and coda end times using a Hilbert envelope RMS decay threshold.
使用ObsPy自动下载ISC目录事件3°范围内的台站波形，并进行去趋势、去均值和100 Hz重采样预处理。
在SeisBench框架内利用预训练PhaseNet模型自动拾取P波和S波震相。
基于一维AK135速度模型计算走时残差，通过剔除残差大于10秒的拾取并确保S波晚于P波到时来进行数据清洗和质量控制。
利用第95百分位振幅比计算信噪比（SNR），并基于希尔伯特包络均方根（RMS）衰减阈值估算尾波结束时间。
de: Initial download of 1,033,868 MiniSEED waveforms from 38,510 ISC earthquakes (Jan 2022 – May 2024) across 3,101 Raspberry Shake (AM network) stations.
Curated final dataset of 333,068 waveforms (~31.5 GB HDF5, ~36 MB CSV) split into RSGeo1C (77,573 traces), RSGeo3C (115,512 traces), and RSMEMS3C (139,983 traces).
Comparative evaluation of 13 pre-trained PhaseNet models (DiTing, STEAD, NEIC, INSTANCE, GEOFON, Original, etc.) on pick retention and residual distributions.
初步下载了2022年1月至2024年5月期间3,101个Raspberry Shake（AM台网）台站记录的38,510次ISC地震的1,033,868条MiniSEED波形。
清洗后最终数据集包含333,068条波形（约31.5 GB HDF5和36 MB CSV），分为RSGeo1C（77,573条）、RSGeo3C（115,512条）和RSMEMS3C（139,983条）。
对比评估了13个预训练PhaseNet模型（DiTing、STEAD、NEIC、INSTANCE、GEOFON、Original等）的拾取保留率和残差分布。
li: Due to higher self-noise in Raspberry Shake geophones, earthquakes below M 3.5 were excluded to maintain sufficient signal-to-noise ratio.
Data extraction was restricted to January 2022 through May 2024 due to server data availability limitations.
Only automatic PhaseNet picks filtered by a 1D velocity model (AK135) are provided, without manual human analyst verification.
由于Raspberry Shake检波器自噪声较高，排除了M 3.5以下的地震以保证足够的信噪比。
受限于数据可用性，波形提取时间范围仅限于2022年1月至2024年5月。
震相标签仅依赖经一维速度模型（AK135）过滤的PhaseNet自动拾取结果，缺乏人工专家核验。

tm.why: The paper constructs a global labeled seismic waveform dataset specifically designed for training and benchmarking machine learning models like PhaseNet.
The dataset provides annotated P and S phase arrival times, SNR, and coda end times to support earthquake detection and phase picking tasks.
The dataset relies exclusively on waveforms from more than 2,400 low-cost citizen-science Raspberry Shake geophones and MEMS accelerometers.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF (including supplementary tables and figures) was read and analyzed in detail.

sum: SeisBench DAS is an open-source extension to the SeisBench library designed to standardize machine learning workflows for Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS). To address the lack of comparability and interoperability in DAS deep learning, the framework defines standard formats for benchmark datasets, metadata, labels, and models. Built on the xdas framework for data ingestion and virtual array handling, and PyTorch for model execution, SeisBench DAS provides an efficient engine to apply deep learning models to diverse DAS data formats. This tool bridges the gap between model developers and geophysical practitioners, facilitating the adoption and comparison of machine learning methods in fibre-optic seismology.
SeisBench DAS是SeisBench库的开源扩展，旨在标准化分布式声学传感（DAS）的机器学习工作流。为解决DAS深度学习中缺乏可比性和互操作性的问题，该框架定义了基准数据集、元数据、标签和模型的标准格式。它基于用于数据摄取和虚拟台阵处理的xdas框架，以及用于模型运行的PyTorch，提……

t: An extension of the SeisBench library integrating xdas for data ingestion and PyTorch for applying deep learning models to standardized DAS datasets.
集成xdas进行数据摄取并使用PyTorch将深度学习模型应用于标准化DAS数据集的SeisBench扩展库。
Standardized DAS benchmark datasets, metadata, and labels designed for interoperability across different machine learning models.
标准化的DAS基准数据集、元数据和标签，旨在实现不同机器学习模型之间的互操作性。
Provides an efficient, open, and extensible engine that bridges the gap between model developers and practitioners applying deep learning to DAS.
提供了一个高效、开放且可扩展的引擎，桥接了模型开发者与应用深度学习于DAS的从业者之间的鸿沟。
Performance and utility are dependent on community adoption and the continuous integration of new DAS datasets and models.
其性能和实用性取决于社区的采纳以及新DAS数据集和模型的持续集成。
First standardized framework for DAS machine learning, defining unified formats for datasets, metadata, and models to ensure comparability.
首个针对DAS机器学习的标准化框架，定义了统一的数据集、元数据和模型格式以确保可比性。

Standardizes DAS benchmark datasets, metadata, labels, and deep learning models to improve interoperability.

推出了SeisBench DAS，这是一个专门针对分布式声学传感（DAS）的开源、可扩展机器学习框架。

与xdas集成，用于虚拟台阵处理和数据摄取。
基于PyTorch的深度学习模型部署和推理引擎。

该框架定义了DAS基准数据集的标准格式，并提供了一个将模型应用于多种DAS数据格式的引擎。

作为一个新引入的框架，其成功取决于社区的采纳以及未来DAS数据集和模型的集成。

tm.why: The paper introduces SeisBench DAS, a machine learning framework specifically designed for seismological applications of DAS.
The framework is entirely dedicated to standardizing and processing Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the provided abstract and online metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: This study presents a novel method for near real-time snow avalanche detection using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) on a 10 km telecommunication cable in the Swiss Alps. To distinguish avalanches from vehicle traffic, the authors introduce a dual-frequency short-term over long-term average (STA/LTA) attribute. This attribute produces coherent high-value spatio-temporal signatures for avalanches, while traffic generates negative values with distinct move-out. The workflow combines a quasi-instantaneous threshold-based trigger for onset detection with a rapid waterfall image analysis to evaluate event morphology and discard traffic alerts. Tested over a full winter, the system demonstrated high robustness with extremely low false-alert rates (4.5‰ when the road was open, 0.36‰ when closed) and successfully identified 73 potential avalanches, proving DAS to be a viable, cost-effective solution for operational natural hazard monitoring.
本文提出了一种利用分布式声学传感（DAS）进行近实时雪崩监测的新方法。研究利用阿尔卑斯山Flüelapass公路旁10千米长的通信光缆进行了一个冬季的连续监测。为区分雪崩与车辆噪声，引入了双频短时长时平均（STA/LTA）属性，雪崩在此属性下表现为高值时空特征，而车辆则表现为负值。该工作流结合了准瞬……

t: A two-step workflow using a dual-frequency STA/LTA attribute for quasi-instantaneous triggering and waterfall image analysis to discriminate avalanches from traffic.
结合双频STA/LTA属性的准瞬时触发与瀑布图图像分析的两步走工作流。
Continuous DAS data from a 10 km telecommunication cable along Flüelapass road (Swiss Alps) monitored over a full winter, validated with photographic evidence.
在阿尔卑斯山Flüelapass公路旁10千米通信光缆上采集的一个冬季连续DAS数据。
The system successfully identified 73 potential avalanches with extremely low false-alert rates (4.5 ‰ when road open, 0.36 ‰ when closed).
成功识别出73次潜在雪崩，且虚警率极低（开放时4.5‰，关闭时0.36‰）。
The waterfall image analysis step introduces additional latency to assess the spatio-temporal morphology of the event.
第二步瀑布图分析需要等待事件充分发展，从而引入了额外的警报延迟。
Introduction of a dual-frequency STA/LTA attribute that produces positive coherent signatures for avalanches and negative values for traffic.
引入双频STA/LTA属性，使雪崩产生相干高值而车辆产生负值，实现人地噪声区分。

Introduced a dual-frequency STA/LTA attribute that successfully discriminates avalanches from anthropogenic traffic noise.
Demonstrated low false-alarm rates and high reliability over a full winter of continuous monitoring.

通过整个冬季的连续监测，展示了极低的虚警率和高可靠性。

Dual-frequency short-term over long-term average (STA/LTA) attribute calculation.
Two-step workflow: quasi-instantaneous threshold-based triggering followed by waterfall image spatio-temporal analysis.
分布式声学传感（DAS）信号处理。
双频短时长时平均（STA/LTA）属性计算。
两步走工作流：准瞬时阈值触发，随后进行瀑布图时空图像分析。

Photographic evidence used to confirm detected avalanche events.

性能可能取决于通信光缆相对于雪崩路径的具体耦合和几何形状。

The application focuses on snow avalanche detection and monitoring in the Swiss Alps.
