sum: Conventional travel-time tomography and physics-informed neural networks require prescribed velocity models or eikonal equation residuals during learning. This paper demonstrates that scalar travel-time relations alone can identify wave-propagation geometry without velocity inputs, ray labels, or equation supervision during training. By fitting smooth neural fields (residual-SiLU MLPs) or classical moving least squares to raw source-receiver coordinates, physical readouts—such as takeoff angles, local P/S velocities, ray trajectories, focal mechanisms, and Moho depth—are extracted post-training via the high-frequency isotropic eikonal relation. A derived local derivative-error bound proves that directional sampling coverage and smoothness govern gradient identifiability. Tested on synthetic 3-D media, 2.90 million Chinese earthquake arrivals, and California manual picks, value-only fields accurately recover propagation directions (5.34° median error), local wave speeds, and continental Moho patterns (ρ=0.910), while regularized query tomography recovers structure even when high-frequency perturbations break pointwise derivatives.
本研究证明仅靠标量走时关系即可在无速度输入、射线标签或方程监督下识别波传播几何。通过在原始震源-台站坐标上训练平滑神经场或移动最小二乘模型，可在训练后利用高频各向同性程函关系提取离源角、局部P/S波速、射线路径、震源机制及莫霍面深度。作者推导了局部导数误差界，阐明采样方向覆盖度与平滑性决定了梯度的可……

t: Trains a 256-unit, four-block residual-SiLU MLP solely on normalized 6-D source-receiver coordinates and scalar P/S travel times using a Huber loss, extracting propagation directions and slownesses post-training via automatic differentiation and the isotropic eikonal equation.
仅用归一化六维坐标和标量P/S走时训练残差SiLU网络，训练后通过自动微分与程函方程提取传播方向与慢度。

Evaluates synthetic 3-D FMM media, 2.90 million Pg/Sg/Pn/Sn arrivals from 791,404 Chinese earthquakes (2009–2022), and California SeismicX-Cont archives (172,534 mixed picks and 121,630 manual-only records) alongside receiver-function Moho and MUSCAL velocity references.
采用三维FMM合成介质、中国79万次地震的290万条走时及加州人工拾取数据集，结合接收函数莫霍面与MUSCAL模型进行评…

Recovers 3-D takeoff directions with 5.34±0.07° median angular error, test-sealed P/S velocities with 0.0606/0.0258 km/s MAE (detrended ρ=0.791/0.862), synthetic focal mechanisms with 15.38° error, and China Moho thickness correlating at ρ=0.910 (0.592 detrended).
三维离源角恢复中位误差为5.34°，盲测P/S波速MAE为0.0606/0.0258 km/s，中国莫霍面相关性达ρ=0…

Scalar accuracy alone does not certify derivatives (a 0.05-s oscillation raises angular error to 38.94°), surface stations lack depth-derivative support, China Moho contrasts are compressed, and California lateral velocity fidelity is limited.
标量精度不能保证导数可靠，地表台站缺乏深度导数支撑，中国莫霍面反差被压缩，加州横向速度保真度受限。

Establishes conditional identification of unsupervised physical derivatives and wave-propagation geometry directly from scalar travel-time archives across neural and classical representations without velocity inputs or equation supervision.
无需速度输入或方程监督，直接从标量走时档案中跨表征无监督条件识别物理导数与波传播几何。

kc: Demonstrates conditional identifiability of wave-propagation geometry (takeoff directions, local slowness, ray paths) purely from scalar travel times without equation supervision or velocity inputs during learning.
Derives a theoretical local derivative-error bound linking relational sampling design (directional diversity and proximity) and smoothness to gradient accuracy.

Validates post-training physical readouts across neural fields and classical moving least squares on synthetic 3-D benchmarks, 2.90M Chinese arrivals (Moho mapping), and California datasets (focal mechanisms and regularized tomography).
Extends the unsupervised value-to-geometry readout principle to synthetic phase-bearing quantum wavefunctions governed by the Schrödinger equation.
证明了在训练期间无方程监督或速度输入的情况下，仅从标量走时即可条件识别波传播几何（离源方向、局部慢度、射线路径）。
推导了理论局部导数误差界，将关系采样设计（方向多样性与邻近度）及平滑性与梯度精度联系起来。
在三维合成基准、290万条中国走时（莫霍面成像）和加州数据集（震源机制与正则化层析成像）上，验证了神经场和经典移动最小二乘法的训练后物理读取能力。
将无监督“数值到几何”读取原理推广至受薛定谔方程支配的含相位合成量子波函数。
me: Minimal-coordinate residual-SiLU and tanh multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) trained with phase-balanced Huber loss solely on raw 6-D source-receiver coordinates and scalar arrival times.
Post-training automatic differentiation interpreted via the isotropic eikonal equation and regional Pg-Pn head-wave approximations.
Local identifiability analysis using a Gaussian-weighted local design tensor and its normalized minimum eigenvalue.
Classical local-polynomial / moving least squares (MLS) controls and conventional regularized shortest-path ray tomography queried on frozen neural fields.
极简坐标残差SiLU和tanh多层感知机（MLP），仅使用原始六维震源-台站坐标和标量到时，通过震相平衡Huber损失进行训练。
训练后利用自动微分提取梯度，并通过各向同性程函方程和区域Pg-Pn首波近似进行物理解释。
利用高斯加权局部设计张量及其归一化最小特征值进行局部可识别性分析。
经典局部多项式/移动最小二乘（MLS）对照，以及基于冻结神经场采样查询的常规正则化最短路径射线层析成像。
de: Synthetic 1-D layered and 3-D heterogeneous velocity media solved with reciprocal Fast Marching Method (FMM) for ground-truth travel times and gradients, including a prospectively locked, test-sealed realization.
Unified China Earthquake Network catalogue (2009–2022) comprising 2.90 million Pg, Sg, Pn, and Sn arrivals from 791,404 events, evaluated against a withheld 194-cell receiver-function Moho reference.

California SeismicX-Cont dataset (172,534 mixed picks and 121,630 manual-only P/S records), USGS ComCat waveform moment tensors, 447 manual P first-motion polarities, and the MUSCAL 3-D reference velocity model.
Synthetic 2-D quantum fields (Gaussian packet, harmonic-oscillator vortex, and free-packet interference) under Schrödinger evolution.
利用互易快速行进法（FMM）求解真值走时与梯度的一维层状和三维非均匀合成速度介质，包含前瞻性锁定且测试密封的实现。
中国地震台网统一目录（2009–2022年），包含791,404次地震的290万条Pg、Sg、Pn和Sn到时，并与保留的194格接收函数莫霍面参考模型进行对比评估。
加州SeismicX-Cont数据集（172,534条混合拾取和121,630条纯人工P/S记录）、USGS ComCat波形矩张量、447个P波初动极性以及MUSCAL三维参考速度模型。
薛定谔演化下的二维合成量子场（高斯波包、谐振子涡旋与自由波包干涉）。
li: Accurate scalar travel-time fitting alone does not guarantee reliable physical derivatives; high-frequency oscillatory perturbations can corrupt pointwise gradients without changing scalar MAE.
Surface-confined receivers lack vertical coordinate offsets, leaving the receiver-depth derivative uncalibrated unless source-receiver reciprocity symmetry is explicitly supplied.

In the manual-only California experiment, extracted velocity models capture broad depth organization but exhibit strongly attenuated lateral amplitudes and limited lateral fidelity, especially for S waves.
Continental Moho thickness readouts from the China neural field compress thickness contrasts (12.69 km vs 23.52 km in reference) and do not outperform direct catalogue times with fixed slownesses.
仅靠精确的标量走时拟合不能保证物理导数可靠；高频振荡扰动可在不改变标量误差的情况下破坏逐点梯度。
地表台站缺乏垂直坐标偏移，若不显式提供震源-台站互易对称性，台站深度导数将无法标定。
在加州纯人工拾取实验中，提取的速度模型仅能反映宏观深度结构，横向振幅严重衰减且横向保真度有限（尤其是S波）。
中国神经场读取的大陆莫霍面厚度压缩了厚度反差（12.69 km对比参考值23.52 km），且未优于固定慢度下的直接目录走时。

tm.why: The paper trains continuous neural travel-time fields (residual MLPs) on raw source-receiver coordinates and scalar arrival times to extract wave propagation geometry and velocities post-training.

The study extracts local P- and S-wave velocities, ray paths, and continental crustal thickness (Moho depth) from scalar travel-time relations, comparing directly with conventional ray-based tomography.
It establishes a local derivative-error bound governed by a relational design tensor, connecting sampling coverage and smoothness to the conditional identifiability of physical derivatives.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 69-page PDF manuscript (26 pages main text + 43 pages Supplementary Information), including all equations, tables, and 7 main figures.

sum: This study investigates the use of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) for in-situ snow avalanche monitoring by deploying 3 km of fibre-optic cable directly across two active avalanche release zones at Brämabüel near Davos, Switzerland, during the 2025–2026 winter. Recording continuously at 2 m spatial resolution and 200–1000 Hz, the system data were converted into RGB Power Spectral Density video-like spatio-temporal representations to visually distinguish avalanches from ski-resort anthropogenic noise. Out of 15 independently documented avalanches, DAS detected 11 events, including five flowing directly over the cables and six within a 300 m range. Novelty lies in deploying cables directly within steep starting zones rather than using valley telecommunication lines, successfully capturing two distinct phases: precursory initial fracture/release processes and subsequent coherent downslope flow motion.
本研究在瑞士达沃斯Brämabüel的两个雪崩释放区直接布设了3公里光缆，利用分布式声学传感（DAS）在2025-2026冬季开展雪崩监测。系统以2米空间分辨率和200-1000 Hz采样率连续记录应变率，并将数据转化为RGB功率谱密度时空视频以区分雪崩与滑雪场人为噪声。在记录的15次雪崩中，DAS……

t: Continuous DAS strain-rate recordings (2 m spacing, 200–1000 Hz) along 3 km of surface-anchored optical fibres were converted into RGB Power Spectral Density video frames to visually identify avalanche fracture and flow signals.
沿地表固定的3公里光缆连续采集应变率，并转化为RGB功率谱密度视频以识别雪崩破裂和流动信号。
A 3 km DAS array deployed across two avalanche starting zones (2250–2470 m a.s.l.) in Davos recorded from December 2025 to April 2026, validated by cameras, lidar, and SNOWPACK simulations.
2025年12月至2026年4月在达沃斯两个雪崩起始区采集的DAS数据，结合相机、激光雷达和雪层模拟验证。
DAS detected 11 of 15 documented avalanches (five flowing directly over the cables, six within ~300 m), clearly resolving initial fracture processes (<4 s) and subsequent downslope flow motion.
15次雪崩中检测到11次（最远300米），清晰分辨出小于4秒的初始破裂释放阶段及随后的下坡流动。
Detection range was limited to ~300 m due to weak ground coupling of surface-laid cables under snow and high seismic attenuation in weak depth-hoar basal snow layers.
地表光缆耦合较弱且深霜基底雪层衰减强烈，导致探测距离受限在300米内。

Unlike prior DAS studies using valley telecommunication lines, cables were installed directly inside steep avalanche starting zones, observing in-situ fracture release processes before downslope flow.
首次将DAS光缆直接部署于陡峭雪崩起始区内，原位观测到初始破裂释放及随后的流动全过程。

kc: Deployed a 3 km DAS fibre-optic array directly within steep avalanche release zones in Davos, Switzerland, operating continuously over the 2025–2026 winter.
Captured in-situ two-phase avalanche strain-rate signals: initial snowpack fracture/release processes followed by moving signals from downslope flow.
Converted high-volume continuous DAS recordings into RGB PSD video-like representations to separate avalanches from skiers, groomers, lifts, and helicopters.
Detected 11 of 15 documented avalanches at distances up to ~300 m, identifying ground-surface installation and weak depth-hoar basal layers as range-limiting factors.
在瑞士达沃斯陡峭的雪崩释放区内直接布设3公里DAS光缆阵列，并在2025-2026冬季连续运行。
原位捕捉到雪崩应变率信号的两个阶段：初始雪层破裂释放过程及随后的下坡流动信号。
将海量连续DAS记录转换为RGB功率谱密度视频表示，有效区分雪崩与滑雪者、压雪机、缆车和直升机噪声。
在15次记录雪崩中检测到11次（最远约300米），并指出地表铺设耦合较弱及松散深霜基底是限制探测距离的主因。
me: Continuous DAS strain-rate acquisition at 2 m spatial resolution and 200–1000 Hz sampling rate across two parallel slope transects.
Conversion of spatio-temporal DAS data into RGB Power Spectral Density (PSD) video-like representations for visual event identification.
Validation and snowpack characterization using time-synchronized webcams, lidar snow-depth sensors, manual snow profiles, and SNOWPACK modeling.
沿平行坡向测线进行连续DAS应变率采集，空间分辨率为2米，采样率为200–1000 Hz。
将时空DAS数据转换为RGB功率谱密度（PSD）类视频表示，用于事件可视化识别。
结合时间同步摄像头、激光雷达雪深传感器、人工雪层剖面和SNOWPACK模型进行验证与雪层特征分析。
de: Continuous DAS recordings from mid-December 2025 to late April 2026 along two fibres (Fib1 at 2250 m a.s.l. and Fib2 at 2470 m a.s.l.) on Brämabüel.
Ground-truth catalog of 15 dry- and wet-snow avalanches (sizes S2 to S4) triggered by persons, explosives, or naturally.
Meteorological data from IMIS automatic weather stations and seasonal SNOWPACK stratigraphy simulations at Weissfluhjoch.
2025年12月中旬至2026年4月底在Brämabüel两条光缆（海拔2250米的Fib1和2470米的Fib2）上的连续DAS记录。
包含15次干雪和湿雪雪崩（规模S2至S4，由人为、爆破或自然触发）的实测目录。
IMIS自动气象站数据以及Weissfluhjoch站点的季节性SNOWPACK雪层模拟数据。
li: Maximum detection range (~300 m) is much shorter than earlier studies using buried telecommunication ducts due to weaker coupling from anchoring cables directly on the ground surface under snow.
Weak, low-cohesion depth-hoar basal snow layers strongly attenuated seismic wave transmission from the snowpack into the ground.
Event identification relied on visual inspection of PSD videos rather than automated detection algorithms.
由于光缆直接固定在地表并被积雪覆盖，耦合较弱，最大探测距离（约300米）远小于早期使用地下通信管道的研究。
脆弱、低内聚力的深霜基底雪层强烈衰减了雪崩地震波向地下的传播。
事件识别依赖对PSD视频的人工目视检查，尚未实现自动化检测算法。

tm.why: The paper focuses on installing and interrogating a 3 km fibre-optic cable using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) to record strain rates from snow avalanches.
The primary target of the seismic monitoring is snow avalanche fracture release and downslope flow motion in an alpine cryospheric environment.

ev.notes: Full 7-page ISSW 2026 conference proceedings paper provided and analyzed, including abstract, 4 sections, 1 table, and 4 figures.

sum: The authors present QM1D, a new 1D shear attenuation ($Q_\mu$) model of the Earth's mantle. They compiled a dataset of over 90,000 high-quality differential attenuation measurements ($\delta t^*_{\text{ScS-S}}$) from deep earthquakes (1990–2024) using both instantaneous frequency and waveform matching methods. A Bayesian inversion was applied to construct the 1D profiles and quantify uncertainties. The model reveals that the mantle is more attenuating than PREM on average, featuring a highly attenuating layer around 750 km depth (possibly linked to slab stagnation) and weakly attenuating layers around 900 km and 2000 km depth (potentially corresponding to viscosity jumps). The dataset primarily samples the circum-Pacific region.
本文提出地幔剪切衰减一维模型QM1D。作者收集1990-2024年深源地震超9万条高质量S和ScS波形，通过瞬时频率与波形匹配获取差异衰减值，并利用贝叶斯反演构建1D剖面。结果表明地幔平均衰减强于PREM，在750km处存在强衰减层（对应板块滞留），在900km和2000km处存在弱衰减层（对应粘度……

t: Bayesian inversion of over 90,000 differential attenuation measurements (S-ScS) obtained via instantaneous frequency and waveform matching.
结合瞬时频率与波形匹配获取差异衰减，并进行贝叶斯反演。
Over 90,000 high-quality differential S-ScS attenuation measurements from deep earthquakes (1990–2024) at 20–75° epicentral distances.
1990-2024年深源地震的超9万条高质量S-ScS差异衰减测量数据。
QM1D shows higher average attenuation than PREM, with a strongly attenuating layer at ~750 km and weakly attenuating layers at ~900 km and ~2000 km.
QM1D显示地幔平均衰减强于PREM，在750km、900km和2000km处存在异常衰减层。
Significant sampling bias around the Pacific rim due to the spatial distribution of deep earthquakes and seismic stations.
由于震源和台站分布限制，数据在环太平洋边缘存在采样偏差。
First 1D mantle shear attenuation model constructed from a massive, cross-validated S-ScS differential attenuation dataset using Bayesian inversion.
首次利用大规模交叉验证的差异衰减数据集构建地幔1D衰减模型。

kc: Developed QM1D, a new 1D shear attenuation model of the Earth's mantle with robust uncertainty estimates.
Compiled a massive dataset of over 90,000 differential attenuation measurements (S-ScS) spanning 1990–2024.
Identified distinct highly attenuating and weakly attenuating layers in the mid-to-lower mantle, linking them to geodynamical features like slab stagnation and viscosity jumps.
开发了新的地幔1D剪切衰减模型QM1D，并提供了可靠的不确定性估计。
构建了1990-2024年间超过9万条S-ScS差异衰减测量的大型数据集。
识别出中下地幔中显著的强衰减和弱衰减层，并将其与板块滞留及粘度跃变等动力学特征联系起来。
me: Differential attenuation measurement using both instantaneous frequency matching and waveform matching for cross-validation.
Bayesian inversion to construct 1D profiles of mantle shear quality factor (Q_mu) and quantify uncertainties.
结合瞬时频率匹配和波形匹配进行交叉验证，测量差异衰减。
采用贝叶斯反演构建地幔剪切品质因子（Q_mu）的1D剖面并量化不确定性。
de: Over 90,000 measurements of differential attenuation (S-ScS) from seismograms of deep earthquakes (20–75° epicentral distance) between 1990 and 2024.
利用1990年至2024年间震中距在20–75°之间的深源地震波形，获取了超过9万条S-ScS差异衰减测量数据。
li: Significant sampling bias in the mantle around the edge of the Pacific due to the spatial distribution of deep earthquakes and seismic stations.
由于深源地震和地震台站的空间分布限制，数据在环太平洋边缘地幔存在显著的采样偏差。

tm.why: The paper introduces a new 1D model of shear attenuation (Q_mu) in the mantle using differential attenuation measurements.
The resulting attenuation model is used to infer mantle structures, viscosity jumps, and slab stagnation zones.
The authors perform a Bayesian inversion to construct the 1D profiles of mantle shear quality factor and their uncertainties.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata provided, as no PDF was available.

sum: This paper investigates the role of thermal cracks, formed during the cooling of the oceanic lithosphere, on its seismic anisotropy. By modeling the development of thermal cracks and their alignment, the study evaluates how these microstructures alter elastic wave velocities and anisotropy parameters. The results help reconcile discrepancies between observed seismic anisotropy in the oceanic upper mantle/crust and predictions from purely mineral-alignment-based models, highlighting the non-negligible contribution of crack-induced anisotropy in young oceanic lithosphere.
本文研究了海洋岩石圈冷却过程中形成的热裂隙对其地震各向异性的影响。通过模拟热裂隙的发育及其定向排列，评估了这些微结构如何改变弹性波速和各向异性参数。研究结果有助于解释观测到的海洋地壳/上地幔地震各向异性与纯矿物定向排列模型预测之间的偏差，强调了在年轻海洋岩石圈中裂隙诱导各向异性的不可忽视的贡献。

t: Effective medium modeling combined with thermal cooling simulations to evaluate elastic properties of cracked lithosphere.
结合等效介质模型与热冷却模拟，评估含裂隙岩石圈的弹性性质。
Synthetic thermodynamic and elastic parameters representative of oceanic lithosphere.
代表海洋岩石圈的合成热力学和弹性参数。
Thermal cracks significantly alter seismic anisotropy, helping explain discrepancies in young oceanic lithosphere observations.
热裂隙显著改变了地震各向异性，有助于解释年轻海洋岩石圈的观测偏差。
Relies on simplified crack geometry and idealized fluid saturation states.
依赖于简化的裂隙几何形状和理想化的流体饱和状态。
Directly links thermal stress-induced cracking to large-scale seismic anisotropy observations in oceanic plates.
直接将热应力诱导的裂隙作用与海洋板块的大尺度地震各向异性观测联系起来。

kc: Quantifies the contribution of thermal cracking to the seismic anisotropy of the oceanic lithosphere.
Integrates thermal cooling models with effective medium theories to predict elastic properties.
Provides a mechanism to explain discrepancies between seismic observations and mineral-alignment models.
定量评估了热裂隙对海洋岩石圈地震各向异性的贡献。
将热冷却模型与等效介质理论相结合，预测了弹性性质。
提供了一种解释地震观测与矿物定向排列模型之间偏差的机制。
me: Effective medium theory (e.g., Hudson's crack model) to calculate elastic properties of cracked media.
Thermal stress and cooling modeling of the oceanic lithosphere.
利用等效介质理论（如Hudson裂隙模型）计算含裂隙介质的弹性性质。
海洋岩石圈的热应力和冷却模拟。
de: Synthetic modeling based on thermodynamic parameters of oceanic lithosphere.
Comparison with observed seismic anisotropy data from oceanic regions.
基于海洋岩石圈热力学参数的合成模拟。
与海洋区域观测到的地震各向异性数据进行对比。
li: Simplified crack geometries and assumptions about crack connectivity and fluid saturation.
Lack of direct in-situ calibration of crack density at lithospheric depths.
简化的裂隙几何形状以及关于裂隙连通性和流体饱和度的假设。
缺乏在岩石圈深度对裂隙密度的直接原位校准。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates the effects of thermal cracks on the seismic anisotropy of the oceanic lithosphere.
It targets the physical properties and structure of the oceanic lithosphere during cooling.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the title, venue, and metadata.

sum: Understanding how water is stored in Earth's lower mantle is essential for constraining mantle dynamics and seismic anomalies. Previous studies on hydrous Al-bearing SiO2 relied on quenched samples at lower pressures. Here, the authors conducted in situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction experiments up to 45 GPa and 2100 K using a multi-anvil apparatus with sintered diamond anvils, complemented by SEM-EDS analysis and DFT calculations, to study the SiO2–AlOOH system. They demonstrate that anhydrous CaCl2-type SiO2 (post-stishovite) and hydrous δ-AlOOH form extensive, stable mutual solid solutions above 1800 K, and the solid-solution extent increases strongly with pressure. Furthermore, SiO2 incorporation enhances the thermal stability of δ-AlOOH. These findings provide the first in situ evidence that pressure-stabilized CaCl2-type solid solutions can redistribute water released from dehydrating peridotite into subducted mafic and silica-rich crustal lithologies, explaining dehydration melting near 660 km and mid-mantle seismic scatterers at 800–1,600 km depth.
针对下地幔储水机制争议，本文利用装有烧结金刚石压砧的多面砧装置开展了高达45 GPa和2100 K的原位同步辐射X射线衍射实验，并结合扫描电镜能谱分析与第一性原理计算，研究了SiO2–AlOOH体系相系。首次原位证实无水CaCl2型SiO2（后斯石英）与含水δ-AlOOH在1800 K以上形成广泛的……

t: The authors performed in situ synchrotron XRD experiments using a multi-anvil apparatus with sintered diamond anvils, estimating high-pressure CaCl2-type solid-solution compositions via Vegard's law alongside SEM-EDS and DFT calculations.
利用烧结金刚石多面砧进行原位同步辐射XRD实验，结合Vegard定律、EDS及DFT计算估算高压固溶体成分。
Starting materials of amorphous SiO2 and boehmite (AlOOH) mixed in 1:1 and 9:1 molar ratios were compressed up to 45 GPa and heated to 2100 K, complemented by 0 GPa DFT relaxations.
1:1和9:1摩尔比的非晶SiO2与软水铝石混合物在高达45 GPa、2100 K下的实验数据及0 GPa DFT计算。

At ~42–45 GPa and above 1800 K, CaCl2-type SiO2 and δ-AlOOH form extensive mutual solid solutions without forming phase Egg, with unit-cell volumes following a linear Vegard trend and solubility increasing with pressure.
在约42–45 GPa和1800 K以上，后斯石英与δ-AlOOH形成遵循线性体积规律的广泛固溶体，且溶解度随压力剧增。
EDS weight-loss H2O estimates have non-negligible uncertainties, and in situ XRD could not resolve the stishovite–post-stishovite transition directly due to peak broadening and overlap.
EDS失重法测水不确定性较大，且原位XRD因峰宽化和重叠无法直接分辨后斯石英相变。

Provides the first in situ high-pressure, high-temperature demonstration of mutual hydrous–anhydrous solid solution and thermal stabilization between SiO2 and δ-AlOOH up to 45 GPa, overcoming prior quench-only constraints.
首次在高达45 GPa原位高温高压下直接证实SiO2与δ-AlOOH的相互固溶及热稳定化效应。

kc: Provided direct in situ XRD evidence of extensive mutual CaCl2-type solid solution between SiO2 and δ-AlOOH up to 45 GPa and 2100 K.
Demonstrated that pressure and temperature strongly enhance the mutual solubility of SiO2 and AlOOH and increase the thermal stability of hydrous AlOOH.
Proposed a mechanism for deep mantle water redistribution from Al-poor peridotite into subducted silica-rich crustal lithologies, linking mineral physics to mid-mantle seismic scatterers.
提供了高达45 GPa和2100 K下SiO2与δ-AlOOH形成广泛CaCl2型相互固溶体的直接原位XRD证据。
证实压力和温度显著增强SiO2与AlOOH的互溶度，并提高了含水AlOOH相的热稳定性。
提出了深部地幔水从贫铝橄榄岩向俯冲富硅地壳岩性重分配的机制，将矿物物理特性与中下地幔地震散射体联系起来。
me: In situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction (XRD) at high pressure and temperature using a multi-anvil apparatus with sintered diamond anvils at SPring-8.
Vegard-type linear volume mixing modeling to estimate in situ high-pressure solid-solution compositions from unit-cell volumes.
Ex situ XRD, SEM-EDS chemical analysis, and weight-loss H2O estimation on recovered samples, paired with 0 GPa Density Functional Theory (DFT) structural relaxations.
在SPring-8利用配备烧结金刚石压砧的多面砧装置进行高温高压原位同步辐射X射线衍射（XRD）实验。
利用Vegard型线性体积混合模型，根据原位晶胞体积估算高压下固溶体的化学成分。
对回收样品进行非原位XRD、SEM-EDS成分分析及基于失重法的H2O含量估算，并结合0 GPa密度泛函理论（DFT）结构弛豫计算。
de: In situ multi-anvil XRD experiments on SiO2–AlOOH mixtures (1:1 and 9:1 molar ratios) at pressures up to 45 GPa and temperatures up to 2100 K.
Ambient-condition XRD patterns, back-scattered electron images, and EDS elemental maps of quenched recovered samples.
First-principles DFT calculations of orthorhombic SiO2–AlOOH solid-solution lattice parameters at 0 GPa.
对摩尔比为1:1和9:1的SiO2–AlOOH混合物在高达45 GPa和2100 K条件下进行原位多面砧XRD实验。
淬火回收样品的常温常压XRD图谱、背散射电子图像和EDS元素分布图。
0 GPa下正交晶系SiO2–AlOOH固溶体晶格参数的第一性原理DFT计算数据。
li: High-temperature in situ XRD patterns alone could not unambiguously resolve the stishovite to post-stishovite transition due to peak broadening and overlap.
EDS-based H2O content estimates from total weight loss carry non-negligible absolute uncertainties and only apply to high-H2O phases.
Decompression-induced amorphization prevented ambient XRD identification of certain intermediate compositions (e.g., Al0.62Si0.38OOH0.62 synthesized at 45 GPa, 2100 K).
由于衍射峰宽化和重叠，仅凭高温原位XRD图谱无法明确分辨斯石英向后斯石英的相变。
基于EDS总失重法估算的H2O含量存在不可忽略的绝对不确定性，仅适用于高含水相。
减压引起的非晶化使得部分中间成分（如45 GPa、2100 K合成的Al0.62Si0.38OOH0.62）无法通过常温XRD识别。

tm.why: The study investigates mineral phase relations, water storage capacity, and water redistribution in subducted crustal and peridotitic lithologies under lower-mantle pressure and temperature conditions, linking them to mid-mantle seismic scatterers.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including all 5 main figures and sections 1 through 3.6.

sum: This study presents a tailored prestack depth migration (PSDM) workflow that integrates dual-element 2D seismic datasets—novel landstreamer and nodal recordings—acquired over the Thorning salt pillow in Denmark for geological carbon storage (GCS) site characterization. By combining dense near-offset landstreamer data with long-offset nodal data, the authors resolve differences in geometry, amplitude, phase, and statics. This early-stage merging improves shallow velocity model building and illumination of both shallow Quaternary paleovalleys and deeper structures. The resulting high-resolution depth image successfully delineates a fault system along the southwestern margin of the Gassum Formation reservoir and deformed suprasalt strata down to depths exceeding 5 km. The work demonstrates the value of dual-element seismic acquisition and tailored processing for complex onshore reservoir and seal characterization.
本研究针对丹麦碳封存场地，提出结合陆地拖缆与节点双数据源的二维地震叠前深度偏移方法。通过融合近偏移距拖缆与长偏移距节点数据，克服了两者的几何与物理差异，提升了速度模型构建精度。高分辨率成像成功刻画了Gassum组储层边缘断裂、超盐地层及浅部古河谷，成像深度超5公里，为陆上复杂储层与盖层表征提供了新方……

t: A tailored prestack depth migration (PSDM) workflow that merges dense near-offset landstreamer and long-offset nodal 2D seismic datasets at an early stage, resolving differences in geometry, amplitude, phase, and statics.
结合近偏移距陆地拖缆与长偏移距节点数据的早期融合及叠前深度偏移（PSDM）工作流。
Dual-element 2D seismic datasets (landstreamer and nodal recordings) acquired over the Thorning salt pillow in Denmark for geological carbon storage site characterization.
在丹麦Thorning盐枕上方采集的陆地拖缆与节点双数据源二维地震数据集。
High-resolution depth imaging delineating a fault system along the Gassum Formation reservoir margin, deformed suprasalt strata, and shallow Quaternary paleovalleys down to depths exceeding 5 km.
获得了高分辨率深度图像，清晰刻画了深至5公里的储层边缘断裂、超盐地层及浅部古河谷。
The 2D nature of the seismic profiles limits the resolution of 3D structural complexities and out-of-plane reflections common in salt tectonics.
采用二维地震剖面限制了对盐构造区三维复杂结构及面外反射的精确表征。
Early-stage integration of landstreamer and nodal data to combine dense near-offset and long-offset coverage, improving both shallow velocity modeling and deep structural imaging.
首次在早期融合拖缆与节点数据，兼顾近、远偏移距优势，同时提升浅部速度建模与深部成像。

kc: Developed a tailored 2D seismic processing and prestack depth migration (PSDM) workflow that successfully merges landstreamer and nodal datasets at an early stage.
Achieved high-resolution imaging of the Gassum Formation reservoir, identifying a critical fault system along its southwestern margin.
Mapped shallow Quaternary paleovalleys and overburden discontinuities, providing crucial insights into seal integrity and groundwater systems for carbon storage.
开发了定制的二维地震处理和叠前深度偏移（PSDM）工作流，成功在早期阶段融合了陆地拖缆和节点数据集。
实现了Gassum组储层的高分辨率成像，识别出其西南边缘的关键断裂系统。
绘制了浅层第四纪古河谷和上覆地层的不连续性，为碳封存的盖层完整性和地下水系统提供了关键见解。
me: Dual-element seismic acquisition combining landstreamer (dense near-offset) and nodal (long-offset) systems.
Early-stage data merging addressing differences in geometry, amplitude, phase, and statics.
Velocity model building and Prestack Depth Migration (PSDM).
结合陆地拖缆（高密度近偏移距）和节点（长偏移距）系统的双数据源地震采集。
解决几何、振幅、相位和静校正差异的早期数据融合。
速度模型构建与叠前深度偏移（PSDM）。

Dual-element dataset consisting of landstreamer and nodal receiver recordings.
在丹麦Thorning盐枕上方采集的二维地震测线数据。

li: The study is limited to 2D profiles, which may not fully capture 3D structural complexities and out-of-plane reflections in salt tectonics environments.
Merging datasets with different instrument responses and coupling (landstreamer vs. nodes) requires complex calibration of amplitude and phase.
该研究局限于二维剖面，可能无法完全捕获盐构造环境中的三维复杂结构和面外反射。
融合具有不同仪器响应和耦合特性（拖缆与节点）的数据集需要复杂的振幅和相位校准。

tm.why: The paper focuses on high-resolution seismic depth imaging of the crust, specifically targeting the Gassum Formation reservoir and suprasalt strata down to 5 km depth.
The study utilizes a dual-element acquisition setup combining novel landstreamer and nodal seismic arrays.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the comprehensive abstract provided in the metadata, as the full PDF was not available.

sum: This Zenodo dataset supports the article 'Near-complete 3D deformation mapping from Sentinel-1 through extended burst overlap interferometry'. It contains Sentinel-1 SAR products, including standard burst overlap interferograms (BOI) and extended burst overlap interferograms (EBOI). The data covers two primary regions: Queen Maud Land (Antarctica) for ice velocity/deformation mapping, and the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence in Türkiye for coseismic deformation. The Türkiye dataset includes unwrapped interferograms, azimuth/range pixel offsets, and 3D decomposition inversion results combining these measurements. This dataset is highly valuable for testing and validating high-resolution 3D surface displacement mapping methods using Sentinel-1 burst overlap interferometry.
该Zenodo数据集支持关于通过扩展爆发重叠干涉测量（EBOI）进行Sentinel-1近完整三维形变制图的研究。数据集包含两部分：一是南极毛德皇后地的标准与扩展爆发重叠干涉图，用于冰川形变监测；二是2023年土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什地震序列的同震形变输入数据及三维形变分解反演结果。数据格式包括GeoT……

t: Extended burst overlap interferometry (EBOI) and standard burst overlap interferometry (BOI) combined with range/azimuth pixel offsets for 3D deformation mapping.
结合距离向/方位向像素偏移的标准与扩展爆发重叠干涉测量（EBOI）三维形变制图方法。
Sentinel-1 SAR datasets covering Queen Maud Land (Antarctica) and the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence in Türkiye, including unwrapped interferograms and offsets.
覆盖南极毛德皇后地和2023年土耳其地震序列的Sentinel-1雷达数据集，含解缠干涉图及偏移量。
Provides complete 3D coseismic deformation fields for the 2023 Türkiye earthquakes and ice-sheet deformation products for Queen Maud Land.
提供了2023年土耳其地震的完整三维同震形变场以及毛德皇后地的冰盖形变产品。
The dataset is restricted to two specific study areas and the Queen Maud Land BOI data is downsampled.
数据集仅限于两个特定研究区，且毛德皇后地的BOI数据经过了降采样。
First public release of extended burst overlap interferometry (EBOI) products for near-complete 3D deformation mapping of major tectonic and cryospheric events.
首次公开释放用于重大构造和冰冻圈事件近完整三维形变制图的扩展爆发重叠干涉（EBOI）产品。

kc: Provides a benchmark dataset for testing standard (BOI) and extended burst overlap interferometry (EBOI) methods.
Delivers high-resolution 3D coseismic deformation fields for the 2023 Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye earthquake sequence.
Includes ice-sheet deformation data over Queen Maud Land, Antarctica, demonstrating cryospheric applications.
提供了用于测试标准（BOI）和扩展爆发重叠干涉测量（EBOI）方法的基准数据集。
交付了2023年土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什地震序列的高分辨率三维同震形变场。
包含了南极毛德皇后地的冰盖形变数据，展示了其在冰冻圈的应用。
me: Extended Burst Overlap Interferometry (EBOI) for measuring azimuth-direction displacements.
Standard Burst Overlap Interferometry (BOI).
3D displacement decomposition inversion combining range/azimuth offsets and interferograms.
用于测量方位向位移的扩展爆发重叠干涉测量（EBOI）技术。
标准爆发重叠干涉测量（BOI）技术。
结合距离向/方位向偏移量和干涉图的三维位移分解反演。

Sentinel-1 SAR data over the 2023 Türkiye earthquake sequence (frames 014A, 021D, 116A, 123D).
南极毛德皇后地的Sentinel-1雷达数据（相对轨道2，升轨，2026年3月）。
2023年土耳其地震序列的Sentinel-1雷达数据（覆盖框014A、021D、116A、123D）。

数据集仅限于两个特定的地理区域（毛德皇后地和土耳其）及特定时间段。

sum: This study presents an integrated workflow to enhance microseismic catalogs and characterization in the Irpinia Near-Fault Observatory, Southern Italy. By combining machine learning and similarity-based detection techniques, the authors leverage high-resolution data from permanent networks, temporary dense arrays, and two DAS systems. The workflow successfully lowers detection thresholds, resolves small-scale fault patches, and determines fault plane orientations. Furthermore, the study adapts machine learning models to native DAS records for automatic P- and S-wave phase arrival picking, association, and local magnitude estimation. This end-to-end near-real-time workflow significantly improves monitoring capabilities for microseismicity.
本研究提出了一种集成工作流，用于提升意大利南部伊尔皮尼亚近断层观测站的微震编目与表征。作者结合机器学习和基于相似性的检测技术，融合了永久网络、临时密集台阵及两套DAS系统的超高分辨率数据。该方法降低了检测门槛，精细刻画了十米级破裂的断层片和走向。此外，研究成功将机器学习模型应用于原始DAS记录，实现……

t: Integrates machine learning and similarity-based detection techniques to automatically identify P and S phases, associate events, and estimate local magnitudes on both conventional seismic and native DAS records.
结合机器学习与相似性检测技术，在常规地震和原始DAS记录上自动识别P/S波、关联事件并估算震级。
High-resolution seismic observations from the permanent network, temporary short-term dense arrays, and two DAS systems operating in the Irpinia Near-Fault Observatory, Southern Italy.
意大利南部伊尔皮尼亚近断层观测站的永久网络、临时密集台阵以及两套DAS系统的超高分辨率地震观测数据。

Significantly increased the microseismic catalog density, resolved decametric-size fault patches and rupture orientations, and demonstrated effective automatic phase picking and magnitude estimation on native DAS records.
显著增加了微震编目数量，解析了十米级断层片与破裂方向，并实现了DAS记录上的高效自动震相拾取与震级估算。
Potential dependency of DAS machine learning performance on local noise levels, cable coupling quality, and the specific geological setting of the Irpinia region.
DAS机器学习模型的性能可能高度依赖于局部噪声水平、光缆耦合质量以及特定区域的地质背景。
Seamless integration of multi-scale seismic data (from kilometric permanent networks to decametric DAS) into an operational, near-real-time end-to-end workflow using adapted machine learning.
将多尺度地震数据（从公里级永久网到十米级DAS）通过改进的机器学习无缝集成到近实时端到端运行工作流中。

kc: Developed an operational near-real-time end-to-end workflow integrating machine learning and similarity-based detection for microseismicity.
Demonstrated significant enhancement of seismic catalogs using temporary dense arrays and DAS systems in the Irpinia Near-Fault Observatory.
Successfully adapted machine learning models to native DAS records for automatic phase picking, association, and magnitude estimation.

sum: This study utilizes visible to near-infrared (VNIR-SWIR) microimaging reflectance spectroscopy to continuously map hydration, mineralogy, and iron partitioning at submillimeter resolution across a 1-km drilled core of terrestrial peridotites from the Samail ophiolite (Oman Drilling Program). The results confirm pervasive low-temperature serpentinization dominated by Mg-serpentine with variable Fe2+/Fe3+ partitioning. Residual Fe2+ in primary and secondary minerals indicates ongoing capacity for H2 production, even where magnetite is disfavored. The study also identifies various alteration minerals in gabbroic dikes, highlighting Ca2+ mobility, and provides new spectral data for xonotlite and H-rich andradite-grossular garnets. This work establishes a high-resolution mineralogical framework for understanding subsurface habitability and interpreting serpentinization processes across the Solar System.
本研究利用可见光-近红外微成像光谱，对阿曼1公里橄榄岩岩心进行亚毫米级连续矿物制图。结果证实了普遍的低温蛇纹石化，主导矿物为含可变铁的镁蛇纹石，残留Fe2+表明其具持续产氢潜力。研究还揭示了辉长岩脉中的钙移动性，并提供硬硅钙石等新光谱数据。该成果为评估地下宜居性及理解太阳系类似过程提供了新框架。

sum: On 26 August 2026, a massive rock and glacier collapse on Tsangbu Ri mountain triggered a devastating flash flood along the Lhende Khola and Trishuli rivers in the Himalaya. This study presents the first complete seismic dataset and analysis of the cascading event using 45 broadband, short-period, and Raspberry Shake stations across Nepal and China, alongside global teleseismic records. Using NonLinLoc on high-frequency first-arrivals and long-period waveform-coherence back-projection, the authors locate the main failure within 5 km of the satellite-observed scarp and estimate a landslide volume of ~100 million cubic meters. They also identify an ML 2.5 seismic event 17 minutes prior and >60 smaller template-matched events. Furthermore, 0.7–8 Hz seismic tremor power tracks the downstream debris flow for over two hours, while 15–70 s Rayleigh waves propagated globally, demonstrating the potential of regional seismic networks for cascading hazard early warning.

sum: This paper addresses the challenge of incomplete replica libraries in matched field processing for underwater source localization using ship noise. Because vessel trajectories rarely cover the entire region, the authors formulate replica recovery as a matrix completion problem. They propose a physics-guided Bayesian matrix completion with graphs (BMCG) method. To overcome the high effective rank of cross-correlation replica libraries, they apply an envelope transform (ET) to mitigate phase oscillations and reduce rank. Additionally, they exploit circular structures revealed by ET to initialize BMCG. Simulations and experimental data demonstrate that this approach successfully recovers missing replica entries and improves source localization accuracy under sparse observation conditions.

sum: Current off-fault seismic networks lack the spatial resolution and sensitivity to detect subtle preparatory processes, such as micrometer-scale fault dilation, slow creep, or fluid-pressure transients, before large earthquakes. This perspective and review paper argues for a paradigm shift toward On-Fault Observatories (OFOs), which place multi-disciplinary sensors—including distributed fiber-optic sensing (DAS, DSS, DTS), 3D strain probes (SIMFIP), pressure gauges, and broadband borehole seismometers—directly inside active fault zones via boreholes and underground tunnels. The authors categorize OFOs into passive installations on hazardous tectonic faults (e.g., SAFOD, MiDAS, Koyna, DSeis) and active testbeds (e.g., LSBB, SURF, BedrettoLab) where faults are intentionally activated via controlled fluid injections. Results from existing testbeds demonstrate centimeter-scale hypocenter precision across six magnitude units (Mw -5 to 1) and unperturbed source corner-frequency estimates (~370 Hz). Embedding OFOs into digital twins will transform earthquake physics, EGS safety, and prospective earthquake forecasting.
现有远场台网缺乏解析大震前微米级断层扩容、慢滑移或流体压力瞬变等微弱孕震过程的灵敏度。本文提出向“断层原位观测站（OFO）”范式转变，利用穿断层钻孔和地下隧道，将分布式光纤传感（DAS/DSS/DTS）、三维应变探头（SIMFIP）、孔隙压力计及井下宽频带地震仪直接布设于断层核与破碎带内。论文综述了……

t: The authors propose deploying On-Fault Observatories (OFOs) using fault-crossing boreholes and tunnels to directly measure strain, stress, fluid pressure, temperature, and seismicity via passive monitoring and controlled fluid-injection fault activation.
通过穿断层钻孔和隧道布设OFO，结合被动监测与受控流体注入激活，直接测量应变、应力、流体压力、温度和地震活动。

Case studies span passive borehole observatories (SAFOD, DSeis, Koyna, MiDAS) and active underground testbeds (LSBB, SURF, BedrettoLab ETB) equipped with SIMFIP probes, DAS/DSS/DTS fibers, and broadband (0–100,000 Hz) seismic networks.
涵盖被动观测站（SAFOD、Koyna、MiDAS等）与主动地下实验室（LSBB、SURF、BedrettoLab），配…

BedrettoLab experiments resolve 3D fault geometry with centimeter hypocenter accuracy across six magnitude units (Mw -5 to 1), while <150 m recordings capture true corner frequencies (~370 Hz vs ~60 Hz at >1 km).
BedrettoLab以厘米级精度解析跨6个震级（Mw -5至1）的三维断层结构；<150 m近源记录准确恢复370 H…

Passive OFOs suffer from long earthquake recurrence intervals and shallow borehole reach, while active OFOs face challenges controlling maximum magnitudes and capturing delayed or distant induced ruptures.
被动OFO受限于大震复发周期长和钻孔深度；主动OFO面临震级窗口控制难及最大事件空间偏离与时间延迟的挑战。

Proposes a unified community roadmap combining passive tectonic OFOs, active controlled fault-activation testbeds, and two-way coupled Digital Twins to move from distant, accidental observations to direct, testable earthquake physics.

kc: Advocates a paradigm shift from off-fault surface monitoring and accidental fault activation to direct On-Fault Observatories (OFOs) and controlled fault activation experiments.
Synthesizes hardware advances (DAS, DSS, DTS, SIMFIP probes) across six key coupled observables: geology, strain, stress, fluid pressure, temperature, and ground motion.
Reviews global passive OFOs (SAFOD, DSeis, Koyna, MiDAS) and active underground fault-activation testbeds (LSBB, SURF, BedrettoLab ETB).

Outlines how OFO datasets can resolve long-standing questions in rupture nucleation, dynamic weakening, frictional heat dissipation, rupture arrest, and blind forecasting, supported by Digital Twin frameworks.
倡导从地表远场监测和意外诱发地震向直接“断层原位观测站（OFO）”和受控断层激活实验的范式转变。
系统综述了针对地质、应变、应力、流体压力、温度和地面运动六大耦合观测量的新型原位硬件技术（DAS、DSS、DTS、SIMFIP探头）。
总结了全球代表性被动OFO（SAFOD、DSeis、Koyna、MiDAS）和主动地下断层激活实验场（LSBB、SURF、BedrettoLab ETB）的观测成果。
阐述了OFO数据结合数字孪生框架在解决破裂成核、同震弱化、摩擦热耗散、破裂终止及前瞻性盲测预测等核心科学问题中的潜力。
me: Direct in-situ multi-parameter fault-zone sensing via fault-crossing boreholes and underground access tunnels.
Distributed fiber-optic sensing for acoustic (DAS), strain (DSS), and temperature (DTS) profiling along cemented and open boreholes.
Controlled hydraulic stimulation and step-rate fluid injection using packer systems and 3D strain/pressure probes (SIMFIP) to induce micro- to small earthquakes.
Near-source spectral inversion using generalized Brune models and dynamic coupling of OFO data streams with 3D fault-process models (Digital Twins).
利用穿断层钻孔和地下通道开展直接原位多参数断层带传感观测。
利用固井和裸眼钻孔中的分布式光纤传感技术获取声波（DAS）、应变（DSS）和温度（DTS）连续剖面。
使用封隔器系统和三维应变/压力探头（SIMFIP）进行受控水力激发和阶跃注入，诱发微震至小震。
基于广义Brune模型的近源谱反演，以及将OFO数据流与三维断层过程数值模型动态耦合（数字孪生）。
de: Passive OFO borehole datasets: SAFOD (2.7 km borehole, Mw -3 to 2 repeating earthquakes, DAS deployed in 2026), DSeis (2.9 km depth in Moab Khotsong mine), Koyna (3 km pilot hole targeting 6 km depth), and MiDAS (700 m borehole with 3D DAS/DTS).

Active OFO fault-activation experiments: LSBB in France (~280 m depth in carbonate rocks), SURF EGS Collab in USA (10 m scale stimulations up to 1.5 km depth), and BedrettoLab ETB/FEAR in Switzerland (100 m scale, >1 km depth, >40 boreholes).
BedrettoLab microseismicity catalog (8,900 events, Mw -5.0 to -0.5) and near-source (<150 m vs ~1500 m) displacement amplitude spectra for an induced Mw -0.95 earthquake.
被动OFO钻孔数据集：SAFOD（2.7 km钻孔，记录Mw -3至2重复地震，2026年布设DAS）、南非DSeis（2.9 km深矿井钻孔）、印度Koyna（3 km先导孔，目标深度6 km）及台湾MiDAS（700 m钻孔结合三维DAS/DTS）。
主动OFO断层激活实验：法国LSBB（~280 m深碳酸盐岩断层）、美国SURF EGS Collab（1.5 km深处10 m尺度水力激发）及瑞士BedrettoLab ETB/FEAR（>1 km深处100 m尺度实验，含>40个钻孔）。
BedrettoLab微震目录（8,900个事件，Mw -5.0至-0.5）以及一次Mw -0.95诱发地震在近源（<150 m）与较远距离（~1500 m）的位移振幅谱对比数据。
li: Passive OFOs face low recurrence rates of large earthquakes (decades to centuries) and boreholes only reach the uppermost seismogenic zone.
Drilling through mechanically weak, fluid-rich fault zones entails high costs, borehole instability/deviation, and harsh downhole conditions that degrade electronic sensors.
In active OFOs, maintaining dynamic ruptures at shallow, low-stress depths is difficult, and the largest induced events can occur with delays and at unforeseen distances from injection points.
被动OFO受限于大震极低的复发率（数十年至数百年），且钻孔仅能触及发震层最浅部。
钻穿力学软弱、富流体的断层带面临高昂成本、井壁失稳/偏斜风险，且恶劣的井下环境易导致电子传感器快速退化。
在主动OFO中，较浅深度和低应力条件下难以维持动态破裂，且最大诱发事件常发生在远离注入点的未知位置并伴随时间延迟。

tm.why: The paper explicitly focuses on resolving fundamental questions of earthquake rupture nucleation, propagation, energy balance, dynamic weakening, and arrest using direct on-fault measurements.
The authors emphasize measuring fault zone hydro-mechanics, micrometer-scale fault dilation, slow fault deformation, and aseismic slip directly within fault cores and damage zones.
A central pillar of the paper is 'Active On-Fault Observatories' that use controlled fluid injections to intentionally induce earthquakes and study fault activation at decameter to hectometer scales.

ev.notes: Full 22-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including main text (§1–§4), Box 1, Box 2, all 9 figures (Figs. 1–8 and Fig. B1), and 160 references.

sum: This paper proposes the "Bulk Viscous Resistance Principle" to resolve the discrepancy between low geodynamically inferred lithosphere-asthenosphere system resistance (0.01–0.03) and high laboratory rock friction (0.6–0.85). The framework divides plate resistance into rate-dependent viscous drag at the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) and rate-independent brittle friction at trenches. By deriving an analytical framework from diffusion creep laws, the author shows that a purely solid mantle cannot explain the ultra-low resistance. Instead, it requires melt-assisted diffusion creep distributed across an equivalent thickness of 10–100 km, matching the global asthenospheric low-velocity zone (LVZ). This unified physical framework successfully reconciles geodynamic observations with mineral physics.
本文提出了“体粘性阻力原理”，以解决地球动力学反演的超低岩石圈-软流圈系统阻力（0.01-0.03）与实验室岩石摩擦系数（0.6-0.85）之间的矛盾。该框架将板块阻力划分为岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）处的速率相关粘性拖拽和俯冲带处的速率无关脆性摩擦。基于扩散蠕变本构方程，本文推导了体粘性阻力系数的……

t: Analytical derivation of the bulk viscous resistance coefficient based on the diffusion creep constitutive law and three hierarchical sub-mechanisms.
基于扩散蠕变本构关系和三个层级子机制，解析推导了体粘性阻力系数。
Representative mineral physics parameters for diffusion creep under pure solid and melt-bearing mantle conditions, compared against geodynamic inversion constraints.
纯固体和含熔体地幔条件下扩散蠕变的代表性矿物物理参数，并与地球动力学反演约束进行对比。
A purely solid mantle requires unrealistic creep thickness to match geodynamic resistance, whereas melt-assisted diffusion creep yields matching resistance with an equivalent thickness of 10–100 km.
纯固体地幔需要极端的蠕变厚度，而熔体辅助扩散蠕变在10-100千米等效厚度下即可匹配动力学阻力。
Simplified representation of transient water absorption in subduction zones and reliance on 1D analytical approximations of complex 3D mantle flow.
简化了俯冲带中瞬态水分吸收的过程，且依赖于复杂三维地幔流的一维解析近似。
Proposes a unified physical framework reconciling geodynamic and laboratory resistance discrepancies by shifting focus from localized LAB shear to distributed asthenospheric creep.
提出统一物理框架，通过将关注点从局部LAB剪切转向分布式软流圈蠕变，调和了动力学与实验室阻力差异。

kc: Proposes the Bulk Viscous Resistance Principle to explain the low effective resistance of the lithosphere-asthenosphere system.
Decomposes plate resistance into rate-dependent viscous drag at the LAB and rate-independent brittle friction at subduction trenches.
Derives a first-principles analytical framework for the bulk viscous resistance coefficient based on diffusion creep.
Demonstrates that melt-assisted diffusion creep across the entire asthenosphere (10–100 km), rather than a localized shear band, is required to match geodynamic observations.
提出了体粘性阻力原理，用以解释岩石圈-软流圈系统的低有效阻力。
将板块阻力分解为LAB处与速率相关的粘性拖拽和俯冲海沟处与速率无关的脆性摩擦。
基于扩散蠕变，从第一性原理推导了体粘性阻力系数的解析框架。
证明了要匹配地球动力学观测，需要整个软流圈（10-100 km）内熔体辅助的分布式扩散蠕变，而非局部的剪切带。
me: Theoretical derivation of the bulk viscous resistance coefficient from diffusion creep constitutive laws.
Decomposition of physical mechanisms into interface selection, creep accommodation, and melt spreading.
Quantitative parameter analysis using standard solid and melt-bearing mantle properties.
基于扩散蠕变本构方程，对体粘性阻力系数进行理论推导。
将物理机制分解为界面选择、蠕变调节和熔体铺展三个层级。
利用标准的固体和含熔体地幔性质进行定量参数分析。
de: Analytical calculations using representative diffusion creep parameters for pure solid and melt-bearing mantle conditions.
Comparison of theoretical resistance coefficients with geodynamic inversion values (0.01–0.03) and laboratory friction coefficients (0.6–0.85).
在纯固体和含熔体地幔条件下，使用代表性扩散蠕变参数进行解析计算。
将理论阻力系数与地球动力学反演值（0.01-0.03）及实验室摩擦系数（0.6-0.85）进行对比。
li: The model relies on simplified 1D analytical formulations of diffusion creep and equivalent thickness.
Transient water effects in subduction zones are simplified to explain constant trench friction without detailed numerical multiphysics modeling.
该模型依赖于扩散蠕变和等效厚度的简化一维解析公式。
简化了俯冲带中的瞬态水分效应以解释恒定的海沟摩擦，缺乏详细的多物理场数值模拟。

tm.why: The paper proposes a physical framework for the effective resistance of the lithosphere-asthenosphere system, which is a core topic in geodynamics and lithospheric structure.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the detailed abstract from ESS Open Archive as no PDF was available.

sum: This Zenodo dataset supports a study on monitoring Earth's tidal response on the deep seafloor using fiber-optic sensing. It contains three main components: (1) predicted solid-Earth tide (SET) and ocean tide loading (OTL) horizontal strain rate time series (east, north, northeast) computed using FES2004 and Wahr's theory; (2) preprocessed Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) strain rate data, including highpass filtered versions and datasets with/without common-mode noise removal; and (3) interpolated cable coordinates (longitude, latitude, bathymetry, and azimuth). This dataset enables the validation of deep-ocean tidal models and demonstrates the utility of seafloor telecommunication cables for large-scale geophysical monitoring of deformation processes.
该数据集支持利用光纤传感监测深海海底潮汐响应。内容包括：基于FES2004和Wahr理论计算的固体潮与海洋潮汐负荷水平应变率预测时序；预处理后的分布式声学传感（DAS）应变率数据（含高通滤波及去共模噪声版本）；以及光缆轨迹坐标与水深。该数据有助于验证深海潮汐模型，展示了海底光缆进行大规模地球物理形变……

t: Modeling of solid-Earth tides and ocean tide loading combined with spatial mean subtraction and highpass filtering of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) strain rate data.
结合固体潮与海洋潮汐负荷建模，对分布式声学传感（DAS）应变率数据进行空间均值去除和高通滤波。
NetCDF datasets containing preprocessed seafloor DAS strain rates, modeled tidal strain rates (SET and OTL), and interpolated fiber-optic cable coordinates (bathymetry, azimuth).
包含预处理海底DAS应变率、模拟潮汐应变率（SET和OTL）及光缆坐标与水深的NetCDF数据集。
The dataset provides processed strain rate time series and tidal predictions along a deep seafloor cable, enabling large-scale monitoring of Earth's tidal response.
提供了沿深海光缆的应变率时序和潮汐预测，实现了对地球潮汐响应的大规模监测。
The dataset is limited to a single cable's geographic path and provides preprocessed rather than raw DAS waveforms.
数据局限于单条海底光缆路径，且仅提供预处理后的应变率而非原始DAS波形。
First open dataset combining deep-seafloor DAS strain measurements with co-located solid-Earth and ocean tide loading strain predictions.
首次公开结合了深海海底DAS应变测量与同位置固体潮及海洋潮汐负荷应变预测的数据集。

kc: Provides a unique open-access dataset of deep-seafloor DAS strain rates for tidal deformation studies.
Includes co-located solid-Earth tide (SET) and ocean tide loading (OTL) strain rate predictions.
Offers detailed cable geometry and bathymetry to facilitate spatial analysis of the tidal response.
为潮汐形变研究提供了一个独特的、开放获取的深海海底DAS应变率数据集。
包含了同位置的固体潮（SET）和海洋潮汐负荷（OTL）应变率预测模型数据。
提供了详细的光缆几何形状和水深数据，以促进潮汐响应的空间分析。
me: Solid-Earth tide (SET) modeling based on Wahr's (1981) theory and Tamura's (1987) potential.
Ocean tide loading (OTL) modeling using FES2004 mass distribution convolved with Green's functions.
DAS preprocessing including spatial mean subtraction for common-mode noise removal and highpass filtering.
基于Wahr (1981) 理论和Tamura (1987) 势函数的固体潮（SET）建模。
利用FES2004质量分布与格林函数卷积进行海洋潮汐负荷（OTL）建模。
DAS预处理，包括用于消除共模噪声的空间均值减法和高通滤波。
de: Preprocessed DAS strain rate NetCDF files (with and without common-mode noise removal).
Highpass filtered DAS strain rate NetCDF files.
Model predictions of SET and OTL strain rates, and interpolated cable coordinates.
预处理后的DAS应变率NetCDF文件（包含和未包含共模噪声去除）。
高通滤波后的DAS应变率NetCDF文件。
SET和OTL应变率的模型预测数据，以及插值后的光缆坐标。
li: The dataset is regional, restricted to the path of a single deep-seafloor fiber-optic cable.
No raw DAS data is provided due to its massive volume, only preprocessed strain rates.
该数据集具有区域性，仅限于单条深海海底光缆的路径。
由于数据量巨大，未提供原始DAS数据，仅提供了预处理后的应变率。

tm.why: The dataset contains preprocessed Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) strain rate data from a deep seafloor fiber-optic cable.
The data is recorded on a deep seafloor fiber-optic cable, monitoring ocean-bottom deformation and tidal responses.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed dataset description provided in the Zenodo repository abstract.

sum: The early 2025 Santorini–Amorgos seismic crisis in Greece featured an exceptionally high rate of moderate-sized earthquakes (235 M4+ events in February). Using PhaseNet, GaMMA, VELEST, and TomoDD, the authors detect and relocate 66,109 earthquakes and invert 301 moment tensors via gCAP. The high-resolution catalog illuminates a 30-km-long, southeast-dipping normal-fault network at 7–13 km depth between Kolumbo volcano and Amorgos Island. The sequence migrated ~30 km in 19 days via alternating fast northeastward advances and slow southwestward retreats, punctuated by 46 hour-long seismicity bursts accounting for half the seismic moment release. Individual bursts migrated upward and laterally at up to ~3 km/hr with abrupt cessation back-fronts indicative of stress shadows behind an advancing dike tip. Combined with a global analog search showing such M4.5+ productivity only occurs during magmatic/eruptive unrest, the results demonstrate a deep magmatic dike intrusion arrested below ~8 km depth.
本研究针对2025年初希腊圣托里尼-阿莫尔戈斯地震危机，采用PhaseNet、GaMMA、VELEST和TomoDD构建了包含66,109次地震的高精度重定位目录，并利用gCAP反演了301个震源机制解。目录清晰勾勒出8–12 km深处长约30 km的东南倾正断层网络。序列在19天内快速迁移约30……

t: The authors combined PhaseNet phase picking, GaMMA association, VELEST 1-D velocity inversion and initial location, TomoDD double-difference relocation, and gCAP waveform moment-tensor inversion.
结合PhaseNet拾取、GaMMA关联、VELEST一维反演、TomoDD双差重定位与gCAP矩张量反演。

Continuous seismic waveforms from NOA and Aristotle University networks between December 2024 and June 2025, yielding 66,109 relocated earthquakes, a 44,392-event high-resolution subset, and 301 moment tensors.
2024年12月至2025年6月区域连续波形，获66,109个重定位事件和301个震源机制解。
Seismicity delineated a ~30-km-long fault system at 7–13 km depth, migrating ~30 km in 19 days via 46 hour-long bursts (speed up to ~2.77 km/hr) that released half the total seismic moment.
勾勒出7–13 km深处30 km长断层带，识别出释放一半地震矩的46次快速迁移簇发事件。
1-D velocity models may introduce systematic absolute location offsets, and sparse instrumentation prevents uniquely distinguishing dike propagation from fluid migration and aseismic slip.
一维速度模型可致绝对位置偏移，观测稀疏使岩脉侵入与无震滑动机制难以唯一区分。
Resolves 46 rapid hour-long seismicity bursts with stress-shadow back-fronts, post-19 February shallowing arrest, and global M4.5+ volcano analogs to demonstrate episodic deep dike intrusion.
首次精细解析46次小时级簇发事件后缘截断、后期变浅停滞特征及全球火山强震序列类比。

kc: Constructed a high-precision ML-based relocated catalog of 66,109 earthquakes (44,392 best-located subset) and 301 moment tensors for the 2025 Santorini–Amorgos crisis.
Identified 46 hour-long episodic seismicity bursts over 19 days that accounted for roughly half of the total seismic moment release and migrated at speeds up to ~3 km/hr.
Demonstrated via a global volcanic catalog search that sustained rates of ≥60 M4.5+ earthquakes in 18 days are exceptionally rare and strongly linked to magmatic intrusion or eruption.
Proposed a conceptual propagating dike model explaining burst back-fronts, flanking normal-fault activation, Kaiser stress-memory backpropagation, and arrest below ~8 km depth.
利用机器学习与双差重定位构建了2025年圣托里尼-阿莫尔戈斯危机包含66,109个事件的高精度地震目录及301个震源机制解。
识别出前19天内的46次小时级地震簇发事件，占累积地震矩释放的一半，其垂向与侧向迁移速度高达~3 km/hr。
通过全球火山地震目录检索证实，18天内发生≥60次M4.5+地震的序列极为罕见，且均与岩浆侵入或喷发活动相关。
提出了脉动式传播岩脉概念模型，解释了簇发地震后缘截断、侧翼正断层激活、Kaiser应力记忆回退及岩脉在~8 km深度以下停滞的机制。
me: Machine-learning phase picking with PhaseNet and phase association with GaMMA on continuous regional seismic waveforms.
Absolute location and 1-D layered velocity inversion using VELEST, followed by relative double-difference relocation using TomoDD and uncertainty estimation via bootstrap and SVD-mode HypoDD.
Waveform-based full moment tensor inversion using the gCAP method for 301 earthquakes with ML > 3.8.
Continuous waveform envelope amplitude analysis at near-field stations ANYD and THERA to detect and characterize 46 episodic seismicity bursts.
Global analog data-driven search across GVP Holocene volcanoes for sequences with ≥60 M4.5+ crustal earthquakes within 18 days.
使用PhaseNet深度学习拾取器与GaMMA高斯混合模型关联器处理连续地震波形。
使用VELEST进行绝对定位与一维层状速度模型反演，随后使用TomoDD进行双差相对重定位，并通过自助法和HypoDD奇异值分解评估不确定度。
采用gCAP波形反演算法计算了301个地方震级大于3.8级地震的完整矩张量解。
基于近场台站ANYD和THERA连续波形包络振幅分析，识别并刻画了46次脉冲式地震簇发事件。
基于全球全新世火山数据库开展数据驱动的全球类比搜索，筛选18天窗口内发生至少60次M4.5+地壳地震的序列。
de: Continuous seismic waveforms from networks operated by the National Observatory of Athens (NOA) and Aristotle University of Thessaloniki between 2024-12-01 and 2025-06-12.
Near-field island station deployments, notably station ANYD installed on Anydros Island on 3 February 2025, which reduced depth uncertainties from ~4 km to <1 km.
Global earthquake archives within 50 km and ≤30 km depth of Holocene volcanoes in the Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program database.
雅典国家天文台（NOA）和塞萨洛尼基亚里士多德大学地震台网在2024年12月1日至2025年6月12日期间记录的连续波形数据。
近场海岛台站观测数据，特别是2025年2月3日在Anydros岛架设的ANYD台站（将震源深度不确定度从约4 km降低至1 km以内）。
史密森尼全球火山计划（GVP）数据库中全新世火山周边50 km、深度≤30 km范围内的全球公共地震目录档案。
li: Strong one-sided network geometry before 3 February caused kilometer-scale location uncertainties during the earliest unrest phase.
Use of 1-D layered velocity models in VELEST and TomoDD neglects 3-D velocity heterogeneity, potentially causing systematic absolute depth offsets.

Sparse near-field instrumentation and lack of joint time-dependent geodetic-seismic modeling prevent uniquely distinguishing direct dike tip opening from intrusion-induced fluid migration or aseismic slip.
2月3日增设近场台站前，台网呈单侧分布，导致危机早期阶段的定位存在公里级不确定度。
VELEST和TomoDD采用一维层状速度模型，未考虑三维速度非均匀性，可能导致震群绝对位置（尤其是深度）存在系统性偏移。
危机期间近场观测稀疏且缺乏时变大地测量与地震联合动力学建模，无法完全排他地区分岩脉直接张裂与侵入诱发的流体迁移或无震滑动。

tm.why: The paper investigates the 2025 Santorini–Amorgos volcanic-tectonic seismic crisis and concludes it was driven by a laterally propagating magmatic dike intrusion arrested at depth.
The authors build a high-resolution catalog of 66,109 relocated earthquakes using PhaseNet, GaMMA, VELEST, and TomoDD to resolve fault structures and burst migration.
A machine-learning workflow (PhaseNet deep-learning phase picker and GaMMA associator) is central to detecting over 66,000 events from continuous waveforms.

ev.notes: Full 22-page research article PDF from JGR: Solid Earth used, including all 7 main sections and 11 figures.

sum: This study presents a detailed energy analysis approach for structures equipped with vibration absorbers under seismic excitation. Instead of traditional relative coordinates and ground acceleration, the author proposes an alternative mathematical model using absolute coordinates, ground displacement, and ground velocity. This formulation provides clearer insights into the structural energy content and the influence of absorbers on stiffness. The performance of a linear tuned mass damper (TMD) and a nonlinear energy sink (NES) is evaluated using a 9-story structure subjected to three historic earthquake records (Kobe, El Centro, and Northridge). Results show that both absorbers facilitate energy transfer from the ground to the structure, with the TMD transferring more energy during the Kobe earthquake, while the NES outperforms the TMD under El Centro and Northridge excitations, demonstrating the utility of energy-based structural assessment.
本研究提出了一种用于分析地震激励下含有振动吸收器结构能量响应的详细方法。不同于传统的相对坐标和地面加速度法，该方法构建了基于绝对坐标、地面位移和地面速度的替代数学模型，能更清晰地揭示结构内部的能量演化。研究在一栋九层结构上对比了线性调谐质量阻尼器（TMD）和非线性消能减震器（NES）在神户、El C……

t: An alternative mathematical model using absolute coordinates, ground displacement, and ground velocity instead of relative coordinates and ground acceleration to analyze structural energy content.
采用绝对坐标、地面位移和地面速度代替相对坐标和地面加速度的替代数学模型来分析结构能量。
Three historic ground acceleration inputs (Kobe, El Centro, and Northridge earthquakes) applied to a simulated 9-story structure.
将神户、El Centro和北岭三次历史地震的地面加速度输入应用于模拟的九层结构中。
Both TMD and NES allow more energy transfer into the structure; TMD transfers more energy during Kobe, while NES outperforms TMD during El Centro and Northridge earthquakes.
TMD和NES均促进了能量向结构的转移；在神户地震中TMD转移更多，而在El Centro和北岭地震中NES优于TMD。
The study relies on numerical simulations of a single 9-story structure under three specific earthquake records without experimental validation.
研究依赖于单一九层结构在三组特定地震记录下的数值模拟，缺乏实验验证。
Introduction of an absolute-coordinate formulation for structural energy analysis to evaluate linear and nonlinear vibration absorbers under continuous seismic input.
引入了用于结构能量分析的绝对坐标公式，以评估持续地震输入下线性与非线性振动吸收器的性能。

kc: Proposes an alternative mathematical model for structural energy analysis using absolute coordinates, ground displacement, and ground velocity.
Provides a detailed comparative analysis of linear TMD and nonlinear NES performance under continuous seismic energy input.
Demonstrates that the relative performance of TMD and NES in energy transfer is highly dependent on the specific earthquake ground motion characteristics.
提出了一种利用绝对坐标、地面位移和地面速度进行结构能量分析的替代数学模型。
详细对比分析了线性TMD和非线性NES在持续地震能量输入下的工作性能。
证明了TMD和NES在能量转移方面的相对性能高度依赖于具体的地震动特征。

sum: This study presents new in situ major and trace element data from highly serpentinized peridotites drilled at ODP Hole 1277A on the Newfoundland margin. Despite intense serpentinization, relict minerals preserve evidence of high degrees of melt extraction (≥14%) initiated in the garnet stability field, predating Jurassic rifting. The mantle section experienced subsequent melt-rock interaction, lithospheric-scale shear zone deformation, and hydration/serpentinization during exhumation. The findings demonstrate that the pre-rift history and refractory nature of the lithospheric mantle play a primary role in governing the structural and magmatic evolution of magma-poor conjugate rifted margins.

sum: Common-image gathers (CIGs) contain rich kinematic information regarding subsurface velocity errors via reflector focusing and residual moveout, yet are rarely used directly as conditioning inputs for probabilistic inversion due to high dimensionality and redundancy. This paper introduces a multiscale windowed self-attention summary network that compresses 3D subsurface-offset CIG volumes into compact latent embeddings while preserving offset-dependent structure and adapting to background-velocity mismatch. These embeddings condition a rectified-flow matching generative model that transports a Gaussian prior to the posterior distribution of subsurface velocity models via ODE integration. Numerical experiments evaluate latent channel compression and robustness against 1D and 2D initial background-velocity errors. Results demonstrate that multiscale summary conditioning significantly reduces posterior RMSE (down to 0.0679), increases SSIM (up to 0.8815), and yields cleaner, more concentrated uncertainty maps compared to single-scale summaries or conditioning directly on raw CIGs.

sum: This study utilizes continuous seismic data from 2014 to 2022 along the Xianshuihe fault zone (XSHF) to investigate its kinematic and mechanical heterogeneity. By employing machine learning for earthquake detection, the authors cataloged 12,534 events and inverted for a regional 3D crustal velocity model. Integrating these with a GNSS-derived fault locking model, they analyzed spatiotemporal seismicity patterns and b-value variations. The results reveal pronounced segmentation along the northern XSHF, with two primary locked zones north of Bamei and complex stress loading in the Bamei–Kangding releasing bend. The study highlights that the northern XSHF is progressively entering a locked state with potential for Mw 6.8+ earthquakes, demonstrating how integrating high-resolution seismicity, velocity models, and geodetic locking constraints can clarify deformation and seismic hazards in major intracontinental strike-slip systems.
本研究利用2014-2022年鲜水河断裂带地震数据，通过机器学习检测地震并反演三维速度模型。结合GNSS锁定模型分析发现，断裂带北部显著分段且存在两个主要锁定区，具Mw 6.8+强震潜力；八美—康定段弯曲控制了地震分布。该工作融合多源数据揭示了走滑断裂带的力学非均匀性与地震危险性。

sum: Free-surface boundary conditions in geodynamic Stokes flow simulations often suffer from numerical 'drunken sailor' instabilities at large time steps, traditionally mitigated via heuristic gravity stabilization terms. This paper applies variational calculus and the Gateaux derivative to the internal energy minimization formulation of linear incompressible Stokes flow on a deforming domain. By accounting for both intrinsic field variations and geometric domain perturbations, the authors rigorously derive the complete weak form. They demonstrate that free-surface stabilization emerges naturally as a boundary integral containing two terms: the standard gravitational force term and a previously unconsidered internal viscous deformation term. Dimensional analysis via Reynolds and Froude numbers shows the viscous term can be non-negligible in rifting and subduction. Finite-element benchmarks in Firedrake (Rayleigh–Taylor instability and rising plume) confirm the derived full stabilization matches existing gravity-stabilized formulations and high-resolution reference solutions.
地球动力学模拟中的自由表面边界常引发“醉汉”数值不稳定，以往多依赖经验性的重力稳定项来缓解。本文针对线性不可压缩斯托克斯流的内能极小化泛函，利用变分法与Gateaux导数，在同时考虑状态变量内禀变分和几何域微扰的条件下，严格推导了变形域的完整弱形式。研究表明，自由表面稳定项作为边界积分自然产生，包含……

Evaluated using two 2D finite-element geodynamic benchmarks (Rayleigh–Taylor instability and rising buoyant plume) across lid viscosities from 10^21 to 10^24 Pa·s and time steps up to 5000 years, plus two analytical verification tests.

Replaces heuristic derivations of free-surface stabilization with a rigorous variational proof on deforming domains, uncovering a previously unknown viscous boundary stabilization term alongside the standard gravity term.

sum: This paper addresses a key limitation of Generative Neural Network (GNN) priors in geophysical inversion: standard latent-space inversions fail when the true Earth model lies outside the GNN's low-dimensional generative manifold. The authors propose a Bayesian model-space inversion method that uses the generative manifold as a guide rather than a strict constraint, allowing the inversion to escape the prior distribution and recover off-manifold features. Validated using non-linear travel-time tomography on synthetic geological structures, the method successfully reconstructs complex off-manifold features with low uncertainty, outperforming both uninformative uniform priors and standard latent-space inversions.
本文解决了地球物理反演中生成神经网络（GNN）先验的一个关键局限：当真实地球模型处于低维生成流形之外时，标准的潜在空间反演会失败。作者提出一种贝叶斯模型空间反演方法，将生成流形作为引导而非严格限制，从而允许反演“逃离”先验分布并恢复流形外的特征。通过非线性走时断层成像合成实验验证，该方法成功重建了复……

一种贝叶斯模型空间反演方法，利用生成神经网络流形作为引导，在先验分布之外寻找解。

The computational efficiency of the Bayesian sampling in high-dimensional spaces and dependency on the guiding manifold's quality are potential limitations.

Using the generative manifold as a guide in model-space inversion rather than restricting the solution space to the latent space of the GNN.
在模型空间反演中将生成流形作为引导，而不是将解空间限制在GNN的潜在空间内。

sum: This study investigates the 2010–2014 Mt. Pollino seismic swarm in Southern Italy by integrating full moment tensor solutions (41 events), Savage–Wood radiation efficiency (91 events), pore-pressure diffusion modeling, and global velocity–duration–moment scaling relationships. Results reveal mechanically partitioned rupture behavior: events with large positive isotropic components (up to ~40%, mean 25%) localize within a central high-attenuation, fluid-rich carbonate domain, whereas high-radiation-efficiency earthquakes occur along its stronger lower boundary. Spatiotemporal migration fits a hydraulic diffusivity of D = 0.265 m²/s. Empirical scaling laws show migration velocity V ∝ T⁻⁰·⁶⁹ and cumulative moment M₀ ∝ T⁰·⁷⁶, placing the sequence in the fluid-induced global domain and implying an inverse balance between expansion rate and moment release (M₀ ∝ V⁻¹). Despite anomalous kinematics, self-similar moment–length scaling and ~1 MPa stress drops confirm normal tectonic fault strength, providing quantitative indicators to distinguish fluid-modulated swarms from purely tectonic sequences.
本研究综合全矩张量反演（41个事件）、Savage-Wood辐射效率（91个事件）、孔隙压力扩散模型及全球速度-持续时间-地震矩标度关系，研究了意大利2010–2014年Mt. Pollino震群。结果显示破裂存在力学分区：具显著正各向同性分量（高达~40%）的事件集中在高衰减富流体碳酸盐岩区内部，……

t: Integrates Bayesian full moment tensor inversion (GROND) for %ISO components, S-wave spectral analysis for Savage–Wood radiation efficiency, pore-pressure diffusion envelope fitting (90th percentile distance), and Jackknife-validated power-law regressions for velocity–duration–moment scaling.
结合全矩张量反演(%ISO)、S波谱辐射效率、90%分位数孔隙压力扩散拟合及Jackknife标度回归。

Uses 2,394 relocated hypocenters (ML ≥ 0.1) from the >4,800-event 2010–2014 Mt. Pollino swarm catalog, alongside 41 full moment tensor solutions (Mw 2.7–5.2) and 91 Savage–Wood radiation efficiency estimates (Mw 2.2–5.2).
采用Pollino震群2,394个重定位震源、41个全矩张量解和91个辐射效率估计值。

Finds positive isotropic components up to ~40% (mean 25% ± 8%), hydraulic diffusivity D = 0.265 ± 0.044 m²/s, migration velocity scaling α = 0.69 ± 0.02, moment–duration scaling γ = 0.76 ± 0.02, and ~1 MPa stress drops.
正各向同性分量达~40%(均值25%)，扩散系数0.265 m²/s，α=0.69，γ=0.76，应力降~1 MPa。

Point-source 1D velocity models and attenuation corrections affect source parameters, and the small sample size prevents formal statistical testing of spatial partitioning against subset-selection bias.
受一维速度模型和衰减校正限制，且样本量不足以检验空间分区的统计显著性。

Links non-double-couple source mechanics (%ISO) and radiation efficiency with global V–T–M₀ scaling to establish quantitative kinematic indicators for fluid-driven aseismic transients in normal-strength crust.
将非双力偶震源机制和辐射效率与全球V-T-M₀标度结合，建立流体驱动无震瞬变的运动学指标。

kc: Demonstrates descriptive mechanical partitioning between volumetric/hybrid failures (high %ISO up to ~40%) inside a high-attenuation fluid-rich zone and efficient shear ruptures (high radiation efficiency) along its boundary.
Quantifies pore-pressure diffusion with an effective hydraulic diffusivity of D = 0.265 ± 0.044 m²/s that explains the ~150-day, ~7 km separation between the Mw 4.3 and Mw 5.2 main events.

Establishes empirical power-law scaling for migration velocity (V ∝ T⁻⁰·⁶⁹) and moment release (M₀ ∝ T⁰·⁷⁶), placing the Pollino swarm in the global fluid-induced domain (φ = 1.2) while preserving ~1 MPa tectonic stress drops.
揭示了高衰减富流体区内部的体积/混合破裂（高%ISO，达~40%）与边界处高效剪切破裂（高辐射效率）之间的力学分区特征。
量化了孔隙压力扩散过程（水力扩散系数D = 0.265 ± 0.044 m²/s），合理解释了Mw 4.3和Mw 5.2两次主震之间约150天、7公里的时空演进。
建立了迁移速度（V ∝ T⁻⁰·⁶⁹）与地震矩释放（M₀ ∝ T⁰·⁷⁶）的经验幂律标度关系，将Pollino震群定位于全球流体诱发域（φ = 1.2），同时证实其保持~1 MPa的正常构造应力降。
me: Probabilistic time-domain full moment tensor inversion using the Bayesian bootstrap GROND framework and Qseis 1D Green's functions to extract isotropic (%ISO) components.
S-wave displacement spectral fitting to determine static stress drop, apparent stress, and Savage–Wood radiation efficiency.
Pore-pressure diffusion envelope fitting (90th percentile hypocentral distance in overlapping time bins) and log–log linear regression with Jackknife resampling for V–T–M₀ scaling.
利用基于贝叶斯自举法的GROND框架和Qseis一维格林函数进行概率时域全矩张量反演，提取各向同性（%ISO）分量。
通过S波位移谱拟合计算静态应力降、视应力和Savage-Wood辐射效率。
采用重叠时间窗内90%分位数震源距包络线拟合孔隙压力扩散前缘，并结合Jackknife重采样进行V–T–M₀双对数线性回归标度分析。
de: Seismicity catalog of >4,800 earthquakes (ML ≥ 1.0) from EIDA/INGV for the 2010–2014 Mt. Pollino swarm, including 2,394 relocated hypocenters (ML ≥ 0.1).
41 full moment tensor solutions (Mw 2.7–5.2) and 91 Savage–Wood radiation efficiency estimates (Mw 2.2–5.2) compiled in Table 1.
来自EIDA/INGV的2010–2014年Mt. Pollino震群目录（>4,800个ML ≥ 1.0事件），包含2,394个高精度重定位震源（ML ≥ 0.1）。
表1汇编的41个全矩张量解（Mw 2.7–5.2）和91个Savage-Wood辐射效率估计值（Mw 2.2–5.2）。
li: Moment tensor inversions rely on point-source approximations and 1D velocity models, while radiation efficiency estimates depend on spectral fitting and attenuation corrections.

The spatial segregation between high-%ISO and high-radiation-efficiency events is presented as a descriptive pattern because the small sample size precludes formal statistical testing against subset-selection bias.
矩张量反演依赖于点源近似和一维速度模型，而辐射效率估计受谱拟合和衰减校正的影响。
由于样本量有限且无法对子集选择偏差进行严格的统计检验，高%ISO与高辐射效率事件的空间分离仅作为描述性模式提出。

tm.why: The paper analyzes full moment tensor isotropic components, Savage–Wood radiation efficiency, and stress drops to constrain rupture mechanics during the 2010–2014 Mt. Pollino swarm.
The study investigates how a fluid-pressurized aseismic slow-slip transient and pore-pressure diffusion modulate earthquake source migration and velocity–duration–moment scaling.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 15-page article-in-press PDF from Scientific Reports, including all text sections, Table 1, and Figures 1–4.

sum: This paper presents a large, open-access seismological dataset (network code ZK) collected during the DETECT experiment in the Irpinia region of the Southern Apennines, Italy, a high seismic hazard zone. Operating from August 2021 to August 2022, the deployment consisted of 20 seismic arrays comprising 200 stations (broadband, short-period, and 4.5 Hz geophones) positioned above the fault segments of the devastating 1980 M 6.9 Irpinia earthquake. The resulting 5.2 TB dataset of continuous waveforms is archived and disseminated via FDSN-compliant web services. This dataset provides high-resolution observations crucial for studying fault mechanics, earthquake detection, and local seismic structure.
本文介绍了意大利南部阿平宁山脉DETECT实验采集的大型开放地震数据集（网络代码ZK）。该区域为1980年M 6.9伊尔皮尼亚地震震源区，具有极高地震危险性。在2021年8月至2022年8月期间，研究团队部署了20个地震阵列，共计200个台站（包括宽频带、短周期和4.5 Hz检波器）。该数据集包含5……

t: Deployment of 20 seismic arrays, each containing a mix of broadband, short-period, and high-frequency geophones managed via SeisComP.
部署20个地震阵列，每个阵列混合使用宽频带、短周期和高频检波器，并使用SeisComP管理。
A 5.2 TB dataset of continuous seismic waveforms from 200 temporary stations in Southern Italy, recorded from August 2021 to August 2022.
2021年8月至2022年8月在意大利南部200个临时台站录制的5.2 TB连续地震波形数据集。
Successful archiving and open-access availability of high-density seismic array data over the active Irpinia fault zone.
成功归档并开放获取活跃的伊尔皮尼亚断裂带上方的高密度地震阵列数据。
The temporary network operated for only one year, limiting long-term seismicity monitoring.
临时观测网络仅运行了一年，限制了长期的地震活动性监测。
First dense, multi-scale array deployment directly targeting the fault segments of the destructive 1980 M 6.9 Irpinia earthquake.
首次针对1980年M 6.9伊尔皮尼亚破坏性地震断层带进行的高密度、多尺度阵列部署。

kc: Release of a high-density, 5.2 TB continuous seismic dataset (network ZK) from the Southern Apennines.
Deployment of a unique configuration of 20 seismic arrays (200 stations total) over the 1980 Irpinia earthquake fault segments.
Full compliance with international FDSN standards for open-access data and metadata dissemination.
发布了意大利南部阿平宁地区高密度、5.2 TB的连续地震数据集（网络代码ZK）。
在1980年伊尔皮尼亚M 6.9地震断层带上方部署了由20个阵列（共200个台站）组成的独特观测网。
完全符合国际FDSN标准，实现数据的开放获取与元数据分发。
me: Array design with 20 distinct arrays, each with a maximum aperture of ~2 km.
Mixed-sensor deployment per array: 1 broadband, 1 short-period (1 Hz), and 8 high-frequency (4.5 Hz) geophones.
Data curation and metadata management using SeisComP in accordance with GIPP/GEOFON policies.
阵列设计：包含20个独立阵列，每个阵列的最大孔径约为2公里。
混合传感器部署：每个阵列配备1个宽频带、1个短周期（1 Hz）和8个高频（4.5 Hz）检波器。
使用SeisComP系统并遵循GIPP/GEOFON政策进行数据管理与元数据整理。
de: One year of continuous seismic recordings from August 2021 to August 2022.
200 temporary stations deployed in the Irpinia region, Southern Italy.
2021年8月至2022年8月期间为期一年的连续地震记录。
在意大利南部伊尔皮尼亚地区部署的200个临时地震台站。
li: The temporary deployment was limited to approximately one year of recording.
High-frequency geophones (4.5 Hz) may have limited sensitivity to very low-frequency seismic signals compared to broadband sensors.
临时部署的观测时间有限，仅持续了大约一年。
与宽频带传感器相比，高频检波器（4.5 Hz）对极低频地震信号的敏感度可能有限。

tm.why: The paper presents a large seismological dataset collected from a temporary deployment of 20 seismic arrays with 200 stations.
The dataset targets the Irpinia area in southern Italy, one of the regions with the highest seismic hazard in the country.
