sum: This study investigates earthquake preparatory processes (EPPs) preceding seven episodes of major seismicity in the Kuril-Kamchatka subduction zone from 2014 to 2025, culminating in the 29 July 2025 Mw 8.8 megathrust earthquake. Using a compiled ISC catalog of 2,682 complete events (Mw ≥ 3.6), the authors track damage evolution via the seismic regularity coefficient (dc) and seismic strain dynamics coefficient (SSD), grounded in continuum damage mechanics. Before 2022, strong earthquake episodes were preceded by deep, isolated dc and SSD minima followed by dc maxima, reflecting complete strain-localization cycles on southern or distant structures. In early 2022, a deep dc minimum gave way to a sustained upward dc trend with only shallow minima preceding the 2024 Mw 7.0 foreshock and 2025 Mw 8.8 mainshock. This transition uniquely dates the onset of mechanically coupled, multi-patch maturation triggered by viscoelastic stress transfer, undetected by standard seismicity-rate analyses.
本研究探讨了2014至2025年千岛-堪察加俯冲带七次强震序列（含2025年7月29日Mw 8.8巨型逆冲地震）前的孕震过程。基于ISC目录中2682个完整事件（Mw ≥ 3.6），作者利用连续损伤力学框架下的地震规则性系数（dc）和地震应变动力学系数（SSD）追踪损伤演化。2022年前，每次强震前……

t: Tracks earthquake preparation using the seismic regularity coefficient (dc, average pairwise distance in equivalent-dimension space of waiting time, offset, and magnitude) and seismic strain dynamics coefficient (SSD, log rate of cubic-root moment release), aggregated across magnitude cutoffs.
利用等效维度空间中的地震规则性系数（dc）和地震应变动力学系数（SSD），跨多震级阈值滑动聚合以追踪孕震损伤演化。

ISC earthquake catalog (2014–July 2025) within a polygon isolating the Kamchatka megathrust segment down to 100 km depth, complete above Mc = 3.6 with N = 2,682 events, evaluated in both raw and Reasenberg-declustered forms.
2014至2025年7月堪察加俯冲带研究多边形内100 km以浅的ISC完整地震目录（Mc=3.6，2682个事件）及去…

Before 2022, major earthquake episodes were preceded by deep dc and SSD minima (lead times 8 days to 1 year). From early 2022, dc showed a sustained upward trend with shallow minima 3 and 5 months before the 2024 Mw 7.0 and 2025 Mw 8.8 events.
2022年前强震前均现深dc和SSD极小值；2022年初起dc持续上升且仅伴随浅极小值，提前5个月指示2025年8.8级…
No dedicated viscoelastic stress-transfer model was built for Kamchatka; spatial correlations with geodetic locking and gravity patches are qualitative visual comparisons using fixed bounding boxes.
缺乏专门的粘弹性应力转移模型，且与大地测量闭锁及重力异常斑块的空间对比仅基于定性视觉比较。

Demonstrates that catalog-based dc-SSD metrics detect a dated transition to coupled multi-asperity fault preparation three years before the Mw 8.8 megathrust event, invisible to standard seismicity-rate analyses.
仅凭地震目录指标便提前三年识别出8.8级巨震断层段向多凹凸体耦合孕震的转变，突破了常规地震活动率分析的盲区。

kc: Applied seismic regularity (dc) and seismic strain dynamics (SSD) metrics to characterize a decade of preparatory seismicity preceding the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka megathrust earthquake.
Identified a regime transition in early 2022 separating complete, isolated localization cycles in the south (2014–2021) from coupled multi-patch maturation on the 2025 mainshock segment (2022–2025).
Demonstrated that dc and SSD detect precursory spatio-temporal deformation organization three years before the mainshock, even when moderate seismicity rates (Mw ≥ 4.5) remain constant.
应用地震规则性系数（dc）和地震应变动力学系数（SSD）刻画了2025年堪察加Mw 8.8巨震前十年的孕震地震活动特征。
识别出2022年初的孕震机制转变，区分了2014-2021年南部孤立的应变局部化周期与2022-2025年主震断层段的多凹凸体耦合孕育过程。
证明了即使在中等地震活动率（Mw ≥ 4.5）保持恒定的情况下，dc和SSD仍能提前三年检测到主震前的时空变形组织前兆。
me: Transformation of earthquake waiting times, epicentral offsets, and magnitudes into equivalent dimensions to compute the average pairwise distance (seismic regularity coefficient, dc).
Calculation of the seismic strain dynamics coefficient (SSD) from scalar seismic moments and waiting times as a logarithmic proxy for inelastic strain accumulation rate.
Multi-threshold trajectory aggregation using a fixed 254-day sliding window across Mcut = 4.0–4.3 with trimmed mean filtering on both raw and Reasenberg-declustered catalogs.
Physical interpretation of dc and SSD trajectories via first- and second-moment analysis of a nonlocal continuum damage rheology constitutive law.
将地震等待时间、震中距和震级转换为等效维度，计算平均成对距离以获取地震规则性系数（dc）。
利用标量地震矩和等待时间计算地震应变动力学系数（SSD），作为非弹性应变积累速率的对数代理指标。
在原始和Reasenberg去丛集目录上，采用254天固定滑动窗口跨Mcut = 4.0–4.3计算多阈值轨迹，并通过截尾均值进行聚合。
基于非局部连续损伤流变本构定律的一阶和二阶矩分析，对dc和SSD演化轨迹进行物理机制解释。
de: Earthquake catalog extracted from the International Seismological Centre (ISC) Bulletin (1990–2026) within 45°–65°N and 150°–175°E at focal depths up to 100 km.
Compilation of moment magnitudes (Mw) from GCMT and NEIC, supplemented by local magnitudes (Ml) from KB GS RAS converted via an empirical linear relation.
Homogeneous complete sub-catalog (January 2014 to 20 July 2025, Mc = 3.6) containing N = 2,682 events inside a tectonic polygon isolating the 1952/2025 Kamchatka rupture segment.
从国际地震中心（ISC）公报提取1990-2026年间45°–65°N、150°–175°E范围内震源深度100 km以内的地震目录。
整合GCMT和NEIC的矩震级（Mw），并利用经验线性关系转换俄罗斯科学院堪察加分院（KB GS RAS）的地方震级（Ml）作为补充。
构建2014年1月至2025年7月20日期间限定在1952/2025破裂段多边形内的完整均匀子目录（Mc = 3.6，包含2,682个事件）。
li: The proposed viscoelastic stress relaxation mechanism driving the early 2022 dc minimum relies on an order-of-magnitude analogue rather than a dedicated Kamchatka stress-transfer model.
Spatial correspondence among seismogenic patches (SPAD), geodetic locking subclusters, and gravity anomalies is purely qualitative based on visual map comparisons.
Classification of major events into Group A and Group B uses fixed geographic bounding boxes rather than formal geometry-based patch assignments.
驱动2022年初dc极小值的粘弹性应力松弛机制仅基于量级类比验证，未建立专门针对堪察加研究段的应力转移数值模型。
发震斑块（SPAD）、大地测量闭锁子簇与重力异常边界之间的空间对应关系仅基于已发表图件的定性视觉对比。
强震序列A组和B组的划分基于固定的地理边界框，而非严格的断层斑块几何分配程序。

tm.why: The paper analyzes progressive damage accumulation, strain localization, and coupled asperity mechanics during earthquake preparatory processes.
It investigates the nucleation and multi-patch rupture preparation of seven major earthquake episodes including the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka megathrust event.
The study relies exclusively on statistical metrics (dc and SSD) computed from compiled and declustered regional earthquake catalogs.

ev.notes: Full 29-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, introduction, seismotectonic setting, data preparation, mathematical formulation of dc/SSD and continuum damage mechanics, results, discussion, 7 figures, and 1 table.

sum: Microseismic monitoring in hydraulic fracturing and enhanced geothermal systems suffers from low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), while existing deep-learning denoisers distort waveform phases and degrade source localization. This study proposes MRGAN, a multi-resolution residual generative adversarial network integrating three-level Daubechies (db4) wavelet decomposition, a multi-scale residual encoder (kernels 3, 5, 7), a channel-attention wavelet feature fusion module (WFFM), and a multi-scale PatchGAN discriminator. The network is trained with a composite objective combining WGAN-GP adversarial loss, L1 reconstruction loss, wavelet coefficient loss, and a novel Hilbert-transform-based instantaneous phase-aware loss. Evaluated on STEAD, EGS Collab Experiment 2, and PNW-ML benchmarks, MRGAN achieves 14.28 dB SNR and 3.21° phase error at −5 dB input SNR (61.5% phase error reduction over DeepDenoiser), cuts downstream PhaseNet P-wave picking error by 50.6%, and runs in 12.85 ms per sample.
针对微震监测信噪比极低及传统深度学习去噪引起相位畸变的问题，本文提出多分辨率残差生成对抗网络MRGAN。模型结合三级db4小波分解、多尺度残差编码器、通道注意力小波特征融合模块与多尺度PatchGAN判别器，并引入基于希尔伯特变换的瞬时相位感知损失。在STEAD、EGS Collab和PNW-ML数……

t: MRGAN decomposes noisy waveforms via 3-level db4 DWT, encodes sub-bands with parallel 3/5/7 kernel residual blocks, fuses them via channel attention, reconstructs via IDWT, and trains with WGAN-GP, L1, wavelet, and Hilbert phase losses.
结合三级db4小波分解、并行多尺度残差编码、通道注意力特征融合与多尺度PatchGAN，引入希尔伯特瞬时相位损失。

Evaluated on three open datasets: STEAD (100,000 waveforms mixed with real seismic noise at −10 to +5 dB), EGS Collab Experiment 2 borehole hydraulic-fracturing data (15,000 records), and PNW-ML multi-event data (30,000 records).
采用STEAD（10万条）、EGS Collab水力压裂微震（1.5万条）和PNW-ML多类别数据集（3万条）进行评估。

At −5 dB input SNR on STEAD, MRGAN achieves 14.28 dB SNR, 0.947 CC, and 3.21° phase error (61.5% reduction over DeepDenoiser), reducing downstream PhaseNet P-pick error by 50.6% (19.2 ms) with 12.85 ms inference latency.
-5 dB输入下SNR达14.28 dB，相位误差仅3.21°，PhaseNet拾取误差降低50.6%，单样本推理12.…
Denoising saturates below −10 dB SNR due to sub-band spectral overlap, training requires paired clean-noisy data, and the 15.3M parameter size needs compression for edge devices.
低于-10 dB时去噪增益饱和，依赖成对合成加噪数据训练，且15.3M参数量对边缘端偏大。
First end-to-end microseismic denoiser unifying multi-resolution wavelet decomposition, channel-attention fusion, and WGAN-GP with an explicit Hilbert-transform-based instantaneous phase-aware loss.
首次将多分辨率小波分解、残差GAN与基于希尔伯特变换的显式瞬时相位感知损失统一于端到端网络。

kc: Unifies three-level db4 wavelet decomposition, multi-scale residual encoding (kernels 3, 5, 7), channel-attention wavelet feature fusion, and a multi-scale PatchGAN discriminator within a WGAN-GP framework.
Introduces a Hilbert-transform-based instantaneous phase-aware loss with Hann tapering that reduces mean phase error by 79.5% in ablation tests without sacrificing amplitude fidelity.
Demonstrates strong zero-shot cross-scenario generalization on EGS Collab and PNW-ML datasets, reducing downstream PhaseNet P-pick MAE by 50.6% with a 12.85 ms real-time inference latency.
在WGAN-GP框架内统一了三级db4小波分解、多尺度残差编码器（卷积核3、5、7）、通道注意力小波特征融合及多尺度PatchGAN判别器。
提出基于希尔伯特变换和汉宁窗削边的瞬时相位感知损失，消融实验表明其在不影响幅度的前提下将平均相位误差降低79.5%。
在EGS Collab和PNW-ML数据集上实现了零样本跨场景泛化，将下游PhaseNet的P波拾取误差降低50.6%，且单样本推理耗时仅12.85 ms。
me: Three-level discrete wavelet transform (DWT) using Daubechies-4 (db4) wavelets to project 1D waveforms into four frequency sub-bands (cA3, cD3, cD2, cD1) before encoding.
Cascaded Multi-Scale Residual Blocks (MSRBs) with parallel 1D kernels (sizes 3, 5, 7) and a Wavelet Feature Fusion Module (WFFM) using squeeze-and-excitation channel attention.
Multi-scale PatchGAN discriminator operating at original, 2x, and 4x downsampled scales trained under WGAN-GP objective.
Composite loss integrating Wasserstein adversarial loss, time-domain L1 loss, wavelet-domain L1 loss, and FFT-Hilbert instantaneous phase L2 loss with 64-sample boundary Hann tapering.
利用三级db4离散小波变换（DWT）将一维微震波形分解为四个频率子带（cA3, cD3, cD2, cD1）并分别输入独立编码器。
设计含并行1D卷积核（尺寸3、5、7）的多尺度残差块（MSRB）及基于通道注意力机制的小波特征融合模块（WFFM）。
构建在原始、2倍和4倍下采样尺度上运行的多尺度PatchGAN判别器，采用带梯度惩罚的Wasserstein损失训练。
联合优化对抗损失、时域L1损失、小波域L1系数损失以及带64点汉宁窗边界处理的希尔伯特变换瞬时相位L2损失。
de: STEAD benchmark (100,000 waveforms at 100 Hz; 80k train, 10k val, 10k test) mixed with real STEAD background noise at −10, −5, 0, and +5 dB SNR.
EGS Collab Experiment 2 borehole microseismic dataset (15,000 records downsampled from 5000 Hz to 100 Hz) for real-field hydraulic-fracturing evaluation.
PNW-ML dataset (30,000 records across local earthquakes, mining, surface, and induced events) for zero-shot cross-scenario transfer testing.
Downstream arrival-time picking evaluation using PhaseNet on 10,000 STEAD test records and false-positive rate (FPR) testing using STA/LTA on 300 pure-noise segments.
采用STEAD数据集（10万条100 Hz波形），将干净事件与真实背景噪声按-10、-5、0和+5 dB线性混合进行训练与测试。
使用EGS Collab Experiment 2深井水力压裂微震数据集（1.5万条记录，从5000 Hz降采样至100 Hz）评估实际野外数据去噪效果。
在PNW-ML多类别数据集（3万条记录，含天然地震、矿震、地表事件及诱发微震）上进行零样本跨场景泛化测试。
利用PhaseNet对1万条去噪波形进行P/S波到时拾取验证，并在300条纯噪声记录上通过STA/LTA检验假阳性率（FPR）。
li: Denoising gain begins to saturate at extremely low input SNRs below −10 dB due to severe spectral overlap across all wavelet sub-bands.
Relies on supervised training with paired clean-noisy waveforms created via synthetic noise injection rather than self-supervised or unpaired learning.
The 15.3M parameter count is relatively large for resource-constrained edge sensors and requires model compression for edge deployment.
Uses a scalar instantaneous phase error loss rather than a full complex-valued spectral loss.
当输入信噪比低于-10 dB时，由于信号与噪声在所有小波子带内严重频谱混叠，去噪增益开始出现饱和。
目前依赖通过合成加噪构建的成对干净-含噪数据进行有监督训练，尚未采用自监督或非成对学习策略。
模型参数量达15.3M，对于资源受限的边缘端监测设备偏大，需结合知识蒸馏或剪枝进行压缩。
相位约束仅基于标量瞬时相位误差，尚未扩展为联合约束幅度与相位的全复数域频谱损失。

tm.why: The paper develops a deep-learning framework (MRGAN) combining discrete wavelet decomposition, multi-scale residual blocks, channel attention, and WGAN-GP for microseismic waveform denoising.
The denoising method specifically targets low-SNR microseismic monitoring in hydraulic fracturing, enhanced geothermal systems (EGS Collab Exp. 2), and mining.
The phase-aware loss is explicitly designed and validated to improve downstream P/S arrival-time picking (PhaseNet) and hypocenter localization accuracy.

ev.notes: Full 27-page article-in-press PDF analyzed, including abstract, methodology equations, 10 figures, and 12 tables.

sum: This Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) project summary report presents a neural-operator-based simulation framework trained on high-fidelity 3D spectral-element physics simulations to rapidly predict seismic wave propagation. Evaluating both time- and frequency-domain Fourier Neural Operators (FNO), the authors found the frequency-domain approach most mature for real-data applications in the San Francisco Bay Area (SFBA). The trained operator successfully estimated source mechanisms for 22 of 28 SFBA earthquakes within 30 degrees of catalog solutions, outperforming conventional grid searches. To overcome spectral bias—where AI models reproduce low frequencies better than high frequencies—the team developed a multistage training strategy. Additionally, the differentiable operator was tested on synthetic subsurface imaging, complemented by a traditional full-waveform inversion study that produced an improved SFBA velocity model. The project released open-source codes (MS-FNO, SeisNeurOP) and a 21-frequency SFBA simulation dataset.
本报告总结了劳伦斯利弗莫尔国家实验室（LLNL）开发的基于神经算子的三维地震波模拟与反演框架。该方法利用高精度谱元法模拟数据训练傅里叶神经算子（FNO），评估了时域和频域方法，其中频域方法最为成熟。在旧金山湾区的实际数据测试中，该模型成功估计了28个地震中22个的震源机制（与目录解偏差在30度以内）……

t: The project trains time- and frequency-domain 3D Fourier Neural Operators on high-fidelity spectral-element simulations to serve as fast, differentiable surrogate forward models for earthquake source characterization and subsurface structure inversion.
利用三维谱元模拟训练时域和频域傅里叶神经算子，作为快速可微代理正演模型用于震源与结构反演。

The models were trained on 3D spectral-element simulations (including a 21-frequency SFBA dataset) and tested on real regional seismic observations from 28 small-to-moderate earthquakes in the San Francisco Bay Area.
采用三维谱元合成数据（含湾区21频点数据集）训练，并用旧金山湾区28个实际中小地震检验。

The frequency-domain neural operator estimated source mechanisms for 22 of 28 Bay Area earthquakes within 30 degrees of catalog solutions, outperforming conventional grid search, while companion FWI improved the regional velocity model.
频域算子使28个湾区地震中22个的震源机制误差小于30度，优于网格搜索；伴随FWI改进了速度模型。
The AI models inherently reproduce lower-frequency seismic waves better than higher-frequency waves, and neural-operator subsurface structure imaging has thus far only been tested on synthetic data.
AI模型重现低频波优于高频波，且基于神经算子的地下结构成像目前仅在合成数据上进行了实验。

Establishes a reusable, differentiable frequency-domain neural operator trained on 3D spectral-element solves that mitigates spectral bias via multistage training and achieves accurate source inversions on real regional data.
构建了基于三维谱元法的可微频域神经算子，通过多阶段训练减轻频率偏差并实现实际数据震源反演。

kc: Developed 3D time- and frequency-domain Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) trained on spectral-element simulations for fast seismic wavefield prediction.
Demonstrated real-data seismic source inversion in the San Francisco Bay Area, recovering 22 of 28 earthquake mechanisms within 30 degrees of catalog solutions.
Mitigated high-frequency spectral bias in 3D FNO seismic wavefield simulations using a multistage training approach.
Produced an improved San Francisco Bay Area subsurface velocity model via companion full-waveform inversion and released software packages (MS-FNO, SeisNeurOP).
基于谱元法模拟开发了用于快速地震波场预测的三维时域和频域傅里叶神经算子（FNO）。
在旧金山湾区实际数据中验证了震源反演，28个地震中有22个的震源机制恢复误差在目录解30度以内。
采用多阶段训练方法减轻了三维FNO地震波场模拟中的高频谱偏差问题。
通过伴随的全波形反演研究生成了改进的旧金山湾区地下速度模型，并发布了软件包（MS-FNO、SeisNeurOP）。

Multistage training strategy to reduce frequency bias toward low-frequency seismic waves
High-fidelity 3D spectral-element waveform modeling for generating training datasets

tm.why: The report details the development of Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) learned from spectral-element simulations for 3D seismic wavefield modeling and inversion.
The project trains neural operators on high-fidelity 3D spectral-element seismic simulations to accelerate computationally expensive forward wave solves.
The report includes subsurface structure imaging experiments with the neural operator and a companion full-waveform imaging study producing a new San Francisco Bay Area subsurface model.

sum: This study investigates the junction between the Eurasia Basin and the Laptev Sea shelf using new bathymetric and seismic reflection/refraction data. The authors present evidence for a smooth ocean-to-continent transition that lacks traditional transform faults, challenging conventional models of rift-to-drift transitions and oceanic spreading propagation into continental margins. The findings provide critical insights into the geodynamics of the Arctic region and the structural evolution of passive margins.
本研究利用最新获取的水深和地震数据，对欧亚盆地与拉普捷夫海陆架交界处进行了调查。研究结果表明，该区域存在一个平滑的洋陆过渡带，且缺乏传统的转换断层。这一发现挑战了关于裂谷向漂移转变及洋中脊向大陆边缘延伸的传统动力学模型，为理解北极地区的地球动力学演化和被动大陆边缘的结构演化提供了关键的新证据。

t: Analysis of marine seismic reflection/refraction profiles and bathymetric data to image crustal structure.
利用海洋反射/折射地震剖面和水深数据对地壳结构进行成像分析。
New bathymetric and seismic datasets collected at the Eurasia Basin-Laptev Sea shelf junction.
在欧亚盆地-拉普捷夫海陆架交界处采集的新水深和地震数据集。
Identification of a smooth ocean-to-continent transition zone lacking transform faults at the shelf junction.
确定了该陆架交界处存在一个缺乏转换断层的平滑洋陆过渡带。
Absence of direct borehole or drilling samples to confirm basement lithology and age.
缺乏直接的钻孔或钻探样品来证实基底岩性和年龄。
First direct evidence of a transform-free, smooth ocean-to-continent transition in this Arctic sector.
首次在该北极区域提供了无转换断层、平滑洋陆过渡的直接证据。

kc: Provides new high-resolution bathymetric and seismic data at the Eurasia Basin-Laptev Sea shelf junction.
Demonstrates a smooth ocean-to-continent transition characterized by the absence of transform faults.
Improves geodynamic models of oceanic spreading propagation into continental lithosphere in the Arctic.

证实了该区域存在一个以无转换断层为特征的平滑洋陆过渡带。

sum: Forecasting injection-induced seismicity is challenging due to complex subsurface fault-weakening mechanisms. This study derives two composite physics-informed parameters from analytical radial pore-pressure diffusion: the magnitude of strength drawdown (r ∂P/∂r) and the rate of strength drawdown (t ∂P/∂t). These features are embedded into a two-stage machine learning framework—combining a Bayesian bidirectional LSTM with multi-head attention and an XGBoost regressor—to forecast logarithmic seismic moment rates. Tested on high-resolution injection and microseismic datasets from the Utah FORGE and EGS Collab geothermal stimulation experiments, models incorporating these physical features substantially outperform baseline models in capturing temporal trends and peak seismicity. Results show that r ∂P/∂r dictates event size and localization near the well during early steep spatial pressurization, whereas t ∂P/∂t governs onset timing and nucleation rate during rapid injection transients. This demonstrates the effectiveness of physics-guided ML in mitigating induced seismic hazards.
本研究针对注水诱发地震预测难题，基于径向孔隙压力扩散解析模型推导了两个物理信息参数：表征断层强度折减幅度的空间压力梯度项（r ∂P/∂r）和表征折减速率的时间压力梯度项（t ∂P/∂t）。作者构建了结合贝叶斯双向LSTM（含多头注意力机制）与XGBoost的两阶段机器学习框架，并应用于Utah FO……

t: A two-stage machine learning framework combining a Bayesian Bi-LSTM with multi-head attention (Stage 1) and an XGBoost regressor (Stage 2) trained on physics-informed pressure-gradient features r(∂P/∂r) and t(∂P/∂t) to forecast logarithmic seismic moment rate.
结合含多头注意力的贝叶斯Bi-LSTM与XGBoost的两阶段机器学习框架，嵌入物理特征r(∂P/∂r)和t(∂P/∂t…

Concurrent fluid injection and microearthquake (MEQ) records from three step-rate injection episodes (EP3–EP5) at EGS Collab Experiment 1 and three hydraulic stimulation stages (S1–S3) at Utah FORGE well 16A(78)-32.
采用EGS Collab实验1的三个阶跃注水阶段（EP3–EP5）和Utah FORGE 16A(78)-32井三个压裂…
Adding composite parameters r(∂P/∂r) and t(∂P/∂t) (Model B) reduced test RMSE from 69.34 to 31.38 (AIC from 19.2×10^6 to 4.59×10^6) on Utah FORGE and from 46.52 to 21.50 on EGS Collab.
引入复合参数r(∂P/∂r)和t(∂P/∂t)将Utah FORGE测试集RMSE从69.34降至31.38，EGS C…

The analytical model assumes continuous point-source injection into a homogeneous, isotropic, spherically symmetric medium, simplifying actual fracture-network transport and limiting direct transferability across evolving hydraulic regimes.
解析模型假设均匀各向同性球对称介质点源注入，简化了实际裂缝网络流动及渗透率演化。

Explicitly links seismic moment scaling to two composite strength-drawdown parameters—r(∂P/∂r) for spatial magnitude and t(∂P/∂t) for temporal rate—and validates their mechanistic roles via physics-guided machine learning.
推导出控制断层强度折减幅度r(∂P/∂r)与速率t(∂P/∂t)的复合参数，并通过物理引导机器学习验证其发震机理。

kc: Derived two first-order composite physical parameters, r(∂P/∂r) and t(∂P/∂t), representing the spatial magnitude and temporal rate of fault strength drawdown.
Developed a two-stage hybrid machine learning architecture (Bayesian Bi-LSTM with attention + XGBoost) to forecast logarithmic seismic moment rate and its epistemic uncertainty.
Demonstrated on Utah FORGE and EGS Collab field datasets that including physics-informed strength-drawdown features dramatically reduces test RMSE and AIC compared to raw hydraulic inputs.
Clarified complementary physical mechanisms: r(∂P/∂r) controls event size and localization early in injection, while t(∂P/∂t) governs seismic onset and burst intensity during rapid flow transients.
推导了两个一阶复合物理参数 r(∂P/∂r) 和 t(∂P/∂t)，分别表征断层强度折减的空间幅度和时间速率。
开发了结合贝叶斯Bi-LSTM（含自注意力机制）与XGBoost的两阶段混合机器学习架构，用于预测对数地震矩率及其认知不确定性。
在Utah FORGE和EGS Collab现场数据集上证明，相比原始水力参数输入，加入物理信息特征可显著降低测试集RMSE和AIC值。
阐明了互补的物理机制：r(∂P/∂r)控制注水早期事件的规模和空间局域化，而t(∂P/∂t)主导快速流量瞬变期间的发震时间和丛集强度。
me: Analytical 3D spherical point-source pore-pressure diffusion modeling (Carslaw & Jaeger) to derive spatial and temporal pressure gradients at microearthquake hypocenters.
Two-stage machine learning framework: Stage 1 uses a 128-unit Bayesian Bi-LSTM with an 8-head self-attention module and DenseFlipout head to estimate predictive mean and epistemic uncertainty.
Stage 2 concatenates Stage 1 mean-uncertainty outputs with static input features into an XGBoost regressor to capture residual nonlinearities.
Permutation/ablation testing across multiple input feature protocols (Models A–F) evaluated via RMSE and Akaike Information Criterion (AIC).
采用三维球对称点源孔隙压力扩散解析模型（Carslaw & Jaeger），推导微震震源处的空间和时间压力梯度。
两阶段机器学习框架：第一阶段使用128单元贝叶斯Bi-LSTM、8头自注意力模块和DenseFlipout头，输出预测均值和认知不确定性。
第二阶段将第一阶段的均值-不确定性对与静态输入特征拼接，输入XGBoost回归器以捕捉残差非线性关系。
对多种输入特征组合方案（模型A–F）进行排列与消融测试，并使用均方根误差（RMSE）和赤池信息准则（AIC）评估模型性能。
de: Three sequential hydraulic stimulation stages (S1 for training, S2 for validation, S3 for testing) from Utah FORGE well 16A(78)-32.
Three step-rate fluid injection episodes (EP3 for training, EP4 for validation, EP5 for testing) from EGS Collab Experiment 1.
Concurrent high-resolution time series of injection rates, injection pressures, and microearthquake (MEQ) catalogs smoothed over 2-minute moving windows.
Utah FORGE 16A(78)-32井的三个连续水力压裂阶段数据（S1用于训练，S2用于验证，S3用于测试）。
EGS Collab 实验1的三个阶跃速率注水阶段数据（EP3用于训练，EP4用于验证，EP5用于测试）。
同步的高分辨率注水速率、注水压力时间序列以及在2分钟滑动窗口内平滑处理的微震（MEQ）目录。
li: The analytical pressure-diffusion model assumes continuous point-source injection into a homogeneous, isotropic, spherically symmetric 3D medium, overlooking complex flow through discrete natural fracture networks.
Validation and test set performances show reduced accuracy compared to training sets due to evolving fracture reactivation and permeability changes across stimulation stages.
Findings are demonstrated within short-term Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS) stimulations and require further validation before transferring to long-term wastewater disposal settings.
解析压力扩散模型假设在均匀、各向同性、球对称三维介质中进行连续点源注入，忽略了天然裂缝网络中的复杂流体运移。
由于不同压裂阶段裂缝重新激活和渗透率演化的差异，模型在验证集和测试集上的表现相比训练集有所下降。
研究结果仅在短期增强型地热系统（EGS）增产实验中得到验证，推广至长期废水回注等场景尚需进一步检验。

tm.why: The paper directly addresses forecasting injection-induced microseismicity during hydraulic stimulation in enhanced geothermal systems (Utah FORGE and EGS Collab).
It develops a two-stage hybrid machine learning architecture (Bayesian Bi-LSTM with self-attention followed by XGBoost) to predict the temporal evolution of logarithmic seismic moment rate.
The study derives physical parameters representing the magnitude and rate of fault frictional strength drawdown driven by pore-fluid overpressures.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was analyzed, including mathematical derivations in Section 2, experimental benchmarks in Section 3, and Figures 1–3 plus Table 1.

sum: Surface-related multiple elimination (SRME) relies on adaptive subtraction to reconcile amplitude and phase mismatches between predicted multiples and recorded marine seismic data. Traditional stationary and regularized non-stationary least-squares matching filters (LSMF) struggle with rapid local variations due to local smoothness constraints. This paper introduces a physics-based deep learning (PDL) approach that formulates the adaptive matching filter (AMF) equation as a self-supervised neural network regression problem. Using a 2D patching scheme on initial SRME multiple models and raw data, a lightweight two-layer dense network learns a globally optimal, nonlinear, non-stationary mapping without requiring external labeled training datasets. Evaluated on simple NMO-corrected synthetic gathers, the complex Pluto synthetic dataset, and North Sea Viking Graben marine field data, PDL consistently outperforms regularized non-stationary LSMF, reducing multiple residuals and energy leakage while preserving primary reflection continuity and broadband spectral characteristics.
自由表面多次波消除（SRME）中的自适应相减常受限于地震数据的强非平稳性。本文提出一种基于物理的深度学习（PDL）方法，将自适应匹配滤波（AMF）方程构建为自监督神经网络回归问题。通过二维分块方案将初始预测多次波和原始地震数据分割为大量训练样本，利用双层全连接网络学习非线性、非平稳的全局最优匹配映射……

t: A two-layer dense neural network replaces the regularized non-stationary matching filter in SRME, trained self-supervised on 2D patches to map initial SRME-predicted multiples to observed seismic data before subtracting the predicted multiples.
用双层全连接神经网络替代SRME中的正则化非平稳匹配滤波器，基于二维分块进行自监督训练以匹配并减去预测多次波。

Tested on a 751x121 NMO-corrected synthetic gather, an 1126x818 common-offset Pluto synthetic dataset (8 ms sampling), and a 1500x120x1012 marine field dataset from the North Viking Graben (4 ms sampling).
测试了751×121动校正合成炮集、1126×818 Pluto共偏移距合成数据及1500×120×1012北海Viki…

On the first synthetic example, PDL reduces MSE from 7.02 (classic LSMF) to 4.66 and improves SSIM from 0.987 to 0.997, while yielding cleaner stacked reservoir images (1.3–2.5 s) on Viking Graben field data.
在合成测试中将MSE从7.02降至4.66，SSIM从0.987提升至0.997，并显著改善实测数据靶区（1.3-2.5…
PDL has limited capability to suppress ambient noise and struggles with complex structures unless performed in flat domains (like common-offset) or using small, computationally costly shift sizes.
对环境噪声压制能力有限，且在复杂陡倾构造处需依赖较小的分块滑动步长，增加了计算开销。

Eliminates local smoothness constraints of shaping-regularized non-stationary regression by using patch-based, self-supervised neural network regression guided directly by the adaptive matching filter formulation.
结合自适应匹配滤波物理机制与二维分块自监督深度学习，克服了传统非平稳回归中的局部平滑约束限制。

Employs a 2D patching strategy to generate abundant training pairs from a single seismic profile, enabling localized feature extraction and non-local gradient smoothness without explicit smoothing regularization.
Demonstrates superior primary preservation and multiple removal over regularized non-stationary least-squares matching filtering (LSMF) on synthetic, Pluto, and Viking Graben marine field datasets.
将自适应多次波相减构建为由自适应匹配滤波方程引导的自监督物理深度学习（PDL）回归问题。
采用二维分块策略从单张地震剖面生成大量训练样本，在无需显式平滑正则化的情况下实现局部特征提取与非局部梯度平滑。
在合成数据、Pluto模型和Viking Graben海洋实测数据上验证了该方法在多次波去除和一次波保护上优于经典非平稳最小二乘匹配滤波（LSMF）。
me: Self-supervised neural network matching filter using two dense layers (ReLU and linear activations) replacing regularized non-stationary regression.
2D spatial-temporal patching and unpatching workflow controlled by patch size and shift size.
Benchmarking against shaping-regularized non-stationary least-squares matching filter (LSMF) using MSE, SSIM, amplitude spectra, and local similarity.
使用包含ReLU和线性激活函数的双层全连接网络构建自监督匹配滤波器，替代正则化非平稳回归。
由分块大小和滑动步长控制的二维时空分块与重构工作流。
通过均方误差（MSE）、结构相似性（SSIM）、振幅谱和局部相似性指标，与基于整形正则化的非平稳最小二乘匹配滤波（LSMF）进行对比基准测试。

2D NMO-corrected synthetic shot gather (751 x 121) with flat primaries and curved multiples, including patch/shift sensitivity and SNR (5 dB, 10 dB) tests.
2D Pluto synthetic dataset in common-offset domain (1126 x 818, 8 ms sampling).
2D marine field dataset from the North Viking Graben, North Sea (1500 x 120 x 1012, 4 ms sampling).
含随机高斯噪声的一维二次多项式回归合成基准测试（50个散点）。
含平缓一次波和弯曲多次波的二维动校正合成炮集（751×121），包含分块参数敏感性及信噪比（5 dB、10 dB）测试。
共偏移距域二维Pluto复杂合成数据集（1126×818，采样率8 ms）。

li: Limited ability to suppress random ambient noise; requires pre-denoising under low SNR conditions.
Best suited for relatively flat events (such as in the common-offset domain); complex dipping structures require small shift sizes that increase computational cost.
压制环境随机噪声的能力有限，低信噪比条件下需预先去噪。
最适用于相对平缓的同相轴（如共偏移距域）；复杂陡倾构造需要较小的滑动步长，从而增加计算成本。

tm.why: The paper proposes a self-supervised, physics-based deep learning (PDL) neural network filter for adaptive seismic multiple subtraction.
The authors formulate adaptive multiple subtraction as an under-determined non-stationary regression inverse problem solved via neural network parameterization rather than shaping regularization.

ev.notes: Full 36-page PDF analyzed, including equations, methodology, synthetic/Pluto/Viking Graben experiments, hyperparameter sensitivity analyses, and all 21 figures.

sum: Geodetic studies of postseismic creep infer a 1–2 orders of magnitude reduction in upper-mantle viscosity after large earthquakes, yet the underlying microphysical mechanism remains debated. The authors perform gas-medium apparatus compressive load-relaxation experiments at 1100–1200°C and 300 MPa on pre-dried, coarse-grained (∼400 μm) Åheim dunite, mimicking rapid coseismic loading and subsequent postseismic relaxation, as well as relaxation from steady-state creep. Microstructural analyses via EBSD and dislocation decoration confirm constant grain size and crystallographic preferred orientation, while dislocation density increases from 1.1×10^12 to 1.3–1.9×10^12 m^-2. Comparing mechanical data with numerical simulations shows that an intragranular backstress model (based on dislocation density evolution and long-range elastic interactions) matches the full relaxation curves well, whereas an intergranular plastic-anisotropy model underpredicts stress relaxation. Extrapolated to upper-mantle conditions, only the backstress model reproduces the 1–2 orders of magnitude postseismic viscosity drop.
针对大地震后上地幔黏度降低1-2个数量级的微物理机制争议，本文利用气体介质设备在1100–1200°C和300 MPa下对粗粒（约400 μm）Åheim纯橄榄岩开展轴向压缩载荷松弛实验，首次在多晶橄榄石中模拟快速同震加载与震后应力松弛路径。EBSD与位错染色显示变形前后粒径和晶格优选取向不变，仅位……

t: Axisymmetric compressive load-relaxation experiments on coarse-grained Åheim dunite in a Paterson apparatus at 1100–1200°C and 300 MPa, paired with EBSD, dislocation counting, and numerical simulations of backstress and plastic-anisotropy creep models.
在1100–1200°C和300 MPa下对粗粒纯橄榄岩开展压缩松弛实验，结合EBSD、位错计数与模型模拟。

Pre-dried cores of Åheim dunite (~86% forsterite, ~400 μm grain size) deformed to 1.6–2.5% strain across rapid loading, immediate relaxation, creep, and steady-state relaxation intervals, plus 11,300 hand-counted dislocations over 8,000 μm^2.
粒径约400 μm的预干燥Åheim纯橄榄岩四阶段加载数据，以及8,000 μm^2内手数的11,300个位错。

Immediate relaxation strain rates exceed steady-state flow laws by 0.5–1.1 orders of magnitude; dislocation density increases from 1.1×10^12 to 1.3–1.9×10^12 m^-2 without grain-size or CPO evolution; the backstress model reproduces the 1–2 orders of magnitude mantle viscosity drop.
即时松弛应变率高出稳态流变律0.5–1.1个数量级，位错密度增至1.3–1.9×10^12 m^-2，背应力模型成功预测…

The backstress model overestimates final steady-state dislocation density by 1.25–4 times, overpredicts strain rates during relaxation from steady state, and predicts an overly sharp stress-exponent transition.
背应力模型将稳态位错密度高估1.25–4倍，且预测的应力指数转变过于陡峭。

First laboratory investigation of polycrystalline olivine under postseismic-like rapid loading and stress relaxation using coarse-grained (~400 μm) rocks that avoid fine-grained grain-boundary sliding and recrystallization artifacts.
首次在粗粒多晶橄榄石中开展类震后快速加载松弛实验，排除了细粒晶界滑移干扰。

kc: Performed high-temperature load-relaxation experiments on coarse-grained (~400 μm) Åheim dunite simulating rapid coseismic loading and postseismic relaxation.
Demonstrated via EBSD and dislocation decoration that dislocation density increases during transient creep while grain size and CPO remain unchanged.

Showed that the intragranular backstress model reproduces both laboratory relaxation curves and the 1–2 orders of magnitude postseismic viscosity reduction in the upper mantle, outperforming the intergranular plastic-anisotropy model.
对粗粒（约400 μm）Åheim纯橄榄岩开展了高温载荷松弛实验，模拟了快速同震加载和震后应力松弛。
通过EBSD和位错染色证明，在瞬态蠕变过程中位错密度增加，而晶粒尺寸和结晶学优选取向（CPO）保持不变。
证明晶内背应力模型不仅能重现实验室松弛曲线，还能解释上地幔震后1-2个数量级的黏度降低，优于晶间塑性各向异性模型。
me: Axisymmetric compressive deformation and load-relaxation testing in a Paterson gas-medium apparatus at 1100–1200°C and 300 MPa.
Microstructural characterization using electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) for grain size and CPO, and oxidation decoration with BSE imaging for dislocation density.
Numerical forward modeling using the constitutive equations of the intragranular backstress model and the intergranular plastic-anisotropy model.
在Paterson气体介质设备中于1100–1200°C和300 MPa下进行轴对称压缩变形与载荷松弛测试。
利用电子背散射衍射（EBSD）表征粒径和CPO，并结合氧化染色与背散射电子（BSE）成像统计位错密度。
基于晶内背应力模型和晶间塑性各向异性模型的本构方程开展数值正演模拟与外推。
de: Pre-dried, annealed cores of Åheim dunite (~86% forsterite, mean grain size ~400 μm) tested across rapid loading, immediate relaxation, constant-load creep, and relaxation from steady state.
Control load-relaxation tests on dummy samples of Fe, Ni, and alumina to calibrate jacket strength and apparatus compliance.
Manual count of 11,300 decorated dislocations across 8,000 μm^2 in 21 BSE images.
预先干燥退火的Åheim纯橄榄岩岩芯（约86%镁橄榄石，平均粒径约400 μm），经历快速加载、即时松弛、恒载蠕变及稳态松弛四个阶段。
对Fe、Ni和氧化铝假样品进行对照载荷松弛测试，以校正套管强度和仪器柔度。
在21张BSE图像（总面积8,000 μm^2）中手动统计了11,300个染色位错。
li: The backstress model consistently overestimates final steady-state dislocation density by a factor of 1.25–4 and predicts a sharper transition in apparent stress exponent than observed.
Apparatus compliance varies between assemblies and had to be calibrated by matching strain rates at the steady-state transition, with 1100°C strain rates near the resolution limit.
Experiments and models only consider 1D coaxial loading, whereas natural coseismic stresses may load the mantle at an angle to background tectonic stress.
背应力模型将最终稳态位错密度高估了1.25–4倍，且预测的表观应力指数转变比观测结果更陡峭。
仪器柔度随组装而异，需通过匹配稳态蠕变末端的应变率进行标定，且1100°C下的应变率接近仪器分辨率极限。
实验和模型仅考虑了一维同轴加载，而自然界同震应力可能与背景构造应力呈一定角度。

tm.why: The study investigates the microphysical mechanisms of transient dislocation creep and viscosity evolution in the upper mantle during postseismic relaxation and glacial isostatic adjustment.
The laboratory deformation experiments specifically simulate rapid coseismic loading followed by postseismic stress relaxation.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article used, including all text, methods, microstructural data, and 4 figures.

sum: This study investigates the rupture process and seismogenic mechanism of the 2023 Mw 6.0 Jishishan earthquake in Gansu Province, China. By developing a joint inversion framework integrating InSAR line-of-sight displacements, static GNSS offsets, and teleseismic waveforms, the authors constrain the fault geometry and resolve the kinematic rupture process. The results indicate that the rupture occurred primarily at depths of 5–12 km with a maximum slip of ~30 cm, yielding an estimated Mw of 5.94 and a duration of ~20 s. Tectonic analysis shows the event was dominated by thrust faulting with a minor strike-slip component within a compressional regime. Coulomb stress calculations suggest stress transfer influenced subsequent aftershocks. This work provides key insights into the seismogenesis and seismic hazards of the Lajishan fault system.
本研究联合InSAR、GNSS和远震波形数据，反演了2023年甘肃积石山Mw 6.0级地震的破裂过程。结果显示破裂主要集中在5-12 km深度，最大滑移约30 cm，矩震级为Mw 5.94，持续约20秒。该地震以逆冲为主伴有微弱走滑，受区域挤压构造控制。库仑应力计算表明主震促进了后续余震。该成果揭示……

The rupture concentrated at 5–12 km depth with ~30 cm maximum slip, Mw 5.94, ~20 s duration, dominated by thrust faulting.
破裂集中在5-12 km深度，最大滑移约30 cm，矩震级Mw 5.94，持续约20秒，以逆冲为主。
Potential resolution limits on shallow slip and early rupture details due to reliance on far-field seismic and static geodetic data.
依赖远震和静态大地测量数据，可能限制了对浅部滑移和早期破裂细节的分辨率。
First joint kinematic inversion of the 2023 Jishishan earthquake combining InSAR, GNSS, and teleseismic data to constrain the Lajishan fault system.
首次联合InSAR、GNSS和远震数据对2023年积石山地震进行运动学联合反演。

Determined the kinematic rupture parameters, including a maximum slip of ~30 cm at 5-12 km depth and a duration of ~20 s.

利用同震InSAR形变的非线性反演来约束断层几何结构。

Static GNSS coseismic offsets and regional interseismic velocities.
Far-field (teleseismic) seismic waveforms.

静态GNSS同震偏移量及区域震前GPS速度场。

Simplified 1D velocity structure used in the joint inversion may introduce minor modeling uncertainties.

tm.why: The paper performs a kinematic joint inversion to resolve the spatiotemporal rupture process of the 2023 Jishishan earthquake.
It analyzes the seismogenic mechanism and tectonic loading of the Lajishan fault system within a compressional regime.

sum: Conventional Amplitude Source Location (ASL) relies on station-specific coda normalization and homogeneous velocity models, often yielding large location errors in strongly heterogeneous volcanoes. This study introduces a modified ASL framework incorporating a linear vertical velocity gradient (ASL-VG) and source location-dependent amplification factors (SLAFs). Analyzing 339 volcano-tectonic (VT) earthquakes recorded by eight stations at Izu Oshima volcano, Japan, the authors compute SLAFs from reference events (located via P and S arrivals) and interpolate them onto a 2-D grid using ordinary kriging with an exponential variogram, replicated across depth. Cross-validation in the 8–16 Hz band (with Q=50, v0=1.5 km/s, k=0.33 s^-1) yields median vertical and horizontal misfits of 1.1 km and 1.0 km, compared to 2.2 km and 2.3 km for conventional ASL. The novelty lies in spatially varying empirical amplitude corrections via kriging, which effectively eliminates summit-ward location bias and improves depth distributions.
传统振幅震源定位（ASL）依赖基于尾波归一化的台站场地放大校正和均匀速度模型，在强非均匀火山区误差较大。本文提出改进的ASL框架，引入线性垂直速度梯度（ASL-VG）和震源位置相关放大因子（SLAF）。利用日本伊豆大岛火山8个台站记录的339个火山构造地震（VT），由参考事件计算SLAF，并通过指数……

t: The method computes ray-theoretical amplitudes in a 1-D linear vertical velocity gradient and corrects observed 8–16 Hz envelope amplitudes using source location-dependent amplification factors (SLAFs) interpolated via ordinary kriging with an exponential variogram model.
在一维线性垂直速度梯度介质中计算射线理论振幅，并利用指数变差函数普通克里金插值的震源位置相关放大因子（SLAF）校正8-…

Vertical-component records (2013–2023) of 339 volcano-tectonic earthquakes from eight 1-Hz stations (JMA and NIED V-net) at Izu Oshima volcano, split into Groups A (170) and B (169) across four clusters for cross-validation.
