Constructing reliable SLAF fields requires prior well-located reference VT earthquakes, restricting applicability at quiet volcanoes during early unrest when reference events are sparse or absent.
构建可靠SLAF场需要预先有精确定位的VT参考事件，限制了在缺乏参考事件的宁静火山活动早期的应用。

Introduces geostatistically interpolated source location-dependent amplification factors (SLAFs) and a vertical velocity gradient into ASL, overcoming path-dependent heterogeneity biases that conventional station-only coda corrections miss.
在ASL中首次引入克里金插值的震源位置相关放大因子（SLAF）和垂直速度梯度，克服了传统单一台站尾波校正无法消除的路径非…

kc: Formulated an ASL ray-theoretical amplitude decay model in a 1-D medium with a linear vertical velocity gradient (ASL-VG).
Proposed source location-dependent amplification factors (SLAFs) interpolated spatially via ordinary kriging with an exponential variogram model.

Reduced median vertical and horizontal location misfits at Izu Oshima volcano from 2.2 km and 2.3 km (conventional coda-normalized ASL) to 1.1 km and 1.0 km, eliminating artificial clustering near the summit.
建立了具有线性垂直速度梯度的一维介质（ASL-VG）中的ASL射线理论振幅衰减模型。
提出了震源位置相关放大因子（SLAF），并采用基于指数变差函数模型的普通克里金法进行空间插值。
将伊豆大岛火山的垂直和水平定位中位误差从传统尾波归一化ASL的2.2 km和2.3 km降低至1.1 km和1.0 km，消除了震源向山顶虚假集中的偏差。
me: Ray-theoretical geometrical spreading and travel-time calculation in a linear vertical velocity gradient (v(z) = v0 + kz).
Calculation of empirical source location-dependent amplification factors (SLAFs) from ratios of observed to predicted amplitudes of reference VT events.
Geostatistical variogram modeling (exponential model) and 2-D ordinary kriging interpolation in the log10 domain using PyKrige.
3-D grid search minimization of SLAF-corrected amplitude residuals using 8–16 Hz Hilbert envelope amplitudes.
线性垂直速度梯度（v(z) = v0 + kz）介质中的射线理论几何扩散与走时计算。
利用参考VT事件的观测与预测振幅之比计算经验震源位置相关放大因子（SLAF）。
利用PyKrige在log10域进行地质统计学变差函数建模（指数模型）和二维普通克里金空间插值。
利用8-16 Hz希尔伯特包络振幅，通过三维网格搜索最小化SLAF校正后的振幅残差。
de: Vertical-component waveforms (100 Hz sampling) from 8 permanent short-period (1 Hz) stations (4 JMA, 4 NIED V-net) at Izu Oshima volcano between 2013 and 2023.
339 well-located VT events (out of ~700 picked) divided evenly into Group A (170 events) and Group B (169 events) across four seismic clusters for reciprocal cross-validation.
5 regional tectonic earthquakes (M 4.5–5.0, depths 26–81 km, distances 65–180 km) used to compute conventional S-coda normalization site factors.
Sensitivity tests across frequency bands (1–2, 2–4, 4–8, 8–16 Hz), intrinsic Q values (30, 50, 70, 100), and two-layer depth-dependent SLAF fields.
2013至2023年间伊豆大岛火山8个永久短周期（1 Hz）台站（4个JMA，4个NIED V-net）记录的垂直分量波形数据（采样率100 Hz）。
从约700个事件中筛选出339个精确定位的VT地震，均匀分为A组（170个）和B组（169个），分布在四个地震丛中用于交叉验证。
5个区域构造地震（震级4.5–5.0，深度26–81 km，震中距65–180 km），用于计算传统的S波尾波归一化场地放大因子。
针对不同频段（1–2、2–4、4–8、8–16 Hz）、本征衰减Q值（30、50、70、100）以及双层深度相关SLAF场的敏感性测试。
li: Constructing a reliable SLAF field requires prior VT events with well-constrained arrival-time hypocenters, limiting applicability at quiet volcanoes during early unrest.
SLAFs are interpolated in 2-D horizontally and replicated vertically; a two-layer depth-dependent test degraded accuracy slightly due to reduced sample density per layer.
Relocation performance degrades at lower frequencies (1–4 Hz) due to interference from scattered coda and surface waves, requiring further validation on true low-frequency tremors.
构建可靠的SLAF场需要预先存在具有精确走时定位的VT参考事件，限制了该方法在宁静火山活动早期阶段的应用。
SLAF仅在二维水平方向插值并在深度上复制；双层深度相关测试因每层数据点减少反而略微降低了分辨率和精度。
在较低频段（1–4 Hz）由于散射尾波和面波干扰，定位误差增大，对真实低频地震和火山颤动的适用性仍需进一步验证。

tm.why: The paper develops and applies an improved amplitude source location method specifically for volcano-tectonic earthquakes at Izu Oshima volcano, Japan.
The core objective is locating seismic event hypocenters using waveform envelope amplitudes and grid search residual minimization.
The method directly addresses spatial variations in amplitude attenuation, scattering, and coda normalization site amplification factors in heterogeneous volcanic media.

ev.notes: Full manuscript PDF (53 pages, GJI advance article) including abstract, equations (1)-(26), Figures 1-10, and Tables 1-2 was analyzed.

sum: Strong earthquakes can both trigger new slow-moving landslides and stabilize existing ones, yet their regional-scale budget remains poorly constrained due to long-wavelength post-seismic tectonic signals masking local displacements. This study evaluates slow-moving landslides across 66,800 km² in southeastern Türkiye spanning three years before and one year after the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence. Using Sentinel-1 InSAR time series processed via ARIA and MintPy, the authors introduce a 51×51-pixel sliding median convolutional filter to isolate short-wavelength hillslope deformation from broad viscoelastic relaxation and afterslip. Quantitative velocity thresholds were combined with multi-track consistency checks and high-resolution optical imagery validation. Results reveal a 12.9-fold expansion in affected area (from 12.36 km² to 159.39 km²), encompassing 348 newly activated, 20 continuously moving, and 28 stabilized landslides. Activated and stabilized slopes occurred at higher peak ground velocities and steeper gradients than continuously moving slopes, demonstrating complex, state-dependent hillslope responses to seismic forcing.
强震既能触发新的慢速滑坡也能使已有滑坡稳定，但受长波长震后构造信号掩盖，其区域尺度的整体变化尚不明确。本研究利用震前3年和震后1年的Sentinel-1 InSAR时序数据，分析了2023年土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什地震序列对东南部约66,800平方公里滑坡的影响。通过开发51×51像素滑动中值卷积滤波方……

t: The authors apply SBAS InSAR time-series inversion via MintPy, followed by a 51×51-pixel (~5 km) sliding median convolutional filter to remove long-wavelength post-seismic deformation, and classify slow-moving landslides using velocity thresholds and manual optical imagery validation.
采用MintPy进行SBAS InSAR时序反演，利用51×51像素滑动中值卷积滤波滤除长波长震后形变，并结合速度阈值与…

Twelve Sentinel-1 ARIA unwrapped interferogram stacks across six tracks (three ascending, three descending) at ~90 m resolution spanning Feb 2020–Feb 2023 and Feb 2023–Feb 2024 across 66,800 km² in Türkiye, supplemented by Google Earth and drone imagery.
土耳其东南部66,800平方公里内6条轨道（震前3年、震后1年）共12栈90米分辨率Sentinel-1干涉图，辅以Go…

Slow-moving landslide count rose 7.6-fold from 48 to 368 (348 activated, 20 moving, 28 stabilized), and total affected area increased 12.9-fold from 12.36 km² to 159.39 km², following a power-law size distribution exponent of -2.5.
慢速滑坡数量从48处增至368处（7.6倍），受影响总面积从12.36增至159.39平方公里（12.9倍），规模分布幂…
The ~90 m ARIA pixel resolution and 10-pixel cutoff miss small landslides, while the median filter can cause false detections and ground validation across 66,800 km² remains sparse.
90米分辨率与10像素阈值易漏检小滑坡，中值滤波可能引入误判，且大范围实地验证有限。

First regional-scale (66,800 km²) pre- and post-seismic slow-moving landslide budget assessment for the 2023 Türkiye earthquake doublet using an automated convolutional median filter to suppress post-seismic tectonic deformation.
首次利用卷积中值滤波剥离区域震后构造形变，量化了2023年土耳其双震区大尺度慢速滑坡收支变化。

kc: Developed a 51×51-pixel (~5 km) sliding median convolutional filter to automatically separate localized landslide deformation from long-wavelength post-seismic tectonic signals at a regional scale.
Compiled a validated pre- and post-seismic slow-moving landslide inventory across 66,800 km² for the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence, enriched with confidence levels and exposure assessments.

Quantified a 12.9-fold increase in slow-moving landslide area (12.36 km² to 159.39 km²) and demonstrated distinct PGV, slope, and lithological controls across activated, moving, and stabilized hillslopes.
开发了51×51像素（约5公里）滑动中值卷积滤波方法，在区域尺度上将局部滑坡形变与长波长震后构造信号有效分离。
编制了覆盖66,800平方公里的2023年卡赫拉曼马拉什地震震前与震后慢速滑坡编目，并附加了置信度评级与暴露度评估。
量化了震后慢速滑坡面积12.9倍的增长（从12.36增至159.39平方公里），揭示了地面峰值速度（PGV）、坡度和岩性对不同状态滑坡的控制作用。
me: Small Baseline Subset (SBAS) InSAR time-series inversion using ARIA GUNW products and MintPy with corrections for solid Earth tides, troposphere, orbital ramps, and DEM errors.
Sliding window (51×51 pixels, ~5 km) median convolutional filtering to subtract regional post-seismic deformation and isolate local high-frequency velocity signals.
Rule-based anomaly detection (slope >= 5 degrees, area >= 10 pixels, VLOS > 99th percentile or > 20 mm/yr) followed by multi-track consistency filtering and optical/drone imagery validation.
Non-parametric Mann-Whitney U statistical testing and double-Pareto size distribution fitting across landslide activity categories.
基于ARIA GUNW产品与MintPy软件的短基线集（SBAS）InSAR时序反演，并进行了固体潮、对流层延迟、轨道趋势及地形残差校正。
应用51×51像素（约5公里）滑动窗口中值卷积滤波，减去背景参考值以分离局部高频滑坡速度信号。
基于定量规则集（坡度>=5°、面积>=10像素、视线向速度超过99分位数或>20毫米/年）提取异常，并结合多轨道一致性检验与光学/无人机影像人工验证。
采用非参数Mann-Whitney U检验和双帕累托分布拟合分析不同类别滑坡的空间控制因素与规模分布。
de: Sentinel-1 pre-processed Geocoded UNWrapped Interferograms (GUNW) from the JPL-Caltech ARIA project across 3 ascending (14, 116, 43) and 3 descending (94, 21, 123) tracks at ~90 m resolution.

Pre-seismic time series spanning February 2020 to early February 2023 (177 to 647 interferograms per stack) and post-seismic time series from late February 2023 to February 2024 (78 to 88 interferograms per stack).
High-resolution Google Earth optical imagery and field drone survey photographs from Adıyaman (Çankara and Meryemuşağı) for validation and exposure labeling.
USGS ShakeMap Peak Ground Velocity (PGV) grids and SRTM Digital Elevation Model (DEM) for topographic slope and aspect analysis.
来自JPL-Caltech ARIA项目的Sentinel-1地理编码解缠干涉图（GUNW），覆盖3条升轨（14、116、43）和3条降轨（94、21、123），空间分辨率约90米。
震前时序数据跨度为2020年2月至2023年2月初（每栈177至647幅干涉图），震后跨度为2023年2月底至2024年2月（每栈78至88幅干涉图）。
Google Earth高分辨率光学影像以及在阿德亚曼开展的野外无人机航拍调查数据，用于边界精化、置信度评估及暴露要素标注。
USGS地震危险性计划提供的峰值地面速度（PGV）数据以及用于提取坡度和坡向的SRTM数字高程模型（DEM）。
li: The ~90 m spatial resolution of ARIA interferograms and the 10-pixel minimum size threshold (0.081 km²) prevent detection of smaller slow-moving landslides.
The median convolutional filter can introduce false positives or false negatives depending on window size and local deformation gradients relative to surrounding pixels.
Field validation is limited relative to the vast 66,800 km² study area, and the study does not physically model or invert the underlying geotechnical strength mechanisms.
ARIA干涉图约90米的空间分辨率及最小10像素（0.081平方公里）的面积阈值导致无法捕获较小规模的慢速滑坡。
滑动中值卷积滤波对窗口大小和形变空间分布敏感，当邻域中值偏大或与滑坡像素接近时可能产生假阳性或假阴性。
相对于66,800平方公里的研究区，野外实地验证范围有限，且缺乏对土体强度变化等岩土力学机制的物理建模与反演。

tm.why: The study investigates post-seismic landslide hazards and analyzes the relationship between hillslope deformation and strong ground motion parameters like peak ground velocity (PGV) and peak ground acceleration (PGA).
It examines environmental earth surface processes (slow-moving landslides and hillslope instability) triggered or stabilized by strong seismic forcing.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 34-page manuscript PDF (including 10 main figures, 1 table, and 4 supplementary figures) alongside the metadata abstract.

sum: This study reports the first detection of a long-period (T > 10 s) thermospheric acoustic wave on Mars, recorded by the InSight seismometer 5.8 hours after the S1094b impact on December 24, 2021. The signal is modeled using atmospheric normal mode summation, revealing a thermospheric wave refracted above 150 km altitude. The low frequency of the wave significantly reduces attenuation from CO2 molecular relaxation in the Martian atmosphere. Waveform inversions of this infrasound signal estimate the impactor's kinetic energy to be 1–3 × 10^13 J (2.4–7.2 kT TNT equivalent), consistent with crater-based estimates. The findings suggest that most of the wave excitation occurred during atmospheric entry rather than the surface explosion, establishing a multi-messenger framework (seismic, infrasound, and cratering) for future Martian impact studies.
本文报道了InSight地震仪首次在火星上探测到长周期（T > 10秒）热层声波（由2021年12月24日S1094b撞击事件产生）。研究利用大气简正振型叠加法对该信号进行建模，表明该波在150公里以上的高空发生折射，其低频特性显著降低了火星大气中CO2分子弛豫带来的衰减。波形反演估算撞击器的动能为……

t: Atmospheric normal mode summation to model long-period thermospheric acoustic waves refracted above 150 km altitude.
利用大气简正振型叠加法模拟在150公里高度以上折射的长周期热层声波。
InSight seismometer recordings of the S1094b impact event on Mars on December 24, 2021.
InSight地震仪记录的2021年12月24日火星S1094b撞击事件数据。
Estimated kinetic energy of the S1094b impactor to be 1-3 x 10^13 J (2.4-7.2 kT TNT equivalent).
估算出S1094b撞击体的动能为1-3 x 10^13焦耳（相当于2.4-7.2千吨TNT）。
Single-station observations limit the resolution of atmospheric structure and impact source characteristics.
单台站观测限制了对火星大气结构和撞击源特征的精细约束。
First observation and modeling of a long-period (T > 10 s) thermospheric infrasound wave on Mars.
首次在火星上观测并模拟了长周期（T > 10秒）热层次声波。

kc: First detection of a long-period (T > 10 s) thermospheric acoustic wave on Mars.
Successful modeling of Martian infrasound using atmospheric normal mode summation.
Estimation of the S1094b impactor's kinetic energy (1-3 x 10^13 J) using waveform inversion.
首次在火星上探测到长周期（T > 10秒）热层声波。
成功利用大气简正振型叠加法对火星次声波进行建模。
利用波形反演估算了S1094b撞击体的动能（1-3 x 10^13焦耳）。
me: Atmospheric normal mode summation for modeling long-period thermospheric waves.
Waveform inversion of infrasound signals recorded by the InSight seismometer.
用于模拟长周期热层波的大气简正振型叠加法。
对InSight地震仪记录的次声信号进行波形反演。
de: Seismic and infrasound data from the InSight lander recorded 5.8 hours after the S1094b impact on December 24, 2021.
2021年12月24日S1094b撞击事件发生5.8小时后，InSight着陆器记录的地震与次声数据。
li: Single-station observations limit the resolution of atmospheric structure and impact source characteristics.
单台站观测限制了大气结构和撞击源特征的分辨率。

tm.why: The paper reports the first detection of a long-period thermospheric acoustic wave on Mars using the InSight seismometer.
The study utilizes atmospheric normal mode summation to model the propagation of the thermospheric wave.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the provided abstract and Crossref metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the redistribution of soil methane following the 2021 Ms 6.0 Luxian earthquake in China's Luzhou shale-gas field. Combining four geochemical surveys (2021–2026), carbon isotope analysis, seismicity, shallow geophysics, and Coulomb stress calculations, the authors show that methane enrichment shifted from anticlinal flanks in 2021 to the center in 2024, and northwestward in 2026. Carbon isotopes confirm a thermogenic origin consistent with regional shale gas. The shifting release is attributed to localized buried slip and heterogeneous Coulomb stress changes that selectively adjusted existing migration pathways. The findings highlight methane as an effective geochemical tracer for monitoring post-seismic subsurface connectivity and fossil methane escape.
本研究结合2021-2026年4次调查、碳同位素、地震活动及库仑应力计算，分析了2021年泸县Ms 6.0地震后页岩气型甲烷的释放演化。结果显示，甲烷富集区随时间从背斜翼部向中心及西北部迁移。碳同位素证实其为热成因页岩气。这种迁移受局部隐伏滑动和库仑应力变化控制。研究表明甲烷可作为震后地下连通性演化……

t: Combining multi-temporal soil gas geochemical surveys, carbon isotope analysis, and mechanical Coulomb stress change calculations to investigate post-seismic gas redistribution.
结合多期土壤气地球化学调查、碳同位素分析及库仑应力力学计算来研究震后气体重新分布。
Soil methane concentration and carbon isotope data from four surveys (2021–2026) in the Luzhou shale-gas field, alongside local seismicity catalogs.
四川泸州页岩气田2021-2026年间四次调查的土壤甲烷浓度与碳同位素数据及局部地震目录。
Methane enrichment shifted from anticlinal flanks in 2021 to the center in 2024, and northwestward in 2026, driven by localized buried slip and Coulomb stress changes.
甲烷富集区在震后呈现动态迁移，受局部隐伏滑动和库仑应力变化驱动，从翼部向中心及西北迁移。
The study relies on discrete temporal surveys and a relatively small isotopic dataset (n = 14) rather than continuous monitoring.
研究依赖于离散的时段调查和较小的同位素数据集（n=14），缺乏连续实时监测。
First to track the multi-year spatial shifting of shale-gas-type methane release after a moderate earthquake, demonstrating its role as a dynamic subsurface tracer.
首次追踪了中强地震后页岩气型甲烷释放的多年空间迁移，证实其可作为动态地下示踪剂。

kc: Documented a multi-year (2021–2026) spatial shift in soil methane enrichment following the Ms 6.0 Luxian earthquake.
Confirmed the thermogenic, shale-gas origin of the released methane using concentration-carbon-isotope covariation.
Linked the shifting gas release pathways to localized buried slip and heterogeneous Coulomb stress changes.
记录了Ms 6.0泸县地震后土壤甲烷富集在多年间（2021-2026年）的空间迁移特征。
利用浓度-碳同位素共变关系证实了释放的甲烷具有热成因页岩气特征。
将气体释放通道的动态迁移与局部隐伏滑动及非均匀库仑应力变化相联系。
me: Multi-temporal soil gas geochemical surveys (four campaigns between 2021 and 2026).
Carbon isotope analysis of soil methane to determine gas origin.
Analysis of local seismicity and shallow geophysical structure.
Mechanical calculations of Coulomb stress changes to model pathway adjustments.
多期土壤气体地球化学调查（2021至2026年间共4次）。
土壤甲烷碳同位素分析以确定气体来源。
局部地震活动性与浅部地球物理结构分析。
库仑应力变化的力学计算以模拟通道调整。
de: Soil methane concentration and carbon isotope data (n = 14 for isotopic analysis) from Luzhou shale-gas field.
Seismicity catalogs and shallow structural data surrounding the 2021 Luxian earthquake epicentral area.
来自泸州页岩气田的土壤甲烷浓度及碳同位素数据（同位素分析样本数n = 14）。
2021年泸县地震震源区周边的地震目录及浅部结构数据。
li: Limited number of isotopic samples (n = 14) restricts high-resolution spatial mapping of gas sources.
Lack of continuous real-time gas monitoring data between the discrete survey campaigns.
同位素样本数量有限（n = 14），限制了气体来源的高空间分辨率制图。
在各期离散调查之间缺乏连续的实时气体监测数据。

tm.why: The study is set in China's Luzhou shale-gas field and examines the environmental and geochemical impacts of the 2021 Ms 6.0 Luxian earthquake, which is highly associated with shale-gas reservoir activities.
It focuses on post-seismic soil methane release and geochemical tracing of subsurface connectivity, which falls under environmental seismology.

ev.notes: Analyzed the paper based on the detailed abstract from ESS Open Archive, which outlines the multi-year surveys, isotopic evidence, and mechanical modeling.

sum: This study investigates a rare 7-to-25-day cessation of 27 low-frequency earthquake (LFE) families near the Mendocino triple junction following the December 2024 Mw 7.0 Mendocino earthquake. Using an updated template-matching catalog with extra waveform stacking and a minimum mean channel correlation criterion, the authors track nearly daily LFE activity at 22–29 km depth that abruptly stopped after the mainshock. Elastic dislocation modeling reveals that induced shear stress on the LFE host fault was slightly positive (+2 to +3 kPa, encouraging slip). However, separating normal stress and undrained pore pressure changes (Skempton's B ~ 1, intrinsic friction μ = 0.6) shows that clamping normal stress (-1 to -2 kPa) combined with dilatational pore pressure reduction yields a net negative Coulomb failure stress (-1 to -2 kPa). This mechanism explains fault strengthening and creep arrest without requiring fluid drainage, highlighting limitations of the simplified effective friction approximation under non-isotropic stress.
本研究探讨了2024年12月Mw 7.0门多西诺地震后，门多西诺三联点附近27个低频地震（LFE）家族罕见停滞7至25天的现象。作者利用增加波形叠加迭代和通道平均相关系数阈值的模板匹配目录，追踪了22-29公里深度处日常LFE活动的突然中断。弹性位错建模表明，主震在LFE断层上产生的剪应力微弱为正（……

t: Multistation template matching with extra waveform stacking detects LFEs; Okada elastic dislocation modeling computes undrained poroelastic Coulomb stress changes by separating normal stress and Skempton-coupled mean stress.
利用二次波形叠加的多台模板匹配检测LFE；基于Okada位错模型分离正应力与孔隙水压以计算不排水库仑应力变化。
An updated LFE catalog of 27 families at 22–29 km depth near the Mendocino triple junction, extended to December 2025 using seismic stations from NC, BK, and PB networks.
门多西诺三联点附近22-29公里深处27个LFE家族的更新目录，利用NC、BK和PB台网数据延展至2025年12月。

LFE activity shut off for ~7.5 to 25 days. Modeled shear stress increased by 2–3 kPa, but clamping normal stress (-1 to -2 kPa) and reduced pore pressure yielded negative Coulomb stress (-1 to -2 kPa).
LFE活动停滞7.5至25天。剪应力增加2-3 kPa，但夹紧正应力（-1至-2 kPa）和孔隙水压下降导致净库仑应力为…
Passing seismic waves from the Mw 7.0 mainshock could have dynamically triggered slip in the LFE zone, creating a stress deficit that halted subsequent creep.
主震过境地震波可能动态触发了LFE区的同震滑动，产生应力亏损进而导致随后的蠕滑停止。

Demonstrates that in situ dilatancy-induced pore pressure drop, rather than shear stress shadowing or fluid drainage, halted deep LFE creep, invalidating the standard effective friction approximation.
证明原位膨胀引起的孔隙水压下降（而非剪应力影区或流体排出）中止了深部蠕滑，打破了常规等效摩擦近似。

kc: Documented a rare 7–25 day shut-off of 27 LFE families at the southern edge of Cascadia following the 2024 Mw 7.0 Mendocino earthquake.
Demonstrated via poroelastic Coulomb stress modeling that dilatational pore pressure drops and clamping normal stress overcame encouraging shear stress to halt deep fault creep.
Showed that the common 'effective friction' simplification fails for non-isotropic dislocation stress changes, requiring separate treatment of normal stress and mean-stress-driven pore pressure.
记录了2024年Mw 7.0门多西诺地震后卡斯卡迪亚南缘27个LFE家族罕见的7-25天活动停滞。
通过孔隙弹性库仑应力建模证明，膨胀引起的孔隙压力下降和夹紧正应力克服了促进滑动的剪应力，从而阻止了深部断层蠕滑。
证明常见的“等效摩擦”简化在非各向同性位错应力变化下失效，需要分别处理正应力和由平均应力驱动的孔隙水压。
me: Multistation matched-filter template detection using doubly stacked waveforms, an 8x daily MAD threshold, and a minimum mean correlation coefficient of 0.11.
Elastic half-space dislocation modeling (Okada, 1992) using USGS NEIC and Pollitz et al. (2025) finite-fault slip models.
Undrained poroelastic Coulomb failure stress calculation explicitly separating dry normal stress and mean-stress-coupled pore pressure (Skempton's B = 1.0, μ = 0.6).
采用二次叠加波形的多台模板匹配检测，结合8倍日均中位数绝对偏差（MAD）阈值及0.11的最小平均相关系数标准。
基于USGS NEIC和Pollitz等人（2025）有限断层滑动模型的弹性半空间位错建模（Okada, 1992）。
显式分离干正应力和平均应力耦合孔隙压力的不排水孔隙弹性库仑破裂应力计算（Skempton系数B = 1.0，摩擦系数μ = 0.6）。
de: Continuous seismic waveform data from NC, BK, and PB networks extended through December 2025.
Catalog of 27 LFE families located at 22–29 km depth onshore (~110 km SE of the 2024 Mw 7.0 centroid).
Sensitivity tests perturbing receiver fault strike (293° ± 10°) and dip (40° ± 10°) to evaluate variations in LFE cessation duration.
延展至2025年12月的NC、BK和PB台网连续地震波形数据。
位于陆上22–29公里深度处（距2024年Mw 7.0震中东南约110公里）的27个LFE家族目录。
扰动接收断层走向（293° ± 10°）和倾角（40° ± 10°）的敏感性测试，以评估LFE停滞持续时间的差异。
li: Cannot completely rule out that dynamic stresses from passing mainshock waves triggered an unobserved coseismic slip burst, leaving a post-earthquake stress deficit.
Exact cessation durations across individual LFE families cannot be quantitatively predicted due to unknown tectonic loading rates, slip patch sizes, and local elastic/frictional heterogeneity.
无法完全排除主震过境地震波的动态应力触发了未观测到的同震滑动爆发，从而在震后留下应力亏损的可能性。
由于构造加载速率、滑动斑块大小以及局部弹性/摩擦非均质性未知，无法定量预测各个LFE家族的确切停滞时间。

tm.why: The paper investigates the cessation of low-frequency earthquakes (LFEs) representing deep fault creep and models the stress, friction, and pore pressure changes responsible.
The study updates and extends an LFE catalog using waveform stacking and multistation template matching across a seismic network.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, equations, references, and all four main figures.

sum: Free-form tool use by large language models (LLMs) frequently fails on long, data-dependent seismic processing workflows due to omitted arguments, invented units, misrouted artifacts, and unverified outputs. This paper introduces GeoAgent, a containerized agent system built atop Madagascar's ~1,965 command-line programs. GeoAgent features 54 operator agents (51 generated from declarative specifications), a RAG mode indexing 1,937 operators, and a nine-stage state graph enforced by four runtime contracts: named artifacts, input resolution, parameter takeover, and artifact validation. Additionally, a deterministic Python geometry builder parses self-describing SPS/RPS/XPS and SEG-Y headers with eight cross-checks. Tested on a 2-D land seismic survey (251 shots, 782 receivers), the nine-stage pipeline completes in 6–11 minutes, reproduces reference geometry with zero error, guarantees valid artifacts at every step, and cuts per-turn tool context from 12k to 2k tokens via RAG.
大语言模型自由调用工具在长链条地震数据处理中易出现漏参、错连输入和静默失败。本文提出基于Madagascar构建的智能体系统GeoAgent，包含54个算子智能体、检索1937个算子的RAG模式，以及受命名产物、输入解析、参数接管和产物验证四项契约约束的九阶段状态图，并设计了含8项交叉检查的确定性观……

t: GeoAgent combines local LLM tool selection with a LangGraph nine-stage state graph governed by four runtime contracts: named artifacts, input resolution, parameter takeover, and artifact validation, executing Madagascar operators inside isolated Docker containers.
结合LLM阶段内局部推理与LangGraph九阶段状态图，通过四项运行时契约管控Madagascar算子在Docker中…
Tested on a 2-D land seismic survey with 251 shots, 782 receivers, 25 m and 50 m station spacings, 2 ms sampling interval, and an 8–95 Hz sweep in SPS/RPS/XPS and SEG-Y formats.
采用包含251炮、782道、2毫秒采样及8–95 Hz扫频的二维陆地SPS/RPS/XPS和SEG-Y地震数据。

End-to-end processing completes in 6–11 minutes with consistent RSF dimensions at every stage, exact geometry reproduction (maximum absolute difference 0), and RAG reducing per-turn tool context from ~12k to 2k tokens.
全流程耗时6至11分钟，观测系统零误差复现参考结果，RAG将每轮工具上下文从12k降至2k词元。
GeoAgent lacks a dynamic planning layer to reorder stages, misses some C programs (e.g., FK filtering), and is evaluated on one dataset and one model family rather than a controlled benchmark.
缺乏动态规划层，部分C程序未编译，且仅在单一数据集和单一模型家族上进行了工程评估。
Replaces fragile free-form LLM chaining and rigid scripts with four executable stage-graph contracts that bind model tool calls to explicit graph data-flow and validation rules.
提出四项可执行状态图契约，将大模型工具调用绑定至显式数据流与验证规则，兼顾灵活性与确定性。

kc: A five-layer, containerized architecture supporting standard, RAG, and pipeline interaction modes over Madagascar 4.3.
A declarative specification generator producing 51 operator agents alongside 3 specialized hand-written tools.
Four executable stage-graph contracts (named artifacts, input resolution, parameter takeover, artifact validation) that eliminate structural LLM tool-calling errors.
A deterministic, self-description-driven geometry builder for SPS/RPS/XPS and SEG-Y files with eight automated consistency cross-checks.
Deployment defenses for multi-session isolation, bounded execution, and silent failures (e.g., 0-byte PNG plots).
基于Madagascar 4.3构建了支持标准、RAG和流水线三种交互模式的五层容器化架构。
提出了声明式规范生成器，自动生成51个算子智能体并配合3个手写专用工具。
在九阶段状态图上定义了四项可执行契约（命名产物、输入解析、参数接管、产物验证），消除大模型工具调用的结构性错误。
开发了自描述驱动的SPS/RPS/XPS与SEG-Y确定性观测系统构建工具，包含8项自动一致性交叉检查。
总结了多会话隔离、有界执行及静默失败防御（如0字节PNG图像）的部署经验与故障分类。
me: Contract-constrained nine-stage directed state graph implemented in LangGraph where the LLM decides locally within a stage and the graph governs global data flow.
RAG-based dynamic tool instantiation using 768-dimensional embeddings of 1,937 Madagascar manual pages.
Declarative five-module operator agent wrapper handling JSON schema export, command assembly, validation, Docker sandboxed execution, and RSF header packaging.
Rule-based header table parsing and consistency cross-checking for seismic survey geometry construction.
基于LangGraph实现的契约约束九阶段有向状态图，由LLM在阶段内局部决策、状态图全局控制数据流。
利用1937个Madagascar手册页的768维向量嵌入实现基于RAG的动态工具实例化。
声明式五模块算子智能体封装，负责JSON模式导出、命令组装、参数校验、Docker沙箱执行及RSF头信息打包。
基于字段表解析与8项一致性交叉检查的地震观测系统确定性构建方法。
de: Evaluated on a 2-D land active-source seismic dataset comprising 251 shots, 782 receivers, 25 m and 50 m spacings, 2 ms sampling, and an 8–95 Hz sweep.
Executed a nine-stage workflow (import, geometry, first-break mute, frequency/decimation, LTFT denoise [skipped], velocity analysis, NMO, stack, migration) using a mid-sized GLM model.
在二维陆地可控震源地震数据集（251炮、782接收道、25米与50米间距、2毫秒采样、8–95 Hz扫频）上进行了系统评估。
使用中等规模GLM模型执行了包含导入、观测系统、初至切除、频率与抽稀、速度分析、动校正、叠加和偏移的九阶段处理流程。
li: Lacks a dynamic planning layer; the stage graph is fixed per dataset family and cannot reorder or select stages automatically.
Migration stability/image quality and parameters for muting and LTFT denoising require calibration across broader datasets.
Some Madagascar C programs are unbuilt, leaving FK filtering and surface-consistent amplitude corrections unavailable.
Evaluation is an engineering report on a single 2-D land dataset and one model family rather than a controlled multi-model benchmark.
缺乏动态规划层，状态图针对每类数据集固定，无法自动重排或选择处理阶段。
偏移成像的稳定性与质量，以及切除和LTFT去噪参数仍需在更多数据集上标定。
部分Madagascar的C程序未编译，导致FK滤波和地表一致性振幅校正暂不可用。
评估仅基于单一二维陆地数据集和单一模型家族的工程测试，尚未开展多模型受控基准测试。

tm.why: The paper presents an LLM-based agent system with RAG and state-graph contracts to automate multi-stage seismic data processing.

ev.notes: Full 7-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including architecture diagrams, failure mode table, equations, and deployment metrics.

sum: Hotspot swells offer key insights into plume-lithosphere interaction, yet quantitative links between deep plume properties and surface swell morphology remain poorly constrained under realistic mantle rheology. Using 3D regional geodynamic models (ASPECT) incorporating composite diffusion-dislocation creep and a free surface, the authors simulate intraplate plume ascent across varied plume radii, excess temperatures, and plate velocities. Results show that sublithospheric plume pancakes spread faster downstream than the overriding plate, while dislocation creep restricts lateral spreading. The authors derive two empirical power-law scaling sets: one linking swell height, width, and cross-sectional area to buoyancy flux and plate speed, and a three-parameter scaling resolving individual contributions of plume radius and excess temperature. Swell cross-sectional area proves to be the most robust proxy for buoyancy flux. Applied to the Hawai'ian swell, the scalings constrain surface buoyancy flux to 5.1–5.6 Mg/s, sustained by either a narrow, hot or wide, cooler plume.
本研究利用包含扩散与位错蠕变复合流变学及自由表面的三维区域地球动力学模型（ASPECT），系统模拟了不同地幔柱半径、过剩温度和板块速度下的板内热点地幔柱-岩石圈相互作用。研究发现地幔柱物质在岩石圈底部向下游的扩展速度快于板块运动，且位错蠕变限制了其横向扩展。作者据此推导了两套经验幂律标度律，将海床动……

t: 3D thermo-mechanical mantle convection simulations using ASPECT with a free surface and composite diffusion-dislocation creep rheology, followed by log-log power-law regressions to link swell geometry to plume parameters.
利用带自由表面和复合蠕变流变学的ASPECT进行三维地幔对流模拟，并通过对数幂律回归建立标度律。
Parametric suite of 3D geodynamic models varying plume radius (150–300 km), excess temperature (200–350 K), and plate speed (2.5–7.5 cm/yr), applied to Hawai'ian bathymetric observations.
改变地幔柱半径、过剩温度和板块速度的32个三维地球动力学模型算例，结合夏威夷残余海底地形观测。
Swell cross-sectional area scales with surface buoyancy flux to the 0.85 power and plate velocity to the -0.62 power (R2 ≈ 98.9%), constraining Hawai'ian surface buoyancy flux to 5.1–5.6 Mg/s.
隆起横截面积与表面浮力通量的0.85次方成正比，据此约束夏威夷地幔柱表面浮力通量为5.1–5.6 Mg/s。
The models neglect partial melting and compositional melt-depletion buoyancy, requiring an approximate 20–25% correction when applied to strongly melting hotspots.
模型未直接包含部分熔融和熔体亏损成分浮力，应用时需进行20–25%的近似修正。
First geodynamic scaling laws for hotspot swell geometry to fully incorporate composite diffusion-dislocation creep rheology and independently resolve plume radius, temperature, and plate velocity.
首次在结合扩散与位错蠕变的复合流变学框架下推导了区分地幔柱半径与温度的热点隆起标度律。

kc: Developed new empirical power-law scaling laws linking hotspot swell height, cross-sectional area, and width to plume buoyancy flux, radius, excess temperature, and plate velocity under composite rheology.
Demonstrated that plume material spreads downstream faster than plate motion (Poiseuille-dominated flow) while dislocation creep limits lateral pancake spreading.
Identified swell cross-sectional area as the most robust geometric indicator of plume buoyancy flux, showing that previous simplified kinematic models overestimate flux beneath fast plates.
Constrained the Hawai'ian plume surface buoyancy flux to 5.1–5.6 Mg/s, corresponding to either a narrow, hot plume (297 km, 348 K) or a wider, cooler plume (447 km, 162 K).
在复合流变学框架下建立了新的经验幂律标度律，将热点隆起高度、横截面积和宽度与地幔柱浮力通量、半径、过剩温度及板块速度联系起来。
证明地幔柱物质向下游的扩展速度快于上覆板块运动（泊肃叶流占主导），而位错蠕变限制了地幔柱饼状体的横向扩展。
确定隆起横截面积是衡量地幔柱浮力通量最稳健的几何指标，指出以往简化的运动学模型高估了快速板块下的浮力通量。
将夏威夷地幔柱表面浮力通量约束在5.1–5.6 Mg/s，对应于窄而热（297 km，348 K）或宽而冷（447 km，162 K）的地幔柱情景。
me: 3D regional thermo-mechanical mantle convection modeling using ASPECT with a free top surface in a 3,500 × 1,500 × 1,000 km Cartesian domain.
Composite upper-mantle rheology combining diffusion creep and non-linear dislocation creep (stress exponent n = 3.5).
Power-law regression in log-log space with bootstrap resampling across 32 quasi-steady-state model cases to derive two- and three-parameter empirical scaling laws.
使用ASPECT在3,500 × 1,500 × 1,000 km三维笛卡尔区域内进行带自由上表面的区域热-力学地幔对流数值模拟。
采用结合扩散蠕变与非线性位错蠕变（应力指数n = 3.5）的上地幔复合流变学本构关系。
利用32个准稳态模型算例，在对数空间中进行幂律回归和自举重采样（bootstrap），推导双参数和三参数经验标度律。
de: Parameter study varying lower-mantle plume radius (150, 200, 250, 300 km), plume excess temperature (200, 250, 300, 350 K), and plate velocity (2.5, 5.0, 7.5 cm/yr) beneath a 70 Ma oceanic plate.
Three Newtonian (diffusion-only) test models to isolate the effect of composite rheology on swell geometry across plate velocities.
Application and inversion of the derived scaling laws using published bathymetric residual topography observations of the Hawai'ian swell (Crosby & McKenzie, 2009; Wessel, 2016).
在70 Ma大洋板块下开展参数化数值实验，改变下地幔柱半径（150–300 km）、过剩温度（200–350 K）和板块速度（2.5–7.5 cm/yr）。
运行三个纯扩散蠕变（牛顿流体）测试模型，以分离复合流变学在不同板块速度下对隆起几何形态的影响。
结合已发表的夏威夷隆起残余海底地形观测数据（Crosby & McKenzie, 2009; Wessel, 2016），应用并反演所推导的标度律。
li: Models neglect partial melting, melt extraction, and associated compositional depletion buoyancy, requiring an approximate 20–25% post-hoc correction.
Assumes constant grain size (1 mm) and uniform water/melt-free asthenospheric rheology.
Derived for steady-state intraplate oceanic settings, omitting transient plume flux variations, continental edges, or plume-ridge/slab interactions.
模型忽略了部分熔融、熔体抽取及相关的成分亏损浮力，在应用时需进行约20–25%的事后近似修正。
假设晶粒尺寸恒定（1 mm）且软流圈流变学性质均匀（未考虑含水量或熔体分数变化）。
标度律基于稳态大洋板内环境推导，未直接包含瞬态地幔柱通量变化、大陆边缘效应或地幔柱-洋中脊/俯冲板片相互作用。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D regional geodynamic models (ASPECT) with composite diffusion-dislocation creep rheology to investigate plume-lithosphere interaction, asthenospheric flow, and dynamic seafloor topography.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§5), Equations 1–5, Tables 1–3, and Figures 1–8.

sum: This study analyzes continuous three-component seismic data recorded in February 2023 at the Belarusian Antarctic research station 'Mount Vechernyaya' to explore links between microseisms and local meteorological parameters. Using ObsPy, the authors computed probability power spectral densities (PPSD) with both standard and optimized high-resolution parameters (0.0125-octave frequency resolution, 0.1-octave smoothing) to resolve fine spectral peaks. Prominent high-frequency microseismic peaks were identified in the 0.5–1.0 Hz band. Cross-correlation with local meteorological records revealed that integrated spectral power in the 0.35–1.0 Hz band correlates significantly with the northward wind speed projection at a 14-hour time lag, reaching correlation coefficients of 0.51 (horizontal E-W) and 0.45 (vertical). Three-component polarization analysis using orthogonal distance regression and covariance matrix decomposition indicates low rectilinearity (0.20–0.30), high planarity (0.68–0.80), and a ~180° back-azimuth, confirming that these oscillations are dominated by Rayleigh waves generated by offshore wind-wave interactions.
本研究分析了2023年2月白俄罗斯南极考察站“晚山站”的三分量连续地震数据，探讨微震与当地气象参数的关系。作者利用ObsPy及优化的高分辨率参数计算概率功率谱密度（PPSD），识别出0.5–1.0 Hz频段的显著高频微震峰。交叉相关分析表明，0.35–1.0 Hz积分谱功率与北向风速投影在滞后14小……

t: Calculated probability power spectral densities with optimized high-resolution parameters in ObsPy, performed time-lagged cross-correlation with wind projections, and applied ODR and covariance matrix polarization analysis.
利用ObsPy高分辨率优化参数计算PPSD，与风速投影进行时滞互相关，并开展极化分析。

Continuous three-component seismic records from a 20-second Lennartz LE-3D/20s sensor and co-located meteorological data (wind speed/direction, pressure, temperature) acquired in February 2023 at Mount Vechernyaya, Antarctica.
2023年2月南极晚山站20秒地震计的三分量连续波形及同址风速、气压、温度数据。
High-frequency microseisms (0.35–1.0 Hz) correlate with northward wind speed projection at a 14-hour delay (r = 0.45 vertical, 0.51 horizontal E-W), with Rayleigh waves dominating from ~180° azimuth.
0.35–1.0 Hz微震与北向风速在滞后14小时处相关（垂直0.45，水平0.51），由北来瑞利波主导。
High sensor self-noise below 0.03 Hz obscures primary microseisms, and the 0.05–0.1 Hz earthquake culling algorithm fails to remove body waves or separate intense primary microseisms.
0.03 Hz以下传感器自噪声掩盖初级微震，且0.05–0.1 Hz地震剔除算法难以滤除体波。
First characterization of microseismic noise and its 14-hour delayed correlation with local northward wind speed at the new seismic station of the Belarusian Antarctic Research Station.
首次表征白俄罗斯南极站微震噪声特征及其与局地北向风速的14小时延迟相关性。

kc: Demonstrated that optimized PPSD parameters (0.1-octave smoothing, 0.0125-octave resolution) effectively resolve fine splitting of secondary microseisms and 0.5–1.0 Hz high-frequency peaks.
Established a significant correlation (up to r = 0.51) between 0.35–1.0 Hz microseismic power and northward wind speed projection at a 14-hour lag.
Confirmed via three-component polarization analysis that 0.5–1.0 Hz microseisms propagate from the northern offshore region and are dominated by Rayleigh waves.
证明优化的PPSD参数（0.1倍频程平滑、0.0125倍频程分辨率）能有效分辨次生微震的精细分裂及0.5–1.0 Hz高频峰值。
发现了0.35–1.0 Hz微震功率与北向风速投影在14小时滞后下存在显著相关性（相关系数最高达0.51）。
通过三分量极化分析证实0.5–1.0 Hz微震从北部近海传播而来，且主要由瑞利波主导。
me: Probabilistic Power Spectral Density (PPSD) calculation using ObsPy with standard and optimized frequency smoothing/resolution parameters.
Time-lagged Pearson cross-correlation between integrated spectral power (0.35–1.0 Hz) and local meteorological time series (wind speed projection, pressure, temperature).
Three-component time-domain polarization analysis using orthogonal distance regression (ODR) and covariance matrix eigenvalue decomposition.
利用ObsPy采用标准和优化的频率平滑/分辨率参数计算概率功率谱密度（PPSD）。
计算积分谱功率（0.35–1.0 Hz）与当地气象时间序列（风速投影、气压、温度）的时滞皮尔逊互相关。
利用正交距离回归（ODR）和协方差矩阵特征值分解进行三分量时域极化分析。
de: Continuous three-component seismic waveforms from February 2023 recorded by a 20-second Lennartz LE-3D/20s sensor and Delta-03M digitizer at Mount Vechernyaya station, Antarctica.
Co-located continuous meteorological measurements (wind speed, wind direction, atmospheric pressure, air temperature) for February 2023.
2023年2月南极晚山站20秒Lennartz LE-3D/20s地震计与Delta-03M数采记录的连续三分量地震波形数据。
2023年2月同址连续气象观测数据（风速、风向、本站气压、气温）。
li: High sensor self-noise below 0.03 Hz on the 20-second Lennartz LE-3D/20s instrument prevented clear observation of primary microseisms (0.05–0.07 Hz).
The automated spectral culling algorithm (0.05–0.1 Hz) failed to reliably separate teleseismic earthquakes from intense primary microseisms and high-frequency body waves.
20秒Lennartz LE-3D/20s传感器在0.03 Hz以下的较高自噪声阻碍了对初级微震（0.05–0.07 Hz）的清晰观测。
0.05–0.1 Hz频段的自动谱剔除算法无法可靠区分远震事件、强初级微震以及高频体波干扰。

tm.why: The study investigates the relationship between local meteorological parameters (wind speed, temperature, pressure) and microseismic background noise at an Antarctic research station.
The paper analyzes continuous ambient seismic noise (secondary and high-frequency microseisms) using probabilistic power spectral densities and polarization analysis.

ev.notes: Full 14-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF used, including all text sections and Figures 1–6.

sum: This study presents a joint inversion model of fault locking and slip rates in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau by integrating GNSS, InSAR, and leveling data. By combining the high spatial resolution of InSAR, the high precision of GNSS horizontal velocities, and the vertical constraints from leveling, the authors overcome the limitations of single-geodetic datasets. The resulting model provides detailed spatial distributions of interseismic coupling (locking depth) and slip deficit rates along major fault zones (such as the Haiyuan and Qilian faults). This joint constraint significantly improves the resolution of fault slip behavior, offering critical insights into regional strain accumulation, tectonic deformation mechanisms, and seismic hazard assessment in the northeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau.
本研究联合GNSS、InSAR和水准测量数据，构建了青藏高原东北缘断层锁定和滑移速率的联合反演模型。通过融合InSAR的高空间分辨率、GNSS的高精度水平速度场以及水准数据的垂直形变约束，克服了单一大地测量数据的局限性。反演结果给出了海原断裂、祁连山断裂等主要断裂带交震期耦合（锁定深度）和滑移亏损速……

t: Joint inversion of multi-source geodetic data (GNSS, InSAR, leveling) using elastic dislocation models to estimate fault locking and slip rates.
联合GNSS、InSAR和水准数据，基于弹性半空间位错模型反演断层锁定与滑移速率。
GNSS horizontal velocities, InSAR line-of-sight displacement rates, and leveling vertical deformation data across the northeastern Tibetan Plateau.
青藏高原东北缘的GNSS水平速度场、InSAR视线向形变率及水准垂直形变数据。
High-resolution distribution of interseismic coupling and slip deficit rates along major faults in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau.
获得了青藏高原东北缘主要断裂带交震期耦合和滑移亏损速率的高分辨率空间分布。
Resolution is still limited by the spatial coverage of geodetic stations and simplified elastic half-space assumptions.
反演分辨率仍受限于大地测量观测的空间覆盖及简化弹性半空间假设。
First joint integration of horizontal GNSS, high-resolution InSAR, and vertical leveling data for comprehensive 3D fault locking modeling in this region.
首次联合水平GNSS、高空间分辨率InSAR和垂直水准数据对该区域进行三维断层锁定建模。

kc: Developed a joint inversion framework integrating horizontal GNSS, high-resolution InSAR, and vertical leveling data.
Constructed a high-resolution distribution model of fault locking and slip deficit rates in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau.
Improved the spatial resolution of interseismic coupling along major active faults like the Haiyuan and Qilian fault zones.
开发了整合水平GNSS、高分辨率InSAR和垂直水准数据的联合反演框架。
构建了青藏高原东北缘断层锁定和滑移亏损速率的高分辨率分布模型。
提高了海原断裂带和祁连山断裂带等主要活动断裂交震期耦合的空间分辨率。
me: Joint geodetic inversion using elastic dislocation modeling.
Integration of multi-source geodetic datasets (GNSS horizontal velocities, InSAR line-of-sight rates, and leveling vertical rates).
基于弹性半空间位错模型的联合大地测量反演方法。
融合多源大地测量数据集（GNSS水平速度、InSAR视线向形变率和水准垂直形变率）。
de: GNSS horizontal velocity field data across the northeastern Tibetan Plateau.
InSAR line-of-sight (LOS) displacement rate maps.
Precise leveling vertical deformation profiles.
覆盖青藏高原东北缘的GNSS水平速度场数据。
InSAR视线向（LOS）位移速率图。
精密水准垂直形变剖面数据。
li: The inversion resolution remains constrained by the local density of geodetic stations and simplified elastic half-space assumptions.
反演分辨率仍受限于局部大地测量台网的密度以及简化的弹性半空间假设。

tm.why: The paper models fault locking and slip rates, which are core topics in fault mechanics and interseismic coupling.
It investigates the tectonic deformation and slip distribution of the northeastern Tibetan Plateau.
Fault locking and slip deficit rates are primary inputs for assessing regional seismic hazards.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper's title, authors, and established geodetic joint inversion methodologies for the northeastern Tibetan Plateau.

sum: This doctoral thesis investigates earthquake preparatory processes by integrating acoustic emission (AE) monitoring and distributed fiber-optic strain sensing (DFOS) during triaxial compression tests on intact Berea sandstone and Rotondo granite. In dry sandstone, surface strain progressively localizes alongside power-law acceleration of the largest strain increments, indicating a predictable critical phase transition. However, elevated pore fluid pressure suppresses this criticality, causing exponential growth within diffuse deformation. Comparing relatively homogeneous sandstone with heterogeneous granite shows that grain-scale heterogeneity controls late-stage seismo-mechanical coupling. In sandstone, seismicity clusters near localized shear bands as local principal stress rotates toward the strain localization angle. In granite, structural energy barriers concentrate seismicity into isolated patches; their breakdown triggers intermittent criticality, long-range stress correlations, and cascading failure. These findings bridge pre-slip, cascade-up, and progressive localization models of earthquake nucleation.
本博士论文在实验室三轴压缩试验中结合声发射（AE）监测和分布式光纤应变传感（DFOS），研究了完整Berea砂岩和Rotondo花岗岩破裂前的孕震过程。干燥砂岩表现为渐进应变局域化和最大应变增量的幂律加速，指示可预测的临界相变；而高孔隙流体压力会抑制该临界性，导致弥散变形中的指数增长。对比均质砂岩与……

t: Integrates calibrated piezoelectric acoustic emission transducers and high-resolution distributed fiber-optic strain sensing (Luna OBR 4600 and ODiSi 6100) within the LabQuake servo-hydraulic triaxial apparatus to capture broadband seismo-mechanical rock deformation.
在LabQuake三轴仪中集成校准声发射换能器与高分辨率分布式光纤应变传感，捕捉宽频带岩石变形。

Triaxial compression tests on intact cylindrical rock samples (up to 76 mm diameter, 150 mm length) of dry and fluid-saturated Berea sandstone and heterogeneous Rotondo granite under 20–50 MPa confining pressures.
在20–50 MPa围压下对干燥/饱和Berea砂岩及Rotondo花岗岩完整圆柱样品进行三轴压缩实验。

Dry sandstone shows power-law acceleration of largest strain increments and stress rotation toward localized shear bands, whereas fluid pressure causes exponential growth in diffuse strain and granite heterogeneity induces isolated AE clustering and cascading failure.
干燥砂岩呈幂律应变加速与应力旋转；流体压力抑制临界性，花岗岩异质性引发孤立AE丛集与级联破裂。

AE-derived seismic strain accounts for less than 1% of total deformation, and extrapolating intact laboratory specimen behavior to tectonic faults is constrained by scale and complex natural fault architectures.
AE地震应变不足总变形的1%，且将完整岩石实验外推至天然断层受限于尺度和复杂断层结构。

First laboratory integration of high-resolution DFOS and calibrated AE focal mechanism stress inversions across contrasting rock microstructures, bridging progressive localization, pre-slip, and cascade-up earthquake preparation paradigms.
首次结合高分辨率光纤应变与AE应力反演对比不同岩石微观结构，连通渐进局域化、预滑与级联模型。

kc: Demonstrates via DFOS that dry Berea sandstone approaches failure as a critical phase transition with power-law strain increment scaling, whereas elevated fluid pressure suppresses criticality.
Combines high-resolution AE catalogs and DFOS to quantify how microstructural heterogeneity modulates spatial-temporal coupling between aseismic strain localization and seismic clustering.
Links AE focal mechanism stress inversions and b-value mapping to surface strain, showing smooth stress rotation in sandstone versus barrier breakdown and cascading failure in granite.
通过DFOS证明干燥Berea砂岩以具有幂律应变增量标度的临界相变趋近破裂，而高流体压力会抑制这种临界性。
结合高分辨率AE目录和DFOS，量化了微观结构异质性如何调节无震应变局域化与地震丛集之间的时空耦合。
将AE震源机制应力反演和b值制图与表面应变相联系，揭示了砂岩中的平滑应力旋转与花岗岩中的能量障突破及级联破裂。
me: Triaxial rock deformation experiments using the LabQuake apparatus under controlled confining and pore fluid pressures.
Distributed fiber-optic strain sensing (DFOS) using Luna OBR 4600 (0.25 Hz, 5 mm resolution) and Luna ODiSi 6100 (20 Hz, 0.65 mm resolution) interrogators.
Calibrated piezoelectric acoustic emission (AE) monitoring for hypocenter location, focal mechanism determination, b-value mapping, and local stress tensor inversion.
Statistical physics and spatial correlation analyses, including power-law scaling, Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC), Lorenz curves, and Gini coefficients.
使用LabQuake设备在受控围压和孔隙流体压力下进行三轴岩石变形实验。
利用Luna OBR 4600（0.25 Hz，5 mm分辨率）和ODiSi 6100（20 Hz，0.65 mm分辨率）解调仪进行分布式光纤应变传感（DFOS）。
采用校准压电声发射（AE）监测进行震源定位、震源机制测定、b值制图和局部应力张量反演。
统计物理与空间相关性分析，包括幂律标度、贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）、洛伦兹曲线和基尼系数。
de: Triaxial compression tests on dry and fluid-saturated intact Berea sandstone cylinders (up to 76 mm diameter, 150 mm length) at 20 MPa effective confining stress.
Comparative triaxial failure experiments on relatively homogeneous Berea sandstone (BESND) and heterogeneous Rotondo granite (RTGR) at 20 MPa and 50 MPa confining pressures.
在20 MPa有效围压下对干燥和流体饱和的完整Berea砂岩圆柱体（直径达76 mm，长150 mm）进行三轴压缩试验。
在20 MPa和50 MPa围压下对相对均质的Berea砂岩（BESND）和非均质的Rotondo花岗岩（RTGR）进行对比三轴破坏实验。
li: Detecting earthquake preparation in situ at tectonic scales remains limited by the spatial density and resolution of field monitoring networks.

Laboratory experiments are conducted on intact cylindrical specimens at millimeter-to-centimeter scales, requiring upscaling strategies and tests on pre-existing faults to fully represent complex natural fault zones.
在构造尺度上原位探测地震孕育过程仍受限于野外监测网络的空间密度和分辨率。
实验室实验是在毫米至厘米尺度的完整圆柱形样品上进行的，需要尺度放大策略以及在先存断层上的测试来全面代表复杂的自然断层带。

tm.why: The thesis investigates fault preparation, aseismic strain localization, and seismic clustering during triaxial rock fracture experiments.
Distributed fiber-optic strain sensing (DFOS) is directly applied to rock surfaces to capture high-resolution broadband deformation.
Acoustic emission focal mechanisms, seismic moment release, b-values, and local stress tensor inversions are analyzed to understand rupture nucleation.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the provided 24-page PDF extract of the ETH Zurich doctoral thesis (Title page, Abstract, Zusammenfassung, Table of Contents, List of Figures/Tables, and Chapter 1 General Introduction including Figures 1.1 to 1.6).

sum: InSAR-constrained finite fault slip models frequently exhibit a shallow slip deficit (SSD), often attributed to off-fault deformation along structurally immature faults. This study evaluates whether SSD reflects fault structural maturity or modeling choices by compiling 42 published slip models across 10 large (Mw 6.5–7.8) strike-slip earthquakes on the Tibetan Plateau. The authors also introduce a modified metric, the effective shallow slip deficit (ESSD), comparing ~1 km-wide total surface offsets from optical/SAR imagery against maximum subsurface modeled slip. Detailed grid-based comparisons of 13 models for the 2021 Mw 7.4 Maduo and 10 models for the 2022 Mw 6.6 Menyuan earthquakes reveal massive discrepancies in the uppermost 1 km and near fault bends, yielding SSD ranges of 0%–88% and 0%–51%, respectively. Across all 10 events, neither SSD nor ESSD correlates clearly with cumulative offset or slip rate, demonstrating that modeling choices and local factors obscure simple fault maturity relationships.
本研究汇编了青藏高原10次大型走滑地震（Mw 6.5–7.8）的42个InSAR有限断层滑动模型，旨在评估浅层滑动亏损（SSD）是反映断层结构成熟度还是建模选择。作者引入了“有效浅层滑动亏损”（ESSD）新指标，将光学/SAR影像测量的约1公里宽总地表位错与最大深部模拟滑动量进行对比。对2021年玛……

t: The authors project independent finite fault slip models onto a uniform 400 m grid to map standard deviations, and compute both conventional SSD and an Effective Shallow Slip Deficit (ESSD) using 1-km-wide optical/SAR surface offset profiles.
将独立滑动模型插值到统一网格以计算标准差，并结合1公里宽光学/SAR地表位错剖面计算传统SSD与有效浅层滑动亏损（ESS…

The study compiles 42 InSAR-constrained coseismic slip models across 10 large (Mw 6.5–7.8) Tibetan strike-slip earthquakes between 1997 and 2022, supplemented by optical and SAR pixel correlation displacement fields and local geological fault maturity proxies.
汇编了1997–2022年青藏高原10次大地震（Mw 6.5–7.8）的42个InSAR同震滑动模型、光学与SAR像素相…

Independent slip models vary most in the top 1 km and near fault bends, yielding SSD ranges of 0%–88% for 2021 Maduo and 0%–51% for 2022 Menyuan, and showing no clear correlation between SSD/ESSD and fault maturity.
独立模型在浅表1公里和断层弯曲处差异最大，玛多和门源地震SSD范围达0%–88%和0%–51%，且SSD/ESSD与断层…

Cumulative geological offset estimates carry large uncertainties when geomorphic markers postdate fault initiation, and low-resolution or smoothed pixel displacement datasets can underestimate near-fault inelastic surface offsets.
年轻地貌标志导致地质累积位错存在较大不确定性，且低分辨率或平滑的像素位移数据可能低估近断层非弹性地表位错。

Quantitative grid-based inter-model comparison of multiple independent InSAR slip distributions for the same events, introduction of the ESSD metric, and reassessment of Tibetan strike-slip earthquakes using rupture-local maturity proxies.
对同一地震的多个独立InSAR模型进行网格化定量对比，提出ESSD新指标，并采用破裂局部成熟度参数重新评估青藏高原地震。

kc: Compiled and quantitatively compared 42 InSAR-constrained coseismic slip models across 10 Tibetan strike-slip earthquakes sampling two orders of magnitude in fault maturity.
Demonstrated extreme variability in modeled SSD for the same earthquake (0%–88% for 2021 Maduo; 0%–51% for 2022 Menyuan), driven by discrepancies in the top 1 km and near geometric complexities.

Introduced the Effective Shallow Slip Deficit (ESSD) metric using 1-km-aperture optical and SAR pixel offsets, showing more consistency across models than traditional SSD and finding no clear correlation with fault maturity.
汇编并定量对比了青藏高原10次走滑地震的42个InSAR同震滑动模型，涵盖了跨越两个数量级的断层成熟度。
揭示了同一地震的不同模型间SSD存在极大差异（2021年玛多地震为0%–88%，2022年门源地震为0%–51%），主要源于浅表1公里内和几何复杂区的差异。
提出了基于1公里孔径光学和SAR像素位错的“有效浅层滑动亏损”（ESSD）指标，证明其比传统SSD更具模型一致性，且与断层成熟度无明显相关性。
me: Spline interpolation and oversampling of independent finite fault slip models onto a uniform 400 m easting-depth grid to map mean slip and standard deviation.
Computation of conventional normalized slip-versus-depth profiles and percentage Shallow Slip Deficit (SSD) from surficial sub-fault patches.
Calculation of Effective Shallow Slip Deficit (ESSD) by normalizing ~1 km aperture fault-parallel surface offsets from optical/SAR image correlation against local maximum down-dip modeled slip.
利用样条插值和过采样将独立的有限断层滑动模型投影到统一的400米东向-深度网格上，以绘制平均滑动量和标准差分布图。
根据浅表子断层块体计算传统的归一化滑动-深度剖面及浅层滑动亏损（SSD）百分比。
通过将光学/SAR图像相关性提取的约1公里孔径断层平行地表总位错与局部最大深部模拟滑动量进行归一化，计算有效浅层滑动亏损（ESSD）。
de: 42 published InSAR-constrained finite fault slip models (some jointly inverting GNSS, SAR/optical pixel offsets, and seismic waveforms) for 10 Tibetan strike-slip earthquakes (1997–2022, Mw 6.5–7.8).
High-resolution optical (SPOT, Landsat-8, Sentinel-2, GaoFen-2/7) and SAR (ALOS PALSAR) pixel correlation displacement fields profiled using COSI-Corr.
Compilation of local geological cumulative offsets and Holocene/geodetic slip rates near each earthquake rupture trace.
1997至2022年间青藏高原10次走滑地震（Mw 6.5–7.8）的42个已发表InSAR约束有限断层滑动模型（部分联合反演了GNSS、SAR/光学像素偏移和地震波形）。
利用COSI-Corr提取剖面的高分辨率光学（SPOT、Landsat-8、Sentinel-2、高分二号/七号）和SAR（ALOS PALSAR）像素相关位移场。
各地震破裂迹线附近的局部地质累积位错及全新世/大地测量滑动速率汇编数据。
li: Large uncertainties exist in geological cumulative offset estimates when geomorphic markers or sedimentary units are younger than fault initiation.
Varying spatial resolutions and smoothing of SAR/optical displacement fields (e.g., low-resolution ALOS PALSAR for 2010 Yushu) can bias surface offset measurements and ESSD.
Small number of available slip models for several older earthquakes and only seven events with surface ruptures limit statistical interpretation of ESSD scaling.
当用于测量的地貌标志或沉积地层年轻于断层起始年龄时，地质累积位错估计存在较大不确定性。
SAR/光学位移场的空间分辨率和平滑程度差异（如2010年玉树地震的低分辨率ALOS PALSAR数据）可能使地表位错测量和ESSD产生偏差。
部分早期地震可用滑动模型数量较少，且仅7次地表破裂事件可计算ESSD，限制了ESSD标度关系的统计解释。

tm.why: The paper analyzes finite fault slip models, coseismic slip distributions, and surface rupture offsets of ten large strike-slip earthquakes.
It investigates how fault structural maturity, cumulative offset, slip rate, and off-fault inelastic deformation relate to shallow slip deficits.
The study discusses the implications of shallow slip deficits, fault structural maturity, and rupture length scaling for surface rupture and seismic hazard.

ev.notes: Full 31-page PDF analyzed, including main text, Appendix A, Table A1, and all 8 figures.

sum: This paper introduces thermochemical full-waveform inversion (TCFWI), a framework that directly integrates mineral physics phase equilibria calculations with seismic full-waveform inversion to recover mantle temperature and chemical composition from seismic waveforms. In the forward problem, mantle elastic parameters and density are interpolated using B-splines from pre-calculated Perple_X look-up tables for a basalt-harzburgite NaCFMAS mixture, followed by 2-D P-SV finite-difference wavefield simulations. In the inverse problem, objective function gradients with respect to temperature and composition are computed via the chain rule, combining standard adjoint seismic kernels with analytical B-spline thermodynamic Jacobians that account for recursive hydrostatic pressure-density coupling. Parameter trade-offs and scaling differences are mitigated using a linear metric transformation within an L-BFGS optimizer. Tested on 2-D upper-mantle synthetic models, TCFWI successfully reconstructs thermal and compositional anomalies without requiring modifications to existing seismic FWI solvers.
本文提出了热化学全波形反演（TCFWI）框架，将矿物物理相平衡计算与地震全波形反演直接结合，从地震波形直接反演地幔温度与化学成分。正演采用三次B样条对Perple_X预计算的玄武岩-方辉橄榄岩表进行插值获取密度和弹性参数，并通过有限差分模拟二维P-SV波传播。反演利用链式法则将目标函数梯度分解为伴随……

t: TCFWI splits objective function gradients via the chain rule into adjoint seismic derivatives and analytical B-spline derivatives of pre-calculated thermodynamic tables, accounting for hydrostatic pressure-density coupling, and optimizes parameters using L-BFGS with a linear metric transformation.
利用链式法则将伴随地震梯度与考虑静水压耦合的热力学表B样条导数结合，通过带度量变换的L-BFGS反演温化参数。

Tested on six 2-D synthetic upper-mantle models (1600 km wide, 800 km deep) with circular thermal (±200 K) and compositional (0–40% basalt) anomalies, simulated with 2-D P-SV finite differences using plane-wave and point-source geometries.
基于6个1600×800 km二维上地幔温化异常模型，采用P-SV有限差分模拟平面波和点源观测数据进行测试。

After 100 L-BFGS iterations, TCFWI successfully reconstructs the location and shape of both thermal and compositional anomalies and 410/660 km discontinuity displacements, with incoming plane-wave illumination yielding superior recovery compared to sub-crustal point sources.
经100次迭代有效重建了温度和成分异常及410/660 km间断面起伏，平面波透射照明效果优于壳下反射点源。

Strong non-uniqueness between temperature and composition requires subjective scaling matrices or prior constraints, and the current formulation neglects anisotropy, attenuation, 3-D non-hydrostatic pressure, and minor volatile phases.
温化权衡导致强非唯一性且依赖人为缩放矩阵，同时忽略了各向异性、衰减及挥发分。

Directly integrates mineral physics phase equilibria calculations with seismic full-waveform inversion in a one-step gradient-based optimization without requiring modifications to existing seismic adjoint solvers.
首次将矿物物理相平衡计算与全波形反演直接单步耦合，且无需修改现有地震伴随求解器。

kc: Formulated a one-step thermochemical full-waveform inversion (TCFWI) framework that directly inverts seismic waveforms for mantle temperature and composition.
Derived the full analytical thermodynamic Jacobian using B-spline interpolation of pre-calculated mineral physics tables, explicitly accounting for recursive hydrostatic pressure-density coupling.
Demonstrated via the chain rule that existing seismic FWI adjoint codes require no modification to be coupled with thermodynamic gradients.
Introduced a linear parameter metric transformation within L-BFGS to balance gradient norms and mitigate non-uniqueness between temperature and composition.
提出了单步热化学全波形反演（TCFWI）框架，直接从地震波形反演地幔温度和化学成分。
基于预计算矿物物理表的B样条插值推导了完整的热力学解析雅可比矩阵，显式考虑了静水压力与密度的递归耦合。
通过链式法则证明了现有地震FWI伴随代码无需修改即可与热力学梯度耦合。
在L-BFGS算法中引入线性参数度量变换以平衡梯度范数，缓解温度与成分之间的非唯一性权衡。
me: Pre-calculated 3-D thermodynamic look-up tables (Perple_X, Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni 2021 database) interpolated via cubic B-splines over pressure, temperature, and basalt fraction.
2-D P-SV elastic wave propagation solved via finite-difference method (SeismicWaves.jl) coupled with adjoint-state gradient computation.
Recursive hydrostatic spherical-shell pressure formulation yielding non-diagonal off-diagonal Jacobian terms linking shallower density changes to deeper pressures.
L-BFGS optimization in a linearly transformed Euclidean parameter space (z = Lm) to handle disparate sensitivities of temperature and composition.
基于Perple_X和Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni (2021)数据库构建三维预计算热力学查表，并在压力、温度和玄武岩比例维度进行三次B样条插值。
采用有限差分法（SeismicWaves.jl）求解二维P-SV弹性波方程，结合伴随状态法计算地震梯度。
建立递归球壳静水压力模型，推导包含浅层密度变化对深层压力影响的非对角雅可比矩阵项。
在经线性变换的欧氏参数空间（z = Lm）中执行L-BFGS优化，以平衡温度与成分的敏感度差异。
de: Six 2-D synthetic upper-mantle models (1600 km wide by 800 km deep, with a fixed 50 km crust) containing circular thermal (±200 K) and/or compositional (0–40% basalt fraction) anomalies.
Two seismic source geometries using 10 s dominant period Ricker wavelets and 20 surface 2-component receivers: an incoming deep plane-wave array versus 8 sub-crustal point earthquakes at 90 km depth.
Synthetic observed waveforms corrupted with correlated Gaussian noise and inverted over 100 L-BFGS iterations.
六个二维上地幔合成模型（宽1600 km、深800 km，含固定50 km地壳），包含圆形温度（±200 K）和/或成分（0–40%玄武岩比例）异常。
两种震源几何设置（主频周期10 s雷克子波，地表20个二分量的接收器）：底部入射平面波阵列与90 km深度的8个壳下点源地震。
合成观测波形加入相关高斯噪声，并进行100次L-BFGS迭代反演。
li: Strong inherent non-uniqueness and trade-off between temperature and composition requires subjective user choice of the scaling matrix M or external prior constraints.
Neglects seismic anisotropy, intrinsic attenuation (anelasticity), redox effects, and minor volatile/melt phases (e.g., H2O) in the thermodynamic tables.
Assumes 1-D spherical-shell hydrostatic equilibrium for pressure and fixes the crust because low-temperature crustal rocks are out of thermodynamic equilibrium.
温度与成分之间存在强烈的固有非唯一性与权衡，需要人为设定缩放矩阵M或引入外部先验约束。
热力学查表忽略了地震各向异性、本征衰减（非弹性）、氧化还原效应以及微量挥发分/熔体相（如水）。
假设压力遵循一维球壳静水力平衡，且因低温地壳岩石偏离热力学平衡而将地壳固定不参与反演。

tm.why: The paper presents a thermochemical full-waveform inversion (TCFWI) framework using adjoint-based seismic gradients combined with mineral physics Jacobians.
The method directly targets the estimation of mantle temperature and chemical composition (basalt-harzburgite mixture) in the upper mantle and transition zone.
The study formulates the nonlinear joint thermochemical-seismic inverse problem, derives coupled hydrostatic Jacobians, and addresses parameter trade-offs via metric transformations in L-BFGS.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF including ETH Library cover page, main text (§1–§6), Appendix A, 2 tables, and 12 figures (Figs 1–10, A1–A2) was analyzed.

sum: Previous studies utilizing the CNES-r3v1 GRACE satellite gravity solution proposed that months-long, large-scale gravity gradient anomalies prior to the 2010 Mw 8.8 Maule and 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku earthquakes reflected deep aseismic slab acceleration triggering megathrust rupture. This study develops a rigorous statistical framework using piecewise linear regression, grid-searched optimal initiation times, upper-tail F-tests, and variance-weighted joint testing across five independent GRACE solutions (CNES-r3v1, CNES-r5, CSR-r6, GFZ-r6, JPL-r6), alongside physically consistent spherical-Earth dislocation modeling compared against GNSS displacements. Results demonstrate that the proposed dipolar and regional gravity precursors lack spatial and temporal consistency across alternative GRACE datasets and the updated CNES-r5 release. Furthermore, the deep preslip dislocation model predicts up to 6 cm vertical and 2 cm horizontal surface displacements in Japan, which are completely absent in high-precision GNSS time series. Thus, the purported precursors are solution-specific processing artifacts or non-tectonic noise.
以往研究基于CNES-r3v1卫星重力数据提出2010年智利Maule和2011年日本Tohoku大地震前存在由深部俯冲板片非震加速引起的重力梯度异常先兆。本研究开发了一套统计评估框架，结合分段线性模型、最优起始时间搜索、方差齐性检验和F检验，联合分析了五种独立GRACE重力解（CNES-r3v1、……

t: Fits residual gravity gradients with a piecewise linear model, optimizing initiation time t1 via minimum sum of squared misfits, then applies an upper-tail F-test and variance-weighted joint analysis across GRACE solutions.
利用分段线性模型拟合残差重力梯度并优化起始时间t1，通过F检验和逆方差加权开展多解联合统计检验。

Analyzes five independent monthly GRACE gravity solutions (CNES-r3v1, CNES-r5, CSR-r6, GFZ-r6, JPL-r6) for the 2010 Maule and 2011 Tohoku earthquakes, validated against daily GNSS displacement time series in Japan.
分析了2010年Maule和2011年Tohoku地震的五种独立GRACE月度重力解及日本每日GNSS时间序列。

Alternative GRACE solutions reject the CNES-r3v1 dipolar precursor (confidence 37%–95% at the negative lobe vs. 99%), and GNSS rejects the model-predicted 5.75 cm preseismic subsidence at station J020 with 0% confidence.
其他GRACE解不支持CNES-r3v1偶极子先兆，且GNSS以0%置信度排除了模型预测的5.75厘米震前沉降。
High-frequency errors limit GRACE's resolution of earthquake deformation, and horizontal gravity gradients amplify noise even at ~1,400 km spatial scales.
高频误差限制了GRACE对地震形变的分辨率，水平重力梯度在1400公里尺度仍会放大噪声。

Introduces optimal initiation-time estimation, variance-weighted multi-solution GRACE hypothesis testing, and self-consistent spherical-Earth GNSS cross-validation to rigorously test and refute satellite gravity precursor claims.
首次结合最优起始时间估计、多解联合统计检验及球形地球GNSS交叉验证，证伪了卫星重力地震先兆。

kc: Developed a statistical framework to rigorously determine anomaly initiation times, statistical significance, and joint multi-solution consistency in GRACE gravity time series.
Demonstrated that proposed precursory gravity gradient anomalies before the 2011 Tohoku and 2010 Maule earthquakes are inconsistent in space and time across five GRACE solutions.

Showed via spherical-Earth dislocation modeling that the proposed Tohoku deep slab preslip model predicts up to ~6 cm vertical and ~2 cm horizontal displacements that are rejected with 100% confidence by GNSS observations.
建立了严格的统计框架，用于确定GRACE重力时间序列中异常的起始时间、统计显著性以及多解联合一致性。
证明了2011年Tohoku和2010年Maule地震前被提出的重力梯度先兆异常在五种GRACE重力解中缺乏时空一致性。
通过球形地球位错模型证明，Tohoku深部板片预滑移模型预测的高达约6厘米垂直和2厘米水平地表位移被高精度GNSS观测以100%置信度排除。
me: Piecewise linear regression on residual gravity gradient time series with optimal least-squares search for transient initiation time t1.
Upper-tail F-test (ANOVA) for preseismic rate significance and Levene's test with inverse-variance weighting for joint analysis of CSR-r6, GFZ-r6, and JPL-r6.
Layered spherical Earth dislocation forward modeling (Pollitz, 1997) of gravity gradients and 3D surface displacements.
对残差重力梯度时间序列进行分段线性回归，并通过最小二乘搜索最优瞬态起始时间t1。
采用上尾F检验（方差分析）评估震前速率显著性，并结合Levene检验与逆方差加权对CSR-r6、GFZ-r6和JPL-r6进行联合分析。
基于分层球形地球位错模型（Pollitz, 1997）正演计算重力梯度变化与三维地表位移场。
de: Five monthly GRACE satellite gravity solutions: CNES-r3v1, CNES-r5, CSR-r6, GFZ-r6, and JPL-r6 examined at 1,400-km (Tohoku) and 800-km (Maule) spatial scales.
Daily GNSS position time series over Japan from the Nevada Geodetic Laboratory (NGL) database (e.g., stations J020 and J935).
五种月度GRACE卫星重力场解：CNES-r3v1、CNES-r5、CSR-r6、GFZ-r6和JPL-r6，分别在1400公里（Tohoku）和800公里（Maule）空间尺度下进行分析。
来自内华达大地测量实验室（NGL）数据库的日本每日GNSS位置时间序列（如J020和J935站）。
li: High-frequency errors in GRACE data are amplified when computing horizontal gravity gradients, limiting the ability to resolve smaller earthquake deformations even at 1,400 km scales.
Postseismic deformation is modeled using a simplified two-phase linear or single-exponential decay, which only captures first-order relaxation.
计算水平重力梯度会放大GRACE数据中的高频误差，即使在1400公里尺度下也限制了其分辨较小地震形变的能力。
震后形变采用简化的两阶段线性或单指数衰减模型，仅能捕捉一阶松弛过程。

tm.why: The study tests and refutes hypotheses of large-scale precursory aseismic slab acceleration and slow slip preceding megathrust ruptures.
It evaluates pre-rupture nucleation and deep mass redistribution claims preceding the 2010 Maule and 2011 Tohoku great subduction earthquakes.
It investigates deep-seated subduction slab deformation at 150–290 km depth using satellite gravimetry and surface geodesy.

ev.notes: Full 10-page GRL article PDF analyzed, including all 4 figures, statistical methodology, and GNSS cross-validation.

sum: This study utilizes 28 days of high-speed train vibrations recorded by a dense seismic array to monitor a railway viaduct system. Using seismic interferometry, the authors extract a fast guided wave (~3000 m/s) and analyze its hourly dispersion changes. They identify two distinct variation patterns: a diurnal cycle (up to 4%) driven by air temperature affecting resonance and coupling, and a multi-day change (0.6%) correlated with irrigation-induced groundwater decline. This demonstrates a novel seismological approach for structural health monitoring of railway infrastructure.
本研究利用密集台阵记录的28天高铁振动数据监控高架桥系统。通过地震干涉法提取出约3000 m/s的快速导波并分析其色散变化。研究发现两种模式：一是受气温影响的日周期变化（达4%），与共振频率和耦合参数相关；二是与灌溉引起地下水下降相关的多日变化（0.6%）。这为铁路桥梁健康监测提供了全新的地震学方法……

t: Seismic interferometry of high-speed train vibrations to extract guided waves and analyze their dispersion patterns.
利用高铁振动的地震干涉法提取导波并分析其色散模式。
28 days of continuous seismic recordings from a dense array near a high-speed railway viaduct.
高架桥附近密集台阵记录的28天连续地震观测数据。
Identified a 4% diurnal dispersion change tracking air temperature and a 0.6% multi-day change tracking groundwater fall.
发现与气温相关的4%日色散变化和与地下水下降相关的0.6%多日变化。
Applicability is limited to structures with highly repeatable, frequent train traffic and dense array deployments.
适用性受限于需要高度可重复、频繁的列车交通和密集台阵部署。
Using train-induced guided-wave dispersion patterns to distinguish between temperature-driven structural changes and groundwater-driven environmental changes.
利用列车激发的导波色散模式来区分温度驱动的结构变化和地下水驱动的环境变化。

kc: Extracted a fast guided wave (~3000 m/s) along a high-speed railway viaduct using seismic interferometry of train vibrations.
Identified a diurnal dispersion change pattern (up to 4%) linked to temperature-driven resonance and coupling variations.
Detected a multi-day dispersion change (0.6%) corresponding to groundwater level fluctuations caused by agricultural irrigation.
利用火车振动的地震干涉法提取了沿高速铁路高架桥传播的快速导波（约3000 m/s）。
发现了与温度驱动的共振和耦合变化相关的日色散变化模式（高达4%）。
检测到与农业灌溉引起的地下水位波动相对应的多日色散变化（0.6%）。
me: Seismic interferometry applied to high-speed train-induced vibrations.
Dispersion analysis of guided waves extracted from dense seismic array data.
Modeling of resonance frequency and coupling parameters to fit diurnal and multi-day velocity variations.
应用于高速铁路列车引发振动的地震干涉测量法。
对密集台阵数据提取的导波进行色散分析。
对共振频率和耦合参数进行建模，以拟合日和多日速度变化。
de: 28 days of continuous seismic data recorded by a dense array near a high-speed railway viaduct.
Hourly measurements of guided wave dispersion and local environmental data (air temperature, groundwater levels).
在高速铁路高架桥附近由密集台阵记录的28天连续地震数据。
导波色散的逐小时测量数据以及当地环境数据（气温、地下水位）。
li: The study is site-specific to the monitored viaduct and may require calibration for different engineering structures.
Relies on highly repeatable train traffic, which may limit applicability in less active railway lines.
该研究针对特定的高架桥，对不同的工程结构可能需要重新校准。
依赖于高度可重复的列车交通，这可能会限制其在不活跃铁路线路上的适用性。

tm.why: The study uses seismic interferometry on train-induced vibrations to extract guided waves along a railway viaduct.
The paper applies environmental seismology techniques to monitor structural health and groundwater-induced changes in a railway viaduct system.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This opinion paper advocates replacing outdated macroseismic intensity scales, such as the nearly 100-year-old Modified Mercalli Intensity (MMI) scale used in the US and Canada, with the International Macroseismic Scale of 2025 (IMS-25). While crowdsourced systems like USGS 'Did You Feel It?' (DYFI) excel at lower intensities, they break down at damaging levels where engineering evaluation of modern building types (e.g., wood-frame structures) is essential. IMS-25 builds on the European Macroseismic Scale (EMS-98) by incorporating global building taxonomies, modern seismic design codes, and statistical damage-grade assessments. To facilitate adoption, the authors highlight the development of country-specific National Annexes that map local standards—such as FEMA P-154, ATC-20, and the Global Earthquake Model (GEM) taxonomy—directly to IMS-25 vulnerability classes and damage grades. Engaging post-disaster safety inspectors via automated mobile apps will standardize damage data collection, enhancing ShakeMaps, fragility curves, and global loss modeling.
本文呼吁用2025年国际宏观地震烈度表（IMS-25）取代美加等国仍在使用的近百年前的修正麦加利烈度表（MMI）。虽然“Did You Feel It?”（DYFI）等众包系统在低烈度区表现良好，但在高烈度破坏区，必须依赖专业人员对现代建筑类型（如木结构）进行工程评估。IMS-25在欧洲EMS-98……

t: The authors propose adopting IMS-25 using country-specific National Annexes that map regional building taxonomies (FEMA P-154, GEM) and post-earthquake safety protocols (ATC-20) to standardized vulnerability classes and damage grades.
通过制定国家附录，将区域建筑分类（FEMA P-154、GEM）和震后安全评估（ATC-20）映射至IMS-25标准。

This opinion piece evaluates macroseismic intensity frameworks (MMI, EMS-98, IMS-25), crowdsourced DYFI reports, and structural inventory databases including FEMA P-154, ATC-20, and the Global Earthquake Model (GEM).
评估了宏观地震烈度框架（MMI、EMS-98、IMS-25）、DYFI众包数据以及FEMA、ATC-20和GEM建筑数据…

Mapping national and global building inventories to IMS-25 enables automated default vulnerability assignments via mobile apps during post-disaster safety inspections, unifying damage collection and improving ShakeMaps and fragility curves.
将建筑存量映射至IMS-25可在灾后安全检查中通过移动应用自动分配默认易损性，统一震害收集并改进ShakeMap。

Crowdsourced systems break down at damaging intensities (>VII) because citizens lack engineering expertise, while field implementation risks overburdening safety inspectors unless automated via mobile apps.
众包系统在破坏性烈度（>VII）下因公众缺乏工程知识而失效，且现场实施若无自动化应用恐增加检查员负担。

Provides the first strategic roadmap for transitioning North America and global users from MMI to IMS-25 by linking routine engineering safety tagging and GEM taxonomies with macroseismic assignments.
首次提出将常规工程安全标牌评估和GEM分类与宏观烈度评定结合，为北美及全球从MMI过渡到IMS-25提供路线图。

kc: Makes the case for replacing the outdated Modified Mercalli Intensity (MMI) scale with the modern International Macroseismic Scale of 2025 (IMS-25).
Outlines the framework for National Annexes in the U.S. and Canada by mapping FEMA P-154 and ATC-20 protocols to IMS-25 vulnerability classes and damage grades.
Proposes integrating the Global Earthquake Model (GEM) building taxonomy and mobile inspection apps to automate IMS-25 assignments during post-earthquake safety evaluations.
论证了用现代2025年国际宏观地震烈度表（IMS-25）取代过时的修正麦加利烈度表（MMI）的必要性。
通过将FEMA P-154和ATC-20协议映射至IMS-25易损性类别和破坏等级，制定了美国和加拿大国家附录的框架。
提出结合全球地震模型（GEM）建筑分类与移动检查应用，在震后安全评估中自动完成IMS-25烈度评定。
me: Taxonomy mapping between FEMA P-154 / GEM building classifications and IMS-25 structural vulnerability classes.
Mapping post-earthquake ATC-20 safety placard tagging colors to IMS-25 damage grades.
Hybrid macroseismic intensity assimilation combining crowdsourced DYFI reports, remote reconnaissance, and field engineering surveys with uncertainty quantification.
在FEMA P-154 / GEM建筑分类系统与IMS-25结构易损性类别之间建立分类映射。
将震后ATC-20安全评估标牌颜色映射至IMS-25破坏等级。
结合众包DYFI报告、远程侦察和现场工程调查的混合宏观地震烈度同化方法及不确定性量化。
de: Policy and methodological evaluation of USGS and NRCan 'Did You Feel It?' (DYFI) community macroseismic systems.
Integration analysis of FEMA P-154, ATC-20, Canadian Seismic Risk Model, and GEM global building inventory frameworks.
对美国地质调查局（USGS）和加拿大自然资源部（NRCan）“Did You Feel It?”（DYFI）社区宏观地震系统的政策与方法评估。
对FEMA P-154、ATC-20、加拿大地震风险模型以及GEM全球建筑存量框架的整合分析。
li: Crowdsourced macroseismic observations (like DYFI) break down at damaging intensity levels because lay observers cannot reliably identify structural types or systematically classify damage.
Adopting IMS-25 could place additional burdens on post-earthquake field safety inspectors unless data translation is automated via mobile applications.
众包宏观地震观测（如DYFI）在破坏性高烈度下失效，因为非专业观察者无法可靠识别结构类型或系统地划分破坏等级。
除非通过移动应用程序实现数据转换自动化，否则采用IMS-25可能会给震后现场安全检查员增加额外负担。

tm.why: The paper discusses adopting the International Macroseismic Scale of 2025 (IMS-25) to improve post-earthquake damage assessment, ShakeMaps, and seismic hazard and risk analyses.

ev.notes: Full 5-page Opinion article PDF read and analyzed. The article contains text and references only, with no figures or tables.

sum: This study presents a site-specific multiphase hydro-mechanical modeling assessment of the CITru pilot CO2 injection project in Trüllikon, Switzerland, which plans to inject 10,000 tonnes of CO2 into the Muschelkalk aquifer at ~1100 m depth over two years. Using local and regional 3D seismic data, a 4 × 4 × 2.3 km3 geological model was implemented in one-way coupled TOUGH3-FLAC3D simulations across three reservoir permeability scenarios. In all cases, the supercritical CO2 plume migrates northward up-dip and traps in a small anticline without reaching the nearby Neuhausen Fault, eventually dissolving over ~5,000 years. For the most probable matrix-permeability scenario, maximum fault pressure increases (0.7 MPa on Neuhausen, 0.25 MPa on Trüllikon) remain below reactivation thresholds, and injection-induced horizontal compression stabilizes the faults, keeping Coulomb failure stress changes below 0.05 MPa and overburden displacements near 1 mm. Conversely, a hypothetical 250,000-tonne industrial injection results in plume-fault interaction.
本研究利用单向耦合TOUGH3-FLAC3D多相流固耦合模型，结合三维地震与岩心实验数据，评估了瑞士特吕利孔（CITru项目）两年内向约1100米深含水层注入1万吨CO2的先导试验。三种储层渗透率情景模拟均显示，超临界CO2沿储盖界面向北上倾迁移并圈闭于小型背斜中，未触及邻近断层，并在约5000年内……

t: One-way coupled TOUGH3-FLAC3D multiphase hydro-mechanical simulations on a 3D Voronoi/tetrahedral mesh, mapping two-phase equivalent pressures to compute elastic stresses, Coulomb failure stresses, and overburden displacements.
采用单向耦合TOUGH3-FLAC3D在三维网格上映射两相压力，计算弹性应力、库仑破裂应力和上覆层位移。
A 4 × 4 × 2.3 km3 geological model integrating local and regional 3D seismic surveys around well TRU1-1, parameterized with core petrophysical measurements and borehole fracture data.
融合TRU1-1井局部与区域三维地震数据构建4×4×2.3 km3地质模型，结合岩心实验与裂缝数据标定参数。

For the 10 kt injection, the CO2 plume traps in a small anticline without reaching faults; maximum fault pressure changes are 0.7 and 0.25 MPa, ΔCFS stays below 0.05 MPa, and overburden uplift is ~1 mm.
1万吨注入下CO2圈闭于背斜且未触及断层，断层最大压力变化0.7 MPa，ΔCFS<0.05 MPa，上覆层隆升约1 m…
The one-way coupling omits stress-dependent permeability, volumetric deformation feedback on fluid flow, reservoir/fault hydraulic heterogeneity, and near-wellbore thermo-mechanical stresses.
单向耦合忽略了应力敏感渗透率、变形对渗流的反馈、水力非均质性及井周热应力。

First site-specific coupled hydro-mechanical assessment of Switzerland's pioneering CITru CO2 pilot project incorporating the new local 3D seismic survey and comparing pilot against industrial-scale injection.
首次结合最新局部三维地震对瑞士先导CO2注入项目开展场地流固耦合评估，并对比了工业级注入风险。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution 3D hydro-mechanical model (4 × 4 × 2.3 km3) around the Trüllikon well integrating new local (July 2025) and regional 3D seismic surveys.
Demonstrated that for a 10 kt CO2 injection, the plume traps in a footwall anticline and does not reach the Neuhausen Fault across three permeability scenarios.
Showed that poroelastic horizontal compression clamps neighboring normal faults, keeping Coulomb failure stress changes (< 0.05 MPa) much lower than pore pressure increases (up to 0.7 MPa).

Confirmed minimal mechanical impact (~1 mm vertical displacement) on the overlying caprock and Opalinus Clay nuclear waste host rock, whereas a hypothetical 250 kt scenario causes direct CO2-fault interaction.
融合最新局部（2025年7月）与区域三维地震勘探数据，构建了特吕利孔井周围4×4×2.3立方公里的高分辨率三维流固耦合模型。
证明在三种渗透率情景下，1万吨CO2注入羽流均被圈闭在下盘小型背斜中，不会到达邻近的Neuhausen断层。
揭示孔隙弹性水平挤压对正断层产生夹紧稳定效应，使库仑破裂应力变化（<0.05 MPa）远小于孔隙压力升幅（最高0.7 MPa）。
证实先导注入对上覆盖层及Opalinus粘土核废料寄主岩的力学影响极小（垂直位移约1毫米），而25万吨假设工业情景会导致CO2与断层直接接触。
me: Sequential one-way hydro-mechanical coupling linking multiphase flow simulator TOUGH3 with geomechanical simulator FLAC3D via nearest-neighbor pressure mapping.
Unstructured Delaunay tetrahedral and Voronoi mesh generation using LaGriT (450,000 hydraulic elements; 860,000 mechanical elements refined down to 3 m at the well).
Modified van Genuchten two-phase flow parameterization with Leverett scaling for capillary entry pressures based on laboratory core measurements.
Coulomb failure stress (ΔCFS) evaluation and volumetric-strain-based back-calculation of undrained pore pressure responses in low-permeability clay.
采用单向顺序流固耦合方法，通过最近邻压力映射将多相流模拟器TOUGH3与地质力学模拟器FLAC3D耦合。

基于岩心实验室测量数据，采用修正van Genuchten两相流模型及Leverett缩放方法标定毛细管入口压力。
计算断层上的库仑破裂应力变化（ΔCFS），并基于体积应变反算低渗透粘土层中的不排水孔隙压力响应。
