Petrophysical laboratory measurements (relative permeability and capillary pressure curves) on rock core samples from the TRU1-1 borehole.
Fracture characterization and discrete fracture network (DFN) permeability estimates derived from the nearby Schlattingen (SLA2b) geothermal well.
Five deterministic numerical simulation scenarios testing three reservoir permeabilities and two injection scales (10 kt pilot vs. 250 kt industrial).
融合Nagra区域三维地震勘探与CITru项目在TRU1-1井周围（半径1.3公里）开展的局部三维地震层位与断层解释数据。
TRU1-1钻孔岩心样品的岩石物理实验室测量数据（相对渗透率曲线和毛细管压力曲线）。
基于邻近Schlattingen（SLA2b）地热井的裂缝表征与离散裂缝网络（DFN）渗透率估计数据。
测试三种储层渗透率和两种注入规模（1万吨先导试验与25万吨工业规模）的五个确定性数值模拟情景。
li: One-way hydro-mechanical coupling neglects stress-dependent permeability changes and volumetric deformation feedback into fluid flow calculations.
Reservoir and fault zones are modeled with homogeneous and isotropic hydraulic properties within each layer.
Thermo-mechanical cooling stresses near the injection wellbore are omitted from the geomechanical calculations.
单向流固耦合忽略了应力敏感渗透率变化以及体积变形对流体流动计算的双向反馈。
各岩层内部的储层和断层带均假设为均质且各向同性的水力属性。
地质力学计算中未考虑注入井筒附近的温度冷却引起的热力学应力变化。

tm.why: The paper evaluates pressure changes, poroelastic stresses, and Coulomb failure stress changes on faults to assess induced seismicity risks from a pilot CO2 test injection.
The study quantifies fault reactivation potentials, normal and shear stress variations, and fault clamping effects on nearby faults under fluid injection.

sum: Understanding whether megathrust earthquakes rupture to the trench is critical for tsunami hazard assessment in Cascadia. This study integrates shipborne multichannel seismic reflection, multibeam bathymetry, and ultra-high-resolution autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) bathymetry and sub-bottom chirp data across a 580-km-long corridor of the central and southern Cascadia frontal thrust fault zone (FTFZ). The authors identify four distinct Holocene deformation styles: fault-propagation folding, imbricate thrusting, breakthrough thrusting, and pervasive mass wasting/frontal erosion. Joint analysis with crustal-scale depth-migrated seismic profiles demonstrates that these shallow styles correlate strongly with deep megathrust geometry and accretionary mode (full accretion vs. sediment underthrusting). Crucially, AUV surveys reveal widespread on-fault geologic indicators of discrete, episodic slip—including primary fault scarps, bending-moment fault scarps, punctuated growth strata, and single-event offsets—providing compelling evidence for variable-mode coseismic slip reaching the trench in Cascadia.
揭示俯冲带大地震同震滑移是否到达海沟对评估海啸灾害至关重要。本研究整合了船载多道地震、多波束测深以及超高分辨率自主水下航行器（AUV）测深和浅地层剖面数据，对卡斯卡迪亚中南部580公里长的前缘逆冲断层带（FTFZ）进行了精细测绘。研究识别出四种全新世变形样式：断层传播褶皱、叠瓦状逆冲、突破性逆冲以及……

t: Integrates shipborne multichannel seismic and multibeam bathymetry with ultra-high-resolution AUV bathymetry and chirp sub-bottom profiling, alongside crustal-scale depth-migrated seismic profiles, to map shallow fault structures and identify geomorphic and stratigraphic indicators of coseismic slip.
整合船载多道地震、多波束测深、AUV超高分辨率测深与浅剖及地壳尺度深度偏移剖面，识别浅表同震滑移地貌与地层标志。

Multi-scale marine geophysical dataset across 580 km of central and southern Cascadia, comprising crustal-scale CASIE21 2D MCS lines, high-resolution sparker MCS profiles, 30-m shipborne bathymetry, and targeted 1-m AUV multibeam and sub-bottom chirp surveys.
跨越卡斯卡迪亚中南部580公里的多尺度海洋地球物理数据，含CASIE21深部地震、电火花地震、30米船载测深及1米AUV…

Identifies seven fault sections exhibiting four Holocene deformation styles (fault-propagation folding, imbricate thrusting, frontal erosion, breakthrough thrusting) correlated with deep accretionary mode, alongside widespread primary and bending-moment fault scarps and punctuated growth strata indicating coseismic slip.
划分出7个断层段和4种与深部增生模式相关的全新世变形样式，发现广泛发育的断层崖与间断生长地层等幕式同震变形证据。

Geomorphic and stratigraphic observations lack direct sediment core age control in several sections and cannot uniquely distinguish rapid coseismic rupture from slow earthquakes or early postseismic afterslip.
缺乏直接岩芯年代控制，第3段受滑坡和BSR干扰成像较差，且地质记录难以完全区分快速同震破裂与慢滑移或震后余滑。

Provides the first margin-wide, meter-scale AUV and seismic characterization directly linking deep megathrust accretionary modes to variable-mode Holocene coseismic surface deformation along the Cascadia trench.
首次通过全陆缘米级AUV与多尺度地震联合解析，将卡斯卡迪亚深部增生模式与海沟处多模式全新世同震地表变形直接关联。

kc: Mapped a 580-km-long section of the Cascadia frontal thrust fault zone using integrated shipborne and AUV geophysical datasets.
Categorized shallow Holocene deformation into four distinct structural styles linked to megathrust dip, décollement depth, and accretionary mode.
Documented abundant meter- to sub-meter-scale geomorphic and stratigraphic evidence (e.g., bending-moment fault scarps, punctuated growth strata) for episodic coseismic slip reaching the trench.
整合船载与AUV地球物理数据集，精细测绘了卡斯卡迪亚580公里长的前缘逆冲断层带。
将浅表全新世变形划分为四种截然不同的构造样式，并建立了其与主断层倾角、滑脱面深度和增生模式的联系。
记录了大量米至亚米级的地貌与地层学证据（如弯矩断层崖、间断生长地层），证实存在直达海沟的幕式同震滑移。
me: Multi-scale marine geophysical integration combining crustal-scale 2D MCS, high-resolution sparker MCS, shipborne multibeam bathymetry, and AUV 1-m bathymetry and sub-bottom chirp profiling.
Structural and paleoseismic interpretation of geomorphic scarps (primary thrust scarps, bending-moment faults) and stratigraphic geometries (punctuated growth strata, discrete single-event offsets).
多尺度海洋地球物理综合解译，结合地壳尺度二维多道地震、高分辨率电火花多道地震、船载多波束测深以及AUV一米级测深与浅地层剖面。
基于地貌陡坎（主逆冲断层崖、弯矩断层）和地层几何形态（间断生长地层、单次事件离散位错）的构造与古地震学解译。
de: Shipborne high-resolution 2D sparker multichannel seismic reflection profiles and 30-m gridded multibeam bathymetry along central and southern Cascadia.
Crustal-scale depth-migrated 2D MCS profiles from the CASIE21 survey and legacy datasets.
Targeted AUV surveys (MBARI D. Allan B.) acquiring 1-m resolution multibeam bathymetry and 1–4 kHz chirp sub-bottom profiles up to ~40 m sub-seafloor.
沿卡斯卡迪亚中南部采集的船载高分辨率二维电火花多道地震反射剖面与30米网格多波束测深数据。
来自CASIE21航次及历史数据集的地壳尺度深度偏移二维多道地震剖面。
利用MBARI的AUV开展靶向调查，获取1米分辨率多波束测深及穿透深度约40米的1–4 kHz浅地层剖面数据。
li: Lack of direct age control (core chronology) on faulted horizons requires inferring the Holocene-Pleistocene boundary from seismic stratigraphy.
Pervasive mass wasting and shallow bottom-simulating reflectors (BSRs) obscure primary fault structure imaging in FTFZ Section 3 offshore Heceta Bank.
Stratigraphic and geomorphic records alone cannot definitively distinguish fast tsunamigenic coseismic rupture from slower coseismic slip or early postseismic afterslip.
断层错动层位缺乏直接年代学控制（岩芯定年），需依赖地震地层学特征推断全新世-更新世界面。
赫塞塔浅滩外海（第3段）广泛的块体搬运和浅层似海底反射层（BSR）掩盖了主断层构造的地震成像。
仅凭地层和地貌记录无法完全区分快速海啸地震破裂与慢速同震滑移或震后早期余滑。

tm.why: The paper maps shallow frontal thrust fault structures, fault-propagation folding, and bending-moment faults to distinguish coseismic slip to the trench from aseismic creep.
It links shallow near-surface deformation styles with crustal-scale megathrust geometry, décollement depth, and sediment accretionary versus underthrusting modes along the Cascadia subduction margin.
Characterizing the updip limit and mode of coseismic slip along the Cascadia frontal thrust fault zone directly informs regional megathrust earthquake and tsunami hazard assessments.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the provided 20-page PDF text (pages 1–17 and 27–30; pages 18–26 containing Figs. 11–12 and §§4.1.4–6 were omitted in the prompt extract, so anchors and figure analyses are strictly grounded in the visible pages).

sum: Whether subducted seamounts act as strong seismic asperities or weak barriers remains debated. Using 2D quasi-dynamic rate-and-state earthquake cycle simulations and fracture mechanics, this study investigates how seamount-induced normal stress heterogeneity—down-dip enhanced compression and up-dip reduced compression (a 'weak patch')—modulates megathrust slip. In shallow megathrust models, three regimes emerge depending on stress contrast: no seamount effect, runaway earthquake nucleation in the weak patch, and alternating full and confined ruptures accompanied by slow transients. Fracture mechanics confirms that partial ruptures occur when outward-increasing fracture toughness arrests propagation above a scale-dependent stress contrast threshold. On a full megathrust, spontaneous seamount nucleation is rare because low normal stress expands the nucleation length and stabilizes slip, allowing deep ruptures to break through first; however, deep partial ruptures frequently trigger seamount earthquakes and slow slip. This unified physical framework reconciles diverse natural observations of seamount slip behavior.
俯冲海山在地震周期中究竟表现为强凹凸体还是弱屏障一直存在争议。本研究结合二维准动态速率-状态摩擦地震周期数值模拟与断裂力学理论，探讨海山引起的正应力非均匀性（下倾侧挤压增强与上倾侧“弱斑”减压）对断层滑移的控制作用。浅部俯冲带模拟揭示了三种机制：无明显影响、弱斑触发贯穿型破裂、以及伴随慢滑移的局部与……

t: 2D quasi-dynamic boundary element earthquake cycle simulations (FDRA) with aging-law rate-and-state friction on a 30-degree dipping fault with a Gaussian seamount, paired with analytical linear elastic fracture mechanics criteria.
采用FDRA开展含高斯海山的30度倾角断层二维准动态速率-状态摩擦地震周期模拟，并结合线性弹性断裂力学解析判据。
Parametric 2D synthetic setups for a shallow megathrust (46 km length, w=14 km seamount) and full megathrust (100 km length, w=32 km seamount), varying normal stress contrast (0.1–0.98) and Dc.
构建浅部（长46 km，海山宽14 km）与全俯冲带（长100 km，宽32 km）二维参数化模型，改变应力对比度（0.…

Shallow models show three regimes transitioning to seamount nucleation at Δσ/σ0 ≈ 0.2–0.4 and alternating partial/full ruptures at Δσ/σ0 ≈ 0.83–0.95; full megathrust models show creep and triggered events but rare spontaneous nucleation.
浅部模型在Δσ/σ0≈0.2–0.4转为海山成核，0.83–0.95出现局部与完全破裂交替；全俯冲带模型以蠕滑和触发破裂…
The 2D modeling setup ignores 3D rupture wrapping around isolated seamounts, and imposes a time-invariant normal stress profile that neglects stress evolution with slip.
二维模型忽略了三维破裂绕过海山的效应，且采用静态正应力分布，未考虑正应力随滑移的动态演化。

Demonstrates that the up-dip low-stress wake ('weak patch'), rather than the high-stress leading flank, governs seamount slip behavior, unifying fast, slow, and confined ruptures via fracture mechanics.
阐明海山上倾减压尾迹区（弱斑）主导断层滑移行为，利用断裂力学统一解释了快慢滑移与局部破裂。

kc: Identified three distinct seismic cycle regimes around subducted seamounts controlled by the up-dip low normal stress 'weak patch' rather than the down-dip high-stress flank.
Derived and validated analytical fracture mechanics criteria for earthquake nucleation location and scale-dependent rupture arrest under heterogeneous normal stress.

Demonstrated that on a full megathrust, spontaneous seamount nucleation is rare due to expanded nucleation dimensions at low normal stress, though deep ruptures can trigger seamount events and slow transients.
识别出受控于俯冲海山上倾低正应力“弱斑”（而非下倾高应力区）的三种不同地震周期机制。
推导并验证了非均匀正应力下控制地震成核位置及尺度依赖破裂止裂的解析断裂力学判据。
证明在全俯冲带模型中，低正应力导致的成核尺度扩大使海山自发成核罕见，但深部破裂可触发海山地震与慢滑移瞬变。
me: 2D quasi-dynamic boundary element earthquake cycle modeling using Fault Dynamics with a Radiation-Damping Approximation (FDRA) and aging-law rate-and-state friction.
Analytical fracture mechanics energy-balance analysis comparing crack-tip stress intensity factor (K) and spatially varying fracture toughness (Kc).
Parametric exploration of seamount geometry, location, background normal stress, normal stress contrast, and slip-weakening distance, including asymmetric compression tests.
采用带辐射阻尼近似的断层动力学代码（FDRA）与老化律速率-状态摩擦本构进行二维准动态边界元地震周期模拟。
开展解析断裂力学能量平衡分析，对比裂纹尖端应力强度因子（K）与空间变化的断裂韧度（Kc）。
对海山几何形态、位置、背景正应力、正应力对比度、特征滑移距离及非对称挤压效应进行参数空间探索。
de: Shallow megathrust 2D numerical experiments (down to 23 km depth, 14 km wide and 2 km high Gaussian seamount) across varying normal stress contrasts (0.1 to 0.95) and background stresses (10–15 MPa).

Full megathrust 2D numerical experiments (down to 50 km depth, 100 km fault length, 32 km wide and 4 km high seamount) across slip-weakening distances (2e-5 to 2e-1 m) and stress contrasts (0.3 to 0.98).
浅部俯冲带二维数值实验（深至23 km，宽14 km、高2 km的高斯型海山），测试不同正应力对比度（0.1–0.95）和背景应力（10–15 MPa）。
全俯冲带二维数值实验（深至50 km，断层长100 km，宽32 km、高4 km海山），测试不同特征滑移距离（2e-5至2e-1 m）与应力对比度（0.3–0.98）。
li: The 2D plane-strain model cannot capture 3D rupture wrapping around isolated seamounts, potentially overestimating the barrier effect for wide ruptures.
Normal stress perturbations are held constant in time, neglecting temporal stress evolution with accruing slip, off-fault plasticity, and dynamic pore fluid pressure changes.
Uniform rate-and-state frictional parameters are assumed, where fracture energy is independent of total slip.
二维平面应变模型无法捕捉三维破裂绕过孤立海山的过程，可能高估了海山对大尺度破裂的阻挡能力。
正应力扰动设为不随时间演化，忽略了随滑移累积的应力变化、断层外塑性变形及动态孔隙流体压力演化。
假设断层具有均匀的速率-状态摩擦参数，且断裂能独立于滑移量。

tm.why: The paper models rate-and-state fault mechanics, interseismic creep, slow transients, and seismic cycle regimes induced by normal stress heterogeneity from subducted seamounts.
The authors analyze earthquake nucleation, propagation, and arrest (partial vs. full runaway ruptures) using quasi-dynamic boundary element simulations and fracture mechanics criteria.

sum: Multiparameter elastic full-waveform inversion (EFWI) suffers from strong nonlinearity, parameter crosstalk, and differing data sensitivities. This study develops a robust multiscale implicit neural representation (INR) framework for multiparameter EFWI (INR-EFWI) that jointly optimizes continuous neural model representations and physical elastic parameterizations. The network employs a shared encoder combining multiresolution hash encoding and SIREN layers, feeding into three independent parameter-specific decoder branches. Radiation-pattern analysis shows that parameterizing the medium with P-wave velocity (Vp), P-wave impedance (Ip), and Vs/Vp ratio significantly reduces sensitivity overlap compared to conventional (Vp, Vs, density) formulations. Evaluated on synthetic Marmousi and Overthrust models (including low-frequency-deficient and 1 dB noisy scenarios) and the Volve ocean-bottom-cable field dataset, INR-EFWI outperforms conventional automatic-differentiation grid-based EFWI by suppressing crosstalk artifacts, improving structural continuity, and achieving superior model and data-fitting metrics.
针对多参数弹性全波形反演（EFWI）中的强非线性和参数串扰问题，本文提出了一种多尺度隐式神经表示框架（INR-EFWI）。该方法结合多分辨率哈希编码与SIREN网络构建共享编码器，并通过三个独立解码器分支分别表征不同物理参数。辐射花样分析表明，采用（Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp）参数化相比传统（Vp,……

t: A multiscale INR architecture combining multiresolution hash encoding and SIREN in a shared encoder, connected to three independent parameter-specific decoder branches that output (Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp) into a differentiable elastic solver.
构建融合哈希编码与SIREN的共享编码器及三个独立解码分支，输出(Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp)至可微弹性求解器。
Evaluated on synthetic 2D Marmousi and Overthrust models using 5 Hz Ricker wavelets, including low-frequency-missing and 1 dB noisy tests, plus the 5-12 Hz 2C Volve OBC field dataset.
采用Marmousi和Overthrust合成模型（含缺低频和1 dB噪声测试）及Volve海底电缆双分量实测数据。
On Overthrust, INR-EFWI improves MSNR over AD-EFWI from 18.27 to 31.07 dB for Vp, 19.79 to 27.57 dB for Ip, and 19.78 to 39.28 dB for Vs/Vp, while reducing data residuals by an order of magnitude.
在Overthrust模型上，Vp、Ip和Vs/Vp的信噪比分别提升至31.07、27.57和39.28 dB，数据残差…
The (Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp) parameterization is not universally optimal; parameter recoverability remains dependent on acquisition aperture, scattering angles, wave modes, and geological structure.
(Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp)参数化并非普适最优，其可恢复性仍受观测孔径、散射角和地质构造制约。

Jointly designs a multi-branch multiscale implicit neural model representation and a decoupled (Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp) physical parameterization to simultaneously constrain model space and reduce elastic parameter crosstalk.
联合设计多分支多尺度隐式神经表征与(Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp)物理重参数化，协同抑制多参数串扰。

kc: Jointly designs a multiscale implicit neural representation (INR) and physical reparameterization for multiparameter elastic FWI.
Demonstrates via radiation-pattern cosine similarity that (Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp) significantly reduces parameter coupling compared to (Vp, Vs, density).
Develops a hybrid shared encoder (multiresolution hash encoding + SIREN) coupled with three independent parameter-specific decoders to prevent gradient interference.
Validates superiority over conventional grid-based AD-EFWI on Marmousi, Overthrust, and field Volve OBC data, including under noisy and low-frequency-missing conditions.
为多参数弹性全波形反演联合设计了多尺度隐式神经表示（INR）与物理重参数化方案。
通过辐射花样余弦相似度分析证明（Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp）相比（Vp, Vs, ρ）能显著降低参数耦合。
开发了结合多分辨率哈希编码与SIREN的混合共享编码器及三个独立参数解码器分支，以减少梯度干扰。
在Marmousi、Overthrust合成模型（含缺低频和强噪声情况）及Volve海底电缆实测数据上验证了该方法优于传统网格化AD-EFWI。
me: 2D isotropic elastic wave propagation in the velocity-stress formulation optimized via adjoint-state/automatic differentiation.
Radiation-pattern analysis and cosine similarity evaluation to select the optimal physical parameterization (Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp).
Multiscale INR architecture combining a 16-level multiresolution hash encoder and a 3-layer SIREN network as a shared spatial feature extractor.
Three independent GELU-based MLP decoder branches outputting Vp, Ip, and Vs/Vp updates, linked via differentiable transformation to the elastic forward solver.
采用速度-应力格式的二维各向同性弹性波方程，结合伴随状态法/自动微分进行波形反演优化。
利用辐射花样分析和余弦相似度评估优选出（Vp, Ip, Vs/Vp）物理参数化方案。
构建结合16层多分辨率哈希编码与3层SIREN网络的多尺度INR共享空间特征编码器。
设计三个独立的GELU激活多层感知机解码器分支分别输出Vp、Ip和Vs/Vp更新量，并通过可微变换连接弹性正演求解器。
de: Marmousi synthetic model (141 x 341 grid, 25 m spacing, 20 surface shots at 5 Hz, 200 receivers) starting from 1D linear initial models.
Overthrust synthetic model (100 x 401 grid, 25 m spacing, 20 shots, 200 receivers) tested over 300 iterations.

sum: Full Dispersion Spectrum Inversion (FDSI) images near-surface velocities without picking dispersion curves, but pixel-wise L2 misfits suffer from mode mismatch and local minima when starting models are poor. Standard implicit neural representations (MLPs) mitigate initialization sensitivity via low-frequency spectral bias, yet converge slowly on fine structures; conversely, static positional encoding (SPE) introduces high-frequency instability. This paper proposes Adaptive Neural Reparametrization Dispersion Spectrum Inversion (ANR-DSI), which reparametrizes the residual velocity field using a coordinate-based MLP equipped with an Adaptive Positional Encoding (APE) layer. Updated via automatic differentiation through the wave equation and Radon transform, APE dynamically adjusts sinusoidal frequency weights during optimization, naturally inducing a coarse-to-fine trajectory. Synthetic tests (including noisy checkerboards) and field applications on urban Stanford DAS-2 ambient-noise virtual gathers show that ANR-DSI eliminates dependence on accurate initial models, avoids high-frequency artefacts, and accelerates convergence by an order of magnitude with <0.5% memory overhead.

Evaluated on 2-D synthetic S-wave models (including a noisy checkerboard test) and 38 virtual active-source surface-wave gathers extracted via seismic interferometry from ambient traffic noise on a 1 km Stanford DAS-2 dark-fibre array.

Replaces static positional encoding priors with a physics-driven learnable APE layer whose harmonic weights adapt dynamically via backpropagated physical gradients, achieving automatic coarse-to-fine regularization without staged objective switching.

sum: This study investigates the 10 October 2026 Budhi Gandaki rock avalanche in Nepal using seismic data and numerical modeling. By performing single-force inversions on one regional and 28 teleseismic records, the authors identify four distinct force pulses spaced 23–26 seconds apart, alternating in direction. Combined with flow simulations, the results support a two-stage failure mechanism: an initial smaller failure followed 40–60 seconds later by the main body collapse, totaling 6–21 million cubic meters. The entire event reached the Shyar River within three minutes, demonstrating the power of combining seismic source inversion with runout modeling to reconstruct complex landslide dynamics.

sum: This study investigates how the interaction between ice-sheet dynamics and the visco-elastic response of the solid Earth affects the tipping dynamics of an Antarctic-type ice-sheet-shelf system. Using an ensemble of idealized simulations with a Lingle-Clark bed deformation model, the authors explore a wide range of solid-Earth structures and viscous response timescales. They find that the threshold for bifurcation-induced tipping (B-tipping) depends strongly on the solid-Earth structure. Crucially, they identify that rate-induced tipping (R-tipping) occurs in half of the ensemble members when basal melting rates increase rapidly, reducing the effective tipping threshold by up to 40% compared to B-tipping. Once triggered, the marine ice sheet instability cannot be stopped by bed uplift due to the rapid rate of grounding-line retreat.

sum: This study investigates whether ground-motion variability from small earthquakes can track the mechanical evolution of active faults in the southeastern Alps. Analyzing ~115,000 near-fault peak ground acceleration (PGA) recordings from 6,219 earthquakes (0.5 ≤ Mw ≤ 4.2; 2016–2025), the authors use a mixed-effects ground-motion model to isolate the between-event term (δBe). This term represents source-related variability and correlates positively with stress-drop residuals, reflecting rupture efficiency and relative fault strength. Mapping a normalized cumulative stress index reveals persistent east-west mechanical segmentation and multi-year trends, including a post-2022 increase in relative stress drop in the 1976 Friuli earthquake epicentral area. The findings demonstrate that ground-motion variability of small earthquakes serves as a model-independent proxy for tracking spatial and temporal changes in fault mechanics and stress loading.

sum: This book chapter introduces data assimilation as a framework for solving time-dependent inverse problems, combining observations with dynamic models to predict future states. Using the Lorenz system as an illustrative example, the author explains the foundational concepts of Kalman filtering, including the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) and Ensemble Kalman Filter (EnKF). The chapter then transitions to variational data assimilation, highlighting the use of adjoint methods to optimize initial state estimates. Finally, it covers particle filters as a flexible, non-linear approach to representing system states and uncertainties. It serves as an educational and theoretical guide to dynamic state estimation.

sum: This book chapter presents a rigorous derivation and conceptual exploration of the No-Free-Lunch (NFL) theorem within the context of inverse problems and mathematical optimization. The author, Andreas Fichtner, demonstrates that when averaged over all possible mathematical problems, no single optimization or inversion algorithm can outperform any other. This fundamental limitation implies that universal solvers do not exist. Consequently, the success of any practical algorithm relies heavily on incorporating problem-specific prior information or physical constraints. The chapter serves as a pedagogical foundation for understanding why tailoring algorithms to specific physical systems is essential in geophysics and inverse theory.

sum: This study pairs pedogenic carbonate δ18O/δ13C and volcanic glass δD from the Manantiales foreland basin (~32°S) with regional sedimentology to reconstruct the Miocene topographic and climatic evolution of the southern Central Andes. The authors identify a ~4.5‰ decrease in carbonate δ18O between 18.6 and 18.3 Ma, indicating rapid surface uplift as the basin transitioned to a wedge-top setting. Isotope-elevation modeling estimates 1,886 m (68% CI: 1,446–2,255 m) of syndepositional surface uplift. This uplift coincided with rapid crustal shortening and thickening, demonstrating coupled orogenic growth. Additionally, post-16.5 Ma isotopic shifts suggest increased monsoonal moisture or enhanced evaporation during the Miocene Climatic Optimum. The novelty lies in resolving the timing and magnitude of Andean uplift while accounting for shifting moisture sources and climate.

sum: This study analyzes deep mantle plume conduits using the nonlinear full-waveform inversion (FWI) models REVEAL and RevealLO. By tracing least-cost descending paths beneath 49 hotspots and 300 control locations, the authors find that connected slow columns reach the core-mantle boundary beneath 22–27% of hotspots. Plume conduits are more prominent and inclined (at 1000–1500 km depth) beneath the lower mantle viscosity increase (800–1200 km). Although hotspot endpoints are strongly associated with large low-velocity provinces (LLVPs), 33 out of 49 hotspots exhibit alternative low-cost paths ending hundreds of kilometers apart. This demonstrates that while modern FWI models successfully image plume-like conduits, they cannot always uniquely resolve the exact core-mantle boundary source region of individual plumes.

sum: This paper documents the rapid collaborative deployment of 96 temporary seismometers following the 5 April 2024 Mw 4.8 Tewksbury, New Jersey, earthquake. Led by universities and government agencies (including USGS, Rutgers, Yale, Columbia, and TexNet), the deployment targeted aftershock seismicity along the Ramapo, Flemington, and newly discovered Mountainville faults near the Newark basin. The temporary network significantly enhanced regional seismic coverage, enabling high-resolution aftershock monitoring. The paper details the installation logistics, presents data quality control metrics, outlines preliminary passive-source analyses, and highlights public outreach efforts. The resulting dataset is publicly archived at EarthScope Consortium's DMC, providing a valuable resource for studying intraplate seismicity and fault structures in the northeastern United States.

sum: This study documents a dike intrusion at the Dabbahu-Manda Hararo magmatic spreading center in Ethiopia on 16-17 July 2026, marking the end of a 16-year repose. Using NISAR and Sentinel-1 InSAR observations, initially flagged by Large Language Model (LLM) agents, alongside seismic data, the authors invert four radar viewing geometries. They find that a 0.18 km³ dike intruded along 17 km of the rift with a peak opening of 2.4 m. Over a decade of pre-intrusion uplift suggests continuous magma supply during the repose period. This highlights the critical role of long-term magma accumulation, alongside tectonic stress, in controlling the timing of rifting events.

li: The lack of large earthquakes (ML < 3.9) limits the resolution of seismic source characterization.
InSAR observations are temporally constrained by satellite pass times, limiting sub-hourly temporal resolution of the intrusion process.
缺乏大地震（ML < 3.9）限制了地震震源表征的分辨率。
InSAR观测受卫星过境时间的限制，限制了侵入过程在亚小时级的时间分辨率。

tm.why: The paper documents a dike intrusion and magma accumulation in the Dabbahu-Manda Hararo magmatic system.
The intrusion was initially identified in the NISAR interferogram archive by Large Language Model (LLM) agents.
